Transmission efficiency is improved by optimizing the hardware-driver and simplifying the API functions and reliable transmission is realized through the serial number and request-response mechanism. This protocol provides higher transmission efficiency under the precondition of transmission reliability comparing with TCP/IP protocol. Our experiments showed that the optimized protocol has greatly improved the network utilization than TCP/IP and achieved a reliable transfer speed up to 920Mbps.

articleTitle: Gas sensor array based on surface acoustic wave for chemical agent analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Three polymers were chosen for a surface acoustic wave (SAW) sensor array and a pattern recognition approach. Based on a data set collected from 10 candidate sensitive materials for 12 analytes, the selection was accomplished by principal component analysis (PCA) and cluster analysis(CA) methods. Then, the chosen polymers were deposited on three SAW devices combined into an array, and PCA was adapted to classify three gases with similar structures. The results showed that methanol, ethanol and isopropanol could be clearly distinguished by the SAW sensor array, indicating high selectivity of the sensor array.

articleTitle: Shadow removing based on color and texture features
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: An algorithm was proposed to remove the moving shadow in video surveillance. This method gets the moving objects from motion detection in first, in which removal shadow on invariable features of colors and local texture, then gets rid of the change suddenly pixels in edge of shadow. Experiments show that having a strong ability to adapt to different scenes, the algorithm retains the integrity of the foreground., by combining invariable color feature and local change value in pixels.

articleTitle: Consideration and review of the stochastic medium theory for predicting the settlement of the surface ground
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Through the development of the stochastic medium theory for predicting the settlement of the surface ground due to construction of underground engineerings, analyze deformation mechanism of soils is based on the stochastic medium theory. By establish the mathematical model of soil unit, providing the calculate formulas of predicting the settlement of the surface ground and method for determining the relevant parameters. According to assumptions of the calculation course based on the stochastic medium theory, put forward assumptions about applying stochastic medium theory for guiding design and construction of incline-rectifying engineering, offer proposal for expanding this theory to be used to construction of underground engineerings.

articleTitle: Integrated control of active front steering and semi-active suspension based on fuzzy logic method
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper, an integrated vehicle dynamic control system of AFS/SAS is proposed to improve vehicle handling and ride performance. The SMC methodology which is deduced form the linear 2DOF vehicle model is used to design the AFS subsystem controller. Fuzzy logic control strategy is presented to control the integrated system. The simulation results show that the integrated control system can obviously improve vehicle maneuverability and ride quality much more than the individual control.

articleTitle: The nonlinear behavior of engine damping system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The nonlinear behavior of engine damping system is analyzed in this paper. Stability of the system is firstly investigated and the hetrolinic orbit is obtained. Secondly, the critical value of chaos is gained by Melnikov method and the effects of parameters on nonlinearity are studied. Finally, the conclusion is validated that nonlinear damping coefficient is the main impact factor affecting chaotic threshold. Meanwhile, the possibility of chaos with the crankshaft radius increased is proved in this paper. The research on nonlinearity may supply theoretical bases for analysis and optimal design of engine damping systems.

articleTitle: Study on collapse mechanism at tunnel export and its prevention measure
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Collapse accident frequently occurs at tunnel export. In order to reveal the mechanism of this kind of tunnel collapse, three-dimensional elastic-plastic calculation model is established according to Maanshan mountain tunnel. Thick soft overburden, untimly support and rainwater infiltration are considered as the main influencing factors of the tunnel collapse. Its special geological condition is determinative factor and rainwater infiltration is inducing factor. The study shows that collapse at tunnel export is induced by tunnel face instability and loose rock and soil mass collapse at tunnel roof. This kind of tunnel collapse belongs to the failure model which is induced by the combined action of shearing and tension. The support behind excavating face can prevent plastic zone extending to ground surface. It is better that the distance from excavating face is shorter. So the primary support should be constructed timely and advanced support is necessary. The best length of advanced support is 5 m. At the end of this paper, the influence of rainfall to surrounding rock is analyzed through field monitoring data of surface settlement and surrounding rock pressure. It is presented that rainwater infiltration can accelerate the failure of surrounding rock and its influence effect mainly reflects on 1 to 2 days after rainfall. So waterproof and drainage measures should be done to prevent the collapse for rainy season construction.

articleTitle: A model of mathematical point set for urban transport system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper, some new concepts are presented. We propose a model of point set for urban transport, which can provide us the choices of one bus station to another bus station. This model may be helpful for solving the optimization problems of urban transport in some sense.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Realization of publicness and openness: Research on design of open city park's edge space
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Realization of DVB-C modulation system based on Spartan-6
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: A design plan of digital video broadcasting-cable is introduced in this dissertation. The design is based on Xilinx Spartan-6, which has high performance and low power expended, and AD9789, a DVB used chip designed by ADI. The architecture and function of AD9789 is introduced, including the whole design of the system and the realization of variable symbol rate.

articleTitle: Description of high-pressure compressed stratum form
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The thesis deals with all possible factors that influence high-pressure gravel packing from the angle of rock features of loose sandstone and construction technology. And then numerically simulate given naked eye wells and perforated wells by means of finite element analysis software. The simulations suggest that perforation along the direction of maximum principal stress helps occurrence of the cracks. Cracking mechanism of the loose sandstone in the course of high-pressure packing is also discussed on the basis of numerical simulation, with conclusion that bursting pressure of the compacted sand layer is the crack initiation pressure of high-pressure gravel packing, and its crack form directly influences that round the well.

articleTitle: Rock failure process research and analysis of fractal
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Using fractal theory to discuss the fractal structure and rock fractal behavior, describing some complex fractal mechanism and fractal forming process occurred in the rock damage problem, we can explain and describe the rock mechanics problem that cannot be solved in the past. Make a statistical description of complexity and solve all kinds of problems, letting these problems quantified, precise and predictable. Then by using the method of numerical experiments and combining graphic image processing, the track description and analysis of rupture form in different specifications of numerical specimen and detailed statistics on the fractal characteristics can make you find their own broken system has self-similarity.

articleTitle: Performance test of active mirror
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Two sets of measurement systems were designed to measure the tip-tilt angles and the frequency response of the active mirror. A CCD laser interferometer measurement system was designed to measure the tip-tilt angles. The mathematical model between the interferogram and the tip-tilt angle was deduced. After preprocessing the interferogram and thinning the fringes, the least square method was used to fit the fringes. Then, based on equal thickness interference principle, the tip-tilt angles of the active mirror were got. The result of angle movement range in X direction is 56.872", and the resolution is 0.113". The result of angle movement range in Y direction is 49.835", and the resolution is 0.112". A photodiode measurement system was designed to test the frequency response of the active mirror. Modulated by the active mirror with triangle waveform signal, a beam of He-Ne laser was focused on a photodiode, and was converted to electrical signal. The electrical signal and the triangle waveform signal were input to an oscilloscope together. Three different frequency's triangle waveform signals, such as 65Hz, 100Hz and 250Hz, were respectively used to test the frequency response of the active mirror. By comparing the input triangle waveform signal with the output electrical signal, the frequency response of the active mirror was got and it was more than 100Hz.

articleTitle: On the edge-balance index sets of the graph Cn × P10
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper, the edge-balance index sets of the graph C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</sub> × P<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</sub> (n ≥ 3) are researched, and graphical construction method of the corresponding graph is given.

articleTitle: Study on crankshaft runout straightening position and it's runout testing system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The measurement of parameters of the crankshaft runout was implemented online. Then the runout data was processed by adopting the least square method and vector model transformation. The experiment shows that the tested result agrees with the real crankshaft deformation. The classifier for the crankshaft straightening position using LS-SVM was set up. The set classifying system is applied to the crankshaft fillet rolling intensity and straightening machine tool, which results in a good general performance.

articleTitle: Dynamic collision detection algorithm and application
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of penetration and missing detection between particles with high speed in virtual system, a dynamic detection algorithm is presented which efficiency is advanced by the combination of multilevel detection and detection space division method in this paper. The algorithm has been applied in virtual sieving experiment system of discrete material and the results meet a good agreement with industrial experiment. It shows that dynamic collision detection algorithm can avoid the problems of penetration and missing detection between particles with high moving velocity and improve the precision of virtual sieving test. The algorithm is simple and with high efficiency which is suitable for simulation of complex virtual scene with large number of dynamic particles.

articleTitle: Vibration control of ocean platform based on buckling-restrained braces
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The conventional brace appears buckling easily under the strong earthquake. and it can not meet the demand of the structure. The hysteretic behavior is stable and the energy absorption capacity is good. The buckling - restrained brace (BRB) can undergo fully reversed axial yield cycles without loss of stiffness and strength. Ocean platform structure is complicated, and the surrounding environment is harsh. It is significant to study the platform structure vibration control. BRB structure with isolation layer under earthquake and ice load simulation is studied based on ANSYS. The results show that the BRB can reduce the seismic responses of the ocean platform and significantly suppress the maximal acceleration by dissipating the vibration energy through inelastic deformation. The seismic performance is improved. Therefore BRB with simlpe bilinear resilisence is adoptadopted in structure wiih more reqirment to resist horizontal and seismic load. It has a good future.

articleTitle: The structural design of a large diametric double roller flatwork ironer
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper elaborates the working principles of the modern flatwork ironer. The integral structure of a large diametric double roller flatwork ironer is designed. We put forward a new idea of the heating roller, the internal structure of which is transformed from single layer into double layer. As a result, we can fulfill the purpose of saving steam and improving the utilization of thermal energy.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The design on combined mussel shelling machine
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Optimization research on aerodynamic figure of the box car under cross wind
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Under cross wind, the aerodynamic performance of box car is the worst one in all the universal vehicles used in the railroad. Based on 2D steady and incompressible Navier-Stokes equation and k-ε turbulent model, using P64 Box Car as the prototype to analyze and compare the aerodynamic performance of cars with different roof figure by finite volume method, when these cars were under the cross wind of the same velocity. The results show that the figure of car roof greatly affects the aerodynamic performance of box car. The aerodynamic performance of arc-shaped roof cars is much better than that of prototype car with triangular roof, and the overturning moment is least when the roof arc radius is between 1600mm and 1800mm. Meanwhile, the angle of car roof effect the aerodynamic performance greatly too, and the overturning moment is least when the roof angle a changing from 140° to 144°.

articleTitle: Application of numeric simulation of flow field based on fluent in design of Anti-fire colloid preparation machine
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The miner Anti-fire colloid preparation machine was designed referred to the principle of mixer designing in the chemical industry. The computational fluid dynamics (CFD) program FLUENT was used to simulate the inner flow of the colloid preparation machine which was filled with special fly ash slurry by the MRF method. Results of simulation showed the space of double-leaf arrangement had a significant effect on the mixing result for the double leaf blade high and low overlapping arrangement's mixer and processed the optimal space. The affection of baffle width to the mixing effect was also analyzed and acquired some valuable conclusions. The machine was manufactured based the research and the application verified the simulation's significance.

articleTitle: Perspective on building skins integrated with photovoltaics
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: It is discussed the integrated design for building skins with photovoltaics, which combine solar photovoltaic electricity technologies with those of building construction. With the case study of the building 42 of ECN and Greenpix-zero energy media wall of Xicui, it is proposed the architectural aesthetics and ecological energy efficiency with the skillful incorporation of two of them. Finally, the issues of energy, environment and cost concerned with BIPV are also investigated.

articleTitle: Dynamic finite element analysis of ground response using a simplified and complex soil model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This In this paper, the author conducts a three-dimensional nonlinear dynamic analysis to simulate dynamic centrifuge model tests of loose and dense soils using two different soil models that is modified Drager-Prager model and kinematic subloading tij sand model. Modified Drager-Prager model is a simple soil model that requires only 5 parameters, which can be obtained from SPT-N value, and on the other hand, the tij model is a more complex model that requires 9 parameters, which needs to be determined in the laboratory. The dynamic behavior of grounds in the model tests are consisted of Toyoura standard sand with density 1.58 g/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> and 1.43 g/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> are numerically simulated and compared with the physical models. The results show that both numerical models overestimate the peak value of the response acceleration over the physical model. The response acceleration obtained by this simplified model shows a good agreement with the one by tij model before the peak wave. The differences of the results between two numerical models become obvious after the peak wave. And the simplified model can be applied for estimating maximum seismic responses for engineering purpose. The soil behavior, however, needs to examined by a more complex model.

articleTitle: Vector control system of mine hoist based on dsPIC
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The electric driving speed regulation strategy is studied based on vector control of asynchronous motor by the mine hoist working characteristic. The vector control principle and the mathematic model of asynchronous motor are analysed. The dsPIC30F6010 is used as controlling center and the variable frequency speed regulation system of vector control is designed. The vector control technology of asynchronous motor is verified by test. The result demonstrated that the vector control system have higher steady precision, shorter dynamic regulation time, smaller overshoot and its anti-jamming ability is better. The timing performance can be compared beauty with DC completely. And the improved requirement of working reliability, higher controlling precision and energy saving high frequency of mine hoist controlling system can be satisfied.

articleTitle: Research on seasonal changes of several chemical compositions in overground organs of Tilia amurensis
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The polysaccharides, soluble sugar, flavonol glycosides and total phenol content in Tilia amurensis flowers, leaves, branch peel, bark, xylem were determined, and analyzed their seasonal changes. The results indicated that the changing uptrend of polysaccharides content was coincident with sugar, The polysaccharides of leaves, branch peel, bark and xylem showed increasing uptrend fluctuatedly. The changing uptrend of sugar content in each organ was coincident basically with polysaccharides content. The changes of flavone content in flowers didn't fluctuate, showing increasing uptrend completely. The flavone content in leaves showed decreasing uptrend, then increasing, the flovone content in branch peel, bark and xylem changed fluctuatedly from May to August, but showed decreasing uptrend from September. The total phenol content in leaves branch, bark and xylem changed flucruatedly in the growing days, but showed increasing uptrend after the growing days.

articleTitle: Study on preparation and conductivity of SiCp /Cu gradient composites
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: SiCp/Cu gradient composites were fabricated by powder metallurgy using the process of dual-directional extrusion of the floating die. The microstructure and conductivity of SiCp/Cu graded composites were studied by optical microscope and current conductivity instrument. The results show that the SiCp/Cu gradient composites are continuous, and the distribution of reinforced particles is gradient. The average density of SiCp/Cu gradient composites is enhanced 7.1% and conductivity is increased 7.8% by re-pressing and re-sintering processes. After the compression deformation, the microstructure becomes denser, and the maximum density reached to 96.1%. The conductivity of SiCp/Cu gradient composites decreased gradually from the Cu matrix to the surface.

articleTitle: Bispectrum and 1(1/2)dimensional spectrum analysis for vibration data of blower
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The bispectrum and 1(1/2)dimensional spectrum analysis is introduced, then this method is applied to the fault diagnosis of blower. Through the nonlinear phenomenon of quadratic phase coupling is detected by the bispectrum character, and 1(1/2) dimensional spectrum analysis can extract the fault characters of vibration data of blower. The drawback of the STFT analysis, restrictions of frequency resolution, is overcome by the method. Experimental results show that the proposed method is effective in the fault diagnosis of blower.

articleTitle: Photovoltaic generation grid-connected system based on DSP and FPGA control
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper proposes a photovoltaic generation grid-connected system with cascaded multi-level inverter, based on digital signal processor TMS320F2812 and field programmable gate array (FPGA). Carrier Phase Shifting Sinusoidal Pulse Width Modulation (CPS-SPWM) based on FPGA is applied to the system. The principles of Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT) and the implementation of CPS-SPWM are presented. The experiment results show the output waveforms with lower harmonics have the same frequency and phase with grid. The method is easily modularized and expanded in capacity. It is of a good prospect in photovoltaic generation grid-connected system.

articleTitle: Assembly configuration simulation analysis of symmetrical Stewart platform
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: According to the homotopy function, we obtain all eight kinds of assembly configuration of symmetrical Stewart platform with homotopy iterative method. For figure visually these assembly configurations, we set up four multi-rigid-body models with ADAMS, whose horizontal movable platforms locate over the fixed base. At last, a numerical example illustrates visually that two configurations or more of Stewart platform superpose possibly one another for a given set of motion input parameters. When the manipulator comes very close to the superposition point, the manipulator will uncontrol, which is called configuration bifurcation.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Existence problems of university library appraisal and improvement strategies
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Margin cost based optimization of performance and cost in safety related system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In the design of Safety Instrumented System (SIS), the cost of construction and maintenance of the system should be taken into account comprehensively under the circumstance that the safety level is guaranteed. The average possibility of failure on demand (PFD<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">avg</sub>) of SIS is the main criteria to assess its safety performance. The paper focuses on the safety performance and cost optimization of SIS. Based on discrete Markov model and the concept of “margin cost” in microeconomics, the concept of “margin cost based on PFDavg (MCPFD<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">avg</sub>)” is put forward. Moreover, the paper puts forward a method to deal with the safety performance and cost optimization of SIS simultaneously. Finally, an example is given to prove the feasibility of the method which can reduce total cost when the safety performance of SIS can also be ensured. It gives a new method to design SIS and helps people further realize the relationship of safety performance and cost.

Author Keywords: Average Possibility of Failure on Demand
Margin Cost Based on Average Possibility of Failure on Demand

articleTitle: Control of halogenated disinfection by-products precursors by different drinking water treatment process
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: To control the halogenated disinfection by-products (DBPs), this study analysed the the removal efficiency of DBPFP in pretreatment process, conventional process, advanced process and disinfection process of water supply treatment respectively. The results showed that ozone and potassium permanganate have certain removal efficiency for DBPFP, which could improve the coagulation at the same time, consequently strengthened the sequential removal efficiency of DBPFP by conventional process; Advanced treatment process have relatively higher removal efficiency of THMFP and HAA5FP, which will be further improved by the pretreatment. Compared with the conventional treatment process, the THMs and HAA5 produced by pre-O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>+convention+O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>-GAC reduced by more than 56% and 73% respectively. While they were 70% and 45% compared to the free chlorine disinfection technology.

articleTitle: Study on the diffusion of update and substitution for CATV in China based on Norton Model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Based on the analysis of Norton Model and its parameter estimation, this paper takes advantage of statistical data for the empirical analysis about diffusion trend of update and substitution for CATV in China. The findings show that compared with Bass Model, Norton Model which describes two generation products-analog TV and digital TV well with substitution curve has higher fitting degree and prediction accuracy. Now, in China, the digital television industry is rapidly developing that the number of users will reach 160 million in the year 2012, and then will exceed 200 million around the year 2015. Those conclusions have high reference value for our government and enterprises in industry chain of digital television to make decisions.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Operation and management research on Tianjin Airport Economic Park river course ecological restoration project
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Dynamic modification of a submarine's gearbox based on dynamic sensitivity analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The transmission system of submarine's gearbox is increasingly developing in the direction of high-speed, high-efficiency, heavy-load and light-weight, and the requirements of vibration are increasing as well. The gearbox designed according to static standard often has various problems of instability and vibration which greatly weaken the behaviors of gearbox and influence the invisibility performance of submarine seriously. To improve dynamic characteristics of gearbox, a method of modifying gearbox structure is posed by analyzing dynamic sensitivity of submarine's gearbox. And the effect caused by different design parameters of gearbox on modal frequency are studied and discussed. The method and conclusions can be used as a reference of dynamic modification of gearbox.

articleTitle: The analysis and simulation of the pipe collapse deformation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The processes of pipe collapse under external pressure have be calculated and simulated by means of the ANSYS FEA. It introduces the destruction theory of the pipe and some formula by API, and analyses the factors such as geometries, pressure, and its properties, which affect the capability of the resistance to the pipe collapse. The relationship between strain and stress of pipe has been descried. In addition, X-Component of displacement model provided by ANSYS FEA simulates and analyses the deformation of the pipe under the symmetrical pressure and display the whole simulation pictures in different stages of pipe collapse, which are not easy to been observed through the practical mechanical by testing.

articleTitle: Research on modeling and decoupling method of geometric errors for the linear axis of CNC machine tools
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper analyzes the 21 original geometric errors of machine tools and the resulting coupling effects, namely geometric composite errors, and then arrives at the conclusion that the key point of error compensation for CNC machine tools is error value, a function of command position. And it also points the errors can be decoupled into error components of each axis-direction. Therefore, according to the consistency of the geometric composite errors, the decoupling algorithm of the geometric composite errors is researched, and decoupled model is proposed which is not only simplifies the complexity of the geometric model, but is also easy to implement error compensation.

articleTitle: Reliability analysis of underground cavern using Gaussian process classification
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Aiming to the difficulties resulted by implicit performance function and the limitations of traditional methods for reliability analysis of underground cavern, a new method based on Gaussian process classification (GPC), which is a newly developed machine learning method, is proposed for structural reliability analysis of underground cavern. The implicit performance function of underground cavern is reconstructed by GPC model based on small amount of training datasets which are built by finite element numerical simulation. Thus, the implicit performance function is approximated by GPC model with explicit formulation. Then, Monte Carlo Simulation method is applied to get the failure probability and reliability index of underground cavern using the approximated performance function by GPC. The study results show that the method can get accurate and computationally efficient results for reliability analysis of underground cavern.

articleTitle: Existence of almost periodic solution of a class of retarded impulsive differential equations
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper studies the dynamics of a class of retarded impulsive differential equations (IDE), which generalizes the delayed cellular neural networks (DCNN), delayed bidirectional associative memory (BAM) neural networks and some population growth models. We get the existence almost periodic solution of a class of retarded impulsive differential equations in this paper. When the impulsive jumps are absent, our results reduce to its corresponding results for the nonimpulsive systems. The approaches are based on Banach's fixed point theorem, matrix theory and its spectral theory.

articleTitle: A method to analyze the power flow of helical gears power dual-branching transmission
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: According to power split-path system of helical gears, mechanism structural model is brought up and the torque equilibrium condition and deformation compatibility condition also can be obtained. On that basis, the power flow of each gear pair is calculated, and the results of power flow in individual installation error are analyzed deeply. The research demonstrates that the errors make the load-sharing of system bad, and the second-stage error affects more than the first-stage error.

articleTitle: The effect of fire conditions on reliability of steel beam
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In order to study fire behaviors of steel member and the effect of fire conditions on its reliability, fire response of restrained steel beam was implemented by non-linear finite element method. The temperature distribution and deflection curve of beam acquired from numerical simulation are good correlative with ones of experiment. Based on this, the reliability model of steel beam was established using Monte-Carlo method. The effect of stochastic variables in natural fire model on the reliability was discussed by parametric method. The results show that the fire stochastic variables have different effects on sensitivity of beam reliability. The impact of maximum temperature T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">m</sub> is the most obvious, that of shape constant s<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">c</sub> is minimal. With increasing T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">m</sub> and s<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">c</sub>, or decreasing the time t<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">m</sub> at which T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">m</sub> occurs, and increasing the variance of stochastic variables, the reliability of steel beam will descend. When maximum temperature and shape constant were decreased and the time at which maximum temperature occurs was increased, the fire-resistant duration of the beam will be prolonged, which is benefit to improve the fire reliability. The model in this paper is provided a new method for quantitative analysis of stochastic fire reliability and reasonable fire-resistant design.

articleTitle: The energy efficiency tests of helical speed reducers
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The motor speed reducer is a widespread used motor dynamic system product. Its energy specification, system design match, application operation and maintenance and so on, serious influence energy efficiency. The low efficiency type increases consumes the electrical power. But the user does not understand clearly. Therefore the energy efficiency test of the motor reducer is an urgent topic. In order to promote the motor speed reducer energy efficiency, two type helical gear speed reducers are tested. The motor power are 0.5hp, 1hp, 2hp and 3hp respectively and reducer ratio are 10, 20 and 30, they are arranged in pairs. A brake method is established to measure the energy efficiency of motor speed reducer. Two different brands speed reducers are measured for 24 samples. The test results showed that A brand helical gear speed reducer at 100% load condition the most high energy efficiency are 85.24% for 2 Hp and 1:10 ratio, and 93.45% for 3 Hp and 1:20 ratio, 92.55% for 3Hp and 1:30. ° For B brand helical gear speed reducer at 100% load condition the most high energy efficiency are 87.35% for 3 Hp and 1:10 ratio, and 88.4% for 3 Hp and 1:20 ratio, 91.48% for 3Hp and 1:30.

articleTitle: The effect of temperature to emission characteristics of chips
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: According to the impedance characteristic curves of linear regulator chip which are measured in different temperatures, making use of chip model and the determination of LSI/IC equivalent model parameter, the resistance, capacitance and inductance parameters of chips in different temperatures are obtained. And the fitted impedance characteristic curves of chips by vector fitting are obtained. By the method of equivalent current loop, the current spectrum and electric field radiation spectrum of chips are obtained.

articleTitle: Problems and solutions of web search engines
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In order to study the retrieval precision of network information and solve the problems existed in search engines this paper analyzes problems and precision in the information retrieval according to experimental data such as image retrieval with different retrieval keywords, and puts forward a new construction of search engine with intelligentization. It comes to a conclusion that many methods can be used to improve the network retrieval precision effectually. And users need to meet with correct solution to keywords, construction and improvement of knowledge library, reasonable definition of features vectors, information matching and filtering, and increasing the intelligentization for spider, indexer and searcher.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Analysis model of steel-cement soil beam transverse mechanical parameters based on composite enhanced
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: In P2P network the resource search mechanism in regard to trust-reputation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: To the problem of hostile service brought by node anonymity in P2P system, this thesis proposes a reputation aware resource finding algorithm. This algorithm is based on routing indices (RIs) algorithm and adopts the conception of reputation to efficiently restrain the deceiving behavior of hostile nodes in P2P system and reduce the messages load in the system, which can ensure the reliability and safety of the services. Simulation results show that the resource search schemes presented in this thesis not only reduce the searching cost and decrease the latency to locate resources in P2P system effectively, but also provide content-based query and ensure the safety of the whole system.

articleTitle: Extraction approach of hypertext information based on regular expression
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Hypertext is the most popular file format on the Internet, which has simple formal standard, and has the feature of non-continuity. This paper studies how to extract information from hypertext by regular expression, gives results of how to extracting weather information from the weather forecasting pages of sohu, sina and tencent. This paper gives the feasible extraction approach of hyper text, which is very useful in Chinese Information Processing and the research-base of the research engine.

articleTitle: Experiment and analysis on temperature distribution of prestressed concrete beams and slabs
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Experiments on fire resistances performance of 14 unbonded and 1 bonded prestressed concrete simple slabs, 9 two-span unbonded prestressed concrete continuous slabs and 9 two-span bonded prestressed concrete continuous beams are completed. Temperature distribution was tested by 117 thermocouples distributed in concrete and surface of reinforcements. Time-temperature curve of 117 test points were calculated by ANSYS software, calculation value and test value are in good agreement. On the basis of test results, convective heat transfer coefficient, equivalent emissivity coefficient of heat radiation, thermal conductivity parameter of concrete and specific heat were determined through calculation. All these provide basic material for research on fire performance of prestressed concrete beams and slabs subjected to fire.

articleTitle: A method for speed limit sign detection in color images
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Speed limit signs play a vital role in traffic control, as an important means of controlling the vehicle speed. Therefore, achieving the correct recognition of speed limit sign is particularly critical in the road traffic sign recognition system research. In order to probe into accuracy problems and speed problems of the urban road speed limit detection, on the basis of color-geometric features of the road traffic sign, this paper proposes the method of circular extraction using inside-out scanning and number detection based on improved the connected regional characteristics parameters extraction, and gives the related detection algorithm. Experimental results show that this method can accurately and relatively quickly detect the speed limit signs from 44 kinds of prohibition signs. The method further improves the success rate of detection of speed limit signs, and has good feasibility and real-time.

articleTitle: Research progress and prospect of distribution layer in defense works
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Aimed at the design of distribution layer in defense works, the advances in distribution research were summarized and analyzed. Perfect distribution layer should be economical, practicable, reliable and have enough static/dynamic strength, which should weaken the stress waves and absorb the energy deriving from explosion to the greatest extent under the repeated impact loadings. And the development tendency was discussed. The results show: the main materials in distribution layer are still concrete or soil in the present stage and next period of time, and the perfect structure should be the combination of layered structure and cavities-contained structure. All those can be referenced for the design of advanced distribution layer in defense works.

articleTitle: Research on way-use performance for powder soil as road subbase course
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Through studying the method of special powder soil was made of highway subbase, a kind of suitable steady type on mechanics and way-use performance was found, joined materials had mainly cement and pulverized coal ash and lime in the experiment, from joined alone these materials to mix jointly to find the optimal fit material, finally, through contrast tentative data to verify separately mixture qualitative way-use performance, useful reference data was provided for vast users in future.

articleTitle: Study on separation of the vibration response of diesel vibration inner forces based on the blind signal separation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: An approach based on blind extract and deflation is applied in blind separation of the vibration response of dynamic forces of diesel at different locations in order to improve the accurate of the statues monitoring of diesel. The scale factors indeterminacy of blind signal separation is solved by this approach in a in a relative sense. This method is discussed in this paper, and the results of simulation proved it effective. In the end, the Piston Slap of diesel is extracted from the vibration signals of diesel. The results show that the response of the Piston Slap was separated successfully by the discussed method.

articleTitle: Design of wireless monitoring system of auxiliary shaft hoist ropes tension
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper develops a monitoring system of multi-rope hoist ropes tension in Auxiliary Shaft. It also improves the technique to weight the load for cage when the hoist elevates goods. It is that the difference between ropes tension before loading and ropes tension after loading is got as the load for cages to eliminate the inference of sensor's hysteresis and zero drift. The system can diagnose failures such as over-loading, counterweight lacking, jam and make an alert.

articleTitle: Evaluation on influence factor of mechanism usability based on analytical prey incidence process
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Action needs, cognitive needs and learning needs, which reflected mechanism usability, were selected as characteristic variables of system. Universality, stability and full-function were selected as factor variables. Absolute degree of incidence matrixes for system characteristic variables and factor variables were established. Influences of property parameters on mechanism usability were determined according to the superior analytical principle. Example suggests that analytical prey incidence process can be a reasonable and available method to determine the influence degree of property parameters on mechanism usability.

articleTitle: Preparation and properties of gradient structure concrete member
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Based on the dense packing powder theory, the refining and self-healing principles, and hydrophobic treatment, the special surface-layer materials and design are proposed in gradient structure concrete (GSC) member. According to service behavior, the GSC member is divided into serial structure and parallel structure. And it is fabricated corresponding to structural parameters by stacked press process, or pulled clapboard method, or suspended nets method. Use of small and full scale specimens for testing, the results are shown that: 1) the surface-layer strength of the GSC component improved by 30%, compared to that of a conventional single-layer component; 2) the width of the crack ranges from 0 to 0.1mm in the GSC component, whereas a conventional single-layer component are distributed with visible cracks(0.2-0.5mm); 3) The permeating depth and chloride diffusion coefficient of the GSC component is respectively 0mm and 6.3×10-13 m2/s, whereas a conventional single-layer component is 15mm and 12.8×10-13 m2/s.

articleTitle: Fault diagnosis for rotor system based on AR-PCA and BP neural network
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper introduces a method for the fault diagnosis of a rotor system. For a vibration signal of a rotor system fault, an AR model is established first, and then the related parameter and amplitude spectrum of this mode can be obtained, etc. The experiments show the above-mentioned method can effectively diagnose the fault of a rotor system.

articleTitle: Stochastic service models of multi-service in OFDMA system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: To research the call admission control in mobile communication system, a suitable stochastic service model is essential. The self-adaptive technology and the existence of multi-service in OFDMA system make the demand for stochastic service model stricter. This paper builds and analyzes the Petri net models of call admission control in multi-service OFDMA system. And then through analysis of corresponding Markov models and mathematical calculation, the validity of the Petri Net models is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Analysis of discharge matching methods for high lift conveyance cascade pumping station
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Discharge matching of high lift conveyance cascade pumping station has great influence on safe and economic operation of the project. The main influencing factors of cascade pumping station discharge matching are water quality, performance changing of pumps during their operation, pump characteristic differences and system characteristic curve, etc. The discharge matching methods of cascade water lifting project are distributing flow regulation, throttle regulation, variable speed regulation and pump startup or shutdown regulation, etc. If the cascade water lifting project has enough regulation volume or distribution flow between pumping stations, startup or shutdown regulation can be considered. For the project that has no such conditions, variable speed regulation should be used.

articleTitle: Experimental study on rheological characteristics of granular pseudo-fluid
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The rheological characteristics of granular pseudo-fluid are studied using conventional method from continuous-flow theory. Quartz sand particle systems in different sizes, spherical glass particles and alumina particles are focused in this work for their low-velocity shearing movements in a small gap between two concentric rotating cylinders. The accurate rheological equations of those granular systems were obtained and it was found that the shear stress all decreases with the increasing shear rate, it is a totally different trend comparing with normal fluid. Detailed analyzing was carried out on the effects of particle size, shape and surface property on this very special rheological phenomenon. It can be concluded that those physical characteristics of particle and the bearing capacity of tangential force on the particle contact surface are key factors to the distribution and strength of the force chains in the granular systems, and the appearance of force chains is the fundamental reason to the specificity of those granular pseudo-fluid.

articleTitle: Energy harvesting characteristics of a cantilever piezoelectric transducer
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Piezoelectric power generators employing piezoelectric materials to scavenge ambient vibration energy and provide micro electric energy for MEMS. In this paper, a model based on current equivalent circuit method to analyze electric generation characteristics of a cantilever piezoelectric power generator from low-frequency vibrations is put forward and used to discuss a prototype with experimental data. Effects of cantilever geometry and block mass on resonant frequency, output voltage and output power are given and compared with mechanics analysis model.

articleTitle: The application of biomass energy and some existing problems
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: People begin to pay close attention to energy problems. We should make full use of renewable energy. And making it to replace the traditional energy becomes a key problem. This paper discussed the renewable energy of biomass application and some existing problems.

articleTitle: Digital assembly system design for printing press
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Through analyzing deficiencies of the traditional assembly process design, and applying Design For Assembly (DFA) and digital assembly technology, the functional structure of a three-dimensional assembly system is proposed and studied. Based on the secondary development technology of SolidWorks, the virtual assembly system for a typical printing press is designed. Applications of key technologies are explored, which include the capture and presentation of assembly modeling information, interactive assembly planning and simulation in a three-dimensional environment and on-site demo and training. The applications of the developed assembly system demonstrate that the secondary development based on SolidWorks can reduce both the development time and cost drastically, and the developed system offers guidance on both the assembly process design and the actual assembly.

articleTitle: Monitoring and control of gas flow rate in a pyrocarbon coating furnace for heart valves
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: A system employed to monitor and control gas flow rate in a pyrocarbon coating furnace for mechanical heart valve prostheses using D07-19B-type mass flow controller, USB2831-type data acquisition card and computer is developed. The mass flow controller primarily regulates the gas flow rate. The value of the gas flow rate is measured in real-time by the data acquisition card and computer. A program of the data acquisition card and computer is written by MFC of Visual C++ 6.0. The test results indicate that the system can achieve the purposes of real-time acquisition, display, storage and setting the gas flow rate. Thus, the development of the system provides data support for improving the quality of mechanical heart valve prostheses.

Author Keywords: gas flow rate monitoring and controlling

articleTitle: A new class of asymptotically valid confidence regions confidence regions
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Weerahandi introduced the concept of generalized confidence intervals, which are to develop interval estimation. But it is difficult to use this method for constructing generalized confidence regions of vector parameters. In this paper we give a new method based on generalized bootstrap variable to construct asymptotically correct confidence regions of vector parameters.

articleTitle: Effects of support on the properties of light fuel hydrodesulfurization catalyst
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This research reviews the effects of the single component, the mixed oxides and the mesoporous materials on catalyst. Titanium dioxide and zirconium dioxide as single component support show higher activity than alumina in hydrodesulfurization, but their specific surface area need be increased further. Compared with the single component, the mixed oxides with higher specific surface area and strength can improve hydrodesulphurization activity. It is pointed out that mesoporous materials with higher specific surface area, larger pore diameter, narrower pore size distribution and longer-range ordered pore, are advantaged to other supports in hydrodesulphurization of the large molecule substance such as aromatic sulfides.

articleTitle: Measurement accuracy study of operating wavelength and angle error of optical axis of MOCT
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The influence caused by the operating wavelength of light source and intersecting angle error of optical axis on measurement accuracy of magnetic optical current transformer (MOCT) are theoretically analyzed and simulated. The investigation results show that the Verdet constant will change because of the fluctuation of the operating wavelength of light source. And angle error of optical axis will lead to direct current and attenuation, which affect measurement accuracy of MOCT. Based on national standard of ECT, the scopes of the operating wavelength of light source and angle error of optical axis are obtained. The results might be useful for researchers and designers working in the MOCT field.

Author Keywords: intersecting angle error of optical axis

articleTitle: Analysis of influence of model parameters on applications of Duncan-Chang nonlinear elastic model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The Duncan-Chang model is a nonlinear elastic constitutive model that is most widely used in geotechnical engineering. In this paper, we used examples to demonstrate that the value assignment and match of relevant parameters in a constitutive model greatly influence the applications and engineering calculation of the model.

articleTitle: Epoxidation of β-pinene to 2,10-epoxypinane by Oxone
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper describes a highly effective catalytic method for epoxidation of β-pinene to 2,10-epoxypinane using potassium peroxomonosulfate (Oxone) as oxidant and acetone as catalyst. Structure of 2,10-epoxypinane was characterized by data of infrared spectrum, GC-MS spectrum and 1H NMR spectrum. The procedure consists simply in stirring the substrate, NaHCO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> and acetone, at 0°C, with dropwise addition of an aqueous solution of Oxone. Optimization of the conditions identified (1) the mole ratio of Oxone to β-pinene 0.8:1, (2) reaction temperature 40°C, (3) pH 7.0-7.5, and (4) reaction time 2.5h. The yield of 2,10-epoxypinane can reach 85.4% and the system exhibits good chemical selectivity and few byproducts.

articleTitle: Research on the intelligent identification method of wallpaper labeling in the interior decoration
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In order to realize the intelligent identification of wallpaper labeling by using computer vision method, an analysis method of wallpaper labeling texture is proposed based on gray level-gradient co-occurrence matrix (GLCM). First, it determines the key parameters of matrix, makes up suitable GLCM, which the feature parameters is extracted; next, it completes the feature selection of the fourteen parameters in order to reduce the computation and improve the describing ability; last, it designs the probabilistic neural network classifier to accomplish classify experiments, whose overall recognition rate can reach 89.6%, which suggests the method is effective and basically feasible.

articleTitle: Cost-effectiveness analysis of ICT project in university based on DEA model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper, we studied the ICT application in university and the importance of cost-effectiveness analysis of ICT Projects. It attempted to summarize a suit of indexes for cost-effectiveness analysis and then studied the input-output data of a university's ICT projects by C<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>R model and cross-efficiency model in DEA. The results showed the main problems in ICT constructions of that school and the efficiency of them also. At last the paper pointed out this method could be used not only in landscape orientation analysis, but also in longitudinal direction analysis.

articleTitle: Identification of material parameters of door trim panel based on sled test
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Accurate material parameters of the door trim panel is a prerequisite to obtain accurate occupant collision responses in full-scale side crash simulation,. However, these parameters are usually difficult to be obtained directly. A side impact sled with the real door and B pillar was developed in this paper. The injury parameters of the side impact dummy (ES-2) were obtained from sled tests. The finite element model of the sled test was developed, Ls-dyna software was applied to simulate the crash. The material parameters of the door trim panel in the simulation model were changed to compare the injury parameters of the test results and simulation results. The parameters which made the dummy injuries of the simulation approach the test results most can be used in full-scale side impact simulation.

articleTitle: Design and analysis of stablizer of one-kilometer directional drilling rig for gas drainage
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: One-kilometer directional drilling rig is a head-type hydraulic rig, which can drill horizontal deep holes in coalseam with down-hole motor for gas drainage. To avoid the hole axis floating and the rig overturning, a stabilizer is designed for high stable ability in this paper. Stabilizer is subsequently modeled and simulated in four typical conditions where the drilling rod rotates. The result shows that the new stabilizer has larger rigidity and is safe.

articleTitle: Relationship of dark current and doping concentration for MCT photodiode detector design
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Hg1-xCdxTe (MCT) is the most important semiconductor alloy system for infrared (IR) detectors, and zero-bias resistance-area products (R<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub>A) is a crucial factor of MCT Photovoltaic detector's performance whose value is determined by the dark current of photovoltaic detector. In this paper, with Synopsys device simulation software, both current-voltage characteristic and R<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub>A products of n-on-p MCT Photovoltaic Detector had been simulated and analyzed with varying implantation dose. The simulated results indicated that dark current and R<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub>A products depended distinctly upon the doping concentration of photovoltaic detectors, and the optimal doping concentration was obtained for n-on-p MCT Photovoltaic Detector.

articleTitle: The influence of multimedia annotation on vocabulary learning in call of context
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Multimedia-computer assisted vocabulary acquisition has received attention over the past few years, in which the impact of multimedia annotations through different modalities has aroused people's interests. Therefore, it is of great importance to effectively acquire vocabulary incidentally in the cognitive process of reading or listening. This article designs an experiment, comparing the influence of four modes of annotation on reading comprehension. The result indicates that courseware designers should pay more attention to optimizing combination of multimedia annotation in accordance with appropriate modalities, thus, reading comprehension can be improved and vocabulary acquisition enhanced.

articleTitle: Research on new coding system for vibrating feeder design
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The slideway design is the key in designing the disc vibrating feeder, however, a reliable and theoretical guidance has not come into existence, which greatly restricted the appliance of CAD(Computer-aided design). Based on the similarity principle and exist code system, a new coding method applicable to slideway design is brought forward. More detailed information about the parts could be supplied by the new coding system, which makes the design more convenient, simple and accurate with the subjoin of the initial and targeted codes.

articleTitle: Study on the characteristics of single pass all optical wavelength converter based on cascaded second harmonic generation and difference frequency generation with double conversion configuration
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper, theoretical analysis and numerical simulation are expatiated distinctly according to the conversion principle and structure model of SP-cSHG+DFG-DC-AOWC (Single Pass All Optical Wavelength Converter Based on Cascaded Second Harmonic Generation and Difference Frequency Generation with Double Conversion Configuration) relative to SP-cSHG+DFG-DC-AOWC (Single Pass All Optical Wavelength Converter Based on Cascaded Second Harmonic Generation and Difference Frequency Generation with Single Conversion Configuration). For SP-cSHG+DFG-DC-AOWC compared with SP-cSHG+DFG-SC-AOWC, the formula about total conversion efficiency (and total normalized conversion efficiency) is demonstrated detailedly, the characteristics and advantages in waveguide length and wave power are discussed deeply, and the methods and measures to get relatively higher conversion efficiency are given concretely.

articleTitle: Study on single pass all optical wavelength converter based on cascaded second order nonlinearity with double conversion configuration
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper, the comparison of theoretical analysis and numerical simulation in conversion efficiency, bandwidth, frequency difference and multichannel propagation are expatiated distinctly according to the conversion principle and structure model of SP-cSHG+DFG-DC-AOWC (Single Pass All Optical Wavelength Converter Based on Cascaded Second Harmonic Generation and Difference Frequency Generation with Double Conversion Configuration) and SP-cSFG+DFG-DC-AOWC (Single Pass All Optical Wavelength Converter Based on Cascaded Sum Frequency Generation and Difference Frequency Generation with Double Conversion Configuration). Furthermore, it is pointed out that the structure model of SP-cSFG+DFG-DC-AOWC will be an ideal one due to its characteristics and advantages in conversion efficiency, bandwidth, frequency difference and multichannel propagation.

articleTitle: Researches on the gradual development strategy of the green civil building
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Green civil building development is an efficient way to cope with the resources shortage and environmental pollution in housing industry. According to the analysis of the characteristic of green civil building, there are four strategies should be applied which include the policy gradualism, the technical gradualism, the environmental adaptability gradualism and the environmental conscious gradualism. The gradual development strategy of the green civil building should be divided into three stages and each stage has distinct goal. With the comprehensive consideration of the internal demands and external stress at different stage, the conclusion has been drawn that the “S”-type greening asymptotic curve development model is scientific which can meet the demands of multi-objective optimal.

articleTitle: Unsteady flow and the mixing efficiency in transverse jets
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: A numerical method is used to compute the unsteady transverse jets flow and study the air-fuel mixing characteristics in the unsteady flowfield. The unsteady compressible Navier-Stokes equations are solved using a high-order AUSM+ method with dual-time-step implicit time scheme. It is found that the transverse jets flowfield is very unsteady and the unsteadiness is caused by the primary vortices emanating from the jet nozzle. Detained analysis of the instantaneous flow and mass fractions of species are performed, showing that the location of primary vortices significantly affects the mixing efficiency, and the mass fractions of species and mixing efficiency show unsteady and oscillatory with time.

articleTitle: MKMS: Multicast key management scheme for Proxy Mobile IPv6 networks
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Proxy Mobile IPv6 (PMIPv6) is a network-based mobility management protocol to support mobile nodes (MNs) for IP with mobility, without requiring the participation of MNs in any mobility-related signaling. Recently, multicast issues in PMIPv6 networks have generated a great deal of interest among researchers, and several multicast schemes had been proposed. However, these schemes do not take security issues into account. In an attempt to fill that research gap, we propose a dual multicast key management scheme for secure group communications in PMIPv6-based multicast networks. This scheme satisfies the requirements for forward and backward secrecy. Moreover, the performance analysis demonstrates that the proposed scheme incurs low communication cost.

articleTitle: Bearing capacity performance research on cold-formed thin-walled steel-OSB composite floor
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Cold-formed thin-walled steel was used as bearing capacity structures of multi-story and low story dwellings, in which oriented strand board(OSB) was used as wall board and floor board. The composite floor is made of cold-formed thin-walled steel multi-ribbed beam and OSB. It's bearing capacity performance is closely related to shearing strength, spacing, and tightness of self-threading screw. In this paper, elastic analysis on interaction of cold-formed thin-walled “C” steel beam and OSB was carried out, and the bearing capacity calculated formulas of composite floor was obtained, considering the influence of sliding between steel beam and OSB. And the reduction coefficient of floor flexural rigidity related to screw was determined also.

articleTitle: White LED power supply based on Buck converter with active ripple compensation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Considering that the lifespan of electrolytic capacitors in power supply don't match that of LED, we propose a Buck converter which uses active ripple compensation circuit to replace the traditional electrolytic capacitor filter. When the converter works on long duty ratio, the power loss in compensation circuit is small and ripple current and voltage are low. The operation principle of this new topology with peak current mode control (PCM) is discussed. The transfer function of PCM with slope compensation is established. The current loop stability with different slope compensation is discussed through frequency response analysis. Finally, simulation and experiment results of the power supply for LED verified correctness of the theory.

articleTitle: A synchronization controller for the unified chaotic system and its application in secure communication
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: To synchronize the unified chaos systems, a high speed chaos synchronization controller is presented and proved, and based on it a secure communication system is developed. The model of the unified chaos system is introduced firstly, then the tridiagonal structure matrix stability theory is introduced, and the proposed chaos controller' effectiveness is proved based on this stability theory. Then a secure communication system based on unified chaos system is proposed. The proposed controller in this paper has a high synchronization speed and the unified chaos-based secure communication system has a reference meaning for engineering practice. Simulation results validate the presented unified chaos-based secure communication method.

articleTitle: Almost sure stability of stochastic recurrent neural networks with unbounded distributed delays
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper deals with a class of stochastic recurrent neural networks with unbounded distributed delays. By using the LaSalle invariant principle of stochastic differential delay equations, the Ito's formula and a linear matrix inequality approach, a new set of sufficient conditions to ensure the almost sure stability of the considered system. Moreover, an example is provided to illustrate the effectiveness of the obtained result.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of FLD based on leaner strain path for fracture on auto panel surface
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In order to emerge the traditional measurement's shortage of auto body panel, we proposed the corrected FLD based on the linear path method and calculation methods. According to the above mentioned programs and the fracture defect diagnosis, we developed a CAE module for the fracture defect analysis based on VC++ environment, and solved the problems which the traditional sheet metal forming CAE software can not accurately predict. And then a forming process of a hood is simulated by applying the proposed method and AUTOFORM. Comparison between the two simulation results is done which shows the method we proposed is better, and then we introduced some methods to optimize the adjustment amount of metal flow and the stamping dies for fracture. Some suggestions are given by investigating the adjustment amount and modification of the stamping die.

articleTitle: On-chip memory size configuration of SOC system based on real-time constraints
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper, the relationship between scheduling cycle of embedded application and on-chip memory size configuration in SOC system is analyzed, and the method to select the optimal on-chip memory size under real-time constraints is present. The scheduling cycle and hardware cost is used to evaluate the approach. The result shows that the method has reduced scheduling cycle and hardware cost significantly.

articleTitle: Study on thermal stress distribution of repair welding process for gasification furnace flange
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The processing of repair welding online has been designed in this paper for seal section on flange connected with nozzle on the gasification furnace for coal-water slurry gasify in a Coal chemicals CO. LTD. The method of finite element has been used to study the thermal field, thermal stress and deformation in the flange, piping and the connected bolts during the heat treatment through welding with the process of modeling, meshing, solving, data processing and the results analysis. Conclusions have been obtained as following: the flange repair process designed in this paper is feasible for the gasification furnace; spring deformation happens during the heat treatments for flange, piping and the corresponding bolts without plastic deforming except the part of heat band and below; one method of finite element has been discussed in this paper for thermal stress distribution study, which is useful for similar projects solution.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The conceptiong of underground road development in center district of plain metropolis in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: PLC control system for dust removing system of carbon-produce lathing process
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: To reduce energy consumption and improve the level of automation of the system, based on analyzing and studying of dust removing system technological characteristics for carbon-produce lathing process, PLC control system of dust removing system has been ensured. Hardware composing and software function of control system has been built. The industry measure mathematics model has been put forward that is using the average velocity to measure the dust removing capacity, and the PID control algorithm to adjust the throttle intensity of the dust controller has been brought forward. Based on that, the effectual method for engineering actualizing and PLC control flow has been designed. Performance parameters, match with actual capacity, of dust removing system are set by control system automatically.
