Because of this control method, the energy consumption of dust catcher has been reduced about 35%. The application indicates that this control system is compact and credible. It helps to enhance corporation's automatization and management level and to improve environment lustration rate. It provides reference for auto-control of other dust removing.

articleTitle: On the characteristics of swing angle of tilting-pad journal bearing
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Finite difference method and Castelli method are employed to solve dynamic Reynolds equation with oil rupture boundary and to establish single pad database of nonlinear oil film forces. Based on the database, the law of swing angle of tilting-pads of five-pad tilting-pad journal bearing with definite deviation angle is analyzed by Newton iteration method. Numerical Results show that swing angle is related to eccentricity, pre-loading and clearance ratio. To certain bearing parameters, the swing angles of tilting-pads increase with approximate linear relation or increase at first and then decrease with the increase of eccentricity. The swing angles of tilting-pads increase or decrease in accordance with approximate linear relation when clearance ratio increases.

articleTitle: Algorithm of 3D display interface switching based on J2ME platform
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: 3D display applications are among focal topics in the field of the mobile communication, In order to transplant a variety of 3D display technologies to the real-time uses based on the existing widely used mobile platforms, in this paper we propose a good 3D flip algorithm that can be utilized on the J2ME platform. The principle of 3D flip algorithm is derived for display interface using mathematical model and a mapping function about 3D switching the image is thus obtained. We have also analyzed and discussed some problems with the algorithm. Tests show that the proposed algorithm works well on the J2ME platform.

articleTitle: The correlation between microenvironment and tomato fruit quality in greenhouse
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In order to investigate the fruit quality of tomato (Lycopersicon esculentum mill) affected by microenvironment and soil water and fertilizer, the field experiment was conducted in a greenhouse in Ansia research Station of Soil and Water Conservation, Chinese Academy of Science, Yan'an, Shaanxi province, China, from March to October in 2008 and 2009. The research results showed that soluble protein content of tomato fruit was the highest in the low fertilizer and water treatment, and the vitamin C content increased as the soil water content decreased in the same fertilizer treatment, and the sugar content of tomato fruit increased as the solar radiation increased. In the low fertilizer, the correlation between sugar content and atmosphere radiation increased as the soil water content decreased. And it was able to decrease the contents of sugar, amino acid and soluble solid and the ratio of sugar content to organic acid content that to increasing the air relative humidity. As the soil temperature increased, the sugar content, soluble acid content decreased. The high water consumption decreased the content of sugar, soluble solid and soluble protein and sugar/ acid while increasing the organic acid content, as a result decreased the quality of tomato fruit.

articleTitle: Application of new Top-Down method in deep foundation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Aiming at deficiency of cost higher in large area, and deep foundation pit excavation with conventional Top-Down method, A new Top-Down excavation method was introduced based on the general top-down excavation method. The key design techniques of the new Top-Down method include: using the temporary fender cast-in-place piles as exterior-protected construction in top-down excavation process; substituting level bracing system by basement slabs; combining the vertical structural supporting column with the temporary vertical shoring etc. A series of new techniques, including the profiled bar-concrete controlled bracing system, substituting level bracing system by variable level basement roof slap, several large diameter rings bracing on complex boundary condition, the top-down method of podium and the down-up method of turret etc. were first introduced and practiced in excavation engineering. It is shown that the new top-down method have good economic and social benefits. The method provides a new excavation engineering design choice for the similar pits, and the technology will be modified and improved in the future excavation design applications.

Author Keywords: substituting level bracing system by basement slab

articleTitle: The computer-aided Communicative Language Teaching (CLT) in the universities — Case studies in the Chinese context
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Nowadays the computer-aided Communicative Language Teaching has been widely applied in Chinese universities. This paper is to prove the effectiveness and viability of it by using case studies through classroom observations, diary entries and interviews.

articleTitle: Understory light regimes in old-growth and second-growth temperate forests of Northeastern China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Light penetration through the forest canopy affects the growth and survival of tree regeneration. We compared understory light regimes in an old-growth forest and a second-growth forest using hemispherical photography. From each photograph, we ascertained canopy openness (CO), light transmission (gap light index, GLI), sunfleck characteristics, and the spatial distribution of CO and GLI. Old-growth and second-growth forests differed significantly in CO, GLI and the mean number of sunflecks per day. The old-growth forest plot was more open and heterogeneous in its openness than the second-growth forest plot. Sunflecks were more abundant in the second-growth plot, but sunfleck duration was not significantly different between the two forest types. Our study suggests that the characteristics of understory light may be a distinguishing indicator of the different forest types.

articleTitle: Parallel double-acting NC constant flow pistion pump with two-step output pressure driven by rotary servomotor
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: A new type of two-step double-acting composite constant flow piston hydraulic pump is introduced, which based on the rotary servomotor. The primary power transmission device of the equipment is spiral bevel gear. Dependent on the spiral bevel gear, the device achieves the constant output of the flow. The principle of the hydraulic pump system is analyzed, and the output pressure formulas of low pressure and high pressure are given. The constant flow pump system reduces the hydraulic pulse and the instability of output force greatly, and furtherly realizes the highly stable operation of the system. The new type of the hydraulic pump has a good application prospect.

articleTitle: Skinning surface algorithm of B-spline for scattered point cloud
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Due to the intrinsic property of B-Spline surface, the surface reconstruction with scattered and chaos point-cloud is a challenging problem. This paper proposed a skinning surface algorithm of B-spline for scattered point-cloud. First, raw data was preprocessed including denoising, simplifying and slicing to obtain section data. Second, approximating cross section data into B-spline curves and resampling to ensure the common knot vector. Then the new data would be parameterized and interpolated into B-spline curves. Finally, surface of scatter point-cloud would be reconstructed by skinning. Experiments demonstrate that this method is easy to implement and provides an accurate surface model.

articleTitle: Spatial distribution of soil organic carbon of Kaoping River basin in Taiwan
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The interaction among soil organic carbon (SOC), pH and soil electrical conductivity (EC) are highly related to land use and spatial distribution in the Kao-Ping River basin. Soil organic matters provide soil elements and nutrients. PH of soil determines the plant variety and land use. The level of soil salinity can be used to be the indicator of the selection of plant species. In general, when the electrical conductivity is higher than 4 ds/m, it has adverse effects on plant growth. This study aimed to investigate the spatial distribution of SOC, pH and EC in Kao-Ping River basin from the SOC of topsoil samples taken from 40 sites. The results showed the soil of Kaoping River is between neutral and alkaline. Statistically low correlation existed between SOC and pH; correlation between SOC and silt-plus-clay and negative correlation between sand and EC. It can be seen that soil texture in the vegetation areas which contains more silt and clay is higher than in the non-vegetated areas. The conductivity is lower near the upstream. It showed SOC, altitude and vegetation are closely related.

articleTitle: The variable-coefficient Modified Kortweg-de Vries equation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this article, a new transformation mapping the variable-coefficient Modified Kortweg-de Vries (VC-MKdV) equation to the usual coefficient Modified Kortweg-de Vries (MKdV) equation is given. And then we will give some new solutions of the VC-MKdV equation with the known solutions of the usual MKdV equation. At last the tracks of the new solutions for the VC-MKdV equation are well analysed and ploted.

articleTitle: Finite element analysis about subsidence properties of composite foundation under embankment
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Three-dimensional model based on CFG pile composite foundation of the Wuhan-Guangzhou Passenger Line is built by ABAQUS finite element analysis. According to the study of influence of pile-soil modulus ratio on the mechanical settlement properties of CFG pile composite foundation, it gets some useful conclusions for engineering practice, and verifies that ABAQUS finite element software is feasible to deal with nonlinear analysis of geotechnical engineering.

articleTitle: Experimental study on the carbonation of fly ash concrete
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Based on fly ash concrete carbonation test, the impacts of water-binder ratio, fly ash proportion and pouring side to concrete carbonation depths was studied. With the help of the influence coefficient K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">s</sub> of steel bar existence, the carbonation situations of concrete specimen with steel bar existence are analysed. The research results indicate that steel bar existence can inhibit concrete carbonation to a certain extent, the influence coefficient of steel bar existence and carbonation age conforms to logarithm relation.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of 2-D MT tipper response using finite element method
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In the two-dimensional geo-electric model, the tipper response of magnetotelluric(MT) depends on the numerical simulation TE mode. Firstly, the boundary value problem and variational problem were shown, and the finite element method was used for element subdivision, interpolation, integration and general synthesis. Secondly, the electric field value of each node was obtained through solving the complex equation. Lastly, the partial derivatives along the horizontal and vertical electric field obtained using the difference method, and the tipper response of the two-dimensional MT can be calculated. By the numerical simulation of the two models, the tipper responses are obtained including real part, imaginary part and amplitude, and the results reflect the horizontal distribution of the body.

articleTitle: Analysis of lateral disturbances on high-speed vehicle stability
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: According to the Multi-body Dynamics, the lateral disturbances on high-speed vehicle are simplified as lateral forces and difference torques which act on the cm of the vehicle. And a 3 DOF vehicle model is set up for analyzing. It has theoretical significance on the later researches of high-speed vehicle stability with lateral disturbances to consider the disturbances as lateral forces and difference torques. The straight and steering traveling tests of a special car with lateral disturbances are simulated on the simulation platform of ADAMS, and the results are analyzed in detail. It lays a foundation for the further research and optimization design of the vehicle parameters with respect of high-speed vehicle stability.

articleTitle: Research on control system for network financial security
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Network Finance brings great changes and conveniences to enterprise at network economy age, at the same time, but security issues have been the biggest constraint to their development, so how to build the control system of network financial security is an important issue which is urgently in-depth studied. In this paper, the control system of network financial security is constructed systematically on the basis of comprehensive-risks analysis of network financial security, which can provide constructive advices and implementing methods in order to be against the risk of network system and internal control risks for enterprise.

articleTitle: Reciprocating membrane pump's fault diagnosis based on chaos and wavelet packets
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The paper studies the chaos characteristics of different situations in the reciprocating membrane pump' s typical faults with wavelet packets technology. The relative growth rate of the largest Lyapunove exponent is put forward as a new parameter to identify the development of the wearing clearance and the fluctuation of the tank suction' s pressure. The research shows different wearing places have different largest Lyapunov exponents. It is also found that the wearing faults' characteristic frequency bands are high frequency ones, while the pressure' s are low frequency ones. The results are useful to distinguish the pumps' different faults. All these prove vibration monitoring is a new way for the pumps' monitoring.

articleTitle: The prototype implementation of a varying current charger for aged rechargeable Lithium-ion batteries
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: A varying current charger for rechargeable Lithium-ion battery is implemented to maintain a predefined energy bound which is consumed by the overpotential equivalent resistance. For aged Lithium-ion batteries, the traditional CCCV charging method charges the battery with the same constant current no matter how the battery internal overpotential resistance increases. The varying current charger developed in this paper will follow the pre-defined energy bound, calculate the internal resistance from EMF and update the next charge current by matching the estimated time to consume the energy bound and the end of charge time. The hardware prototype is implemented with a FPGA and a current source board and the communicates with PC user interface through UART. The experiments show that the efficiency for the varying charge current method is hold for both a new battery and an aged battery although the charging time is compromised.

articleTitle: Mechanism and experiments of asymmetrical pitch system for MAV
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In view of problem for miniaturizing Micro Air Vehicles (MAV), a novel asymmetrical pitch system faced to rotary wing MAV is introduced. The pitch mechanism and control characteristics are studied and analyzed. Because the deformation of elasticity link is key to generate the blade pitch, it is analyzed and calculated by elasticity finite element method. And the results illustrate the linear relationship between blade pitch angles and the output torque of the motor. Based on control system of asymmetrical pitch, mechanism experiments based on strain gauge are done, and the factors that affect the deformation of the elastic linkage is analyzed. Results indicate that mechanism of asymmetrical pitch is effective.

articleTitle: Study on the engine-CPP associated control approach during ship accelerating process
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: A CODOG system simulation model is built in Matlab/SIMULINK environment, and the model is integrated and improved by using MFC. Then the simulation model is validated by trail data of the ship at sea. Two different “engine-CPP” associated control approaches of accelerating process are proposed, and each approach is simulated and designed. The simulation result shows that adopting the accelerating approach in which the increase rates of engine speed and pitch are changeable, the flexibility of the ship accelerating process will improved remarkably. At last the practicability of this approach is discussed.

articleTitle: Discussion on wastewater treatment model of rural areas in Beijing
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Wastewater treatment of rural areas in Beijing has been long progressed steadily, some available alternative plans of wastewater treatment model of rural areas in Beijing were put forward on the basis of field inspection and theoretical analysis, and combining program of wastewater treatment model of rural areas in Beijing, cite actual project cases to explain, at last, provide references for construction of sewage treatment facilities of rural areas in Beijing.

articleTitle: Human-computer interaction design of BPMSM control system with optimal communication protocol
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: A bearingless permanent magnet synchronous motor (BPMSM) control system has a large number of control variables but has a small amount of data variables. So, adopting optimal coding scheme is demanded in its human-computer interaction. Based on the analysis of data format in serial port communication and data types of control variables, an optimal scheme of data split and combination and a coding one are given. A software synchronization strategy is proposed to keep data integrity. A decoding vectors table of linear pointer array structure and a sending descriptors table of single list structure are introduced to accelerate decoding process and implement dynamic adjustment of sending contents respectively. With this human-computer interaction strategy, code extension is easily realized and has no influence on the efficiency of program. The results show that the BPMSM operates stably, and smooth communication, integrated data, easy operation, convenient code extension and simple maintenance are obtained with this human-computer interaction strategy.

articleTitle: Residual strength of reinforced concrete columns with +-shaped cross section after exposure to fire
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The practical calculation method for the residual strength of reinforced concrete columns with +-shaped cross section after exposure to ISO834 standard fire is investigated. Using a numerical program CAFIRE, the influence of several parameters, such as exposure times, effective lengths, sectional thicknesses, ratios of sectional height to sectional thickness, load eccentricity ratios, reinforcement ratios, load angles and longitudinal reinforcement yield strength on the residual strength of RC columns with +-shaped cross section after exposure to fire is analyzed. 14580 columns with +-shaped cross section and subjected to fire in all sides were selected for residual strength analyses. Based on the calculation results, a simplified calculation method is proposed for the residual strength of +-shaped columns after exposure to ISO834 standard fire.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The development of Taipei Neihu Technology Park
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Study on rock micro-rupture mechanism and macroscopic fracture characteristic of phyllite
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The macroscopic fracture s of rock are strongly linked to the presence of microstructures and micro-defects within. And the evidence of deformation is left after fracture process. This paper put the sericite phyllite and siliceous plate phyllite of Middle Devonian series as the research object on upriver of Jinsha River. The micro-rupture properties of rock are judged and the relation between the form and mechanism of phyllite micro-rupture and mineral component is revealed through scanning electronic microscope and mechanical tests. We analyze the physical meaning of rock fracture combined with mechanic characteristics of macroscopic fracture. So we acquire the evidence of the establishment of bridge between rock micro-rupture mechanism and macroscopic fracture analysis.

articleTitle: Centeral steering virtual test analysis of a car based on ADAMS
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Vehicle's central steering test was an important test project of handling and stability evaluation. First, in the ADAMS software, vehicle dynamics model was established. According to the standards, the central steering virtual test was carried out, and the test transient response signal were recorded, based on experimental data processing method, the yaw rate with the steering wheel rotation curve and lateral acceleration with steering angle curves were plotted. Finally, according to the extracted test index values, the handling stability of the car was a rough evaluated. The paper is a try for the central steering virtual test and evaluation.

articleTitle: Mapping deblocking algorithm of H.264 decoder onto a reconfigurable array architecture
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper introduces several methods for mapping deblocking algorithm onto REconfigurable MUltimedia System (REMUS) processor, which consists of a general RISC processor and two Processing Element Arrays (PEAs). Although reconfigurable array architecture is efficient to computing-intensive tasks, which is difficult to implement control-intensive task, such as deblocking algorithm. In order to figure out this problem, RISC processor calculates several parameters and generate configuration information to determinate filter modes, PEAs accelerate regular computation due to parallelization and pipeline architecture. Compared to the deblocking execution on FloRA, XPP-III, deblocking algorithm on REMUS achieves the speedup of 79.2%, 34.74%, which compares to the implementation on FloRA and XPP-III architecture. Furthermore, those methods can be used for other algorithms to achieve acceleration, such as MC, IDCT.

articleTitle: A new control method for neutral-point-clamped three-level PWM rectifiers
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: A neutral-point-clamped three-level PWM rectifier is studied in the paper. The naturally decoupled state-space equations in stationary reference frame (α-β) were derived. Furthermore, a new PWM method for input current harmonic of rectifier is presented including asymmetrical regular sampling and DC-bus voltage balancing. The hierarchical controller structure is adopted and can be divided as the inner current-loop and the outer voltage-loop. Besides, a proportional sinusoidal signal integrator method, namely proportional-resonant (PR) controllers in two phase stationary reference frame is proposed. The presented PWM control method for three-level PWM rectifiers is simulated using Psim8.0. Simulation and experimental results based on a rectifier of a 75kVA three-level NPC converter prototype show that the provided control scheme provides preferable performance in steady-state.

articleTitle: Embedding paths into the 4-ary n-cube with faulty nodes
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
