articleTitle: Table of content
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The following topics are dealt with:QDCT-based and QDFT-based methods; multichannel vibration signals compression; autonomous mobile robot; Hough transform; mobile education; permanent magnet linear synchronous motor; fault diagnosis; electrohydraulic servo system; switched reluctance motor; vehicle information system; intelligent logistics transportation equipment; hydropower turbine system; artificial limb; support vector machine; narrow band power line communication channel impedance; heterogeneous robots system; multi-agent Web services; virtual organization and fuzzy control.

articleTitle: Contrast study on power quality detection using EMD and EEMD
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Most of the disturbance in the power system is nonlinear and no-stationary. Hilbert-Huang transform (HHT) is an efficient time-frequency analysis method which can detect different kinds of power quality disturbance. HHT consists of empirical-mode decomposition (EMD) and Hilbert transform (HT). EMD can self-adjust according to the characteristics of the signal itself, and decompose the signal into IMFs, so that the disturbance can be separated and studied. Ensemble empirical mode decomposition (EEMD), which improved the performance of EMD, overcomes the mode mixing phenomena which restrain the usage of EMD. This paper did a contrast study on power quality detection using EMD and EEMD. It is concluded that EEMD has better effect on detecting some of power quality disturbances.

articleTitle: Comparision of the evaluation method for building energy consumption in Taiwan-EEWH with USGBC-LEED Green Building Rating System
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This article compared the evaluation method for building energy consumption in Taiwan-EEWH Green Building Rating System with USGBC-LEED. An office building intending to pass the EEWH and LEED certification was taken as an example. EnergyPlus was used to simulate the total building energy consumption of the example building. The credit points that the building got in EEWH and LEED were demonstrated and compared.

articleTitle: Problems and solutions of educational game development
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology industry, educational game has made a rapid popularization. Many domestic and international experiences show that educational games play an important influence on the growth of young people. However, media reports and academic research information show that while educational games improve the learning interest of youth, it also has many problems such as non-scientific design of the games, unreasonable educational and teaching methods, unsatisfactory game result etc. In the future, youth learning can not be separated from educational games. The inevitable way of improving the effectiveness of educational games is to correctly understand the positive role of educational games, to set a reasonable goal, to design the scientific content, to enhance the effect evaluation, to feedback timely the information and to control thoroughly the way of educational games.

articleTitle: An overview of Robot SLAM problem
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper, Robot SLAM Problem are described, the present study of SLAM is reviewed. The potential issues of future research are discussed.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Design of the time driving and image signal processing for linear CCD based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Analysis of the factors that affect QPSK
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In the QPSK modulation and demodulation process, the signal will be affected by some non-ideal factors, in this paper, these non-ideal factors were analyzed. This paper considers the magnitude imbalance, phase imbalance and phase noise factors. We will study the QPSK constellation to analysis the amplitude imbalance and phase imbalance. About the phase noise we will consider the factors that affect the error rate of QPSK.

articleTitle: Data aggregation used for congestion control in WSN based on similar degree reduction
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: A data aggregation preprocessing algorithm for congestion control in wireless sensor networks is proposed in this paper. The algorithm decrease the repeating packet of nodes by reducing data of multiple group sensing data which belongs to a aggregation cycle with similar coefficient, thus can ease congestion of the networks. The experimental results show that this algorithm can reduce communication traffic load of network effectively, and data after similar aggregation processing and truth value can maintain higher coincidence degree.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: RSSI based positioning error ranging removal of mixed
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: The algorithm of natural language parser
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Natural language processed by computer is an important branch of language and linguistics researches, and which includes syntax, semantic and pronunciation. This paper focuses on the syntactic structure of natural language and introduces a algorithm based on Delphi which is a top-down parser to process it. At last the algorithm is proved to be correct by concrete examples.

articleTitle: Control of brushless DC motor with an AVR microcontroller
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper illustrates the basic work principle of a brushless DC motor and presents its control method. According to the method, a control system of a brushless DC Motor is designed using an AVR microcontroller. Design of the control system includes hardware circuit designing and software programming. The hardware structure of the control system consists of a microcontroller ATmega64, power supply circuit, position detection circuit, current chopper circuit, power driving circuit, display circuit and keyboard circuit and so on. The software is developed by c program language. The software includes main program, initialization program, PWM duty ratio reload program, speed calculation program, closed-loop PID regulation program, interrupt service program, LCD display program, keyboard program etc. The experiment result shows that the system is with an excellent dynamic and static performance. Its operation is reliable.

articleTitle: Mobile robot motion planning based on heat conduction equation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Motion planning for mobile robot is one of the most fundamental and complex problems in robotics. Based on introduction of the basic principle of heat conduction equation and some traditional solutions of motion planning, the model for motion planning is presented. The adaptive mesh is used to solve the equation model for motion planning. The calculation results are given and compared with other motion planning methods. Theory and calculation results prove that, as a new method for mobile robot motion planning, the heat conduction equation for mobile robot motion planning is feasible and effective.

articleTitle: The future trends of in-wheel motors for electric vehicles
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In-wheel motor drive has been developed quickly. permanent magnet machines is the preferred. In this paper, the characteristics of permanent magnet machines are first reviewed and evaluated. Then, the new technology of in-wheel motor drive iare discussed, Finally, future research trends of electrical machines in EVs are described.

articleTitle: The study and practice of training excellent network engineering based on CDIO mode
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper analyzed the present situation of network engineering major at home and abroad. Under the background of international trend of higher engineering education, combined with advanced educational concept of engineering and CDIO reform, this fostering professional talent of net-work engineering major plan proposed a program from orientation training of talent, training program designing and curriculum reform. It provided an appropriate mode of relative majors to local engineering colleges that meets international standard and serves needs of local economy.

articleTitle: A novel online algorithm for blind source separation with unknown number of sources
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: A novel algorithm which can online estimate number of sources and separate sources is proposed to solve the Blind Source Separation problem with unknown number of sources. First create a discriminator and threshold, and adjust the estimating number of sources via comparing the size of discriminator and threshold gradually to converge at the true number. Then use a modified natural gradient algorithm to separate the sources. Computer simulation verify the algorithm is effective and perform better than traditional algorithm.

articleTitle: Information literacy education: Problem and stratergy
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In the information age, the information literacy has become a basic human ability. Compared with western countries, China's information literacy is still relatively backword and unable to meet youth's needs in learning and living. In this research, it is an urgent and important task to strengthen and improve the information literacy education. In China, it is required to learn and use the successful experience of foreign countries by strengthening the construction of teachers in information education, integrating and optimizing educational information resources, establishing scientific goals, sound standards and perfect modes of information literacy education, and setting up curriculum system and perfercting evaluation system of information literacy education to gradually promote the improvement of youth's information literacy level.

articleTitle: Research on technology of free-space coherent optical modulation and detection
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper discussed the principle of amplitude modulation and coherent detection, then designed freedom homodyne coherent receiver system, included optical schematic design and the receiver signal acquisition & processing. Through NI data acquisition card acquire signal and LabVIEW graphical program software accomplish signal processing. The detection and collection methods can be applied to the phase and polarization of the demodulation processing.

articleTitle: Intelligent alarm system based on vibration sensor of optical fiber and grating
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Taking vibration sensor of optical fiber and grating into field of perimeter security, an intelligent adaptive alarm algorithm of optical fiber and grating was proposed, based on dynamic programming and difference algorithm The proposed algorithm can realize intelligent alarm for illegal intrusion, with the error alarm ratio of 0.5% and 1.6%. The intelligent alarm system could fulfill the requirements of diversity of perimeter security, developing the new prospects for appliment of optical fiber and grating.

articleTitle: Blended learning trategy design and practice
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This article explores A Case study of Instructional Design Based on Blended Learning. Based on the analysis of the state of blended learning research, the instructional design theory based on blended learning, we present a blended learning model and the CAD course blended learning activity organizational strategies; then, we used the model and strategies into instructional practice. The result shown that blended-learning-based instructional design model and the blended learning activity organizational strategies based on the revised two-dimensional framework of Bloom's taxonomy of cognitive objectives were operational and effective.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on setting conditions of Bus Rapid Transit (BRT) in Medium-sized cities
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Evaluation bid method of railway construction project based on gray situation decision
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: According to the defects of the traditional evaluation bid methods, the essay proposes the evaluation bid methods based on the grey system theory. It establishes a model of grey decision-making and the steps of implementations in evaluation bid of engineering project, and proposes the integrated effect measure algorithm of different polar samples. Also, the essay transforms the qualitative evaluations into the quantitative ones, and then solves the problems that the original methods involved too many human factors and strong subjectivities which influenced the evaluation results. These make the evaluation bid methods improved in comprehensive, rational and scientific respects.

articleTitle: A applied research into switched reluctance motor in electric vehicle
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The control of SRM was discussed: current chopping control, angle position control. This paper presents a inverter circuit and a fuzzy sliding mode control method to minimize the torque fluctuation and noise of the SRM. Based on the experimental results, Using the inverter circuit and fuzzy sliding mode control method can effectively minimize the torque fluctuation and noise of the SRM, For the switched reluctance motor applications in electric vehicles to provide a theoretical basis.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on interchange planning based on the network distribution of urban road
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Study on controlled by beds combination structure to deep of mining failure of coal seam floor
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The probing method of breakage depth mined are Introduced, and the geology, hydrology and rock strata structure of the coal seam floor mined in the test work face are analyzed. the worth of the breakage depth mined of the 6 coal seam floor in the No.2 coal mine of Liu qiao and Zhu zhuang coal mine are acquired. The results show that the probing method of floor breakage depth is different, but its regularity is similar, and the floor breakage depth is clearly controlled by floor rock strata structure.

articleTitle: Temperature-controlling system based on TEC
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: It introduces a temperature-controlling system based on TEC in this paper. This system includes two part: hardware and software system, used a STC89C52 MCU as the core controlling unit, and a TEC-12706 as the main working component. The hardware part includes monitor, temperature acquisition, relay switches and voltage conversion modules as well. SCM turns a relay on or off by comparing DS18B20 collected real-time temperature with threshold temperature, subsequently controlled the cooler work. Tests shows that at an open environment temperature about 30°C, the lowest temperature of the cooler surface could be controlled at about 13°C, power 9w, which achieves the automatic temperature-controlling function basically.

articleTitle: Research on design of data-sharing center for the universities
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The purpose of building data-sharing center in a university information system is as follows: firstly, to solve data integration in heterogeneous business applications; secondly, to achieve information sharing; thirdly, to eliminate information silos; lastly, to provide valuable unified data source for decision analysis by leaders. The paper discusses the design of the data-sharing center, and presents a viable construction framework. The results have important promotional value for other university information systems.

articleTitle: The research of intelligent timing control system for urban traffic signal light
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: With the rapid increase of the urban vehicle's number, the contradiction between the vehicle and road has become increasingly remarkable, and the bottleneck effect of the intersection has become more striking. Practices have proved that reasonable controlling on traffic signal light in the city and designing reasonable signal timing control system can play a significant role in solving the problems such as traffic pollution and traffic energy consumption. Meanwhile, it can contribute to the implementation of the security, speediness and comfort of traffic flow. Based on the characteristics of the urban road traffic flow, this article puts forward an optimization timing plan of the synchronous change of signal lights timing and traffic flow rate in the single intersection, and evaluates the data through computer simulation. The results show that the number of queuing vehicles after being optimized reduces by 30% than that before optimization.

articleTitle: The case study of kindergarten design towards low carbon and green architecture
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: It is discussed the meaning of green architecture and low carbon architecture. With the case study of design strategies in Xiaoshicheng kindergarten design, a great deal of design method and their applications are developed on account of climate character, architectural function, building technology.

articleTitle: Nonlinear layered finite element analysis of RC slab
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this present study, the orthotropic with secant modulus constitutive law of concrete has been proposed. And those developed the nonlinear layered finite element model and program to predict the data from experiments. The proposed finite element solutions result in close correlation with experimental data available for RC slab.

articleTitle: Student perspectives THEOL platform course construction and operation status of the case studies: In 100 web courses of Qingdao university teacher college for example
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Through investigation on Qingdao university teacher college 100 web courses and its users, we found web courses based on THEOL platform have series of questions in use process. Such as: platform and resource needs to be improved, Students' learning stays in the shallow learning state, Emotion exchange loss, etc. Therefore, we must adopt some effective measures such as Strengthening software and hardware construction, Lead and manage learners, Improve leaners' learning ability, Meet learners' emotional needs and so on.

articleTitle: Simulation analysis of Stewart platform safety mechanism
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Safety mechanism, which can move at will when the length of links ranges in its whole extension region, is designed and simulated based on extreme poses. The simulation results indicate that the rotation angle of joints and the distance between two close links satisfy all restrictions when the length of links ranges in its whole extension region. It can be found that the design method about safety mechanism based on links space is a kind of valuable method in mechanism optimization, which transforms the problems about singularity, constraint of the rotation angle limit of joints and links' interference, into the length constraint of links. And moreover, there is no singular point in the safety mechanism's whole workspace.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Study in highway landscape planning based on driver's visual scale
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Thermal research on material and structure of High-Power-LED module
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The high junction temperature of High-Power-LED and low heat-release have directly influence on light luminoue efficiency and device lifetime, so how to maintain the temperature in proper range and improve the function of heat-release, become the key issue for the industrialization of high-power-LED. In this paper, it is given that reducing thermal resistance is the best way to lower temperature of LED. Furthermore, the thermal performance of material, packaging and module structure have been analysed in details, In the end, by reasonable design, it shows two novel module structures and analyses their advantages in heat-release.

articleTitle: Design and development of the wireless sensor node for traffic flow surveillance
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Wireless sensor network is expected to be deployed in intersection to monitor the traffic flow continuously, and the monitoring data can be used as the foundation of traffic light control. In this paper, a traffic information and transmission system based on Zigbee and wireless sensor network is built, and the sensor nodes used in traffic flow surveillance are developed. Structure, hardware and work flow of WSN nodes are designed. The stability experiment and the actual environment experiment are carried out in the last of the paper. The results of experiments show that WSN has the ability to collect traffic flow information quickly and transmit the datum to the processing center in real time.

articleTitle: The model and experimental study of the influence of the blade installation position on the torsional vibration in deep-hole boring
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This thesis mainly focuses on the torsional vibration in deep-hole boring, establishes a mechanical model and analyses the effect of the installation position on the torsional vibration, and the reasonable blade installation position was verified by the experiments.

articleTitle: Experimental study of settlement characteristics of bioreactor landfill
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The variation trend of leachate, biogas production and component and settlement ratio in pre-treatment leachate recirculation landfill (PLRL) were compared with raw leachate recirculation landfill (RLRL) and no leachate recirculation landfill (NLRL). Combine the change of COD, BOD<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sub>, pH value and peak value time of biogas yield in each reactor, it can be summarized that the ratio of BOD<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sub>/COD was the lowest in PLRL. The highest settlement ratio of PLRL, RLRL and NLRL were 65.1%, 49.2% and 17.5%, respectively. Consequently, fast degradation of the waste in PLRL has unique advantages on the settlement.

articleTitle: The application of computer technology in mathematics teaching
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: With the development of science and technology, computer information technology has been widely applied in education and scientific research. In the process of teaching, properly using computer technology can effectively improve the teaching quality. This paper discusses some problems which Computer information technology was applied in mathematics classroom teaching and mathematics research-oriented teaching. By changing the traditional teaching mode, Computer information technology could not only stimulate the students' study enthusiasm and initiative, but aslo promote teaching idea transformation.

articleTitle: Innovation on integration reforms of education & teaching to improve quality of personnel training
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper, the innovation on integration reforms of education and teaching is conducted in-depth study and discussion in College of Network Engineering. From the training ideas of innovative engineering personnel training about the integration reforms of education and teaching, the training system of innovative engineering personnel is planned to establish. From the construction of each curriculums, innovative curriculums, innovative bases, practice teaching system, extra-curricular science and technology activities, innovative environment and teacher teams, the research and construction of innovation on integration reforms of education and teaching is conducted in-depth study and discussion, which will make some effects on the innovative engineering personnel training.

articleTitle: Regional analysis on Urban Agriculture in Xi'an
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Urban agriculture in Xi'an has taken shape and has its own characteristics. This paper based on the analysis on the main tectonic plates, industrial belts and their corresponding distribution areas, making an analysis on 6 main target data out of mass of data with the methods of factor analysis and cluster analysis. Based on the researches mentioned above, this paper finally summarized the characteristics of the Urban Agriculture in Xi'an and displayed its function in Urban agriculture development.

articleTitle: Research on reliability technology of numerical control system based on competing mode
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The reliability of numerical control machine tool is one of the key problems to restrict the rapid development of numerical control machine too industry. Based on traditional reliability analysis methods, the degradation failure modes of numerical control system are investigated, the reliability modeling analysis method based on competing mode of hard and soft failure is presented. The relations between reliability, failure rate, MTBF and failure threshold are analyzed by this method. The results can help to optimize numerical control machine tool reliability design.

articleTitle: An adaptive spread spectrum watermarking algorithm based on orthogonal Walsh codes
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper presents a Walsh code orthogonal spread spectrum watermarking algorithm. First, the watermark is modulated by two orthogonal Walsh codes. Then the watermark is embedded into the medium frequency and low frequency of the carrier block, according to the visual masking effect of the human visual system. The extraction of the watermark without the original image, using correlation detection to despreading. Experimental results show that the algorithm is robust variety of attacks.

articleTitle: A simple SVM control algorithm for inverter
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Based on voltage-second balance principle, a simple SVM control algorithm is proposed in this paper. This algorithm can effectively simplify the calculation and reduce calculation time greatly. Our analysis and the result from simulation indicate that the control effect is same to that of the traditional SVM. Furthermore this algorithm does not need to perform the sine and cosine calculations, and thus it is more convenient and effective than the traditional SVM algorithm. In addition the sampling period can be shorten, and can be used to improve the controlling effect of inverter.

articleTitle: Parallel research of shape context face recognition algorithm based on CUDA
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The shape recognition serial algorithm of Shape Context and parallel processing platform of CUDA are studied in this paper. According to multi-processor pipepine characteristics of CUDA platform, the Shape Context algorithm is made to be adapted to CUDA platform. Through paralleling algorithm, the higher implementation of precision and more than 130-fold speedup are obtained. The purpose of dealing with the real-time processing of the huge amounts of data on face recognition is satisfied.

articleTitle: Improved algorithm of image segmentation based on maximum classes square error
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper, a binary search algorithm is used to search optimal threshold value for image segmentation. It overcomes the shortcoming of huge calculation by using Otsu algorithm to search optimal threshold value traversing the whole grayscale, enable which to be applied in some occasions requiring for high real time. Experimental results show that this method can find reliable optimal threshold value, conduct image segmentation, and improve the processing speed greatly. The improved Otsu algorithm becomes more practical and wider application.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Spatial structure construction of urban green space system in Changsha
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Study on the fractal feature of scale structure and spatial structure of urban system in Shanxi Province
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: The design of outrigger crane circuit hydraulic system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: With the improvement of hydraulic components and hydraulic technology, hydraulic truck crane application became more extensive and more prominent advantages. The design is carried out under the parameters based on a certain type of crane QY16. The maximum outrigger load and the parameters of implementation components and accessories in the hydraulic system on the basis of the maximum load is calculated. In the end, the result of the design is simulated and compared with AMESim.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on road of characteristic urbanization of China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Research on groundwater Level Prediction of Naoli River Basin based on Elman wavelet neural networks
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper researches on Elman neural network and wavelet analysis based on the existing literatures and proposes the Elman wavelet neural network model. This paper also provides Elman neural network training process to apply it to groundwater Level Prediction of Naoli River Basin. This paper proposes groundwater level prediction model of Naoli River basin based on Elman wavelet neural networks. It can be seen that the model has high prediction accuracy and faster convergence according to the prediction results.

articleTitle: Key points of Multimedia teaching of General Technology
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In order to boost classroom efficiency and get curriculum goals better archieved, three key points should be grasped for Multimedia teaching of General Technology. First of all, the spirit of new curriculum reform must be integrated into the course. That is to say, diverse, creative and appropriate teaching-learning activities or situations, which stimulate learners to engage or to involve in exploring, cooperating and autonomic learning, should be designed in the Multimedia Teaching of General Technology. Besides, the features of General Technology must be commanded. Relate learning by doing and doing by learning with students' real daily life, and more attention must be paid to the students' personality development, etc. Last but not least, with practicality as a rule, multimedia design and teaching must unify the tree elements; practicability, artistry and technicality as one.

articleTitle: Design and optimization of micro flexible gripper
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: A micro flexible gripper using piezoelectric actuator was produced. Design, fabrication and tests of the microgripper were performed. The geometric size of the microgripper was optimized. After modeling the micro-gripper, finite element method (FEM) was performed to investigate the flexible mechanism, and Based on the optimal results, a prototype of the microgripper was tested by experiment.

articleTitle: Study on the effect of oxygen ions on the steel corrosion in concrete
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Oxygen ions diffusion directly influences steel corrosion rate, and have worse effect on concrete's structure. The paper, starting from the steel corrosion mechanism, summarized the testing technology and the research progress of oxygen ion diffusion coefficient, analyzed the influencing factors and studied further the effect of oxygen ions diffusion on steel corrosion in concrete. The testing technology of oxygen ion diffusion coefficient is combined with the testing method of steel corrosion rate, and the relationship between oxygen ion diffusion coefficient and steel corrosion rate are established.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Questing for educational thoughts of deep learning
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: The simulation algorithm of wireless sensor networks communication based on ant agorithm
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: A new simulation analysis algorithms establishing wireless sensor networks communication path based on ant algorithm was proposed. The local optimization problem Occurred in large-scale sensor nodes is solved. The new algorithm has good scalability and dynamic adaptability and is very effective to determiner multi-node wireless sensor network communication processes. The algorithm is feasible through simulation test.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Discussion on marine ecological compensation of reclaiming land from sea
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on intelligent design system of hole-series built-up fixture
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Research of computer network curriculum system based on the unique feature of finance and economics colleges
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper proposes a new idea for the educational reform of computer network curriculum in the finance and economics colleges, which can be performed relying on the predominance and unique features of the finance and economics colleges. The orientation of the computer network curriculum is for economic system, based on this, the corresponding course system is proposed, the characteristic teaching and practice contents are established rationally, the cultivation of distinctive specialists for computer network can be guaranteed.

articleTitle: Efficiency of loading rate on straw anaerobic digestion pretreated by solid state NaOH
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The characteristics of the generation of high-energy CH, through anaerobic digestion (AD) of straw pretreated with sodium hydroxide (NaOH) as chemical agent were introduced. The effect of loading rate on AD efficiency and biogas yield of straw were investigated. The main conclusions are: loading rate had a significant efficiency on AD of straw pretreated with 6% sodium hydroxide. Especially when loading rate was 60g·L<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>, at 7<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> day the maximum daily CH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>, production was 24.33 mL.g<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>. TS<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup> and at 37<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> day the AD was finish, the final CH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> yield was 289.1 mL.g<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>. TS<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>, CH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>, concentration in biogas was 54.89%, which is equivalent to bio-energy yield was 25.57MJ/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>, ultimate biodegradability was 58.9%.

articleTitle: Analysis of influence factors of the popularization of green buildings based on fuzzy DEMATEL method
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The influence factor index system of the popularization of green buildings is built. The inter-relations between each pair of indexes are decided by making inquires of the experts, and the effects of factors are analyzed using a fuzzy DEMATEL method. All factors are divided into cause factors and effect factors. The key facctors such as lack of prompting policy, poor energy conservation technology and poor green building materials are figured out.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on how to create the mode of landscape features of metropolitan suburbs recreational village — Case of new rural construction of the suburb of Wuhan city
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Analysis of environmental regulation tool and policy research
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: The automobile engine lubricating oil monitor engineering research based on the near-infrared light method
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This text based on the scattering principle of lubricating oil to near-infrared light, fully used the computer monitor technology, designed the plan of making use of near-infrared light to monitor automobile lubricating oil, and hereby it to monitor the deteriorated condition of lubricating oil. The experiment has proved that: this kind of technology for monitoring automobile lubricating oil can satisfy the deterioration condition monitor demand of automobile lubricating oil, and can give the instructions of the lubricating oil deterioration degree, so we can decide whether the lubricating oil can continue to use according to it. This method changed the traditional conditions that replace the lubricating oil according to time or the travel course number, it realized replacing lubricating oil according to the quality, thus it make the lubricating oil obtain the reasonable economy service life, and guaranteed the good lubrication condition of vehicles.

articleTitle: Research and practice on the course of Database Foundation and Application based on B-Learning
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: B-Learning (Blending Learning) is a combination of learning, that is, the combination of a variety of learning styles. This paper focuses on exploring B-Learning in Database Foundation and Application, and we hope it will provide some useful experiences for developing undergraduate quality and innovative ability.

articleTitle: Parallel research on matrix chain multiplication problem based on multi-core
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Now the computer is developing towards the multi-core and multi-CPU, but some quintessence serial algorithm can not be well transplanted to multi-core computer, so it's necessary to make parallel analysis and improvement on the original serial algorithm. This paper analyzes matrix chain multiplication problem, and gives three algorithms based on the multi-core and multi-CPU - parting matrix chain, balancing load among nucleuses, optimal algorithm at the initial stage, theoretically analyzing and implementing each one and getting good speedup.

articleTitle: Pile signal de-noising testing based on wavelet analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The Piles are abroad in various engineering field as common used foundation format and make certain social and economic benefits. However, with the extensive application of the pile foundation, problems brought by the quality of pile are becoming more and more Prevalent. On the foundation of sufficiently presentation wavelet theory, this paper applied wavelets to erase noise of foundation pile signal, and analyses signal by multi-resolution analysis. The results show that this analysis contributes to correctly identify the foundation pile integrity.

articleTitle: Research of Hermite-Gaussian beams of optical collimated system in atmosphere laser communication
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In atmosphere laser communication, the optical collimated system with different types of optical source have different the luminous energy coupling efficiency, the luminous energy coupling efficiency of optical collimated system also influences the transfer distance. Through analyzing the law that the luminous energy coupling efficiency of Hermite-Gaussian beams varies with the numerical aperture of optical collimated system, and determining the numerical aperture of optical collimated system based on luminous energy coupling efficiency, which is different from the method of determining numerical aperture in the imaging optics system, this paper proposes an effective method to determine the numerical aperture of Hermite-Gaussian beams optical collimated system in atmosphere laser communication.

articleTitle: Design of digital controlled-constant current source based on AVR
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This article describes a design of Digital Control of DC current source based on AVR microcontroller. The system uses the Atmega8 as the main chip and consists of keyboard input, LCD display, I / V conversion, power amplification and other modules. It uses a negative feedback closed-loop control. The MCU can compare real-time the preset value with the measuring results, and adjust the settings, in order to advance the output precision of the current. The design can achieve the functions of different measurement ranges, adjustable output current, exact step and very small current waviness. It also can display the output preset value and the measuring results by LED at the same.

articleTitle: Influence of cnoidal wave on optical soliton run
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: We studied the influence of cnoidal wave on optical soliton run. We found that cnoidal wave only perturb the amplitude and velocity of soliton when the amplitude of cnoidal wave is small enough to satisfy the condictions of adiabatic perturbation. We further found that the influences of cnoidal wave on the amplitude and velocity of soliton are periodic when other factors are ignored.

articleTitle: A digital control method of active power filter
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper introduces a novel digital control method approach applied to a three-phase four-wire active power filter, which is made up of a three-phase four-leg voltage source converter. The controller just detects main current and DC side capacitor voltage and duty cycle of the switches can be calculated simply. This controller has fewer measurement, higher robustness and simpler calculation as comparing to traditional controllers. Simulation results verify that the active power filter with proposed controller can compensate the harmonics effectively.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on metacognitive applied strategy in network learning
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Study for detection methods of traffic parameters based on EPI
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: It is a key segment of the traffic management system about detecting traffic parameters. With the continuous development of computer vision, the video traffic detection method is paid more and more attention. It is constructed that an Epi-polar Plane Image (EPI) method reflect the surface and movement characteristics of the vehicle, then the EPI is processing of normalization, filtering and texture detection. Finally, based on the EPI, it is given about the detection methods of mean velocity and length of the vehicle, traffic flow.

articleTitle: The design and realization of high-fidelity low-frequency power amplifier
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper presents a design method of low-frequency small signal amplifier using two-stage amplifier circuit: preamp circuit was composed by differential amplifying circuit and mirror constant - current circuit, and the second-stage amplifier circuit consists of the voltage amplifier circuit and the current amplifier circuit which was constituted by complementary amplifier circuit and the output-driving circuit. Data acquisition and display was achieved by MCU. Noise voltage is less than 5mV, the distortion degree is less than 1%, and frequency band is between 7Hz and 100KHz in this system.

articleTitle: Selection of watermark coefficient effect wavelet digital watermarking performance
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: With the development of Internet, there are more and more challenges to the protection of digital works. In this paper, we research the technology of wavelet digital watermarking which is used to protect digital images. According to different embedded coefficients, we've done some experiments and analyses. And finally found the relationship between the embedded coefficient and watermarking transparency, robustness or anti-attack ability.

articleTitle: Simulation research on frequency conversion system with flux open loop vectors control
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The simulation of frequency conversion system with flux open loop vectors control is studied in this paper. The modeling and simulation of the vectors control system with flux open loop are completed by applying electrical principles and the toolbox of Simulink and PowerSystem in the Matlab software. The paper mainly introduced the modeling of the speed regulation system and the setting of parameters of the controller, The simulation results and the actual ones matched basically, which proved the correctness of the model. The comparison between the flux open loop vectors control frequency conversion system and the normal one proved the feasibility and superiority of the system.

articleTitle: Study on product with complex surface design for quality-controlling in manufacture
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Product with complex surface could be applied in many industry fields, such as automobile, airplane, household appliances and so on. The gap between design model and machining model brings many troubles in fast, effective and precise transition process from design to manufacture. Design, machining and measurement of complex surface become keys to improve product quality. By subdivision application, information from design to manufacture could be kept effectively. With two examples designed in self-developed software, study on product with complex surface design for quality-controlling in manufacture was verified effectively and strongly.

articleTitle: The food chain model with impulsive effect and the stage structure
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: A class of food chain model with impulsive effect, delay and the stage structure of the highest predator is discussed in this paper. Considering to continuously capture the adult of the highest predator and capture the prey at different fixed moment, we analyze the boundedness of solution for the system, the sufficient conditions of global attractivity of the predators-extinction periodic solutions and systems uniform persistence are obtained.

articleTitle: The microwave-absorption mechanisms of hydrogen plasma in carbon nanotubes
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper, we investigate theoretically the microwave-absorption mechanisms of hydrogen plasma in carbon nanotubes based on the principle of interaction between the microwave and the liberal electron, and an expression of microwave-absorbing attenuations coefficient is obtained. The numerical results indicate that there is strong absorption attenuation in the range of 0.5 GHz~4.5 GHz when n<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">e</sub> = 2.281×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">17</sup> m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup> and v<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">e</sub> = 22.0 GHz, but displaying weak absorption in the range of 10~30 GHz. The experimental phenomena of strong microwave absorption (only around 2.45 GHz) by Hydrogen Plasma in CNTs could be explained.

articleTitle: Study on shear strength of frozon soils under secondary freeze-thaw action
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The shear strength characteristics of two representative kinds of soils from Shanghai soft soil strata in original state, freeze-thaw and secondary freeze-thaw state were tested in laboratory, and the results were analyzed. The changing characteristics of cohesion and internal friction angle were found. The different effects of second freeze-thaw cycles on the two kinds of soil were gained. The results proved valuable reference to the design of freezing works in Shanghai.

articleTitle: Investigating the effects of implementing online tutoring in a Chinese afterschool program
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Recently, e-learning platforms have been used in afterschool tutoring programs for rural schools in Taiwan. This study investigated the effects of applying one-on-one online tutoring in an afterschool program in an elementary school. The program of tutoring the subject of language arts lasted for 14 weeks. Ten tutees participated in this program. A questionnaire was administered to the tutee to gain their perspectives of the effects of online learning. This study finds students showed positive attitudes toward online tutoring, they achieved good academic performance, and they appreciated the tutors' help. The study offers pedagogical suggestions for researchers who are interested in researching this topic.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Study on the habitability of traditional dwellings
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Study of self-adaptive RBF neural network control method for the engine idle speed control
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper presents that studying the performance of the Self-adaptive RBF neural network control method for the idle speed control. Designing a kind of a self-adaptive RBF neural network controller through controlling with the throttle valve and the spark advance angle for engine idle speed, and in the sudden variable load of idle speed is simulated based on Matlab/Simulink platform. The results show that the idle speed ripple value is less than 8rpm, and obviously reduce the engine idle speed fluctuation with controlling the throttle valve and the spark advance angle, which performance better than only by controlling the throttle valve, improving the stability of engine idling.

articleTitle: Analysis on plant landscape characteristics of monastery garden in Fuzhou
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The plant landscape of monastery gardens in Fuzhou have their own distinctive uniqueness in terms of the choice of plant species and plant configuration. This paper investigated some representative monastery gardens in Fuzhou from their plant species selection and configuration. It analyzed and summarized the characteristics of plant species selection and plant landscape of monastery gardens in Fuzhou.

articleTitle: A filter trust region method of a new conic model for unconstrained optimization
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: A trust-region algorithm based on new conic model is presented for unconstrained optimization problems by combining filter and nonmonotone technique. When a trial step is not successful, a filter line search is taken to reduce the number of re-solving subproblem as far as possible. The global convergence of the algorithm is proved under certain conditions. Numerical tests show the algorithm is effective.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Based on the Zhejiang traditional architecture to extract the elements of the tradition national color-culture psychology carries on the knowledge management and culture innovation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Performance analysis on liquid dessicant system with condensing heat regeneration
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Liquid desiccant air conditioning system with condensing heat regeneration was presented in this paper, which integrated vapour compression refrigeration system and liquid desiccant system. The heat rejected from the condenser was used to regenerate the liquid desiccant to improve the performance of system and conserve energy. The influences of inlet parameters such as air, solution on the performance of liquid desiccant air conditioning system with condensing heat regeneration were discussed. Research results demonstrated that liquid desiccant air conditioning system with condensing heat regeneration had remarkable energy saving effect when it was used to reduce the moisture content of fresh air in summer, and characteristics of evaporative condensing regenerator played an important role in performance of system. The COP of liquid desiccant system is 1.18 higher than vapour compression refrigeration system.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Assessment method study of highway transport environmental safety
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: The value of rank-sum test in the tracing of quality — Rectifying diagnosis of tracing transmission assembly quality
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In the tracing of transmission quality, if the tracing result got through the analysis method of horizontal contrast is applied in decision-making, effects of proposed improvement measures are not obvious. In this thesis, characteristics of raw data are analyzed, rank-sum test is adopted to conduct tracing analysis, different tracing results are got and the tracing of transmission quality is scientifically rectified. Practical results show that the tracing conclusion drawn from rank-sum test is convictive.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: New thought about harmony between human and natural mountains and rivers: Afforesting and ecological construction of the unifying of city and countryside
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Experimental research on flue gas desulfurization by water mist
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Flue gas desulfurization process with water mist was conducted on spray-spouted tower. By use of fine limestone particles as the desulfurization sorbent, the experiments to investigate the effects of operating conditions on the SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> removal efficiency had been carried out. Results showed that it has been obtained that the SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> removal efficiency was 80% Some alkali metal compounds (such as NaON, NaCl, MgCl<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>) have been used as an additive to improve the SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> removal efficiency. The experimental results show that the three additives can increase significantly desulfurization efficiency. The effects of NaOH and NaCl are better than MgCl<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>, the desulfurization efficiency using the additives is over 90% comparative with without additives process.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Based on grouped interactive teaching mode reform: — ≪Object-oriented programming≫ to discuss teaching reform
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Study on protection and renaissance of the traditional villages of South Anhui under multi-cultures — Taking the historical block of Shuidong Town, Xuancheng City, Anhui province
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Restrains the OSPF routing method based on the genetic algorithm the research
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: OSPF is one of the routing protocols which is the most widely used in internet and intranet today. The link-state algorithm in OSPF is based on the thought of local optimization, but in certain cases, routing algorithms based on local optimization might lead to a disadvantage which will remarkably depress global performances. A self-adaptive method based on the genetic algorithm is proposed, which utilizes local information to achieve self-adaptive randomization and harmonize each router's local performance requests, which also improves the network transmit performance in both network delay and link cost, synchronously, local optimization in routing algorithms is solved well.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The risk control of public works contract compliance in Taiwan — The thought construction industry should be considered
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: The coordination work between engine management system and TCU in transmission control
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In automatic transmission control, we need intervene engine torque control through TCU. In this paper, its necessity, basic mechanism, main condition will be deeply discussed as well as the key issues that need attention in the implementation. The issues that torque distribution for hybrid vehicle automatic transmission control are also discussed.

articleTitle: Design of centrifuge electric control system based on PLC
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In according to the technical process of filtrating system and the basic designing principle of electric control system, this system is realized by Siemens S7-200 PLC for the important production process of filtering the product from the fluids in the centrifuge reactor in the petrochemical industry. Depend on the control requirement of the system, the main circuit diagram and control circuit diagram would be designed, and then analysing the internal logic.

articleTitle: Research of twin-cutter turing automatic programming system based on CAX integration technology
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Based on the analysis of the twin-cutter turning characteristics and requirement of CNC programming, twin-cutter turning automatic programming system adopting CAX integration technology is developed. CAD, CAPP, CAM, CAT are integrated by CAX, function complement each other and information closed-loop flow in the system. The product description, process design, NC code generation and simulation are realized.

articleTitle: Studies on simulation of queue system in ticketing business based on event-driven mechanism
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Based on Event-driven mechanism queue system in ticketing business conducted a systematic analysis, using the event scheduling simulation strategy, the establishment of latency and the window based on the number of simulation models. The interaction between the average customer waiting time and the number of service windows was studied under the certain condition of predetermined the number of service window at the beginning. The simulation results with actual data comparison, analysis of the validity of the model. The model allowed the ticket offices to save costs and increase customer satisfaction, provide a useful reference.

articleTitle: The dynamic response of nearly saturated cohesive soil to impact and its deformation and strength behavior after impact
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Unconsolidated-undrained triaxial tests were conducted on the nearly saturated fine-grained samples after being impacted. The axial deformation and induced pore pressure during impact and the stress - strain relationship and strength parameters after impact were investigated.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Study on persistence diagnosis of China's construction energy-saving process based on chain management
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: The method of the test of pile-soil stress ratio of the composite ground under Geotechnical Grille in field
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The parameter of diaphragm type earth pressure cells (EPC) is usually determined from calibration test by applying a known fluid pressure to the EPC and recoding the output, it cannot be used when the normal stress in soil was measured by EPC. According to the stress distribution on the pile top and the earth face between piles within the composite ground under Geotechnical Grille, calibration tests of EPC were conducted under the condition which can reflect stress distribution features on piles top and earth face between piles, and the simulation calibration factors were obtained which can be used to calculate the stress of piles top and earth face between piles directly. The simulation calibration test indicated that the factor from the simulation calibration test of the piles was less than the factor from the fluid calibration test, and the curve from the simulation calibration test of the pile was a parabola, and the amount of measurement result from the fluid calibration factor was 1.36~2.4 times to the simulation calibration factor. It also indicated that the factor from simulation calibration test of the earth face between piles closed to the fluid calibration factor, and the simulation calibration curve close to line. The example of engineering showed that the pile-soil stress ratio is relatively small if all use the uniform calibration factors, Calculation results of the pile-soil stress ratio of composite ground under flexible foundation was 1.7~2.9 if used the simulation calibration factors of pile and the earth face between the piles respectively.

articleTitle: The research application of inspection robot for the smart grid
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Catering to the new strategic project of smart grid, this paper introduces a design of high-voltage transmission inspection robot, which worked on earth wire and so that automatically inspection on the entire transmission line becomes the reality. Robot control system using hierarchical control structure, included remote management host, robot control ontology and motor drives. Under the auto-operation mode, it makes its own decisions for planning the sequence of operations according to knowledge data base without the upper layer's involvement. Using image recognition obstacle and expert data base, the combined method of using laser sensor over obstacles, the inspection robot autonomous obstacle had came true. The experiment and test results show that the inspection robot system has possessed the capabilities of navigation and inspection tasks on the power lines. It has a good application prospect.

articleTitle: Treatment and reuse of printing and dyeing wastewater using BAF/DM technology
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In the paper, the integrated wastewater reclamation system of the combined biological aerated filter (BAF) and dynamic membrane (DM) technology was feasible and effective for dyeing and printing wastewater treatment. The experiment was carried out continuously under of the optimal condition of hydraulic retention time (HRT) of 1.0 h, pH of 7.0-8.5, temperature of 25-30°C and an air/water volume flow ratio about 2:1 in the biological aerated filter reactor, and that dynamic membrane was run at an optimal of the operating pressure of 0.15MPa, and the cross-flow velocity of 1m/s. The results showed that the average concentration of COD, color and turbidity in the effluent were less than 50 mg/L, 15 times, 2NTU, respectively. The average COD, color, turbidity removal efficiencies were 90%, 91% and 90% respectively. The experimental results showed that showed that the integrated wastewater reclamation system is increasingly considered as a competitive method to printing and dyeing wastewater treatment.

articleTitle: Study on braking distance with combination control strategy of permanent magnetic brake system for high speed train
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Analyzed the present situation of emergency braking during train high speed movement and the merit and operational characteristic of permanent magnetic brake system were introduced. Considered the characteristic of emergency braking and service braking, the necessity of applying permanent magnetic brake and united brake control was expounded. Based on this, studied the control strategy and united brake flow with the control objective of braking distance, and calculated the emergency braking distance with different level of adhesion used and non-adhesion brake ratio, then discussed the change of braking distance with using united brake control before and after. The results proved that there are good effects on shortening braking distance and improving working conditions of main braking system with using magnetic brake system in high speed railway.

articleTitle: Study and analysis of coal mine gunite system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper, the structure of the coal mine pneumatic-driven gunite system was shown, the working principle of pneumatic hydraulic system was analyzed; the dynamic characteristic of the gunite material in the screw propeller was also analyzed in detail. The study to the pressure, flow rate and torque or power is very helpful to the designing of the machine. The conclusion can be obtained that benefit of this gunite system applied in coal mine is practicable.

articleTitle: Research on vibration reduction performance of holey straight bevel gear
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Different from the tooth profile modification, a design of the holey straight bevel gear is proposed. Based on the sphere involutes deduced with the engaging principle, the precise model is established by Pro/E in the first place. Then the finite element model is established in HyperWorks and the transmission error is analyzed. Finally taking transmission error together with mesh impact as the dynamic excitation, the dynamic models of the holey straight bevel gear are built and the acceleration mean square of the dynamic steady state response is applied to express the vibration and noise subsequently. The result shows that, comparing with the ordinary gears the holey gears have better performance on the reduction of vibration and noise.

articleTitle: Optimization of preparation parameters and characterization of the Mn0.5Zn0.5Fe2O4 thermal-sensitive magnetic ferrofluid prepared by the hydro-thermal method
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The bare magnetic Mn<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.5</sub>Zn<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.5</sub>Fe<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> nanoparticles were prepared by the hydro-thermal method. The optimized preparation conditions were obtained by the orthogonal experiment. Crystal structure and the grain diameter of the particles were observed by X-ray Diffraction (XRD) and Transmission Electron Microscope (TEM), and the Curie temperature of the bare particles and the performance of the magnetic moment of the particles at different temperatures were characterized by the Vibrating Sample Magnetometer (VSM). The bare particles were modified by the oleic acid, and the modification effect was verified by the Infrared Test (IR). Mn<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.5</sub>Zn<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.5</sub>Fe<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> thermal-sensitive magnetic ferrofluid with excellent performance were prepared by dissolving the modified particles in the kerosene carrier. The saturation magnetization could reach up to 278Gs and the Curie temperature is confirmed to be 322K, which indicates that the quality of the Mn<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.5</sub>Zn<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.5</sub>Fe<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> thermal-sensitive ferrofluid is better than other Mn<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.5</sub>Zn<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.5</sub>Fe<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> thermal-sensitive ferrofluids prepared by the coprecipitation method previously reported (Saturation magnetization: 150Gs, Curie temperature: 340K).

articleTitle: Discussing the reform of programming courses through the practice of “Data Structures”
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The ability of programming is basic for students to get comprehensive information literacy, so we analysis the problems about programming courses, and put forward that it is important and necessary to reform programming courses teaching model and methods. Through the course of “Data Structures” teaching practice, we study and discuss the programming courses reform content.

articleTitle: Study on the engineering diseases of the loess regions construction
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Because of the special engineering nature of loess, for example: water sensitivity, large holes, structural, etc., resulting in a variety of engineering disease appeared in the building in loess area. These diseases cause great losses to life and property.
