The simulation results show that with the increase of incidence, the region under the effect of pressure difference extends towards the blade leading edge, and the position of leakage vortex generation moves progressively upstream; Moreover, with pressure-side winglet, at all these incidences, the blade loading near the tip are increased, thus the strength of tip leakage flow is intensified, and the aerodynamic performance of the cascade is deteriorated.

articleTitle: Study on landscape ecology compensatory design of old urban riverside area
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Discusses the re-utilization of the riverside, comparing the differences between the regular design of riverside and ecological balance. Further summarizing the strategy of the old urban riverside ecological stability, according to the gathering of internal and external empirical research and methods of contrast and analysis: First, the antecedence measure of the river's ecological balance, including using engineering measures to compensate the natural morphology of the channel, compensating riparian buffer morphology zone by stratification, natural prototype embankment to compensate riparian habitat, and the measure of biological conversation to compensate everglade systems of the channel; Second, putting forward the measure of compensation for riparian old historical : protection of historical relic buildings and dynamic function replacement, “Facadism” protection of historical old buildings, compensation for the local customs; Third, consummating the system of road. Utilizing the ecological compensation design to reduce the interference to environment in a maximum degree.

articleTitle: Study on shaking table test of a L-form and expanded single story masonry building in Damxung — One part of the serial shaking table tests of seismic strengthening of comfortable housing project for farmers and herdsmen in Tibet
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper, the shaking table test of a L-form and expanded single story masonry building in Damxung county is introduced, this is one part of the serial tests of seismic strengthening of comfortable housing project for farmers and herdsmen in Tibet autonomous region. The acceleration and displacement in elasticity, creaking and failure process are tested and the earthquake resistant capability of this type of building is analyzed. The results show that this kind of building can meet 9-degree requirement for fortification against earthquake, which can provide scientific basis for the earthquake-resistant, design and construction of housing projects for farmers and herdsmen in Tibet. Finally, some reasonable suggestions are given.

Author Keywords: t comfortable housing project for farmers and herdsmen

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Environment and economic social development of healthy adaptation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Research on 2-D SDCT method based on parallel computing
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Now, 2-D DCT is applied widely in the field of signal processing. But the transform is operated by twice 1-D DCT successively, which limits the operation efficiency to improve farther. To overcome such drawbacks, a new method based on parallel computing is proposed in the paper. First, a sort of new matrix operation algorithm and a new transform matrix are defined in the interest of convenient parallel computing. Then, 2-D SDCT is operated integrally based on the new transform matrix and new matrix operation criterion. The theoretical analysis shows that the calculating amount of the proposed method to compute 2-D DCT only needs one equivalent multiplication and a few equivalent additions, and the operation efficiency relative to other fast algorithms is improved notably.

articleTitle: Inspection and recognition of optical target in Opto-Eleetronic target tracking system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Inspection and recognition of optical target are one of important research field in Opto-Eleetronic target tracking. According to need for project, system of Inspection and recognition of optical target is proposed based on digital signal processor TMS320 DM642. The system block diagram for hardware design is discussed, and algorithm flow diagram as well as detailed software processing algorithm is described. It is proved by experiment that this system can steadily inspect and recognize the optical target in a certain complex background.

articleTitle: A call admission control strategy for TD-SCDMA trunking communication system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: With the growth of bandwidth adaptive applications in wireless and mobile networks with different QoS requirements, there is an urgent need for an adaptive bandwidth management scheme which makes use of the flexible bandwidth requirements of these new traffic classes. In this paper, a Call Admission Control (CAC) strategy is proposed based on full consideration of the adaptivity of multimedia services and the priority of trunking user, in which Initial Access Rate Discount and Deceleration is adopted. The algorithm improves the flexibility of system resource allocation by using different initial access rate for different services according to their characteristics; Meanwhile, utilizing deceleration strategy to further ensure the Quality of Service (QoS) of high-priority users and services. Compared with existing schemes, the proposed algorithm improves the overall performance of system.

IEEE Keywords: Time division synchronous code division multiple access

articleTitle: Effect of weld parameters on weld quality in sheet to tube joining with simulation and experimental research
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Single sided resistance spot welding (SSRSW) developed from RSW is a feasible plan to join vehicle structure to closed-form tube and is increasingly used in automobile manufacturing. Successful implementation of SSRSW to improve structural crashworthiness and reduce vehicle weight requires knowledge of issues related not only to joint performance but also processing requirements. In this study, effects of weld processing parameters on weld quality were researched by numerical and experimental method. It was found that the width of the weld lobe is narrow and the weldability of sheet and tube is bad under constant electrode force. Reasonable processing parameter matching is very important to the sheet to tube welding.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The study of passive location system based on the change of phase
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: The multi-basispoint and time-sharing measurement method for large lathe geometric precision detection based on laser tracker
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Aiming at low efficiency, low accuracy and other issues existing in large lathes geometric precision detection, the paper proposes a new method of measuring geometric precision of lathes. The method is based on the principle of GPS positioning, Using a laser tracker on four different positions, the coordinates of the same target points with a continuous trajectory could be acquired. By a large number of coordinates of the target points, the redundant equations could be established. By solving the equations· the precise location of the movement target points could be obtained. The 13 geometric errors could be separated through the coordinates of the target points. The method is called multi-basispoint and time-sharing measurement in the article.

articleTitle: Effect of the plasma and temperature on the chemical components of particulate matter using corona discharge
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: NTP (Non-thermal Plasma) is one of a promising applications for decontamination of particulate matter, but the research on the chemical components of particulate matter treated by plasma is poor. Particulate matter collected by plasma reactor and filters with NTP action and without NTP action was measured by TGA (Thermogravimetric Analysis). The chemical reactions between radical and particulate matter were researched. And GC/MS (Gas Chromatography/Mass Spectrometry) was used to analyze the PAHs (Polycyclic Aromatic Hydrocarbons) of particulate. The experimental results indicate that after the NTP reaction, the rate of SOF(Soluble Organic Fraction) and DS (Dry Soot), and the concentration of inorganic salt on particulate both increase, and the content of PAHs is lowered.

articleTitle: Mechanical properties of nano montmorillonite modified wood-plastic composites
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Nano montmorillonite was treated by different chemical methods, and the nano particle modified wood-plastic composites were prepared by compression molding process, the effect of nano montmorillonite loading on the mechanical properties of the composites was investigated. The results show that, proper amount of nano montmorillonite can improve the tensile, flexural and impact properties of the composites, when nano montmorillonite is organized with cetyltrimethylammonium bromide, the tenisle properties of the composites except for the elongation at break can be furthermore improved, while the composites will have the best flexural and impact properties when the organicized nano particles are treated with coupling agent. The maximum increases of tensile strength, tensile modulus, flexural strength, flexural modulus and impact strength of nano particle modified WPCs are by 102.72%,179.76%,150.35%,47.02% and 110.71% compared to those of neat WPC respectively.

articleTitle: Influence of masonry structural building crossed by double-line parallel shield tunnel
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Considering the interaction of building-soil-tunnel, the raft foundation masonry building vertical crossed by double-line parallel shield tunnel was simulated by 3D MIDAS/GTS software, and the impact of construction on the building was analyzed. The results show that: When the distance between double-line parallel shield tunnel axis and building axis was zero (L=0m), after the left-line had already passed the building, with the increase of shield tunnel distance, the settlement of the building increased. During the right-line shield tunnel excavation, the building's foundation had differential settlement in driving direction, and it increased first and then decreased gradually to zero. The building's maximum lateral horizontal decreased, and the maximum longitudinal displacement increased first and then decreased. The maximum first principal stress P<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> exceed the standard value which may cause some structural cracking. With the increase of L from zero, the settlement curves' shape changed, and they tilted towards to one side of the tunnel, and the largest settlement increased first and then decrease, and the local foundation tilt increased first and then decreased. When double-line parallel shield tunnel axis and the axis coincide with the building axis, the building maximum first principal stress and maximum shear strain reached the maximum. When the double-line parallel shield tunnel was under the building, it may cause large harm to the building. When the two-lane tunnel is moving away from the building, its adverse effects on the building was decline. Finally, the safety of the building was assessed comprehensively.

articleTitle: A low complexity antenna selection algorithm for multiuser MIMO systems
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Block diagonalization (BD) is a downlink precoding technique that cancels inter-user interference in downlink multiuser MIMO systems. But the number of simultaneously supportable receive antennas is limited by the number of base station transmit antennas for multiuser MIMO systems with BD. When a large number of receive antennas exist, the base station can select a subset of receive antennas for each user to maximize the system throughput. The exhaustive search for the optimal selection, however, is computationally prohibitive. In this paper, we propose a low complexity suboptimal antenna selection algorithm which is based on the channel Frobenius norm (F-norm) for multiuser MIMO systems with BD. Simulation results show that our proposed algorithm can be close to the sum capacity of the optimal algorithm.

articleTitle: Simulation of a DC chopper using single phase matrix converter topology
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Choppers are widely used for traction motor control in electric automobiles and other electric transportation system. In those applications, control of dc motor's speed is required where the supply is dc or an ac voltage that has been rectified. This paper presents work on development of four quadrant DC chopper based on the SPMC topology, an advanced topology that hypothetically could perform many different converter functions. Prior to hardware implementation a computer simulation model was developed using the Power System Block Set (PSB) within the MATLAB/Simulink (MLS) environment, to study the behaviors of the proposed converter. Successful results presented are mainly due to the use of resistive load to reduce complexities. Results from PSB simulation are compared with those obtained from PSpice to ascertain its validity. The output is being synthesized using Pulse Width Modulation (PWM) technique. It is shown that the same SPMC topology could be used as a DC chopper extending the versatility of the topology a desirable feature in the future as increases in costs for skilled manpower could be traded-off with versatile technology.

articleTitle: Application of fault tolerant and federated strong tracking Kalman algorithm in integrated navigation system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: An improved federated strong tracking Kalman filter has been proposed creatively and has been used in loose coupling MSINS/GPS integrated navigation system. Adopting three-layer fault tolerant structure, it can effectively check the errors of data outlier, GPS's velocity jump and the malfunction of the filter state estimate. When the system fault has been diagnosed, it can be insulated in real time, which can make this system have better ability of tolerant the faults. The simulation results show that this approach can resolve the problem of the correlation of GPS's position and velocity measurement data, GPS's velocity jump and the system's sensitivity to initial values. Thus, the real time character, Robust and the ability of tolerating faults of the system has been improved.

articleTitle: Detection and quantitation of insulin-like growth factor-1 in velvet antler by an enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: An enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA) was used to detect the content of insulin-like growth factor-1 (IGF-1) in velvet antler water extract. The ELISA was validated with respect to parallelism, recovery, intra-assay variation, and inter-assay variation. The practical working range of detection was estimated to be 0.8 to 200 ng/mL, and the recovery was 96.7% or more. The effect of sample matrix was assessed by serial dilution. The result indicated that this ELISA method is a reliable, safe, and cost-effective tool for determination of IGF-1 content in velvet antler and serum.

articleTitle: Research of updating strategy using WIFI network for multimedia files in bus system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In order to meet the updating strategy requirements in the bus systems by WIFI network, the optimized ant colony algorithm is proposed in the updating application of multimedia files in bus system. Firstly, the existing problems of the updating strategy are illustrated and the mathematical model of the updating strategy is established. Then the algorithm is constructed based on the ant colony system. Through the analysis of the feasible solution problem, the vehicle updating sequence which makes the multimedia files updated efficiently is achieved. The simulations on matlab are also carried out. Finally, it is demonstrated that the optimized ant colony algorithm is well applied in the updating strategy of multimedia files for the bus system.

articleTitle: Research on the structure and PLC control of a new automatic tool changer
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: With the development of society and technology, the operation methods of industrial production are changing gradually from artificial operation to automation and intellectualization. The way of the artificial tool changer is still used in most of enterprises. While, not only the efficiency of the way is low, but also the precision is low. In the recent years, in order to meet the needs of production, the automatic tool changer system is playing more and more important roles. This topic is ZhenJiang industrial science and technology support project. The project is based on the parameters of special-shaped screw of CNC milling machine of JiangSu QiHang NC limited company to design the automatic tool changer. Based on this, a new automatic tool changer is designed and controlled in the paper.

articleTitle: An assessment model of lifecycle energy consumption in resident buildings and case study
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: With increasing of building energy consumption in China, the role of green architecture in the sustainable development of construction industry is more and more important. As the living standard of people improved, together with high-demand of comfort level, the energy consumption of resident buildings which are so closely related to our lives tends to increase rapidly. In this situation, we should pay more attention to reducing energy consumption in resident buildings. Based on total life cycle theory, this paper has further explicated the calculation of energy consumption in each stage of resident buildings and set up an assessment model. The assessment accuracy will be raised under a series of assessment index defined in the model. It lays the foundation for resident buildings energy conservation, at the same time, promotes the sustainable development.

articleTitle: The research of process-oriented knowledge-based CAD system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Previous Knowledge-Based Engineering (KBE) systems have difficulty in effectively managing the whole design process which often makes the modeling of product fall into chaos. Process-oriented knowledge-based CAD system is proposed in this paper to manage product design process. For realizing process-oriented knowledge-based CAD system, mathematical representations of process design are proposed; the algorithms of process planning using graph theory are studied. A detailed discussion about typical design is put forward including process-oriented knowledge based design methods and architecture. The implementation of Process-oriented knowledge based design of reducer is studied as a case. Process-oriented knowledge-based CAD system is realized which makes the whole design process efficient and stable.

articleTitle: Linear controller design based on the fastest-response for inertial system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper introduces the algorithm of the analog controller design by example of Multi-Inertial-Feature System according to the requirement of the Fastest-Response control. This algorithm identifies the parameters of the multi-order system by LSM with the output and input data firstly; then it calculates the Fastest-Response data according to the multi-order system's feature; finally, the data of control signals were calculated, the controller design was established according to the fastest response control of the high-order system and the controller parameters of the closed loop system were identified with these input and output data.

articleTitle: In-situ remediation of petroleum contaminated groundwater: Application and prospect of permeable reactive barrier
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Remediation of petroleum contaminated groundwater has become one of hotspots in environment research in recent years. PRB is a cost-effective and environmental benign technology. Based on the PRB technology abroad and domestically, this paper puts forward reactive media should be screened based on the ingredients, types and properties of the pollutants. Design and construction of PRB should be rely on the hydrogeological conditions of contaminated site. Immobilizing microorganism is an effective way to improve remediation efficiency and prolong using life of adsorption PRB. PRB has broad application prospects in remediation of petroleum contaminated groundwater.

articleTitle: A banner ads searching and counting system for sports videos
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The ads exposure frequency in a TV is very important for the pricing of the advertising. If we count this exposure frequency by person, it will be very time consuming and error-prone. In this paper, we propose an approach and design a system for searching and counting the number of banner ads appearing in sports videos. The searching proceeds by matching feature points from pre-specified sample ads using the color histogram and the SURF (Speeded-Up Robust Features) algorithm. This searching approach can robustly identify objects among scaling and partial occlusion while achieving near real-time performance. This system worked effectively in our experiments using real videos.

articleTitle: Energy saving with multi-connections over IEEE 802.16e networks
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper considers the energy saving problem of IEEE 802.16e networks which consist of a base station and multiple mobile stations. The mobile station may establish one or multiple connections that have specific QoS requirements, including a bandwidth requirement and delay bounds. Since the mobile station turns off the transceiver to save energy when all connections of the mobile station enter sleep mode. Hence, for minimizing the energy consumption of the mobile station has to schedule each connection efficiently according to the QoS requirements and its sleep cycle. The proposed problem is formulated as an ILP problem that minimize the total number of active frames to save energy. A heuristic algorithms, bandwidth reservation scheme (BRS), is also proposed to improve the computing efficiency. Our approaches not only guarantee the QoS for real-time connections, but also minimize power consumption of mobile stations. Simulation results demonstrate that BRS outperform the previous approaches in terms of energy saving and bandwidth utilization.

articleTitle: Application of the adaptive fuzzy PID controller in switched reluctance motor
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: As the SRD system is multivariable, highly coupled and nonlinear, it is difficult to get a satisfied result by the conventional control. In this paper, the adaptive fuzzy PID controller is designed as the speed regulator, by using the Simulink toolbox of the Matlab, the result shows that the controller can reduce the overshoot, improve the accuracy and possess good robustness.

articleTitle: An analysis of dynamic econometric on impact of mineral resource exploit on urbanization in xinjiang
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Mineral resource exploitation has important impact on region economic development, industrialization level and urbanization. Take xinjiang as example, this paper analysis the basic feature of mineral resource exploitation and urbanization, on this basis, dynamic computation model is established to discuss the relativity of mineral resource exploitation, economic development, industrialization level and urbanization by the method of granger causality test and co-integration analysis. The conclusions are as follows: Over the years, the development of mineral resources has affected urbanization level. whenever the mineral resource exploit index increases 1% will lead to 1.25% of urbanization level, mineral resource exploitation is the causation of development of industrialization level; urbanization level is the causation of mineral resource exploitation. At present, resource superiority is the favorable condition to the development xinjiang economic, which is not plunge into the trap of “resource curse”. Rational development and utilization of mineral resources is very pressing strategic issues in xinjiang.

articleTitle: Characteristic analysis of traction power transformer with coupling finite element method of magnetic field and circuit
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper, a coupling finite element method (FEM) of magnetic field and circuit of traction power transformer is established, including a two-dimensional finite element model and four-quadrant rectifier circuit. The no-load and short-circuit characteristics of traction power transformer are calculated and the value of impedance voltage is given. The space distributions of flux density, magnetic force line of traction power transformer are painted. The values and waveforms of the core loss and copper loss are calculated. The leakage inductance of the transformer replaces the input inductance of four-quadrant rectifier circuits which includes outer voltage PI control and inner current PR control. From the simulation results, it can be seen that the power factor is nearly one and the DC bus voltage is constant.

articleTitle: Study on the power transmission mechanism of a twin-rotor piston engine based on cyloid
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In order to increase the power density of the piston engine, the power transmission mechanism of a twin-rotor piston engine based on cycloid is introduced. The twin-rotor piston engine has a number of advantages compare to other piston engine type. The combination method of its unique power transmission mechanism which use the cycloid and the crank-rocker mechanism creating a cyclic rotary motion superposed on uniform rotary motion of the rotor is proposed. Two types of this mechanism designed by the method are derived. This has been examined through the kinematic analysis. The results show that this engine mechanism is compact and has the multiple power strokes per revolution of the flywheel.

articleTitle: Research on a new glass-curtain cleaning robot
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper introduces a new glass-curtain wall-cleaning robot with multi-suction cups. And the main structure, cleaning system and control system has been researched. When the robot absorb to the wall surface, it can slide down along the surface by a windlass on the roof depending on its own gravity while cleaning. With the motion of four suction cups by turns, the robot can move in vertical direction successfully. The experiments demonstrated that the kind of robot could be put into practice because of the simple mechanism, robust control and good cleaning effect.

articleTitle: Studies on HZSM-5 zeolite catalysts for desulfurization and denitrification
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This article focused on the removal of NO and SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> from flue gas using HZSM-5 zeolite as carrier of catalysts. The loading and modification of desulfurization catalyst V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sub>/ HZSM-5 were studied, and the best preparation procedure of denitrification catalyst Ni-Cu-Ce-La-HZSM-5 was investigated. Results showed that the best loading of V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sub> was 8%. CoO-K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>-V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sub>/HZSM-5 modified by cobalt and potassium sulphate had good activity and thermal stability. And the best preparation procedure of Ni-Cu-Ce-La-HZSM-5 was that HZSM-5 was acidulated by sulfuric acid solution firstly; and nickel ion exchange was implemented secondly; then the PH of the solution was adjusted to 7.8 thirdly when copper, cerium and lanthanum ion exchange was being implemented; and lastly, the catalyst could be produced after being dried and roasted. The best desulfurization efficiency and denitrication efficiency could be up to 98.153% and 99.416% separately when being experimented combinedly.

articleTitle: Research on regulator signal segment match to control valve in split range control system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This article presents the principle that is used to define the positive and negative polarity, which is based on the changes of regulator's input and output relative to the balance condition, the put out of corresponding relationship between high and low signal used in regulator in split control and many control valves.

articleTitle: An improved Kirsch human face image edge-detection method based on canny lgorithm
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In view of the Kirsch edge detection algorithm's shortage, a method of improved Kirsch human face edge detection was proposed. First, this method smoothed the original image with Gaussian filter, calculated its gradient image. Then, this method calculated the gradient image using the improved Kirsch algorithm, and extract edge according T<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf> and T<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> two. Computer simulation experiments indicated that the improved method is not susceptible to Noises, and it could detect weak edge. The result of the experiments showed that the effect of the improved method is super to the classical Kirsch edge detection method.

articleTitle: Mobile bookstore services of TD-SCDMA in E-paper devices
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: With the rapid development of wireless network, online reading has become available in mobile reading devices. E-reader users can read and buy books through wireless network. Users can not only access to real-time comprehensive resource, but also access to book reviews, book recommendations etc. 3G communicating technology significantly improved data transfer speed which can meet network transmission speed requirements for a variety of network applications. Mobile bookstore provides powerful service functions to mobile devices users. A bookstore application solution in E-paper reading device is presented in this paper. The wireless network of the scheme is designed by C/S structure. The system achieves "seamless connection" of user terminals. The workflow between client and server is suggested too, which can provides the technical basis of 3G mobile business applications.

articleTitle: Experimental research on new and old crack comprehensive repair to concrete beams
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: It is almost inevitable for concrete structural cracks to happen. But most of cracks can be patched and thus concrete structures can restore their original function. In order to improve the durability and reinforce the practical function of concrete structures, repairs can be done to the cracks. This study proposes new and old crack comprehensive repair technology. Experimental research on crack repair to concrete beams is conducted in the way of a combination of basalt fiber cement mortar and grouting method. Results show that shrinkage cracks and stressed cracks can be obviously patched; repaired structures also can obtain a good integration; bonding interface crack resistance can be obviously enhanced; and the durability of repaired structures are remarkably improved.

Author Keywords: new and old crack comprehensive repair technology

articleTitle: Effect of old mixture proportion on gradation and performance of recycled asphalt mixture
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Recycling technology for asphalt mixture has been widely applied. The old mixture proportion is an important index for the recycled asphalt mixture. According to the relationship of old-mixture gradation, proportion and design gradation of recycled mixture, the authors discussed the effects of old mixture proportion on gradation adjustment of recycled mixture. Recycled mixtures respectively containing 0%, 30%, 50%, 70% (by weight) of old mixture were prepared to analyze the influence of old mixture proportion on high and low temperature performance, water stability and aging resistance of recycled mixture. The results indicate that gradation of recycled mixture can not be adjusted to aiming gradation if the old mixture proportion was too large. With the increase of old mixture proportion, high temperature performance and aging resistance of recycled mixture enhance, but low temperature performance and water stability decay sharply. In practical application, reasonable proportion of old mixture should be determined according to gradation, performance demand and economy of recycled mixture.

articleTitle: Research of four roll strip mill axial force based on the finite element simulation analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This article researched the object of 2,250R2 mill, made simulation analysis of roll system in condition of adjusting roll cross angle, rolling speed and intersection position of cross rolls, it is concluded that roll cross angle, rolling press quantity, intersection position and rolling speed can change the size of the axial force, axial forces may float small by the pressing ratio increases, larger by rolling speed increases, bigger by adding more far intersection point position, This conclusions have realistic significance in cross rolling schedule making, and provide basis theory reducing rolling axial force.

articleTitle: An optimized rate control algorithm for H.264
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In order to obtain consecutive and smooth video encoding quality under the network bandwith and delay constrained, an optimal rate control algorithm was presented. Because the linear MAD prediction of the basic unit costs too many operations and exists deviation, in this paper, we present a new weighted mode for prediction, and more, macroblock layer rate control is added in the algorithm. Simulation results show that H.264 coder using our proposed algorithm effectively elevates PSNR and achieves lower bit rate.

articleTitle: A positioning and navigation algorithm of autonomous mobile robot
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: A navigation method based on stereo vision, compass and encoders is presented. It has been used in an autonomous mobile robot which developed by the group of the authors. The compass and encoders are used complementarily each other to get correct position. 3D vision-based path-planning makes the robot walk along a better path each calculation cycle and avoid bumping other objects. This navigation system is cheap and convenient to create, and its most important advantage is effective in practice.

articleTitle: Research and development of 4D construction management system for Zhenru Shanghai West Railway Station
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In order to enhance Zhenru Shanghai West Railway Station project management level and efficiency, Tongji University, cooperation with the inventors, developed 4D construction management system for Shanghai West Railway Station by establishing the Shanghai West Railway Station 4D information model and its information integration mechanism. The system implemented the construction visual simulation and 4D dynamic managements of construction progress, labors, materials, machinery by the mutual links of engineering model, construction schedule and resources. The experimental results show that 4D technology is supported to raise information management and improve the efficiency of the Zhenru Shanghai West Railway Station project. The research presents a new information management method for railway station construction, and has a high practical value and broad prospects.

articleTitle: Crashworthiness design of detachable cab
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper a conceptual detachable freight cab is designed to improve competitive capability of railway freight transportation by the formation of push-pull trains. The cab module is attached to the freight wagon with a beam fixed into the draw gear position after removal of the coupler, which is relocated at the front of cab module. Two side anti-climber buffers are fixed in the front of cab. A finite element model composing of the detachable cab and a supposed wagon is built. According to European Standard EN 15227, three crashworthy scenarios are simulated in LS-DYNA. The results of absorbed energy, forces, velocities, accelerations and deformations are assessed. It is proved that the crashworthiness design of the conceptual detachable cab is feasible.

articleTitle: Analysis of SF6 decomposition products by insulator flashover to detect the insulator condition
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: An evident fault occurs on the insulator surface accompanied by a remarkable insulator strength decline were detected, which is probably caused by the SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> decomposition products in the insulator flashover process. A simulation of flashover process on the insulator surface was built in this article in order to analyze the possible decomposition product of SF6. As a result, several specific decomposition products (eg. CS<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>) of the primary insulator material were discovered, which make it possible to assume the reaction mechanism and further application of insulator flashover process via analysis of specific gas such as CS<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>.

articleTitle: Image segmentation algorithm research for sport graphics based on artificial life
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper, linking with the basic principle of artificial life for image segmentation, on the basis of theory research, The segmented partitions emerge when the state of the lives reaches an equilibrium. The artificial life approach is promising in image processing because it is inherently parallel and coincides with the self-governing biological process. The final segmentation result is achieved at last. The experiments demonstrate the feasibility of the artificial life approach on both intensity images and color images. The experiment results prove that in the view of the sport image segmentation, this algorithm provides fast segmentation with high perceptual segmentation quality.

articleTitle: Study of iron release kinetics model when desalinated water transmitted in water distribution system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Desalinated water, which could destroy the original balance of pipe networks and water when transmitted in water distribution system, would result in the substandard effluent in pipe ends such as high turbidity, chromaticity or iron content caused by iron release. In this paper, a trial network was constructed in the laboratory to simulate the water quality condition of real water distribution system. A kinetics model based on iron release mechanism was established using the experimental data. On the whole, the prediction accuracy of this kinetics model is over 80%, and it can be used on iron release prediction. Especially, the longer the immersion time is, the better it works.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of buffer managment algorithm in wireless network based on NS2
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: To realize the real network system is always the most costing or unpractical during the research of wireless network. Simulating network algorithms by using Network Simulation 2 (NS2) is one of valid and economical research methods. In this paper, a new buffer management algorithm in wireless network is proposed and implemented based on NS2. The test results show the feasibility and effectiveness of using NS2 in wireless network simulation.

articleTitle: High frequency data processing method of the force balance vibrating accelerometer
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper studies the force-balance transducer digital recording of the offshore platform vibration detecting comprising instrumental high-frequency error correction data processing question primarily. The paper elaborated the data processing algorithm and introduced in detail the error correction of the instrument with the method of successive acceleration formula. To exemplify this theory, this article has given the newest adjustment processing result of the largest number character style record obtained in the May 12, 2008 Wenchuan earthquake. Furthermore, it also has provided macroseismic recording correction results of the offshore platform vibration examination with the wireless force-balance Vibration Sensor. The results indicate that the newly-proposed method of the data processing containing the instrumental high-frequency error correction of the force-balance sensor digital recording will obtain "the high fidelity" test data, which is more suitable for the application of structural parameter identification.

articleTitle: FEA of thermal-structural and dynamic characteristic of high-speed spindle
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The finite element dynamic analysis model of the spindle assembly was developed based on thermoelasticity and finite element method. The force and the thermal value of spindle were calculated. The static and dynamic characteristics were analyzed. The modal, frequency, stress and displacement were obtained. The influence of spindle structure and parameters on spindle dynamic characteristics was discussed, further, the weakness of spindle structure was founded. Analysis result provides foundation for optimization of machining spindle system in future.

articleTitle: Parameters optimization for the thread of crank-slider-CST type low rear protective device of truck: Parameters optimization for thread of crank-slider-CST protective device
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: To make the crank slider protective devices to meet the requirements of regulation, optimization was carried out to the absorbing thread of the crank-slider-CST protective device. Based on the finite element model in VPG and simulation in LS-DYNA, with the orthogonal optimization design, obtained the parameters of the absorbing thread. The crash speed in these simulations is 50km/h, which is higher than the regulatory speed. The simulation showed that all indexes could meet the regulation very well, and the effectiveness of the device was demonstrated.

articleTitle: Dynamic simulation for fuel cell based on distributed and lumped parameter models
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Research on dynamic behavior of the PEM (proton exchange membrane) fuel cell is very important to understand the operating mechanism, optimization fuel cell structure and the systematic integration. The paper was based on the distributed-parameter model and lumped-parameter model. Distributed-parameter model include conservation equations, and lumped-parameter model is based on electro-chemical model. The simulation was implemented with the PEM module of Fluent software and MATLAB/Simulink. A 3D structure model for single cell with a single channel is established. The simulations are about dynamic responses of voltage when current density varies. Compared with the results, we can know applications of these two models. Distributed-parameter model is more helpful in optimization of the cell structure and improving the cell's dynamic characteristics because it considers the property of the physical parameters. Lumped-parameter model is very useful in the modeling of single fuel cell, stack and the whole system and the optimization of control.

articleTitle: The rearch about the single-phase ground fault location based on backward travelling wave in small current grounding system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: On the basis of traditional traveling wave fault location method based on module component, the paper propose a new method based on modulus maximum and backward traveling wave and used in small current grounding system. Meanwhile, selecting the proper mother wavelets and summarizing algorithm and processes of fault location. Finally, simulating single-phase ground fault in the system of 35 KV in PSB of matlab7.1, verifying the correctness and accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on cast in-situ pile load bearing capacity characteristics in hand made excavation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Under special domestic conditions in yunnan province of complicated geological formation, different climatic conditions as well as uneven topography and relief, hand made excavation for cast in-situ piling, using on a large scale primary finite element software ADINA, a detailed research on the factors influencing the working mechanism, pile cap subsidence and end resistance is done. Load versus displacement graph is basically divided into 3 stages; During pile-soil interaction process, the soil body around the pile appears to take a shape of centre of basin type as in a subsidence state, pile end resistance continues to increase as pile cap load increases. At the same time load sharing with the extremity ends of the pile also continues to increase.

Author Keywords: hand made excavation cast in-situ pile

articleTitle: BPTC (196,96) code simulation and implementation in C-code DSP chip
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This study discussed the decoding mechanism of block product turbo code (BPTC) (196,96) and analyzed its efficiency, used the Hamming (15,11) and Hamming (13,9) block channel code combinations and block interleaving to construct a BPSK modulation and BPTC (196,96) coding system in the concept of feedback encoding in turbo code. The system is based on the Analog Device DSP platform, the C code is used to simulate BPSK modulation and demodulation module, AWGN channel module, BPTC (196,96) coding module to construct a wireless communication system, so as to observe its coding efficiency, and compare its complexity and coding gain with one-dimension Hamming code (15,11). This study also discussed the physical mechanism of decoding difference between Hamming code and BPTC. When the C code system program is constructed, the system program should be optimized and realized on the DSP platform, fast verification and similar functions to software defined radio (SDR) can be realized by replacing modules, such as modulation modules, channel modules and coding modules.

articleTitle: Energy-aware data gathering and routing protocol based on double cluster-heads
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper proposed an Energy-aware Data Gathering Protocol Based on Double Cluster-heads EAGRDC. Vice cluster head is added in the cluster to responsible for data forwarding, thus it can unload part of the energy consumption of the main cluster head, so the frequency of the cluster head become death node can be decreased in the network, thus effectively balance the residual energy of nodes in the network. When routing between clusters, a layer structure is used to seek the next hop node. The experiment results showed that, compared to LEACH and EADEEG, EAGRDC can effectively extend the time of death of node 30 rounds, and its number of cluster head is the most stable, thus it can significantly prolong the lifetime of network.

articleTitle: Design and adjustment of ultrasonic torsional vibration acoustic system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The ultrasonic torsional vibration acoustic system is devised. The system consists of a ultrasonic generator, two longitudinal transducer, two longitudinal horn, a reverse horn and bearing components. It is of the vibration frequency 20.7 KHz and ultrasonic vibration amplitude 15μm. The system is installed in the Lathe Slide to boring the precision deep hole. Ultrasonic generator has been improved because phase-locked tracking band-pass filter is made use of. It make better track of the cutting process, the system work stable, anti-interference ability, power output large and stable. The key features of a complex acoustic system design and commissioning are described.

articleTitle: Research of three-axis vibration sensor and calibration method based on MEMS
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Aerocraft flight test for multiple directions of vibration signals, we designed a three-axis MEMS-based vibration sensor. Paper-based three-axis MEMS vibration sensor starting the design process, detailed design of the whole process of the sensor. Highlighted in the design process should pay attention to the issues and practical applications for the sensor issues arising in the corresponding calibration methods to ensure the reliability of the sensor, and in practical applications with satisfactory results.

articleTitle: A high speed chaos controller for modified coupled dynamos system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: To control the chaos of the Modified Coupled Dynamos System (MCDS), a high speed chaos controller is presented. The model of the modified coupled dynamos system and its chaos behaviors are introduced and analysized firstly, then the tridiagonal structure matrix stability theory is introduced, and based on this stability theory, the proposed chaos controller' effectiveness is proved. The proposed controller in this paper is simple to be implemented in practice. What's more, the transient time can be shorted by increasing the control parameter' value. Simulation results show that theoretical analysis is proper and the proposed method is effective.

articleTitle: Construction of trunking communication system in CERS based on multi-living agent method
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Based on the system theories, this paper analyzes the trunking communication system in CERS (City Emergency Response System) by using of the technology of multi-living agent and the function of the trunking communication system in CERS, then the author proposes to build the trunking communication system in CERS by using multi-living agent method; finally the paper analyzes the basic structure and workflows of the trunking communication system in CERS based on multi-living agent method.

articleTitle: Study of heat transfer performance of tube-fin heat exchanger with interrupted annular groove fin
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The numerical analysis on convective heat transfer behavior and pressure drop characteristics of staggered circular tube bank fin heat exchanger with smooth fin and with interrupted half annular groove fin is carried out under the conditions of different tube rows (1,2,3,4,5), different fin spans (1.5mm, 2mm, 2.5mm) and different annular angles of interrupted half annular groove(30°,50°,70°), in addition, the velocity fields and the temperature fields of the structures are obtained. The results show that the ability of heat transfer could be enhanced by increasing tube rows, fin spans and annular angle of interrupted half annular groove in certain range, and the Nu number increases with the increase of Re number, whereas the resistance coefficient decreases with the increase of Re number in the heat exchangers both for the smooth fins and the interrupted half annular groove fins. The features of flow and heat transfer for heat exchanger with interrupted half annular groove fin are obtained by analysis of the formation, development and influence area of the vortices generated by interrupted half annular grooves.

articleTitle: Study and application on mine clean mining technology
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Based on describing the environmental pollution by mining and the concept of mine clean mining technology, we further explained the technological principle and process with paste backfilling, and described the constitutes of filling material and its characteristic, the constitutes of paste backfilling system and its process in detail. What is more, this paper summarized the technological characteristic and the scope of application of paste backfilling. Finally, cooperating with a practical engineering in Daizhuang Mine, it analyzed the concrete implement process and proved the applied effect of the paste backfilling. The results show that paste backfilling mining is an effective approach to settle damage caused by coal mining to water resources, land resources, building resources. Compared with other approaches, it has some advantages, such as high security, high recovery ratio, and environment friendly, and moreover, the surface subsidence can be controlled effectively, but also solid waste, such as coal gangue, can be used as a resource with paste backfilling. This method is worth to be applied and popularized as a mine clean mining technology.

articleTitle: Simulated calculation of interblade vortex in Francis turbine's whole flow passage
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: A three-dimensional model for Francis turbine's whole flow passage is established in this paper. Simulated calculations of fixed guide vanes, guide vanes, runner and internal flow field of a draft tube are conducted. Velocity vector distribution and static pressure distribution of volute, guide vanes, runner and in the draft tube of the Francis turbine under three operating conditions (design operating conditions, maximum flow conditions, minimum flow conditions) are obtained. Meanwhile, the interblade vortexes in fixed guide vanes, guide vanes and between runner blades of the turbine are compared and analyzed in detail on different operating conditions and at different moments of the same cycle. Therefore, the interblade vortexes in the guide vanes and runner, and the pressure pulsation in the draft tube, as well as its law, especially the inter-relationship between flow separation vortex and its pulsation frequency at the outlet side of the blade under different operating conditions are found out. This is of great guiding significance in improving the operational stability of the turbine.

articleTitle: A new algorithm for cyclostationary signal blind deconvolution
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Blind source separation is to retrieve sources from mixed signals collected by sensors, without any prior knowledge about the sources and the pipeline. Some source signals is cyclostationary signal. The proposed method is derived by applying nonholomic constraints natural gradient iterative learning to the novel contrast function which is defined according to convolutive mixtures and cyclostationary of source signals. The efficiency of the algorithm is supported by simulation, which shows that the proposed method has improved performance for the separation in terms of waveform similarity, separation filter global transfer filter and convergence speed, compared to the traditional deconvolution method.

articleTitle: System design of environmental supervision of highway construction
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Environmental supervision plays an important role during highway construction. There are a lot of key components involved in environmental supervision, such as how to improve the work effectively and efficiently. Based on remote sensing and Geographic Information System (GIS), this paper presents a design for environmental supervision system in terms of environmental monitoring technology, integrated management and public involvement. The main components in the system include unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV)-based environment monitor and environment management database and environment monitoring subsystem.

articleTitle: Key technology research on adaptation layer of android platform
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper, a new way transplant applications of J2ME to android through create adaptation layer is proposed, for common way has many shortcomings, such as low efficiency, division of labor not easy and less code reuse. The experimental results shows that the new way can transplant J2ME applications to Android efficiently and it can solve the division of labor and the code reuse problems.

articleTitle: An experimental study of alkali soil improvement with coal ash and coal shale
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Simulation experiments are adopted in this paper as the main research technique. Cultivating different saline-alkali tolerant plants on culture media with different formulas whose contents of coal ash, coal shale and slime is dissimilar, then constantly observed index of the tested plants such as germination percentage, germinating time, average high level, survival rate, etc. After that we analyzed the improvement of alkali soil with different contents. As the main conclusion of this paper, we found that in the short run, coal shale did better improvement to the alkali soil than coal ash; but in the long run, coal ash did a better job to the improvement of alkali soil than coal shale. According to the result of group experiment, the improved formula which mixed group a+c (including group 1 and 2) for 30% did shorten the germinating time of Tamarix chinensis, as well as promoted the increment growth and growth rate notably. The improved formula worked better for the purpose of improving the alkali soil than other combinations.

articleTitle: An integrated water turbidity detection method based on multi-spectral analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper, an integrated water turbidity detection<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">†</sup>. method on dam gate is proposed. Based on multi-spectral image analysis and the transmitted power analysis of immersed optical fiber, the quality of water used for waterpower generator can be inspected automatically thus to protect the power generator from damage due to silt. Experimental results show that the proposed method works successfully and efficiently and can be practically applied to the examined dams. Therefore, it acts as a remote monitoring system on dam gate which locates on solitude place thus supports considerable economic benefits and contributions.

articleTitle: Ultrasound assisted rapid synthesis of ionic liquids
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Rapid synthesis of ionic liquids were discussed in this study. Improve the traditional synthesis time and increase the yield of ionic liquids with ultrasound. Synthesis of ionic liquids ultrasound results showed that the first step of synthesis of ionic liquids in ultrasonic output power 100%. The reaction time of 120 minutes [Bmim]Cl ionic liquid yield of 61% for the best yield. The [Bmim]PF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> ionic liquid were synthesized by ultrasound for second step. The original 24 to 48 hours of reaction time reduced to 1 hour. The best yield of [Bmim]PF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> ionic liquid was about 49% The results showed that the use of ultrasound assisted synthesis of ionic liquids can effectively reduce the synthesis time and the yield synthesis in comparison with the traditional reaction.

articleTitle: The social network analysis of political blogs in people: Based on centrality
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: According to the current status and trends of the booming development of the network politics, the article uses social network analysis method to analyze the political blog community consist of the top 50 Politics blogs in People's Daily web, uses data mining and centrality analysis to analyze the friends and network links between the 50 blogs. In order to find several key types among the political blog groups, such as the core group members, the relatively important members and members with special characteristics. The found of those members has an important significance for the further understanding of the political blog community.

articleTitle: Experimental study on decoupling modeling micro-fluid dispensing process
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: During micro-fluid dispensing process, pressurized air drives fluid materials (such as adhesive, sealant) through a circular tube with micro inner diameter onto substrates. This process is affected by some coupled factors and extremely difficult to develop an accurate physical model. Contrarily, an applied model may be more useful and effective. In this paper, by analysis the dispensing process, an applied decoupling linear model of micro-fluid dispensing process was developed step by step, through adding the variables one by one to a nominal model, a completed dispensing model was obtained. Experiments on a typical commercial dispensing system were carried out to test the model, the result shown the model developed in this paper working effectively.

articleTitle: An analysis of the eavesdropping threshold of quantum cryptography protocol
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper establishes a channel model by analyzing various factors which affect the quantum state in the process of practical quantum communication, and derives, through calculation and simulation, a new formula for a safety threshold of eavesdropping discrimination by the BB84 Protocol. This formula can be used to estimate the safety communication threshold of the BB84 Protocol in non-ideal channels. The method for estimating the practical safety thresholds can decide more accurately whether or not eavesdropping exists in the process of quantum cipher key distribution, thus raising the safety and efficiency of communication process.

articleTitle: Migration in virtual resource management
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Large-scale data centers, the workload in each node changes dynamically over time, causing the imbalance of workload, so the workload in some machines may exceeds the threshold, which not only can't guarantee the quality of service requirements (QoS), may also waste resources. This paper designs a resource manager based on migration cost, resource utilization and the number of machines, which develops relevant migration policy for virtual machine migration. The manager is divided into two stages. The initial phase will decide the virtual machines (VM) which should be migrated. The goal is to meet QoS, maximize resource utilization and minimize migration overhead. The second phase develops migration program to resolve the issue of where to move to. The target is to improve resource utilization and reduce the number of machines. Simulation results verify the superiority and rationality of this resource manager.

articleTitle: Mechanism design of internal translation gear transmission and its CAD system development
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The principium model of internal translation gear transmission was evolved from K-H-V planetary gear transmission. Utilizing the motion principle of parallelogram double-crank mechanism, the practical mechanism of K-H type of internal translation gear transmission was devised. The degree of freedom is just 1, so the determinate drive motion can be actualized. The transmission ratio is higher than K-H-V planetary gear transmission, so it has higher deceleration and acceleration performances. According to the structural characteristics of designed internal translation gear transmission, the man-machine interactive CAD system was developed by using VC++ platform, Pro/ENGINEER and Pro/TOOLKIT software package. With the dependable and steady work of this CAD system, the design efficiency of internal translation gear transmission can be greatly improved.

articleTitle: Modeling and solving for virtual network embedding problem with synchronous node and link mapping
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper proposes a Virtual Network Mapping algorithm for the unsplittable flow scenario, which maps virtual nodes and virtual links at the same phrase. We formulate the VN embedding problem as a 0-1 linear programming through substrate network augmentation, and then, based on the policy of divide and rule, we solve the model using linear programming, randomized and iterative method. Simulation experiments show that the proposed algorithm increases the acceptance ratio and the revenue while decreasing the cost incurred by the substrate network in the long run.

articleTitle: Numerical research on enhanced thermoelectric conversion system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The exhaust gas from vehicle engine is a pulsatile current with high speed, high temperature, and high frequency. The thermal calculated parameters of the high-power thermoelectric generator include the convective heat transfer coefficient α, the temperature drop along ΔT, especially the heat transfer area A and the pressure drop Δp. In this paper, we investigated the thermal characteristics of an intramural enhanced generator i.e. thermoelectric component directly mounted in the heater's channel of generator, whose component was designed as a cross shape, where the convective heat transfer took place between the thermocouples and the exhaust gas current directly, also, it took place between the cold crunodes and the flowed cooling water in cooler. Then, the numerical model was established and calculations were done; further more, their characteristics are compared with those of a plain tube (an exhaust pipe without thermoelectric component inside). The numerical calculated results show that the intramural thermoelectric generator effectively improves the area A and coefficient α, it provides a base for lager scale integration of thermocouples.

articleTitle: With the economic and social development should build a human color culture Discipline
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Based on the Game Theory, analyzes the importance of the color culture Discipline in economic development. Namely, in the innovation-design, the color culture not only is an important factor to build national brands and increase the product's cultural value-added, and also is the important initiative of promoting our national culture prosperity and developing world's different cultural exchanges. So, building a human color culture Discipline is imperative. The article firstly elaborates the Chinese tradition color-culture being the important foundation of building the human color culture Discipline. Secondly, discusses to restore comprehensively to the Chinese traditional color-culture, and carries on the knowledge management for it. Finally, carries on the cultural innovation for the many sub-systems of the Chinese traditional Color-culture Discipline. The purpose aims at for building the human color culture Discipline to lay a solid foundation.

articleTitle: An effective video copy detection method
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper introduces a new video copy detection method base on the combination of video Y and U spatiotemporal feature curves and key frames. In this new method, the feature curves are extracted from the video, and then two videos' feature curves are compared to determine whether they have the same content or not. In the comparing process, Grads comparison method and Exception Factor are used. To improve retrieval precision for videos like films, a method based on clips and key frames is added after spatio-temporal feature curves based retrieval. The new algorithm can largely reduce the data amount of video copy detection. Experimental results show the effectiveness and robustness of the method.

articleTitle: The general waveform development flow of software defined radio
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The waveform in software defined radio (SDR) is the important application software which fulfills the function of communication. The waveform development is one of the most important aspects in the industry of SDR. In order to improve its portability and reusability, the waveform software should be developed according to a special flow. Aiming at the general flow of SDR waveform development, we firstly analyze the basic principle which should be complied with when we develop a waveform, namely the Software Communication Architecture (SCA) Specification. Based on the SCA specification, we analyze the types of components made up of a waveform. Then we summarize the general flow for waveform development and discuss the validation of the flow in different integral development environment. The experiences show that the proposed general waveform development flow is proper and feasible and can guide new developers to quickly grasp the process of SDR waveform development.

articleTitle: Simulation of laser ablation of crystalline silicon solar cells by ANSYS
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: By the finite element analysis software ANSYS, we simulate a nonlinear model of laser ablation of crystalline silicon solar cells. Using thermodynamic method, the finite element model of pulsed laser heating crystalline silicon solar cells has been established. Adopting reasonable material thermal physical parameters description, meshing, thermal source model, initial conditions and boundary conditions, the ablation depth, ablation width and ablation morphology of laser ablating crystalline silicon solar cells have been simulated and compared with the experimental observations by scanning electron microscopy. The obtained simulation results are consistent with the experimental measurements.

articleTitle: The design of multi-channel data acquisition system based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper introduced the technical requirements and the realization method of multi-channel data acquisition circuit, proposed some solutions to eliminate channel crosstalk. The design can finish to sampling 32 channel analog signals and convert them based FPGA as a core-logic controller, this device has been successfully applied in a comprehensive telemetry device.

articleTitle: Observation and analysis of blasting vibration attenuation law in waste dump
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The vibration induced by blasting operation is one of the leading factors of waste dump stability near the open-pit, also the critical value of vibration velocity plays an important role in the waste dump stability evaluation. At present, the blasting vibration in waste dump dose not gain enough attention, and there is not vibration empiric formula in waste dump design specifications. By analysis of the propagation characteristic of blasting vibration in waste dump, a formula of blasting vibration attenuation is raised. Based on field test data of blast vibration, an empirical equation is simulated according to the least squares theory. The result shows that the measured value agree well with the predicted value which verified by the docimastic sample. The formula of waste dump blasting vibration attenuation is proved to be reasonable and operable.

articleTitle: Abrasive water-jet process control overvie
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Current research and developments of the abrasive water jet process control were reviewed in this paper. The methods used to monitor the abrasive particles suction process, the water orifice condition, the focus tube condition and wear were reviewed and their advantages and disadvantages were also analyzed, respectively. The expert system with neutral network method was suggested to monitor more than one cutting parameter in order to optimize the cutting process.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation on expansion characters of solid phase in two phases fluidized bed
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: CFD(Computational Fluid Dynamics) numerical simulation method was adopted to study on the solid expansion character in flow process of two phases fluidized bed including liquid and solid phases and testify the reliability. Commercial CFD software-Fluent was used in the study under some proper boundary conditions, such as velocity inlet, pressure outlet, symmetry condition for free liquid surface, standard k-ϵ model for turbulence and Gidapow model for inter-phase drag forces. Beside these, time dependent method was used in numerical simulation.
