Results of simulation were verified with calculation results of Richardson-Zaki experiential relations which were approved widely and they agreed well. The results of simulation could predict bed height and volume fraction of solids for expanded fluidized bed accurately; dynamical simulation could illustrate the start-up process of fluidized bed visually; numerical simulation in CFD could give some theoretical instructions for scale-up design of fluidized bed.

articleTitle: Study on properties of PB-g-PS latex-modified cement mortars
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The PB-g-PS latex was used to modify cement mortar, and the weight ratios of polybutadiene to styrene ranged from 70/30, 50/50 to 30/70. In the constant water-cement ratio of 0.5, and curing 24h at 20°C, RH90% air followed by 27d at 20°Cwater. This study examines the effects of weight ratios polybutadiene to styrene and the polymer-cement ratios on the flow, compressive and flexural strength and water absorption rate of PB-g-PS latex modified cement mortar. The experimental results show that the flow of modified mortar is increased with increasing polymer-cement ratios and decreasing weight ratios of polybutadiene to styrene, PB-g-PS latex can markedly reduce capillary water absorption rate. The minimum is 1.33Kg/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. PB-g-PS latex can marked influences much on the mechanical properties of modified mortars. The compressive of the polymer modified mortar decreased, and the flexural strength of polymer modified mortar decreased as well. Overview on, PB-g-PS latex can be incorporated into cement mortars as cement modifier.

articleTitle: An investigaion of building energy conservation technologies education
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The awareness of architecture students on building energy efficiency technologies plays a key role on the building energy conservation. A survey has been carried out to investigate the awareness of building energy efficiency technologies in architecture students in Zhejiang University of Technology. The survey results indicate that architecture students have insufficient knowledge of building energy conservation technologies. Furthermore, architecture student have low ability of using building energy efficiency technologies. Base on the survey results, two measures have been proposed to architecture education. It is our expectation that the research results of this paper provide reference to architecture education reformation leading to enhance architecture students' ability of using building energy efficiency technologies.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of ECG signal management and playback system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: To lay foundation for the simulation of ECG algorithm and provide a signal source for studying the ECG monitoring system with the method to read the format of Classic ECG database and design a Physiological Signal Management and Playback System. First, to build a hardware platform with high-performance Personal Computer and digital-analog converter. Then, to establish ECG data functional unit in MFC class library, which is based on the Visual C++6.0 platform. Signal source can be controlled effectively as the output of ECG data and playback is synchronous. The interception, storage and playback of any section of ECG waveform have been achieved. The performance of the system stability and data accuracy will finally provide signal sources for simulation of ECG and development of instrumentation.

articleTitle: Simulation and experiment on interference fit between small head of connecting rod and bush
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The mechanical fit between the connecting rod's small head and the bush is a typical interference fit. The thick cylinder model is applied to calculate the theoretical stress on the surface of the small head for this fit. By the contact finite element method, the simulation model is used to get the stress and deformation by constructing the true interference of fit bodies. The stress on the connecting rod's small head surface is measured by interference fit experiment, the result of the theoretical model and the finite element method model is also validated. This paper analyses the simulation error of the interference fit and evaluates the thick cylinder model. The law, how the bush outface shape and position error, interference, the thickness of it have an influence on the interference fit status, is obtained.

articleTitle: Study and design of gateway engine immobilizer based on CAN-bus
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Traditional engine immobilizer commonly used K-Line to communicate. It has been unable to adapt the trends that vehicle CAN network is growing more and more popular in the automobile industry. This made the immobilizer can not communicate with other vehicle controllers effectively. This paper introduces a kind of immobilizer based on the gateway functions participating effectively in the vehicle CAN/LIN network communications.

articleTitle: The research of Radon transform applied in the tunnel seismic prediction
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: With speeding up of railway construction, the more long and deep tunnels are being scheduled. As the geological condition prediction before the tunnel workface is of significant importance for safety, quality, progress and cost etc. of the tunnel construction, non-destructive geophysical methods, such as high-density electrical survey, electromagnetic methods, seismic reflection method and so on are widely used for the prediction. In the seismic prediction, the reflection records are not, however, just the waves being reflected from the ahead of the workface. For the complex geological conditions of the tunnels, many interferential reflections from other directive reflectors are stacked on the ahead reflection records, which may cause some traps for the prediction. As the time-distance curve and apparent velocities of the reflection wave records from the ahead of the tunnel workface with common-source or common-receiver layout are usually of obvious difference from that of the interferential reflections, the Radon transform with its power function in apparent velocity filtering is of potential to separate the seismic waves of ahead reflectors of the tunnel workface from the other directive reflectors. On the other hand, the Radon transform usually is important tool for the separation of P-wave and S-wave for the calculation of the ratio of P-wave to S-wave, passion ratio, and other rock physical parameters to evaluate the ahead geology condition of the workface, since the both waves are of the apparent velocity differences. In the paper, we illustrated the superiority and flexibility of the Radon transform to achieve the reflections from the ahead of the workface. and the P-Wave and S-wave separation under tunnel complex geological condition by numerical model and a real case.

articleTitle: Dynamics and strength analysis of Ring-plate Planetary Indexing Cam Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: A prototype model of Ring-plate Planetary Indexing Cam Mechanism (RPICM) is developed with the commercial software of Solidworks 2010. The dynamics simulation using Solidworks 2010's Motion module is carried out, and the contact force of the cam and the pin gear is received. A 2D finite element model of the RPICM is established with Matlab and ANSYS software. This paper is aimed at the strain analysis of the cam With the finite element analysis (FEA). The computations and analyses show the stress distribution and the place of the most stress. The results of FEA will provide a valuable reference for the structure design and the strength calculation in future research.

articleTitle: Effects of ground treatment on site seismic response
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The effect of foundation treatment on ground motion is studied using finite element method. The difference between natural field and stabilized field is compared; the impacts of the stabilization zone width, depth, soil modulus stabilization, soil modulus and the seismic wave characteristics on response of the ground motion are also investigated. Study shows that foundation stabilization has insignificant effect on frequency characteristic of the horizontal acceleration response spectrum; the PGA may have a large diminution. Greater the stabilization depth is, smaller becomes the peak of the horizontal acceleration response spectrum. It is also show that the stabilization width has significant effect on the edge of the stabilization. Increasing soil modulus stabilization not only can obviously reduce the PGA, but also can improve the PGA of the stabilization, meanwhile reduces the PGA of outside the stabilization. The incident of spectrum wave has great effect on response spectrum of the ground motion.

articleTitle: Five network amalgamation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: After the respective signal characteristics of the telecommunications network, CATV network, internet, power grid and internet of things when transmitted by metal wire as well as existing problems when the signals are integrated are analysed, restricted factors of high-frequency signal transmission is discussed. Then molecular wires to solve the skin effect and electromagnetic interference is proposed in order to achieve broadband transmission of different type signals. With the help of the experiment transmitting five kinds of signals respectively by molecular wires, result of the test shows that it is feasible to use molecular wires as the signal transmission carrier for five networks amalgamation. In addition, distribution of the five signal frequency spectrum is allocated and the suggestions on the position of access point for five networks amalgamation is put forward.

articleTitle: Study on automotive style recognition with the image erosion technology
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper introduces a recognition method on “Many Different Kinds of Automotive Style on Robot Painting Line Recognition System”. This paper mainly uses the dynamically silhouetted image to confirm the outline of the real automotive style's motional sequence image, then uses the median filtering to eliminate a part of noise, then uses the image erosion technology to eliminate the structure noise. At last the automotive style's edge is detected. The dimension of automotive style is detected by the edge to accomplish the goal of recognizing automotive style. The results show that the recognition method based on the image erosion technology could enhance the anti-noise performance and improve the precision of the automotive style dimension.

articleTitle: Research on Support vector machine prediction on surrounding rock deformation based on fuzzy information granulation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: On the basis of our realization to the world, granulation is one of the basis concepts. It refers to the whole divides into the parts. Information granulation has a key role in many methods and technical domains. The theory of fuzzy information granulation (TFIG) is elicited by man's information granulation method and based this to infer. Support vector machine (SVM) is an effective method to predict the time series. This article studies the prediction of surrounding rock deformation by using SVM method based on TFIG. Combining with a project case, the algorithm is realized by Matlab program. The results show that this new method can well and truly predict the bound of the next five day's displacement of surrounding rock.

articleTitle: The simulation application of LabVIEW in the data processing
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper, we introduced a new method to analyze the sensors' signal of mechanical hand by using the virtual instrument. First, we introduced present researching situation and the trend of development of robot and the intelligent robot, simply summarized present researching situation and the trend of development robot multi-information fusion technology. Second, according to method of robot body-perception, this paper established and accomplished the hardware design and software design with LabVIEW. When the mechanical hand snatching the object, the virtual instrument will show the realtime waveform of the signal and finish the data fusion. Then the virtual instrument will judge the object's material. At last, the results of the experiments are given. We confirmed the robot body-perception method is feasible through the experiment and proposed researching tendency in the future.

articleTitle: Repeated sponsored search auction with non-decreasing bid values
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: We apply ascending biding behavior of English auction to solve the revenue loss problem of generalized second price auction (GSP) in repeated sponsored search auction (SSA) for the search engine provider (SEP). The mechanism proposed in this paper is denoted by Non-decreasing Sponsored Search Auction (NDSSA). We focus on analyzing SEP's revenue lower bound and auction efficiency after converging. We proof that SEP's revenue in NDSSA is at least equal to α times of that in Vickrey-Clarke-Groves auction (VCG), while α is the reciprocal of the first click-through rate (CTR). Since any CTR is normalized to a decimal, SEP in NDSSA will obtain more revenue than in VCG. Moreover, NDSSA is efficient, and advertisers with higher valuations will be ranked in better slots.

articleTitle: Solubility predictions for the reciprocal quaternary system (NaCl + MgCl2 + Na2SO4 + MgSO4 + H2O) at 283.15 K using Pitzer ion-interaction model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Solubilities of the reciprocal quaternary system (Na + Mg + Cl + SO4 + H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O) at 283.15K were calculated using Pitzer ion-interaction model and its extended HW model. On the basis of the temperature-dependent equation produced by Spencer-Moller-Weare, the values of the Pitzer single-salt parameters β<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(0)</sup>, β<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(1)</sup>, β<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(2)</sup> and C<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">φ</sup> for NaCl, MgCl<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>, Na<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>, and MgSO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>, the mixed ion-interaction parameters θ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">Na, Mg</sub>, θ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">Cl, SO4</sub>, ψ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">Na, Mg, Cl</sub>, ψ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">Na, Mg, SO4</sub>, ψ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">Na, Cl, SO4</sub> and ψ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">Mg, Cl, SO4</sub>, and the Debye-Hückel parameter A<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">φ</sup> in the quaternary system at 283.15K were fitted. Based on the Jänecke indexes, the phase diagram was plotted. A comparison of the calculated and experimental results shows that the predicted solubilities agree well with the experimental values. This study affords the necessary parameters for solubility predictions of complicated systems and establishes a theoretical basis for the separation of these valuable minerals from salt lake brine.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of management vehicle information system based on the .NET Framework
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper analyzes the present domestic situation of vehicle transportation industry. Because compatibility, high load and exists in the vehicle monitoring system, a solution, based on the .NET Framework 2.0, integration of GPS(Global Position System), wireless communication technology, Microsoft SQL Server 2005 database, Google Maps API V3 and Ajax technology solutions is proposed. The design principle and implementation method of data transmission, vehicle positioning and monitoring, track playback, control and supervision functions are listed in this paper. After the actual test and analysis show that the system is simple, high compatibility, transmission speed, high efficiency, it will effectively improve vehicle management efficiency. The work provides a useful reference for the design of vehicle monitoring platform.

articleTitle: Prediction of municipal solid waste landfill settlement with leachate recirculation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In case of bioreactor landfills, waste settlement will include creep and biological components due to the heterogeneous nature of waste particles, and accelerated biodegradation, respectively, as leachate is recycled. Most settlement models were not developed considering the leachate recirculation effect on settlement. The objective of this paper is to present a settlement prediction model, which accounts for changes in material characteristics as a function of the waste degradation rate. Settlement components including creep and biodegradation effects are identified as a function of the state of decomposition. The degree of decomposition was characterized through gas generation rates and the cellulose plus hemicellulose to lignin ratio. Compression indices representing creep and biological effects were measured on samples ranging from fresh to well-decomposed refuse. In addition, the time factors for the compressibility were determined from the gas production. Finally the proposed model was verified using the settlement data obtained from different landfills.

articleTitle: Method for vibration prediction of claw-pole alternator
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Modal analysis was adopted to analysis vibration of claw-pole alternator stator structure at low-frequency based on ANSYS software in this paper. The mode of vibration and natural frequency were obtained, and then the natural frequency of claw-pole alternator stator was gained according to the calculation formula, comparing the both natural frequency. Statistical energy analysis (SEA) was adopted to predict the vibration of claw-pole alternator stator structure at high-frequency and SEA model was established. Coupling loss factors and internal loss factors were measured. The sound power of claw-pole alternator can gained. Finally, the forecast data and experimental data were analyzed, the vibration characteristic of claw-pole alternator was obtained.

articleTitle: The research on key technologies of Internet of Things on sensing mine
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper is about the Research programs and technical framework of Internet of Things on Sensing Mine. It is discussed the convergence of mine backbone and mobile network, the routing protocols and algorithms, data warehouse platform, and other key technology and implementation methods in this paper. it can provide some reference value to the construction of Internet of Things on Mine.

articleTitle: Simulation of the voltage sag effects on an induction motor
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Analysis of voltage sag events using simulation can be very useful due to serious effects of such events on electrical equipment. This paper presents a study on voltage sag effects on an induction motor using computer simulation with EMTP-ATP. The voltage sags are generated by different fault types with several fault resistances. Their effects on terminal voltage, current, torque and speed of motor are investigated.

articleTitle: Low-complexity calculating scheme of feedback information for receiver in EBSTBC
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Extended balanced space-time block coding (EBSTBC) is able to achieve large coding gain and guarantee full diversity for any number of transmit antennas. However, the calculation of feedback information at the receiver employs exhaustive searching scheme which is at a high complexity. In this work, a low-complexity calculating scheme of feedback information is proposed for the receiver in EBSTBC systems. The scheme firstly choose the coding matrix according to the channel state information (CSI), and the value of extension parameters for achieving maximum coding gain are decided, then the two parts of the information are sent to the transmitter as the feedback information. Theoretical analysis and simulation results show that the calculating complexity of feedback information is greatly decreased, and almost the same reliability performance is achieved as the former scheme.

articleTitle: Cadmium and cobalt removal from heavy metal solution using oyster shells adsorbent
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper investigated the adsorption capacities of crushed oyster shells adsorbent for cadmium and cobalt removal from heavy metal aqueous solution using batch experiments and column experiments. The results showed that: A 24 hour period was considered to provide an adequate contact time between the single-constituent metal ion solutions and the adsorbent to reach equilibrium. The equilibrium adsorption capacities of the adsorbent for single-constituent metal ion solutions was noted to be Cd >; Co. Considering solution pH changes, crushed oyster shells could be a better natural adsorbent in full-scale applications where final solution pH considerations are required. Crushed oyster shells were found to be a better adsorbent for cadmium ion removal in column testing. When a 10 cm diameter fixed-bed column packed with a 15 cm depth of crushed mollusk shells was hydraulically loaded with a nickel and cadmium binary aqueous solution at a rate of 1.5 mL/min, the best cadmium treatment efficiency observed was 49.2%.

articleTitle: The impact of forest cover degree of surface for runoff and geological environmental
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The paper discusses the relationship of the forest cover rate and the quantity of surface flow of two typical basins in LuZhong mountain area in more than forty years. The result shows that : the increase of the forest cover rate, helps to the supply of precipitation to the ground water, and helps to slow down the drainage speed of the precipitation, reduce the flood peak flow in flood season in mountain areas, which could reduce the arises of debris flow disasters; At the same time add the output of ground water in dry season, which means add it's dry season runoff. It concludes that the increase of one basin's forest cover rate is helpful to the flood control of a reservoir in north area which has long dry season and concentrative precipitation time and helpful to water resources development and utilization. On the hand, the development of forest cover has significant effect to ground geohydrologic environment that the groundwater recharge from precipitation is increased.

articleTitle: Analysis and compensation for friction in electro-hydraulic servo system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Friction in the electro-hydraulic servo system makes tracking and pointing accuracy lower, it is one of the most important influence factors. This paper proposes a nonlinear adaptive friction compensation method based on analysis of the position-control system of valve-control asymmetrical hydraulic cylinder and the LuGre friction model. Dual nonlinear observers were constructed to estimate the friction state, which is unmeasurable in the electro-hydraulic servo system, and adaptive laws of friction parameters were built to compensate dynamic friction. Finally the application of Simulink has proven this method is validity.

articleTitle: A modal superposition method for vibration responses of atomic force microscope cantilevers using the Timoshenko beam model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Responses of the flexural vibration of an atomic force microscope (AFM) cantilever are evaluated using the Timoshenko beam theory. An analytical expression for the response of an AFM subjected to a sampling force with an excitation force of an arbitrarily chosen frequency is obtained with the help of the modal superposition method. In this study, the governing equations of the Timoshenko beam model with coupled differential equations expressed in terms of the flexural displacement and the bending angle were uncoupled to produce the fourth order equation. The effects of shear deformation were adopted to solve the dynamic model. A validity comparison for AFM modeling between the Timoshenko beam model and the Bernoulli-Euler beam model was conducted by using the ratios of the Young's modulus to the shear modulus. Based on the results, the Bernoulli-Euler beam model for AFM applies to the small effects of transverse shear deformation, but not to ratios greater than 1000. Moreover, one can reduce the response at the end of AFM by decreasing the shear modulus when the frequencies of processing are far away from the modal frequencies, and by increasing the shear modulus when the frequencies of processing are close to the modal frequencies. Furthermore, an AFM with a large tip width and length is suitable for reducing the response at the end of the AFM.

articleTitle: The study on inverse system decoupling and PID control used in power magnetic beraing
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper, the coupling magnetic field model which the power magnetic bearing generated by interference between the rotation and levitation force is linear inverse system decoupling, and study PID control strategy on decoupling linearization system. According to the performance analysis and simulation of PID control system, it can be concluded that PID control system has quick response, high control precision, good control ability, and excellent robustness. It can be applied to project system.

articleTitle: Study on test technology of smart substation secondary system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: According to the characteristics of smart substation, this text discusses the test process, contents and methods of smart substation secondary system. The emphases and difficulties of the test are also discussed.

articleTitle: Optimal design model for crank-connecting rod mechanism of a-type stirling engine
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In order to attain the maximum external cycle power of a-type Stirling Engine, first, this paper uses multi-objective optimization of the linear weighted evaluation method and with reference to the group AHP method to gain the optimal range of link rod ratio of general crank-connecting rod mechanism, then on that basis, it establishes optimal design model for the maximum external cycle power of α-type stirling engine. finally, it presents and resolves a practical example.

articleTitle: Modeling the potential spatial distribution of endemic plant Potaninia mongolica
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This study modeled the potential distribution of endemic Potaninia mongolica in the eastern Central Asian desert by using ecological niche model: the Genetic Algorithm for Rule-set Prediction (GARP). We created predictive models using herbarium collection data and environmental layers. For model evaluation, we chose the area under the receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve (AUC) as a single measure. Our results showed that: (1) GARP obtained high scores of performance (AUCs >; 0.9); (2) the visual inspection of model results indicated that the generated most potential suitable areas for P. mongolica covered the most desert areas, specifically including the significant portions of southern Mongolia, such as Alashan Gobi, and the East Gobi; the Alashan Left and Right Banner as well as the northern areas of Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region; and the western Yumen, the middle Hexi Corridor of the Gansu Province; (3) the ecological niche of P. mongolica was defined in a widely arid environmental space: Max Temperature of Warmest Month were almost during 30.2-36.8 °C, Min Temperature of Coldest Month were ranged from -15.6 °C to -16.9 °C, and the Annual Precipitation were between 40-80 mm.

articleTitle: System matching and simulation of dual-motor drive coupling for electric vehicles
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The dual-motor drive system for electric vehicles is researched, which comprises two drive motors and coupling device. The dual-motor together provide power for the vehicle while the vehicle travels at a cruising speed or high constant speed. The main drive motor provides power to the vehicle during periods of peak torque demand such as vehicle acceleration or climbing. Taking 18t electric bus as example, do the parameters matching for dual-motor drive system. At last, the dynamic of the electric bus is simulated in Matlab/Simulink and the result demonstrates the effectiveness of the dual-motor drive system. The dynamic performance of the electric bus perfectly meets the need of the design target.

articleTitle: Non-sinusoidal oscillation waveform construction and the optimization of the vibrating parameters for continuous casting mold
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Non-sinusoidal oscillation of continuous casting mold is an effective approach, which can insure high-quality at high casting speed. Based on sinusoidal oscillation waveform, a non-sinusoidal oscillation equipped with optimum mode virtues can be constructed. By employing paragraph-function, boundary condition and continuity condition, the correspondent analytical expression formulas can be calculated, and then, its technological parameters can be determined Finally, putting matlab procedure into use and optimizing oscillation parameter, the optimal technological parameter limits can be confirmed.

articleTitle: Copper ECMP in phosphoric acid-BTA slurries
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Copper ECMP bench test was conducted for copper in 30 wt% H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>PO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>+0.01M BTA slurry on a three-electrode tribo-electrochemical system. Electrochemical and tribological performance of copper in the slurry are studied. The inhibition effect of BTA is shown by material removal rate (MRR) and after-ECMP topographies of copper at different anodic potentials are analyzed by AFM. Results show that the applied anodic potential should be low enough to prevent corrosive pitting.

articleTitle: Research progress of nuclear, biological and chemical polluted water treatment
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: As a major victim of the biochemical warfare in the history, China is confronting the threat of new nuclear, chemical and biological warfare nowadays. Water is the main transmission mode of nuclear, chemical and biological warfare agent. Therefore pure water treatment becomes an important mode of Three Defenses. This paper mainly introduces the characteristics of chemical and biological pollution, the research status of chemical and biological warfare and the latest research and development of chemical and biological polluted water treatment.

articleTitle: A comprehensive error analysis of horizontal machining center based on volumetric error model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The machine tool accuracy is comprehensively affected by geometric, thermal, and cutting force-induced errors. A key step in accuracy design and error compensation is error origins analysis. The object of this study is a MCH63 Precision Horizontal Machining Center. Based on the volumetric error model and using the measurement of error origins, the effects of geometric, thermal, and cutting force-induced errors on the volumetric error components are compared. The results can be used to theoretically direct the accuracy design of different error sources and provide experimental data support for error compensation.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Present situation and strategies of Henan urbanization and industrialization
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Research on the broadband power line communication system based on adaptive OFDM
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: There are characteristics of high noise, big attenuation, the big impedance variation and the uneven frequency response on low-voltage power line channel. Firstly, this paper proposes the combination the adaptive technology with the OFDM technology to realize the reliable and high-speed data transmission channel. It is a key to study the channel estimation of the OFDM technology and the channel allocation of the adaptive technology. Then, we put forward to the algorithm of comb-type pilots Unscented Kalman Filter, and we use the time-frequency domain estimation algorithm to improve the channel estimation accuracy. Lastly, we take the improving particle swarm algorithm to solve the problem of the channel allocation and the bit allocation, realize the sub-carrier bits and the power allocation in multiuser adaptive OFDM system, save running time, reduce the transmitted power and enhancing the efficiency of spectrum.

articleTitle: Fusion of polarimetric image using contourlet transform
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Contourlet transform is the combination of the multi-scale analysis and multi-directional analysis in processing high-dimensional signals and has better approximation precision and better sparse description. Firstly, Using the Contourlet transform, several polarimetric images can be decomposed into low-frequency coefficients and high-frequency coefficients with multi-scales and multi-directions. For the low-frequency coefficients, the average fusion method is used. For the each directional high frequency sub-band coefficients, the larger value of region variance information measurement is used to select the better coefficients for fusion. At last the fused image can be obtained by utilizing inverse transform for fused contourlet coefficients. Experimental results show that the proposed algorithm works better in preserving the edges and texture information compared with the traditional image fusion algorithms.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation and evaluation of wind environment about square earth buildings
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Square Tulou as the typical of Fujian province. Based on Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) software CFX and the SST k-ω) turbulence physics model, this article simulate the wind environment of tulou under different Wind incidence direction, In order to more accurately predict tulou wind environment. To be pedestrian height of the wind speed separation in the corner, where the formation of similar to the "horseshoe" area of strong wind, the wind speed increased by nearly 0.7 times. As a result, pedestrian courtyard height of the flow field has changed, where the average wind speed ratio decreases. Tulou courtyard played an important role in the heat exchange, which between environmental qualiy and the air inside the building heat. The wind speed and flow of various regions inside and outside the building comprehensively deduced by numerical simulation can be provided as a basis for the assessment of wind environment.

articleTitle: Multi-channel acquisition system correspondence and speech code algorithm realization
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper, we initiate a study on the deployment of large memories at the hardware and software design and implementation of a signal data acquisition system, making them essential tools for meeting the different needs of applications in signal acquisition system and not only can complete the data acquisition, storage, and read operations via VB-based interface software options, but also can change sampling rates. Furthermore, IMA-ADPCM speech coding algorithms is used and allows continuous recording of data, which is then stored in the system memory. The highly intelligent data gathering system which has the ability of high-precision real-time sampling, and it has merit in large storage capacity, power supply convenient, low-power, hot-swappable, portable, easy to operate, user-friendly, versatile, and good scalability. Experimental results show the system can achieve high signal to noise ratio of audio signal.

articleTitle: Fast subpixel edge extraction based on two Fourier-Mellin moments with different mask sizes
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In order to quickly and exactly extract the subpixel image edge, a new method of subpixel image edge based on Fourier-Mellin moment is proposed. Firstly all possible edge points were detected quickly with using Fourier-Mellin moment operator with mask size of 3×3, secondly a Fourier-Mellin moment operator with mask size of 7×7 was used to relocate the edge with subpixel accuracy. Experiment results show that the method has good subpixel accuracy, and its processing time is 1.53s. Therefore, the method has advantages of both short running time and high accuracy.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Experience the physical beauty and construct the cultural function of physics education
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: A hybrid description submit method for user level communication
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: High-Performance computing has witnessed a tremendous growth and acceptance over the last decade primarily due to the availability of Clusters. The performance of these clusters hinges upon the communication interface. High performance communication interface always adopts user level communication method based on description. The description submits method would affect the performance of communication interface deeply. The methods based on DMA and PIO are two traditional methods for description submit, and can provide good performance for some communication mode, but all are not suited for different applications. The paper combines merits of these two traditional methods, and put forward a hybrid description submit method for user level communication. Experimental results shown the method which we provided can acquire good bandwidth and latency for different communication modes.

articleTitle: A new asymptotic analysis method for linearly elastic shell
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper, the asymptotic expansions of stress tensor for linearly elastic shell have been proposed by new asymptotic analysis method. Thus 3-D stress tensor is totally decomposed into 2-D variable and thickness variable, which makes the numerical computation of stress tensor in engineer easier and more convenient than before.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Comparison and analysis of carbon emissions from energy consumption between China and Canada
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Reliability distribution of ADB610 steel impact toughness after strain aging
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Reliability distribution for impact toughness after strain aging of 38 mm thick ADB610 steel was investigated. The reliability distribution model was established by using least square method and correlation coefficent maximization method. Then the hypothesis test was calculated by using correlation coefficent test and K-S test method. It can be concluded that the impact toughness after strain aging of 38 mm ADB610 steel obeys Normal distribution, Lognormal distribution, 2-Weibull distribution and 3-Weibull distribution, and Lognormal distribution is the best. The confidence interval of 38 mm ADB610 steel impact toughness after strain aging was investigated, and the security impact toughness after strain aging is calculated to be [211.5, 219.3], [202.5, 213] and [186.6, 201.6] J based on 95% confidence level and 90%, 95% and 99% reliability.

articleTitle: Discussion on the research of CVD diamond tools
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Diamond cutting tools are increasingly wide application, this is a review about CVD diamond tools, with the most highest cost-effective in synthetic diamond. We introduce CVD diamond and CVD synthesis technology, the key technology of CVD diamond coated tools and some related problems here. Summarize the newest technical developments of CVD diamond at home and abroad. Make a summary for future development of CVD diamond tools and look forward to the future.

articleTitle: Solving frictional contact problems by a semismooth Newton method
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper presents a new method for solving three-dimensional frictional contact problems. A semismooth Newton method for solving nonlinear complementarity problems is proposed based on generalized Fischer-Burmeister functions. The parametric variational principle and parametric quadratic programming method are applied to the analysis of the three-dimensional frictional contact problem. The solution of the contact problem is finally reduced to a linear complementarity problem. Then the semismooth Newton method presented is employed to solve the problem. Results of numerical experiments demonstrate the efficiency and reliability of the method proposed.

articleTitle: Influence of highway network construction on ecological service value in Shandong province
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: According to the calculating methods given by Xie gaodi et al, this paper calculates the loss of the ecosystem services value, which is caused by the as-built highway of Shandong province, and the ecosystem services value of the land which will occupied by the proposed highway is estimated. The results indicate that the total loss of ecological services value caused by the construction of highway network in Shandong province is about 2526196900 yuan every year, the loss of the ecosystem services value caused by the as-built highways is about 1686249600 yuan every year, the loss caused by the proposed project is expected to 839947300 yuan every year. Among the loss of ecosystem services value caused by the highway network construction, the contribution of agro-ecosystem and forest ecosystems is the largest, accounting for 77.9% and 18.5% respectively. The contribution of waste treatment is the highest, accounting for 20.5%, followed by the formation and conservation value of soil, accounting for 20.2%.

articleTitle: Embeded reactive power compensator and power factor monitor system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The Reactive power compensator and monitor of Power factor system is designed based on ARM7, with function of long distant transmission. It monitors and measures alternation current parameters, such as the active and reactive electric energy, active and reactive power, voltage, current, power factor and other parameters. To realize reactive compensation, it can automatically switch shunt compensation capacitor by Thyristor Switch Capacitor. The result can display via LCD. Moreover, the system has anti-power-down and code protection.

articleTitle: A novel adaptive step-size algorithm of blind source separation based on non-linear function
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The conventional fixed step-size algorithm of blind source separation (BSS) cann't adaptively chang in the process of original signals separation, so both the convergence speed and the steady-state misadjustment aren't simultaneously satisfactory. To solve the problem, a novel step-size algorithm of BSS based on non-linear function is proposed in this paper, it makes the step-size value match the dynamics of the input signals and unmixing matrix adaptively at each iteration, its performance is investigated through simulations. The results obtained show that superior performance can he achieved relative to that of an existing fixed step-size algorithm.

articleTitle: Driving circuit and system integration for high efficiency HID emission
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In the article, a course on high performance High intensity discharge (HID) driving circuits is presented. With the driving circuits available from a prerequisite course, the present course emphasizes the design and implementation of the driving circuit as well as system integration issues. Laboratory sessions are an essential part of the course. Successive completion of the laboratories automatically leads students to a “working” advanced lightness system.

articleTitle: Quantitative research of urban flood-protection project to the added value of real estate: Based on Intervel-valued instuitionistic fuzzy sets theory
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Applying the Intervel-valued intuition fuzzy information sets, this thesis established the computation module in the added value of urban real estate comes from the flood protection works, and also by the case study of hydraulic engineering in Xiasha-region, Hangzhou City, it also made a field diagnostic study to confirm method's feasibility, explored the practical Quantitative Research of Urban Flood-protection Project to the Added Value of Real Estate.

Author Keywords: Added Value of the Real Estate

articleTitle: Information identification algorithm for satellite navigation under hostile interference
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: An information identification algorithm (IIA) for satellite navigation system was proposed in this paper. It uses the fuzzy step size least-mean-square (FLMS) adaptive filter and power distributing predominance wavelet packets transform (PDP-WPT) to eliminate the hostile interference in the process of information identification. Compared with the conventional LMS algorithm, the FLMS performs high convergence rate and low steady-state fluctuation error. PDP-WPT was presented to track the interference effectively, which improves the convergence rate of information identification. Simulations were conducted to evaluate the convergence rate and identification capability of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Design of friction hoist sliding protection system based on PLC and WinCC
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: A friction hoist sliding protection system(FHSPS) which taking use of Siemens S7-300 and WinCC configuration software is designed in this paper. According to the probation in a coal mine of Qidong, China, any mistaken action is find since putting into use, it not only can alarm the sliding malfunction, but also can brake the wirerope and cage while the malfunction comes up.

articleTitle: Research on simulating settlement of deep soft clay ground with D-M method based on centrifugal model tests
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Consolidation time in the centrifugal model tests is 1/n<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> of the prototype, thus secular settlement of deep soft clay ground can be simulated within a short time. In the paper, authors use the centrifugal model tests to research the improvement mechanism of D-M method. The tests results show that D-M method is feasible to improve deep soft clay ground. The short piles enhance the stability of foundation and the long plastic plank is contributive to decrease the post settlement of ground.

articleTitle: Prepation and tribological investigation of a novel S-N style 1,3,4-thiadiazole-2-thione derivatives
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Two non-phosphorus and ashless 1,3,4-thiadiazole-2-thione derivatives, 5-dodecyldithio-3-phenyl-1,3-4-thiadiazole-2-thione (DPTT) and 5-cetyldithio-3-phenyl-1,3,4-thiadiazole-2-thione (DHTT) were synthesized and confirmed by elemental analyses. Thermal degradation test were conducted to identify their thermal stabilities using a thermo-gravimetric analyzer (TGA). The tribological behavior of the synthesized compounds as additive in rapeseed oil (RSO) was examined by using four-ball friction and wear tester. The worn surface morphology and element chemical composition of rubbing film was analyzed by means of scanning electron microscopy (SEM) and X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS). The results indicate that the additives possess good thermal stabilities, these novel compounds as additives in the rapeseed oil were able to obviously decrease the wear rate and friction coefficient. The results of XPS analyses illustrate that the prepared compounds reacted with metal surface to form a film containing sulfate, sulfide, iron oxide and N-containing organic compounds, all these compounds contributed to the improved tribological properties of the rapeseed oil.

articleTitle: Research on multi-objective optimization of BIW modal
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: BIW modal optimization with traditional FEM method was inefficiency and usually with much mass increase. FEM analysis combined with Multi-objective Optimization method was used to improve the first order frequency of BIW. Mathematic model was built by response surface method to replace FEM model and NSGA-II was used to get non-dominated solutions. During the optimization plates with high relative sensitivity was used as design variables. The first natural frequency was optimized with the mass of BIW was under control. The method in this paper is useful in big complex structures when do some optimization.

articleTitle: A novel estimation strategy for the eye-in-hand depth-independent visual servoing
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: As we know, a novel adaptive visual servoing strategy has been proposed for the control of robot manipulators with an eye-in-hand configuration, where an adaptive law is used to estimate the unknown parameters determined by the products of the unknown 3D coordinates and the unknown camera parameters. From a practical point of view, in this paper, we propose a novel strategy for the estimation of these two types of unknown parameters. The new strategy is very useful in that it can reduce the number of the unknown parameters to be estimated. To demonstrate the feasibility of the proposed method, preliminary simulation results based on a two-link planar robot manipulator are presented in this paper.

articleTitle: The design and research of heating welder temperature control system for PE battery clapboard
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper introduces a design method of heating welder temperature control system for PE battery clapboard based on 89C52 single-chip, and gives hardware circuit diagram of temperature control system. It makes simulation and experimental effect comparison between PID control and integral separation PID control with Smith prediction, proved that integral separation PID control with Smith prediction can better satisfy the PE clapboard heat welding requirements. Based on this research, the heating welder for PE battery clapboard has been made. It is proved that the welding machine can well meet the production requirement and greatly enhance the efficiency.

articleTitle: Cracks detection of beam-type structures based on curvature in time domain using smeared crack model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: A new damage index named smeared cracked model damage index (SCMDI) based on the mean curvature of beam-type structure in time domain to detect cracks is presented, which introduces the smeared cracked model in damage mechanics, is demonstrated to be more robust and high efficiency in crack detection using a numerical model. The discrete measured responses for specified time interval are used to obtain the curvature of each section corresponding to nodes of the finite element model of continuous beam, and the mean curvature of each section in time domain is used to build a damage index that represents the relative ratio of the loss of curvature of the pre-damaged to the post-damaged beam. The SCMDI is used to identify possible locations and corresponding severities of cracks in the beam-type structure. The numerical simulation of a continuous beam demonstrates the validity of the proposed SCMDI.

articleTitle: Preparation and application researches of starch graft copolymer
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Starch graft copolymers have some excellent performance the same as synthetic polymer materials. Application study on it has become a research hotspot. In this paper, the synthesis and application researches of starch graft copolymers, such as the bio-degradable plastics, super absorbent polymer and flocculants were reviewed. The future development in this field was also prespected.

articleTitle: Optimizing analysis of column-span of the typical no-platform-column canopy
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: With the rapid development of the railway construction, more and more no-platform-column canopies are used in railway stations. The typical no-platform-column canopies of different column-span are studied by the separate variable method. The optimizing column-span is presented though contrastive analyzing economics and rationality of the no-platform-column canopies of different column-span, which could be 9m, 12m, 15m, 18m, 21m, 24m, 27m. The result shows that 15m and 18m are the best column-span of the no-platform-column canopy of three platforms and five lines. And the study further shows that when two swing columns are set along the span, the total steel quantity per unit area will decrease by about 25%, It has guiding significance for the design of the column-span, meeting the low-carbon economy and the environmental requirements.

articleTitle: The application of ORDBMS in Pornography identify platform
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Pornography identify platform based on SOA is posed, and structure figure and flow figure of the platform are given. Then the technology of ORDBMS (Object Relation Data Base Management System) is focused on, and the merit of ORDBMS in Pornography platform is discussed. In the application of ORDBMS in Pornography platform, object-oriented data model of platform is firstly constructed, then giving the realization of the data model and discussing the specific application of ORDBMS in the Pornography platform in detail. For the technology of ORDBMS, the Pornography platform solves the problems of large amount of Pornography and complex of Pornography data type, and it receives a very good application and has significance of instructing.

articleTitle: A method for FDTD modeling of wave propagation in magnetized plasma
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The shift operator (SO) method is extended to the case of electric anisotropic dispersive medium by taking magnetized plasma for example. The SO-FDTD formulations are derived based on the permittivity tensor in magnetized plasma and Maxwell curl equations of anisotropic media, in which the transfer matrix between the principal and the laboratory system is used. The LCP and RCP eigenwave reflection and transmission coefficients of magnetized plasma layer, the backward RCS of a plasma sphere in an external dc magnetic field of different directions are computed by proposed method and analyzed. The computed results indicate the correctness and feasibility of our method.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on energy and water consumption of universities in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Active target tracking based on Mean Shift algorithm and color template matching
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: An active tracking algorithm synthesized Mean Shift Algorithm and Color template matching was proposed in dynamic background. After changing of camera perspective or focus, the algorithm, based on the fact: color template matching with the moving target is independent of the position in frames, locates target in new frame using color template matching and then tracks target using Mean Shift algorithm, by initializing Mean Shift search windows with the new location of target. The algorithm can track moving target correctly and keep tracking target in the center of the frame. Experiments show that the algorithm is great of robustness and practical.

articleTitle: Twinkling-state lateral vibration analysis of angular-misaligned shafts during startup process
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Angular-misaligned shafts connected by gear coupling is the main study object. First introduced a model that consists of two angular-misaligned rigid shafts mounted on bearings. The non-dimensional lateral vibration differential equation of angular-misaligned shaft during startup process is derived, the equation is investigated by numerical integral method. The result reveals that the vibration peaks will appear when shaft rotating speeds pass through near a half of ω<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">c</sub> and ω<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">c</sub>, the response peaks will decrease little and the rotating speeds corresponding to peaks will be lag with acceleration increasing, the effect of unbalance to critical-harmonic resonance is bigger than it to ultra-harmonic resonance, the effect of misalignment angle or coupling mass to critical-harmonic resonance is smaller than it to ultra-harmonic resonance.

articleTitle: Content-based cache tactic design and implementation on mobile Widget engine
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The content-based cache algorithm design and implementation of Widget engine on mobile intelligent terminal are presented. This algorithm intelligently downloads and stores the network data, and properly arranges various mobile Widgets network datum by applying the technology on the internal storage and cache. According to the customers' visiting information, and using the theory of the technology of the mobile Widget, a simple and feasible caching refreshing algorithm is designed to make the best use of cache space to achieve the better performance of the system. The feasibility of the proposed algorithm is verified and its advantages are testified by the experiment.

articleTitle: Study on impermanent supporting system of large-span spatial structure and structure conversion technology during construction
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Based on the large-span spatial structure of Ordos's airport terminal, an impermanent supporting system arrangement scheme was put forward during the construction of a large-span spatial steel structure. By FEM analysis, the member force and deformation of the supporting system in construction were got and its availability was validated. Therefore, a whole removal scheme of the supporting system was suggested, as well as the principle and process to ensure the synchronization at each removal step. Through the numerical simulation analysis, the gradual changing bearing characteristic of the supporting system, as well as the principal structure itself, was attained. Thus the structural system conversion was realized successfully. And this practice also provide practical basis for the construction and unloading of similar project.

articleTitle: Retrospective effect and analysis of the pollutant of waste water on the Yangtze River water quality
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The article analyses and predicts the hydrodynamic feature of study area on the basis of mike21 numerical model. It is by the two dimensions pollution diffused simulation method based on the hydrodynamic model. And then it predicts the contributed concentration field of the waste water. Based on the NH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>-N in discharge of sewage, it contrasts the impact on water quality in the Yangtze River of the pollution in waste water from time and space. In general, with the decreasing of Baosteel project's sewage water efflux, the pollutant has less effect on the water equality of Yangtze River's contributed concentration year by year.

articleTitle: Application of intelligent logic control in molecular distillation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: According to the temperature properties and temperature control embodiment in the vitamin E molecular distillation installations, molecular distillation temperature intelligent logic control method is proposed. To detect the molecular distillation unit deviation and the deviation of the temperature change rate as the feedback signal, first we set up its logic control rules; then symbolic logic control rules to get a logic control expression; finally calculate the output state Boolean worth to reach the corresponding logic control quantity. This paper researches knifing type molecular distillation unit.

articleTitle: Application of an average current control method in Double-loop control systems of brushless DC motor
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Double-loop control systems of brushless DC motor (BLDCM) yield a combination of desired characteristics including simplified control structure, high speed accuracy, wide operating speed range and fast dynamic response. The current loop is very important for system performance. Its linearity is influenced by the accuracy of feedback current. The cost of detecting currents in three windings is higher, and most methods based on shunt-current reaction are nonlinear. An average current control method of sampling the dc-link current at the center of the Pulse-Width Modulation (PWM) on-time interval can overcome the above limitations. Average stator current can be regulated by the average current control method. Simulation results demonstrate this method is very effective and can make systems obtain basically same performance compared with the method of detecting currents in three windings.

articleTitle: Research of vacuum thermal insulation characteristic for conduction cooling SMES
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper, the vacuum system of conduction cooling high temperature Superconducting Magnetic Energy Storage (SMES) is seen as the research object. The relation between vacuum degree and material deflation, temperature change is revealed by the theory analyses and experiment in the moment of vacuuming and cryogenics absorbing. The pressure of SMES vacuum system has been maintaining in 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-2</sup> Pa for 20 days in the experiment. The result of experiment is shows that absorbing capability is favorable and require of the vacuum degree is satisfied with G-M refrigerator in SMES vacuum system.

articleTitle: Boron removal from seawater desalination by RO
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Although a number of papers describing the boron removal methods from seawater in the past decades, the reverse osmosis (RO) for boron removal from seawater desalination is consider as one of the simplest and most promising methods. The new progresses on boron removal from seawater by RO membranes and its major effect parameter including operating temperature, operating pressure, solution pH, feed ionic strength, initial boron concentrate, membrane fouling, and so on was reviewed with 22 references. Characteristics of the processes and their operating parameters were summarized. The highlight and the new trend in the future on basic research to understand the boron rejection by reverse osmosis membranes was pointed out.

articleTitle: Nonlinear numerical analysis of piles-soil interaction in lateral spreading of liquefied ground
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Lateral spreading of liquefied ground due to strong earthquakes frequently causes serious damages to multi-piles foundations. The relative displacement of flowing liquefied soil to piles effects the lateral force on piles and the failure of piles. In this study, a 4-piles model in liquefiable soil with two kinds of local slopes is simulated numerically by the 3-D dynamics FE-FD coupled method, in which an fluidal elasto-plastic constitutive model is adopted to describe the saturated soil; the analysis is taken onto the pore water pressure changing of soil, the displacement of soil around piles and the reaction of front and back piles in laterally spreading, also the relationship between the relative displacement of flowing liquefied soil is discussed.

articleTitle: Lead-acid Battery intelligent charger control strategy study
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: There are two key problems should be solved for the charge of Lead-Acid Battery. The first problem is the fast charging, the other is the quality of charge. This paper proposed a novel charging method, capacity trace-pulsing current-floating charge mode method. In the design of the controller, this paper proposed Fuzzy-PI controller, the rapidity and dynamic stability of the system were guaranteed with the bandwidth h of system controlled by the Fuzzy controller. The method and design is verified by the simulation and experiment.

articleTitle: Development of flow stability experimental platform on water flow calibration facility
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: To study the flow stability of the flow calibration facility under different pressure stabilizing methods, analyze the influencing factors, and improve it. The paper develops a flow stability experimental platform. The flow range of it is 0.04~4 m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>/h, the uncertainty of it is better than 0.05% (k=2). It proves that experimental platform works well and can reflect the difference of the flow stability under different pressure stabilizing methods according to the results of experiment on them.

articleTitle: The application of new stacking method to enhance seismic signal
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Common-reflection-surface stack can provide the enhanced seismic stacked section with the best illumination for the reflecting interface in the subsurface. This paper introduced the theory and implementation of 2D zero-offset common-reflection-surface stack, and then applied this method to a 2D synthetic dataset and a low-fold land engineering seismic dataset from Western China. The application on synthetic example and real data shows that zero-offset common-reflection-surface stack can improve the seismic stacked section by increasing the signal-to-noise ratio and enhancing the consistence of reflection event, and the results reveal that this method is a promising tool of seismic data processing.

articleTitle: Game design with Scratch∗: Implications on computer support for collaborative learning
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The purpose of this study was to examine learning effects and problem solving strategies in the context of elementary students designing games with Scratch. Due to the fact that all of the participants were not familiar with Scratch, they were taught its basics before the study began. The study involved 5 design sessions, and each last for three hours. In total, there were 12 participants divided into 4 groups; one group with 3 members was selected as the major research participants. Data were collected via videotaping the design process and analyzing student works. There are three major findings in this study. First, the participants had good learning outcomes with their own design of characters, backgrounds and codes. Second, in terms of time allocation, due to the constraints posed by the instructor, the students spent less and less time on creating characters, and more and more time on programming. But the time spent on creating backgrounds varied with the tasks. Third, the students solved problems by using different strategies, (1) by trial and error, (2) via group dialogues, (3) with the help of group experts and (4) by referencing examples on the websites.

articleTitle: Research of magnetic suspension technology for the reformation of turbine flow meter
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper introduces a new-type turbine flow meter. The concept is to apply magnetic suspension bearing to reform turbine flow meter. Beginning with the structure and working principle of magnetic suspension bearing, the magnet suspension bearing is compared with the common bearing in their differences and characteristics. To draw a conclusion from the comparison that the turbine flow meter based on magnetic suspension bearings superiors to the one with common bearings, and the problems in the application of magnetic suspension bearing are introduced at the same time. Numerous experiments show that the range of measurement can be largely widened and the working life span of turbine flow meters also can be extended with magnetic suspension bearings.

articleTitle: A research of cooperative control method on multisystem containing CST for automobile safety
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: To improve the safety protection capability of automobile while driving, and better to play the role of CST in protecting automobile, aiming at some factors affecting road safety, and combined with the design requirements of control system, the article researched the judge method about driving safety level, human-computer interaction response alerts and emergency measures. And by using cooperative control structure mode on multi-system and the centralized cooperative strategy, the article designed the cooperative control scheme on multisystem containing CST for automobile safety. This cooperative control scheme had better real-time performance and simpler design than a single control system.

articleTitle: The sensitivity of using tribo-electrification responses for monitoring the tribological properties between a thin film of tin
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The traditional method of using the continuous variation of the friction coefficient with sliding distance to monitor the tribological properties between the contacts of soft metal films is generally low in sensitivity. This paper proposed the novel method of using instead the continuous variation of tribo-electrification voltage. This method was investigated experimentally for the dry friction sliding of iron on copper coated with a thin film of tin and was shown to be much superior to the traditional method in terms of sensitivity. The method has the added advantage of the ability to assess the solid to film lubrication of the soft metal film. Finally, a continuous model to represent the wear mechanisms for iron sliding against copper coated with a thin film of tin was proposed.

articleTitle: Hydro-generating unit axis intelligent detection system design based on single-chip microcomputer
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The reason of axis swing of the Hydro-generating unit has been analyzed, summarized unit axis intelligent detection system detection principle and system components. The detection system consists of the AT89C52 single chip microcomputer as the front-end axis swing detector and PC as the host computer, the detector complete unit axis detector swing data collection, transmission; PC complete data optimization process, graphic display and storage, etc. System makes full use of the single chip microcomputer and the characteristics of the computer, the data collection, unit axis adjustment and optimization of data management in one set.

articleTitle: Analysis of dynamic response of base slab in blasting demolition of reinforced concrete girders
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Blasting demolition of reinforced concrete girders was widely applied in the deep foundation pit engineering, but the influence of the blasting load to the permanent structure deserved considered for the short distance between the center of the blasting and the permanent structure. Based on the time-history analysis method, the acceleration time-history curves which was transformed from velocity time-history curves was introduced as the calculating loads and the velocity time-history curves was obtained from field measurement. Then the dynamic response of base slab subjected to blasting load of reinforced concrete girders was calculated through the ANSYS/LS-DYNA software.
