At last the stress, velocity and displacement caused by blasting was analyzed. It was founded that the maximum and minimum principal stress were 6.7 MPa and 8.2 MPa separately and the maximum velocity and displacement were 14.8 cm/s and 0.58 mm separately. The elements didn't yield in the process, so the base slab was safe.

articleTitle: Development and research on a new bearing replacer based on induction heating technolog
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: On the basis of the theoretical analysis, this paper designed a new bearing replacer based on induction heating technique by finite element method. The regularities of the distribution of electromagnetic-thermal coupled field in the replacer, temperature changes with time course and expansion size in shaft and bearing inner race had been simulated during the course of induction heating. The FEM simulation results not only proved the existence of the eddy skin effect, but also achieved the design parameters of the replacer. By experimental verification, the replacer can realize fast disassembling of the bearing inner race, which assembled on an axle with interference fit.

articleTitle: Evaluation of eco-city based on the fuzzy matter element model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Eco-city research has been given close attention during the past decades, and the evaluation of it has become a key part. According to the research results of eco-city evaluation at home and abroad, an evaluation index system has been established, including resource and environment, economy, socio-culture and management. On the basis of the index system, fuzzy matter-element model is used to evaluate eco-city. Taking 9 provincial capital cities as an example, which located in the western of China, the evaluation result shows that it is fairly consistent in actual situation of eco-city construction. So the index system and the model are proved to be effective and feasible, which will be helpful to eco-city's evaluation and construction in the future.

articleTitle: Generation method of Lanzhou dialect speech based on Gaussian Mixture Model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Dialect generation is one of the most important aspects of Chinese speech synthesis. Using the method of conversion prosodic features we can realize high quality speech synthesis. Firstly, A Lanzhou dialect corpus has been built based on "word-list in dialectal survey" for the generation of Lanzhou dialect. Speech corpus was recorded with contrastive (Lanzhou dialect vs. Mandarin) recordings. A pitch target model is introduced, which is optimized to describe feature parameters of the Mandarin speech and Lanzhou dialect speech in the training set of speech corpus. Secondly, the Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) can map the subtle prosody distributions between Mandarin and Lanzhou dlialect speech, we train GMM conversion parameter in the training set, and get converted F0 contours of Lanzhou dialect speech by GMM conversion parameter. Using the converted Lanzhou dlialect F0 contours, we can generate high quality Lanzhou dlialect speech by STRAIGHT algorithm. Subjective experiments demonstrated that the generated speech achieve 4.06 of the average mean opinion score(MOS).

articleTitle: Lane recognition and tracking based on muli-features fuzzy fusion and particle filter
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In order to overcome the instability of the lane object recognition based on only one feature, the shadiness object is extracted from the lane image, multi-features information including texture and edge are adopted, Eigen vectors composing of texture and edge are transformed with fuzzy theory to subjection degree and fuzzy density. Finally, they are fused with fuzzy rules in the frame of particle filter. In the course of lane image processing, successively the origin image is gray-scale transformed, the gray image is segmented with OTSU method, the segmented edge feature is fitted to straight line with improved Hough method, the texture feature is extracted by means of gray scale co-occurrence matrix, in the end, the extracted edge and texture features are fused fuzzily with the improved particle filter. The experimental results shows that the method based on multi-features fuzzy fusion and improved particle filter can provide strong robustness of the recognition and tracking for structural lane, and also acquire better tracking effect for the unstructured lane.

articleTitle: Monitoring large-area mine deformation by GPS considering plate movement
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to investigate how to establish the deformation monitoring datum unification using the nearby IGS station as reference station, which is characterized by stable geologic condition, easily obtain observation data and continuous observation. We have carried out several sets of experiments to test the validity of proposed method used for large-area mine monitoring, and demonstrated the relationship between positioning accuracy and observation time. Through analysis the variation of IGS stations coordinates in time series, the fact shown that the motion of IGS station is non-linear and the max discrepancy may be more than 10mm. Therefore the IGS stations coordinates should be adopted form IGS solution when used to determine the deformation monitoring datum. Finally, an example was test for different schemes, the results show that plate movement should be considered to the high precision GPS deformation monitoring.

articleTitle: A study on vacuum system of sealing-exhaust equipment for ceramic metal halide lamp
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Based on the analysis of sealing-exhaust process for arc tube of ceramic metal halide lamp(CMH) and the calculation to a few key vacuum parameter, this report proposes a design plan of the sealing-exhaust equipment's vacuum system for arc tube of ceramic metal halide lamp, and finally tube of ceramic metal halide lamp, and finally verifies the conductance of vacuum system to reach the design desire.

articleTitle: Generating unit and control system model for stability analysis of power system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper builds a reasonable and brief system model, which can be used for the power system stability simulation. This system model consists of the mathematical models of power units, their sub-control systems, the load and grid. Moreover, this paper established two Coordinated Control System (CCS) models with different logical configuration of the actual CCS and connected these CCS models to the system model, which provided an objective and concise simulation model and analysis platform for the stability simulation of the power system. It is helpful to the modeling and the research for the stability simulation of the power system.

Author Keywords: analysis platform for the stability simulation

articleTitle: Study on virtual enterprise information integration based on multi-Agent Web Services platform
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: After analyzing Virtual Enterprise connotation and characteristics, we point out the limitation of virtual enterprise integration based on Web Services. Then we propose the design proposal fusing the multi-Agent technology in Web Services technology. At last according to this plan, we construct one virtual enterprise information integrative system based on multi-Agent Web Services platform.

articleTitle: A 1.18GHz low phase noise CMOS LC-VCO in DTV-Tuner application
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: A low phase noise LC-VCO in 0.18/μm CMOS 1P5M technology is presented. The VCO achieves a 12.5% frequency tuning range (from 1.12 to 1.26GHz) through the 6-bit binary switched-capacitor array. Simulated results show the phase noise is -113.6dBc/Hz@10kHz offset, the power consumption of the designed VCO is 27mW with 3.3V supply voltage.

articleTitle: The technological research on the separation between law alkalinity copper and sulfur of a certain miner containing copper sulfur iron in anhui
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The research object of this paper is a certain complex sulfur-iwn which contains copper in Anhui province. It focuses on the flowsheet about the separation of copper and sulfur in low alkalinity condition. The content of copper in the original oar is 0.39%, and sulfur is 36.19 percent. In low alkalinity conditions, we used copper compound maily LP collectors, first through copper selective flotation, then through sulfur selective flotation in which the original slurry didn't get activated. It was obtained that the grade of copper concentrate was 18.46 percent and copper recovery was 72.16 percent percent;the grade sulfur concentrate was 48.14 percent and sulfur recovery was 93.72 percent.

Author Keywords: Sulfur select in the original slurry

articleTitle: The improved (G/G′)-expansion method for the (2+1)-dimensional Broer-Kaup equations
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Searching for a new solution method and acquire new exact solutions of nonlinear evolution equations has become one of the hot research field. In this paper we using a new(G/G') method by using the computer algebra system of Mathematics to obtained rich exact solutions of the (2+1)-dimensional Broer-Kaup equations, this method can also be used to find other nonlinear evolution equations of new exact solitary wave solution.

articleTitle: The research on tectonic system from a multidimensional view
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Based on the most common and most basic concept of construction, the technical potential of construction design is exploited in the engineering construction process from various angles, and the concepts of mass customization and integrated building construction are put forward. Moreover, the article explores the safeguard role of integrated construction in the performance of green building and its fidelity effect of technology content in building construction as well as the management mechanism of digital technology through the whole building process in order to promote the modernization level of the whole building industry.

articleTitle: A time-saving algorithm for constructing QC-LDPC codes based on PEG algorithm
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: We propose a new algorithm based on PEG algorithm to construct high-girth quasi-cyclic low-density parity check (QC-LDPC) codes. Before our improved algorithm in introduction, we depict the general algorithm based on PEG algorithm to construct QC - LDPC code, if necessary to eliminate the short cycles, that would bring in cycles-search. When code length of basic matrix is not too long, the algorithm is feasible, but with the code length growth, cycles-search will bring large of calculation and time-consuming sharply. Therefore we put forward an improved method by using the specific relation of basic matrix rows to replace traditional cycles-search, effectively eliminates short cycles, and largely reduces the time complexity at the same time. Through the simulation analysis, the performance can also be comparable with random constructed LDPC codes.

articleTitle: Effects of silicon fume and latex on properties and hydration of modified mortars
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Polybutadiene-graft-polystyrene (PB-g-PS) latex with a weight ratio of 50/50 was used to modify cement mortar. This study examines the effects of silicon fume content and the polymer-cement ratios (P/C) on the flow, compressive and flexural strength and water absorption rate of PB-g-PS latex modified cement mortar. The experimental results show that the flow of modified mortar is increased with increasing polymer-cement ratios, and it is decreased with increasing silicon fume content, PB-g-PS latex and suitable silicon fume content can markedly reduce capillary water absorption rate. PB-g-PS latex can marked influences much on the mechanical properties of modified mortars. The compressive of the polymer modified mortar decreased, and the flexural strength of a portion of polymer modified mortar increased. The suitble silicon fume can improve mechanical properties of modified mortats. The effect of PB-g-PS latex and silicon fume content on cement hydration was explored by XRD, the analysis results showed that the cement hydration was influenced by silicon fume content and P/C.

articleTitle: Experimental research on resistance temperature characteristic of conductive composite materials used in large deformation sensor
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: To research the resistance temperature characteristic of large deformation sensor element produced by the conductive composite materials based on rubber. A series of tests on resistance temperature characteristic of carbon fiber filled conductive silicone rubber are carried out. the results shows that it appears transition temperature during heating-cooling cycle range from 0D to 40D. The composite materials shows Negative Temperature Coefficient of resistance(NTC) phenomenon at temperatures below the transition temperature while it shows Positive Temperature Coefficient of resistance(PTC) phenomenon at temperatures above the transition temperature. The resistance of composite materials gradually decreases, and finally reaches a steady as the temperature cycle.

articleTitle: Large-scale education resource discovering and sharing based on UPnP
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: UPnP is often used for networking, discovering, sharing of network resource from a wide range of vendors. The Intel UPnP SDK is a popular open-source developing kit of UPnP. However, there is some limitation of the SDK. It can support only one server of device in one application, and the device management is not provided. To overcome the limitation, an UPnP-based development framework (UFM) is proposed. Receiving and transferring of network message is excuted in a class encapsulated over the SDK, which acts likes a proxy of the SDK. Therefore, large-scale resource nodes can be managed with the framework. Further-development becomes easy because of classing of the SDK in the framework.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Assessment of carbon dioxide emissions based on construction project life cycle
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Research on some critical problems of contracting for Building Information Model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Benefits of Building Information Model (BIM) for the construction industry are many and varied. Despite the benefits and the range of issues it can bring, BIM for the most part has been treated lightly in project agreement. According to the relatively-recent emergence of BIM and its evolving capabilities and uses, there is a general consensus that the industry must do better. In order to meet the need, the purpose of this article includes the critical problems on contracting for BIM, influence on responsibility and time scope for designers and contractors. It generally discusses contract terms that can help the parties both manage the challenges and maximize the benefits of BIM.

articleTitle: Process modeling and performance evaluation for re-configurable enterprise application system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: A framework for enterprise application system was proposed to reconfigure system's business process effectively by using method of separating process logical and business logical And then, UML/GSPN (generalized stochastic Petri nets) integrated modeling approach was adopted in the framework, it include System's process modeling in UML and performance evaluation in GSPN technology. An example of sales order process in enterprise application system was given to illustrate the validity of the approach. The result show that the performance evaluation method is capable of providing a basic quantitative analysis means in reconfiguration of system's business process.

articleTitle: Effect of moist-curing time at early ages on carbonation resistance of pumping concrete incorporated with fly-ash
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Based on accelerated carbonation test, the variation of carbonation resistance of pumping concrete (C30 grade) with moist-curing time at early ages and fly ash content was studied in this paper. Results indicate that the carbonation resistance of the concrete decreased obviously with moist-curing time at early ages reducing and with the cement replacement by fly ash increasing. For example, under conditions of curing schedules with 28, 7, 3, 2 and 1 d moist-curing at early ages and then 0, 21, 25, 26 and 27 d air-curing at (60+5)% RH respectively, the 28-day accelerated carbonation depths of the concrete incorporated with 20% fly ash were 15.6, 20.5, 25.3, 31.5 and 45.9 mm respectively, and thus it can be seen the calculated times when concrete cover (25 mm) was completely carbonated naturally in the air were 98, 57, 38, 24 and 11 years respectively. The results suggest that for the carbonation resistance of the concrete incorporated with 20% fly ash, it is necessary that the moist-curing time at early ages should need 7 days.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Algorithm of multi-baseline interferometer phase difference in fuzzy circumstance
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: The study for rainfall trend of the middle of Taiwan under climate change
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Although the amount of spring rain is only 10% of total rainfall in Taiwan, it plays an important role of water resource allocation during drought periods. Therefore, increase the rainfall forecast ability will help the combination of surface water and groundwater usage during drought period, it will also help early warning and policy decision. This study focused on local rainfall characteristic and trend of Jhuoshuei River Basin in the middle of Taiwan. To find out the difference of rainfall during October to December and January to March in past 30 years between mountains and flats, the trend correlation of nonparametric statistical method was utilized. The results can be used to predict rainfall in the future and increase water resource management ability.

articleTitle: The numerical conversion algorithm of cardiac electrophysiology image
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Nowadays The research of electrophysiology signal has attracted much attention in clinical discipline. Original experiment record of electrophysiology is significant for further research, especially for the study of Channelopathy. It is difficult to repeat this experiment because of the special cases or the restrictions of the experimental equipment and the cost of experiment. Therefore, it is necessary to convert the curve graphics to numerical value as a method of processing the original data in the medical signal area. The article based on MATLAB software, take the signal of cardiac electrophysiology and Channelopathy for example, Based on characteristic analysis of cardiac electrophysiology and Channelopathy images, the images were subjected to numerical value, including signal extraction, noise extraction, and error correction. This algorithm was used for various types of heart electrophysiology image to prove its feasibility. Finally, the image of numerical value was compared with the original to check its accuracy. Through compare the original data of the image with the post-treatment data treated by the converted program, showing the conversion results are basically accurate. Using this algorithm, electrophysiology image can be converted to numerical value accurately and stored for further research, which is an important preparation especially for the study of heart diseases.

articleTitle: Optimization design for sheet metal parts of mobile electron radar based on finite element analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Based on illuminating the structure, working principle and force analysis of mobile electron radar, the finite element analysis of sheet metal shell is carried out on ANSYS Workbench (AWE) platform. First, the structure of sheet metal shell is simplified, then the 3D entity model and meshing model of sheet metal parts both are established. Secondly, the material attribute, contact type, load and constraints of computation model are defined, and the total deformation, equivalent stress and safety factor of sheet metal shell are gained after numerical calculation. The results show that the local deformation of shell is too large, the safety factor being low, and the stiffness cannot satisfy the requirement. In order to improve the stiffness of sheet metal shell, the strengthen ribs are stamped on the plane of shell, and the plane supporting frame is made into steps. The analysis shows that the sheet metal shell has high safety factor, uniform stress, small deformation, superior performance after optimizing, and it also can fully meet the requirement of using.

articleTitle: Design and finite element analysis of shaking table for fatigue test of high speed train transmission system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: With large scale increases of the train speed, it is of great practical significance to develop a fatigue test stand for high-speed train's transmission system. 3-DOF (three degree-of-freedom) electro-hydraulic shaking table for high-speed train's transmission system fatigue test is designed and its three dimensional mathematical model is established in this paper. In addition, static analysis and modal analysis of this shaking table are carried out by finite element analysis software. The results show the rationality of our mechanism design. The above research work lays the foundation for structural improvement and optimum design of shaking table.

articleTitle: Optimization of microwave-assisted extraction of chondroitin sulfate from tilapia byproduct by response surface methodology
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The chondroitin sulfate was isolated from tilapia byproduct by a method of dilute alkali hydrolysis with the assistance of microwave. Optimization using response surface methodology (RSM) was performed and 3D response surfaces were plotted from the mathematical model. The results indicated that the optimal extraction conditions were as follows: microwave power was 252W, microwave time was 5.64min, ratio of solid to liquid was 1:29, and alkali concentration was 7%. Under these conditions, the mean extraction rate of chondroitin sulfate was 1.632%, which was in good agreement with the predicted model value.

articleTitle: The current practice and promotion strategy of dry-mix mortars in Taiwan — Taking technology acceptance model as an approach
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Compared with traditional cement processing methods, dry-mix mortars are more environmental friendly by reducing air pollution or waste production on construction sites. It can also reduce carbon dioxide emissions, helps to keep the construction site clean, and allow for more flexibility in storage space for materials while reducing cement redundancy after the cement finishing is completed. It can be said that this new and advanced construction material is environmental friendly and convenient to deploy and transport, delivers product of stable quality, helps to facilitate construction, and saves materials. In this study, a questionnaire survey was conducted on people in the construction industry in Taiwan to explore their perceptions of the characteristics of dry mix mortars and their acceptance of this material. Totally 133 valid samples were returned. After the analysis of the questionnaire results, this research found the more the respondents find dry-mix mortars useful, the more satisfied they are with the material; the more they are satisfied, the more willing they are to promote it. Among all the factors, the perceived usefulness of this material has a particularly significant influence.

articleTitle: Machining technology for non-axisymmetric optical surfaces
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Piezoelectric fast tool servo mechanism, with its existing nonlinear response and hysteresis, restricts greatly the precision when applied to machining of non-axisymmetric optical surface. In this paper, a feed-forward control method is applied to compensate the displacement of the fast tool servo. According to the workpiece surface feature and the tool path, the mathematical model of the minimum setting angle is established to avoid the interference between the tool and the surface to be machined. A new kind of control method - real time calculating control with table look-up is developed. This control method can shorten the calculating time and improve the precision of the machining surface at the same time.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation for new style beam-slab type of Wind Turbine Generators Tower Foundation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The beam-slab type foundation is a new type of Wind Turbine Generators Tower Foundation. It has advantages over traditional foundation in being more convenience and reasonable. Here the finite element analysis software ANSYS is being used to get the reasonable disposal of the s beam-slab type foundation and analyze the static characteristics of the new structure such as stress, displacement and settlement of foundation. The FEM model is created according to the factual three-dimensional mode. The calculation and analysis results are useful in the optimum design of the structure.

articleTitle: Application condition of linearized model uncertainty estimate
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper studies the application condition of linearized model uncertainty estimate numerically for the Magnetotelluric (MT) problem using Bayesian inference theory, based on a three layer case with different parameter combinations. The nonlinear uncertainty estimate is calculated with relatively intensive computation, via Markov chain Monte Carlo method of Metropolis Hastings, giving an unbiased sampling from the posterior probability density (PPD), while the linearized uncertainty estimate which can be achieved cheaply, is based on the Gaussian distribution centered at the optimal model calculated based on a nonlinear optimization method, adaptive simplex simulated annealing (ASSA). The results show that linear uncertainty estimate can be evaluated as an alternative to the nonlinear uncertainty estimate for certain parameter combinations (model structure).

articleTitle: Driving manner and design method on elbow joint of a artificial limb
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper, the driving manner and design method are discussed for the elbow joint of one kind of robot artificial limb. On the basis to satisfy ergonomics, some technical parameters required for the riving manner is make out for the elbow joint. In order to ensure implement for diverse requests, optimization design is adopted in this case. Based on the peculiarity of structure and movement, variables, constraint functions and objective function are all projected reasonably. Complex method is handled to optimize the parameters. Finally, with graphics simulation, it is proved that optimization results suffice the practice requirement commendably.

articleTitle: A fast entity resolution method based on wave of records
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Given a large data collection, entity resolution is to find the records referring to the same entity. A crucial step of entity resolution is to compute the similarity between records. Without careful design, sometimes it has to compare all characters in two records to get a small similarity value. In this paper, we propose a novel method based on waves of records, which is a sequence of frequencies of characters and the same frequency of different characters is considered as different. The structure Wave in our algorithm will decrease comparing times sharply in computing similarity by two techniques: filtering the record pairs without the similar waves, and estimating the maximum similarity of the remaining part of records can be, and if it is too small, the algorithm can end the computation as early as possible without false negative. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our algorithm using a thorough experimental evaluation over real-life data sets.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on the power of FDI control in China's machinery industry
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Design and realization of intelligent logistics transportation equipment
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Trams intelligent logistics transportation Equipment is widely used in industrial automation system. For the short line, and it has higher requirement of positioning accuracy, using the way of SCM + stepper motor, the displacement and the speed will be converted to chip number sending by stepper motor and frequency. So, easily, it can be realized for accurate positioning and speed. Using touch screen, which is easy to predominate running stats, trouble state, operation order, and production state. The positioning precision is satisfied from the result of experiment by this position method.

articleTitle: The optimization for the launch of antimissile shrapnel: The optimization of the angle of fire and the direction angle of antimissile shrapnel
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The trajectory of incoming missile and shrapnel are analyzed to make sure that the incoming missile would be within the distribute range of bullets dispersed by the shrapnel. In the case of the center of bullet group hits the target, the miss distance is optimized with the angle of fire and direction angle as the optimization variables in MATLAB. An unconstrained optimization function `fminsearch' is used. The optimal angle of fire and the direction angle of antimissile shrapnel are solved. The numerical calculation shows that the optimal angle of fire Θ* and direction angle φ* vary periodically with the orientation angle of the launching of shrapnel and the object needed to be protected. When the distance of the launching of shrapnel and the object needed to be protected increases from 60 to 1000 meters, θ* and φ* increase from 17.5°to 22.5°, from 67.4°to 79.7° respectively. When the muzzle velocity increases from 160 to 260m/s, and φ* change from 19.3°to 16.7°, from 48.5°to 54.4 ° respectively. The optimal angle of fire, the direction angle and their situation of change can be analyzed in the mathematical model for optimization of shrapnel gunnery.

articleTitle: Application of artificial intelligence algorithm in thermally stimulated discharge apparatus
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The artificial intelligence algorithm of the AI controller was researched, based on the DH-TSD thermally stimulated discharge apparatus developed by ourselves, and a comparison was made between the temperature rising curves of AI control and step control, the results show that the use of artificial intelligence algorithm can get a better linear for the temperature rising curve, which is conducive to raising the accuracy of the thermally stimulated discharge experiment. At last we demonstrated the conclusion by TSD experiment on the self-developed apparatus.

articleTitle: Priority scheduling algorithm to improve short-term fairness for TCP flows in WLAN
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: There is an unfairness between long-term TCP flows and short-term TCP flows because of the single queue and first-in-first-out scheduling algorithm in access point (AP) in WLAN. This paper suggests a priority scheduling algorithm. In the algorithm AP maintains one queue with a timer for each TCP flow. The scheduled orders of queues are based on values of timers. Network Simulator (NS) is used to simulate the algorithm Simulation results show that data transfer volume of short-term TCP flows is increased and RTT of short-term TCP flows is also reduced without significantly impairing the throughput of long-term TCP flows by the priority scheduling algorithm. The algorithm can improve the fairness between long-term and short-term TCP flows.

articleTitle: Research on the grid plate resistance of the air dense medium fluidized bed based on AMESim
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The traditional dry beneficiation such as the pneumatic separator, the pneumatic jig and the air table, has low efficiency and with heavy dust pollution, can't meet the requirements of the modern beneficiation. The technology of the air-dense medium fluidized bed concentration, an effective dry beneficiation, can solve the above problems. This paper presents the separation principal of the air dense medium fluidized bed, studies the factors of the dry coal separation technology as well as the importance of the grid plate. The grid plate model is established by the simulation software - AMESim. We have studied the diameter of micropore which is a main factor that influences the pressure based on the model. At last, we have got the relationship between the diameter of the micropore and the outlet pressure. This provides references for the rational selection of the pressure source and the grid plate.

articleTitle: Selection of fungus with high ability of cellulase activity production using UV mutagenesis
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Mutation breeding was carried out on Aspergillus nidulans. to obtain strains with high cellulase activity. One mutant strain, U<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub>, with high cellulase activity was obtained through primary screening and secondary screening, which used Congo red medium to compare the hydrolyzed ring and liquid fermentation to compare the enzyme activity, respectively. The enzyme activity of the obtained mutant rose from 39.60 U/ml to 156.79 U/ml, 3.96 times higher than that of original strains.

articleTitle: Analysis of status of Beijing rural sewage treatment
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Status of Beijing rural sewage treatment was analyzed comprehensively, that is, analyze Beijing rural water pollution, water pollution reasons, the main characteristics of wastewater and summary of sewage treatment, aiming at providing reference for maintenance, renovation, operation and construction of Beijing rural sewage treatment facilities mentioned.

articleTitle: Research on self-compensation flexible transmission of the dual drive system design in large rotational equipment
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Self-compensation flexible transmission is introduced into final drive in the reforming of dual drive system of the large rotational equipment. Based on the abrasion transfer principle, the abrasion of big gear ring is transformed fully to roller wheel. And the conception of coarse and delicate adjustment is imported. Exactitude engagement of pinion wheel and big gear ring is guaranteed by big hydraulic cylinder during installation. Small hydraulic cylinder installed in the roller wheel can adjust delicately according to abrasion of the roller wheel and thus it realizes automatic compensation. So pinion wheel can automatically modulate its position to guarantee the best meshing state of pinion wheel and big gear ring. A dynamic model of the flexible transmission is established. The excellent dynamic characteristic of the device are proved by the dynamic model and Lagrange's Equation of Motion. It provides the theoretical basis and design parameters for upgrading the dual drive transmission system of the large rotational equipment.

articleTitle: Analysis on stress loss in prestressed concrete structure
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper aims at the problem of prestress loss caused by friction between prestressed tendon and curved duct for the design of prestressed concrete structure. Formulas of normal pressure between prestressed tendon and curved duct and tension of prestressed tendon are derived based on the Hertz contact theory. And also the results come from experiments, derived formulas and current norms are compared in three cases.

articleTitle: Development of diversified 3D analogue simulation teaching courseware in swimming education
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This study takes butterfly stroke as an example, and develops swimming course analogue simulation multi-media teaching courseware, which utilizes diversified multi-media techniques like 3D multi-media technique, autoware, etc. It stresses more on interaction between teachers and students, with the teaching model that emphasizes on students' active participation. Certainly, the advantage of multi-media analogue simulation teaching software will be expressed more sufficiently, and serves quality-oriented education better.

articleTitle: Research on pulse control and optimal frequency match design for radome tangential grinding
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper investigates the pulse distribution of the three feed motions for the missile-borne radome external contour grinding and meanwhile designs the optimal pulse frequency match method. Firstly, the mathematical analysis model is set up, and the grinding section setting is also obtained. Then the pulse distribution of the X-direction motion, the Y-direction motion and the rotz motion is calculated. Finally, with the premise of ensuring the grinding precision, the optimal pulse frequency match method of these three motions is designed to minimize the grinding time. Besides, the grinding error of this method is also analyzed. The result obtained from the program verifies the correctness of the analysis model and the pulse frequency match scheme. The achievements obtained in this paper have reference value and active meaning for the machining of the special workpieces.

articleTitle: Mean LQI and RSSI based link evaluation algorithm and the application in frequency hopping mechanism in wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The evaluation of communication link is crucial to wireless sensor networks. A link evaluation algorithm based on mean LQI and mean RSSI is proposed by analysis of a large mount of data collected from communication tests. This algorithm can improve the speed and precision of evaluation for communication link, and improve the reliability of wireless sensor networks. Then EPA based Frequency Hopping Metric(EPA-FHM) is presented, and applied to frequency-hopping algorithm. The performance of EPA-FHM is tested with the CC2420 as the platform, and the results show the reliability is improved.

articleTitle: Kinematics and workspace of 3-RUU parallel manipulator
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Kinematics design of a lower-DOF parallel robot parallel, a 3-UUR pure rotational parallel manipulator, is presented. We first analyzed the instantaneous motions of 3-RUU parallel robot at initial configuration by reciprocal screw, after the inverse kinematics and forward kinematics are analyzed. At the basis on the kinematics, the workspace of parallel robot is presented in the paper. The main influences for the workspace of parallel robot consist of circumscribed circle radius of fixed platform Ra, circumscribed circle radius of moving fixed platform R<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">b</sub>, length of connecting rod l and the angles θ among connecting rod. The performances of such 3-RUU mechanisms are very different for different configurations. The curve of simulation which prove the academic analysis is given by Adams.

articleTitle: An high efficient and speed algorithm of Ray Casting in volume rendering
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Ray Casting Algorithm is a classic rendering approach in volume rendering. It is widely used in the 3D visualization field of medical images, but the rendering speed is very slowly. In order to improve the rendering speed, an high efficient and speed algorithm of Ray Casting based on space leaping and rapid interpolation is presented. Along with a comparing experiment of three kinds of methods in time and drawing quality, the result shows that the accelerate algorithm proposed in this paper can not only get a high quality rendering image, but also improve a rendering speed to a high level. There is some certain value in practical aspect of 3D visualization of medical images.

articleTitle: Workflow model based on colored and timed Petri nets
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In order to adapt the complexity and omission of present work, and make the workflow more convenient for operation, it divides the workflow model into three sub models - process model, task flow model and resource model in this paper, which called process-task flow-resource model. Process model works for the general flow of the whole work using common Petri nets modeling, resource model is responsible for resource allocation with colored Petri nets, and task flow model adapts timed Petri nets modeling to formulate the task flow for specific work.

articleTitle: A digital copyright protection scheme for soft-IP core based on FSMs
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Intellectual Property (IP) core reuse is a trend in SOC and IC design. However, sharing IP cores in current competitive market poses significant high security risks due to soft-IPs can be easily copied or even partitioned to cover the ownership proof. In this paper, a digital copyright protection scheme for soft-IP core based on finite-state machines (FSMs) is proposed, in which the authorship of designs can be identified by embedding a digital watermark in the FSMs of the soft-IP during the IC design and detecting the watermark in the authentication process. Our experimental results have shown that the proposed scheme is efficient and robust to attacks and easy to implement without affecting the original performance of the Soft-IP.

articleTitle: Effect of waste oyster shell resurgent on engineering properties of cement mortar
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this study, recycled materials, oyster shells sand is used to replace the river sand (0%, 5%, 10%, 20%, 30%, 40%) at fixed water-cement ratio 0.485 and six weight replacement ratio. The fresh properties harden properties at the age of 1, 7, 28, 56 and 98 days and durability will be tested. The results indicated the replacement of oyster-shell sand for 40%, chloride ion content was 0.23 kg/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>, the workability, strength and durability decreased, but it still meets the specification. Replacement which in the range of 5% to 10%, the strength was up to 80% of the control group. The result of sulphate resistance for the replacement is 10%, whose weight loss is similar to the control group. The proper amount of oyster shells to replace river sand had similar mechanical properties as normal cement mortar. It not only reduces waste amount, but also achieves the goal of Recycling.

articleTitle: Study on speed sensorless vector control of Brushless Doubly-Fed Machine
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The Brushless Doubly-Fed Machine (BDFM), which removes the brush and slip ring, improves security and reliability. The BDFM is proposed to have a bright prospect as an AC drive system or variable-speed constant-frequency power generation system. Vector control is widely studied in the BDFM, but the information of rotor speed and position must be obtained. This paper presents speed sensorless vector control strategy for BDFM double synchronous speed two-axis rotating coordinate mathematical model based on model reference adaptive speed identification theory. Vector control model in Matlab/Simulink environment is designed with popov stability theory. The simulation results verify that this system has good stationary and dynamical property.

articleTitle: The research of test-suite reduction technique
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Ant colony algorithm is a bionic optimization algorithm, it can solve combinatorial problems effectively. For the problem of the test suite reduction, this algorithm could find the balance point between the speed and the accuracy of solution. Unlike other existing algorithms, this algorithm used test cost criteria, as well as the test coverage criteria. Finally, the paper presented the results, the results is given by the others classical algorithms compared with this algorithms. The results show that this algorithm can significantly reduce the size and the cost of the test-suite, and achieved higher effectiveness of test-suite minimization.

articleTitle: Simulation and fuzzy logic analysis on an Off-road HEV
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The hybrid electrical vehicle (HEV) has draw researchers' attention recently. This paper mainly discusses the control strategy of HEV based on fuzzy logic. By using this control strategy, the work space and work efficiency of engine are optimized, which play a vital role on improvement of the operation performance of HEV. Meanwhile, the strategy has been applied to optimize the power balance of battery, which includes the characteristics of battery in the controller. Based on the Matlab/Simulink, the simulation results confirmed the excellent effectiveness of our control strategies, which optimized the fuel consumption of engine and the power balance of battery successfully.

articleTitle: A method of AMT starting control with constant engine speed
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Starting control is the key issue in the development of automated mechanical transmission(AMT). Based on the analysis of the control principle for keeping the engine speed instant, this paper presents another method to keep the engine speed instant while starting by controlling the engine torque. With the coordinate control of the engine and clutch, this control strategy can help the vehicle reduce slipping work, limit the jerk and accomplish the driver's intentions. These advantages above are validated by simulation.

articleTitle: A CPW-feed printed antenna for dual-band WLAN operations
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper, we present the design of a CPW-feed printed antenna which improves the connection between the antenna and the coaxial cable. The proposed antenna is designed to cover two frequency bands of 1.84-2.5 GHz and 4.9-6.3 GHz, which are required by the dual-band WLAN communication. In this work, it is found that the distance between the radiator and the ground is the key parameter for the design of the antenna to work in two resonant bands. Furthermore, tuning the shape of the radiator and the position of the slots on the ground will widen the high resonant band of the antenna. This design of the antenna is simulated on an FR4 substrate with a thickness of 0.4 mm and an area of 11×67 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. Being small in size, cheap in manufacturing, and simple in profile, the proposed antenna is perfect to be embedded into an access point of dual-band WLAN.

articleTitle: Design of vehicle bus data acquisition and fault diagnosis system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper introduces the overall design of vehicle bus data acquisition and fault diagnosis system on the basis of OBD, focusing on its lower computer system and the upper computer system design principles. This system is based on the widely used CAN bus technology, to extract the vehicle's status or fault information. The CAN bus adopts the SAE J1939 protocol standards, maximize the superiority of it. The system acquires and analyses the data from the CAN bus under the SAEJ1939 protocol, which provides about 400 faults. The system displays the faults on the LCD screen in the way of the fault tree, so the users can check them easily. It can send data to the upper computer system or management center by General Packet Radio Service (GPRS), to view the vehicle status or fault information far away, and to achieve the remote monitoring of the vehicle and fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: Analysis of film cooling effectiveness on antivortex hole
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper aims to mainly investigate the adiabatic film cooling effectiveness on different geometries of antivortex holes by numerical analysis. Antivortex film-cooling concept is designed to mitigate the effects of the counter-rotating vortex pair, which reduces the effectiveness of circular cross-section film-cooling holes at moderate to high blowing ratios. The 3D computational geometries are modeled with a single 30 deg angled hole on a flat surface. Numerical simulations have been performed at six different coolant-to-mainstream blowing ratios of 0.5, 1.0, 2.0, 3.0, 4.0, and 5.0, and used five different turbulence models; k-e, RNG k-e, SSG, SST, zero equation models to obtain detailed film cooling effectiveness. The single cylindrical hole is experimentally investigated in this research to confirm the certainty of numerical results of antivortex holes. Antivortex hole shows significantly improved 2D lateral spreading and spanwise averaged film-cooling effectiveness as compared to cylindrical hole due to the anti-vortex by side holes which reduced the detrimental vorticity produced by main hole.

articleTitle: Development of communication interface of AC charging for charging station based on ZigBee
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In order to achieve the intelligent and automation AC charging of EV-Charging Station plug-in electric vehicles, a solution based on ZigBee technology is proposed that Communication between electric vehicle on-board charger and AC charging spot. The hardware system use TI's CC2480 RF chips as core components. This paper focuses on the studying for the topology structure of ZigBee network between AC charging spot of the charging station and electric automobiles, and elaborate a way to realize the enhanced ZigBee tree network, combined with TI's Z-Stack protocol stack.

articleTitle: RFID medical information system: A system implementation on MSP430 platform
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper presents the healthcare application and implementation of RFID (Radio Frequency Identification) system. The RFID tags are introduced to replace register card of hospital for exchanging medical data. It can provide patients a convenient way for to accessing medical information and can help them to keep medical quality, such as remind them for taking medicine and revisit etc. The system was implemented on MSP430 Ultra-EV Board with HF RFID reader (ISO 15693). Experiments were conducted on example for system work. The results showed that the system can provide useful medical information in real-time.

articleTitle: Evaluation method of enterprise information quality based on QFD
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Enterprises, whose information quality has won the particular concern of information quality researchers, are the subjects that are rich in information styles and focuses on information quality in national economy. However, there is no widely recognized effective way on the evaluation of information quality. For this reason, this paper, on the basis of the definition and analysis of information quality, combining with the basic principles and expanding steps of Quality Function Deployment, gives the improved House of Quality model for enterprise information quality evaluation and proposes evaluation of enterprise information quality based on QFD.

articleTitle: The control and compensation strategy research of unified power quality conditioner
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper deals with the power flow analysis and control strategy research of unified power quality conditioner (UPQC). A UPQC is a combination of shunt and series active power filter (APF), sharing a common dc link. It can compensate almost all power quality problems such as voltage harmonics, voltage unbalance, voltage flickers, voltage sags, voltage swells, current harmonics, current unbalance, reactive current, etc. The power flow analysis is based on different compensation strategies. The energy flow relationships of two compensation strategies are analyzed in detail. The vector diagram is given on the basis of the energy analysis. The vector representation of the UPQC is also shown. This paper discusses the control strategy of the UPQC with a focus on the optimum angle injection. An experimental prototype is selected to verify the theoretical analysis. The experimental results are provided to prove the viability and effectiveness of the UPQC.

articleTitle: A novel error concealment approach based on general regression neural network
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In video communication, packet is inevitably lost or transmitted erroneously over error-prone channel. If there are packets lost, the entire video quality will be degraded. The error concealment is thus proposed to solve this problem effectively. Therefore, this paper will propose the general regression neural network (GRNN) can be used to estimate the motion vectors of the corrupted macroblocks. The proposed approach can restore corrupted frame effectively. Experimental results show that the proposed approach in this work can improve the defect of conventional approach and raise the average PSNR of the recovered video sequence.

articleTitle: Optimization of booster disinfection with backtracking algorithm
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Booster disinfection is the reapplication of disinfectant at strategic locations within a water distribution network to keep disinfectant residuals within specified limits. Compared to conventional methods that apply disinfectant only at the source, booster disinfection could improve residual coverage, and reduce the total disinfectant dose due to the more even distribution of disinfectant in space and time. However, decisions on booster disinfection in many places were made only based on experience, causing insufficient residuals at some part of the network. The present work investigates the optimal placement of extra boosters and injection scheduling on the basis of existing locations for disinfection to insure drinking water safety for all consumers. Unlike previous models, the present model optimizes booster facility location from a hydraulic prospective instead of experience. By backtracking the upstream nodes of the residual insufficient nodes, the optimal booster locations could cover the disinfectant need for all consumers. The injection scheduling of the existing disinfection locations could also be optimized with the extra booster disinfection to minimize the total disinfection dose.

articleTitle: Analysis and design of circularly polarized waveguide slot array antenna
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The polarized characteristic of slot array in the broad wall of a rectangular waveguide was researched based on antenna polarization theory in this paper. The aperture electric field vector distribution was obtained by simulating by Ansoft HFSS, and then based on the vector analysis of different aperture combinations, the horizontal polarization and vertical polarization slot unit have been designed firstly. Then, The aperture parameters of the circularly polarization was analysis theoretically based on the principle of polarization synthesis, A new circularly polarized slot unit in the broad wall of a rectangular waveguide was finally obtained.

articleTitle: Study on the effects of heat pipe and fins for heat dissipation under natural convection
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: It's important to dissipate the heat of modern electronic components. The influences of heat sinks with or without heat pipes and with or without fins are simulated under the condition of natural convection by the CFD software Fluent. Through the model based on the numerical study, temperature distribution maps at different kinds of heat sinks and different power are obtained and analyzed. Additionally, experimental results demonstrate the validity of the simulation analysis. It is shown that the heat sink with heat pipe and fins can satisfy the required working temperature of the germanium transistor, while the heat sink with fins but without heat pipe can satisfy the required working temperatures of the silicon tube and the electron tube, under the condition of natural convection.

articleTitle: How do visual angle and physical screen size affect presence and emotional responses of game players?
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This study examines specifically the effects of these two properties of large displays on presence and emotional responses, using physiological as well as subjective methods. The results indicate that the larger visual angle offered by a large display produces higher subjective assessment of spatial presence, engagement, emotional arousal and valence, and greater galvanic skin response than for a small visual angle; and that the larger visual angle causes greater acceleration or deceleration in heart rate in response, respectively, to arousing or attention-requiring events than a smaller visual angle. However, physically larger screen size produces higher subjective assessment of emotional arousal, engagement, and presence, but it does not show a significant effect on physiological response.

articleTitle: A dynamic inversion controller design for miniature Unmanned Aerial Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This article focuses on the nonlinear control issue of miniature Unmanned Aerial Vehicles(UAVs). A complete nonlinear model for miniature fixed-wing UAVs is structured and simplified as an affine nonlinear system aiming at the fast dynamic loop of key attitude control. We adopt the state feedback method to dynamic inversion controller design. To compensate the external disturbance and modeling error, an adaptive compensation algorithm is discussed and an online estimation way for the error coefficient and the external disturbance is presented, which guarantees the asymptotic stability. Simulation result shows that the controller is of short response time and small overshoot, and can achieve decoupling between channels, while the adaptive algorithm can converge quickly with automatic compensation for external disturbances, not well equipped aircraft, and parameters error and so on.

articleTitle: Design of fast fuzzy controller and its application on position control of DC motor
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper, a fast fuzzy controller which is implemented in an FPGA chip is used for the position control of DC motor. The technique of parallel architecture, direct computation and combinational circuit is adopted for the design of controller. In order to simplify the operation of input firing, we adopt the triangular membership function as the fuzzy sets for antecedent part. The firing strength of those triggered fuzzy rules are calculated through the parallel processing, when dealing with the fuzzy inference. For the consequent part of the fuzzy rule, the design parameters are stored as a ROM table so that it can be easily achieved for fuzzy inference. Meantime, a special divider circuit structure is proposed so that only one clock computation time is required for the operation of division. Then, the center average method is used to construct the defuzzifier. In order to demonstrate the correctness and efficiency of the proposed fuzzy control circuit, we combine the fuzzy controller with feedback circuit, comparison circuit as well as driving circuit and implement the whole controller in a Xilinx Spartan 3 FPGA chip. The digital fuzzy controller is applied to the position tracking control of DC motors. The simulation and experimental results show that the presented fuzzy control circuit is feasible.

articleTitle: Detection of line spectrum of the ship shaft-rate electric field based on the improved adaptive line enhancement
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to effectively extract the line spectrum of ship shaft-rate electric signal from ocean environmental electric field. Firstly, the frequency domain characteristic of ocean environmental electric field is analyzed and the received signal corrupted by noise is pretreated by a band-pass filter whose pass band is 1~10Hz. Then, an improved adaptive line enhancement algorithm is introduced, in which coherent accumulative algorithm and output error weights are added. The error is closer to the current time, the weight is bigger. The effectiveness of the algorithm is verified by both the measured data and the simulated data. The verified result shows that the algorithm can detect line spectrum of target signal at the lower SNR situations efficiently compared to the ordinary adaptive line enhancement algorithm.

articleTitle: Study for vehicle recognition and classification based on Gabor wavelets transform & HMM
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Vehicle recognition and classification is an important part of intelligent transportation system. Now, the technology of vehicle recognition has becoming a hot topic all over the world. A vehicle recognition algorithm based on Gabor wavelets transform and hidden Markov model (HMM) is proposed. A Gabor filters are applied on the vehicle images to construct a group of vectors called nodes, and then feature nodes are derived by using principal component analysis, which decrease the dimension of each node. The image including feature nodes is called Gabor-Vehicle. A set of images representing different instances of the same vehicle are used to train each HMM, and each individual in the database is represented by an optional HMM vehicle model. Experimental results show that the proposed algorithm has a high recognition rate with relatively low complexity.

articleTitle: Reconfiguration of communications constellation with ISLs: Fix the net
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: When satellite failure occurs in a communications constellation with inter-satellite links, beside the coverage loss, its link network will become chapped which results in connectivity performance degradation. To reconfigure this type of constellation based on system performance, satellite on-orbit rephasing is required to fix the net. A performance-based evaluation method is proposed to weigh optional reconfiguration schemes with multiple types of evaluation criteria for different situations such as connection break-off or connection quality drop. The evaluation process is demonstrated and discussed through a case study.

articleTitle: Study on appliction of electrohydraulic servo proportional valve in hydraulic system for rolling mills
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This thesis studied the hydraulic servo system used on main press equipment of a multi-roller reversible cold rolling mill. Nozzle flapper type of electrohydraulic servo valve is now widely used. This type of servo valve has such problems as bad contaminating resisting ability, easy to be blocked by contaminating material and requires for highly system maintenance. These problems restricted the reliability of whole system. Aiming at solving these problems, the possibility of replacing nozzle flapper type of electrohydraulic servo valve by electrohydraulic proportional valve was raised in this paper, mathematic model for position servo system of press equipment that uses electrohydraulic servo proportional valve as the control unit was established. Dynamic analysis and simulation based on MATLAB\Simulink was carried out and conclusion was acquired. The study provides foundation for the design of automatic thickness control system of a rolling mill by using electrohydraulic proportional valves.

articleTitle: Analysis of wind energy potential using the Weibull model at Zhurihe
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The Weibull density function is used to estimate the wind energy potential of Zhurihe station, which is the windiest region at the Inner Mongolia of China. In the present study, the wind energy potential of this region is statistically analyzed based on one-year (2004) measured hourly average wind speed data. The probability density distributions are derived from time-series data and the two parameters of Weibull model are estimated. The wind energy potential of Zhurihe station is evaluated by the Weibull model.

articleTitle: Iterative carrier recovery in turbo receivers with distributed pilots
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper considers iterative carrier recovery for continuous transmission. To overcome the potential cycle slip, we propose to employ the distributed pilots with minor overhead for framing. By extensive simulations, we found that the probability of the cycle slip may be very low and not observed in simulations with distributed pilots for the rate-1/3 LDPC coded QPSK modulation at very low signal-to-noise ratios.

articleTitle: Uncompensatable error of four DOF parallel robot
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The design complexity of parallel robots is due to the number of strictly interrelated functional and structural problems. Lower DOF parallel robot rely on strictly geometrical constraints of axis of pairs in and between limbs to obtain the reduced number of DOF. In practice, these constraints will never been perfectly fulfilled due to the inevitability of errors, and hence produce series bad effects and problems. Using screw theory and set theory as mathematical tools, the DOF and constraint system of 4-DOF parallel robot, were systematically summarized and in-depth studied. Kinematic design of a limited DOF parallel robot, is presented that takes into account the error. The errors presented in the paper consist of two kinds. The errors is defined as the position error of rotation center DOF the platform caused by errors in the kinematics constants, such as axis error The above research results provided an insight into the error of 4-dof parallel robot.

articleTitle: A new algorithm of automatic lung parenchyma segmentation based on CT images
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: We present a new frame of lung parenchyma segmentation. Optimal threshold value method and the boundary tracking method are used to get rid of the background interference and segment the lung region. Then new algorithm is used for lung region boundary repairing based on the mathematical morphology method. The experimental results show the new algorithm can segment lung regions from the chest CT images automatically and accurately.

articleTitle: Design and realization of a maze robot
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This article gives hardware design concept of a maze robot taking SCM as a core based on research on design of a maze robot' hardware and maze solving algorithm directing at the problem that there are less sensor-based maze algorithm and it is very difficult to find the shortest path. It proposes a deep first search (DFS) algorithm based on left - right hand wall follower rule and in detail analyzes the realizing processes of this algorithm and this algorithm is realized. Experiments show that this system can find a shorter path from the entrance and the exit of a maze which is not too complicated through two times of search and it features smaller spatial complexity.

articleTitle: Research on MRC based on Rake receiver in troposcatter communication
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper introduces the Rake receiver into troposcatter Communication. An improved maximal ratio combining algorithm based on SNR threshold is presented to decrease the big amount of calculation in traditional Rake receiver. This method both considers probability density function of SNR of the received signal and different users' requirements, adjusts the threshold accordingly, and combines the signals whose SNR are higher than the threshold. The algorithm can efficiently decrease computation while keeping system performance.

articleTitle: Digital-image retrieval based on shape-feature and MPEG-7 standard
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Shape features are an important feature of image, It is the result of carrying on the description to the picture target shape. Using shape feature to retrieval image may enhance accuracy and efficiency of retrieval. This paper introduced the three key aspects to realize image retrieval based on shape feature: the description to shape feature, the extraction shape feature, shape match and introduced the standard of multimedia-content-description interface — MPEG-7.

articleTitle: Analysis of slope length on water soil erosion
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Slope length is one of the important factors for slope-runoff and slope sediment yield. In order to research the role of slope length on slope erosion in the test area, the rainfall runoff observation experiments of different slope length were conducted. The experimental results indicated that runoff volume and erosion amount showed a gradually increasing trend with the increase of slope length.

articleTitle: The research of two-lane highway longitudinal slope based on the running speed in the plateau areas
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Longitudinal slope section of the road is high frequency location of traffic accidents. In order to improve the road safety, the paper was based on the traffic engineering, applying psychology and other theories, and used the advanced GPS, MC5600 and other testing equipments to detect and investigate the road alignment, speed, driver's heart and physiological responses and traffic characteristics on the Qinghai-Tibet Highway. Mining processing the testing data based on theoretical analysis, constructed the mathematical model of the longitudinal slope based on the running speed. Combining with the driver's heart and physiological responses, the range of longitudinal slope was determined in the design of plateau road alignment. It provides technical support for the design and transformation of the road in the plateau area, and it also provides new evidence for the amendment of national design specification.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Construction safety evaluation based on intuitionistic fuzzy TOPSIS
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Position estimation of a mobile robot by PSO algorithm using a laser range finder
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper shows that a laser range finder and four artificial reflectors can be used to determine the position of a mobile robot in a three-dimensional (3D) working space provided that the four reflectors are not installed in the same plane. Moreover, a particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm is used to filter possible measuring errors. To show the feasibility and accuracy of the proposed method, experimental results are included for illustration.

articleTitle: Multi-rope hoist wire rope tension on-line monitoring and analysis of reasons about tension imbalance
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper introduces a multi-rope hoist wire rope tension on-line monitoring system, which is used to monitor the tension of multi-rope hoist wire rope in real time, thus to calculate the real hoisting load and tension difference. This system can alert and avoid accidents such as severe tension imbalance and over loading. In addition, this paper analyses reasons of tension imbalance on the basis of field data, offering theory evidence for measures of improving tension imbalance.

articleTitle: A design of network remote control system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper describes a design of network remote control based on Ethernet controller RTL8019AS and FPGA chip EP3C25Q240C8N. It's through the Altera NIOS II soft-core processor and a simplified TCP/IP protocol LWIP to complete the Ethernet Communication Protocol, and FPGA can configure and control RTL8019AS. Then the information can be communication between FPGA and PC, in order to achieve network remote control and information transmission.

articleTitle: The analysis and simulation of motor's torque ripple in electric vehicle
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Electric vehicle has speed vibration problem in Low-speed condition; one of the reasons is that the vehicle power-train resonates with motor's torque ripple in low motor speed.
