abstract: In this paper, H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>PW<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">40</sub>/MCM-48 was used as the photocatalyst for the degradation of methyl orange solution under light irradiation. It has been shown that the catalyst dosage, the initial concentration of methyl orange, irradiation intensity and irradiation time under light irradiation were the important factors of decolorizing. The best reaction conditions were: the concentration of methyl orange was 7 mg/ L, the dosage of H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>PW<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">40</sub>/MCM-48 was 6.0 g/L, irradiation time was 5.5 h. Under these conditions, the color removal could be up to 84.53 %.

articleTitle: A research of axial-flow pump design with method of variable circulation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The formula of distribution coefficient about outlet circulation in the radial direction was derived by the theoretical analysis of the relationship between theoretical head of axial-flow pump with circulation of impeller. The axial-flow model pump with specific speed of 700 was designed with method of variable circulation, employed distribution coefficient according to the derived formula. The hydraulic design method also included streamline method and cascade solidity linearly decreasing from hub to tip of impeller. Based on energy characteristic test, the performance of model pump was determined. The cavitation performance of model pump at the best efficiency point was confirmed through cavitation test. Based on N-S equations and standard k-e model, the designed pump was simulated through full passage. The results show that the actual pump performance parameters agree with the design, the model pump has wide range of high efficiency zone and high cavitation characteristics. The variable circulation method is suitable for the design of high performance axial-flow pump and the derived formula can be a criterion for circulation distribution. The study provides effectively reference to the optimum design of axial-flow pump.

articleTitle: A QoS-enabled secure LAN access control system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Centralized access control systems improve security and management feasibility in secure LAN (SLAN) system, but also bring in weak extensibility. System delay becomes non-ignorable facing with frequent requests from mass clients. We describe the design, implementation, and performance of a QoS-enabled system for access control system on SLAN. The system optimizes the flexibility and security. Through experiment, we prove that it increases the efficiency of request processing.

articleTitle: Evaluation method of selecting model for testing equipment for vehicle based on extension theory
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Vehicle Performance testing for equipment selection programs affect economic and social benefits is proposed based on normative, economic, technical, service, energy saving and environmental protection, human relations elements of the testing equipment selection evaluation criteria system. Extension theory based on equipment selection decision-making feature set, the use of expert experience to establish expectations element model selection program selection program and alternative element model, extension associate degree through the evaluation of program strengths and weaknesses directly. Example shows that a car based on extension theory comprehensive performance test equipment selection program evaluation is feasible.

articleTitle: Research on amplitude variation during sheet blanking based on servo press
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Three degrees of freedom (TDOF) vibration system during sheet blanking based on servo press is established, and the amplitude vibration of the body, slider and base of the servo press is simulated by the software Matlab/Simulink. The influence of the blanking speed and the initiation fracture position of blank on the maximum amplitude of slider are analyzed in detail. The results show that with the decreasing of the blanking speed, the trend of the maximum amplitude of slider decreases. The amplitude of slider decreases effectively if the position of the initiation fracture of blank is at the wave crest of the free vibration. To reduce the vibration and improve the productivity, a high speed adopts when the slider moves downward, and a slow speed adopts during stamping by utilizing the controllability of the slider stroke of servo press.

articleTitle: Optimization of process conditions for electroless copper plating on polyester fabric
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The copper-coated polyester fabric can be used to prepare electromagnetic shielding materials. At present, electroless copper plating mainly using formaldehyde as the reducing agent. But the stability of the bath is poor and it is also volatile and toxic. Using hypophosphite as reducing agent has more advantages for its stability and the plating process does not release any toxic gases. In this paper, The copper-coated polyester fabric was prepared by electroless plating with the sodium hypophosphite as reducing agent. The roughening condition before plating and the deposition process were optimized through orthogonal test. The surface resistances of conductive polyester fabrics, the deposition rate and the coating adhesion were investigated respectively. The optimum roughening conditions obtained are as following: sodium hydroxide concentration of 250g/L; temperature 70 D; time 15min, and the lightweight rate of the plating layer is 0.43% under the experimental conditions. The optimum conditions of electroless copper plating using sodium hypophosphite as reducing agent are: copper sulfate 8g/L; nickel sulfate 1.0g/L; sodium hypophosphite 35g/L; citric acid 20g/L; boric acid 30g/L; pH 9.0; temperature 75D. With these conditions, the deposition rate reaches 1.274g/(m2·min) and the uniform and compact copper layer with excellent electro-conductivity was obtained.

articleTitle: Study on connection types of multi-dimensional receiving windings in a wireless power transmission system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Multi-dimensional receiving technology is an available method to overcome defects of a wireless power transmission system such as poor efficiency and instability. In present paper four different connection types of three-dimensional receiving windings have been studied. First, characteristics of every connection circuit are obtained by simulations and compared with each other. The results prove that the parallel connection after rectification topology is more feasible. Then, an actual circuit is fabricated to power an equivalent resistance and a LED. Based on this, the output voltage and its waveform are measured. The experimental results verify that this topology type can make full use of all voltages from multi-dimensional windings. It is suitable for the wireless power transmission system.

articleTitle: Study on electric field detection of ship based on character of gradient
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: To improve the capability of countermeasure during detecting electric field of ship, basic method of detecting electric field is analysed, and the mathematical model of electric field of ship and electrod sweep are established in the three-layers media(air-seawater-seabed), then the main problem during electric field detection is pointed out after contrast and analyse. Based on the character of gradient of electric field distribution, the method of improving capability of detection is put forward, and the calculation is done. The results of calculation prove that the method can obviously improve the characteristic of countermeasure during detecting electric field of ship, and increase detecting range.

articleTitle: Renovation design of traditional blocks based on experience: The study of Xuzhou former committee block
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In combination with the case study of Xuzhou former committee block, this article attempts to consider experience as the core of renovation design of traditional blocks. Based on expression of non-verbal elements and combined with the project characteristics, this paper imitates the movie art of "montage" which uses the strategy of arrangement of groups, decomposition and reconstruction, cross juxtaposition and "clipping" the semi-fixed feature elements in the blocks, in an effort to create an exciting feeling of space and to realize the significance of renovation of traditional blocks.

articleTitle: New measure method of distance between vague sets
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Distance measure between vague sets is one of the most important technologies in various application fields of vague sets. In this paper, according to the definition of Canberra distance, a necessary constrain condition of the distance measure between vague sets is pointed out, and an improved axiom definition of distance measure between vague sets is proposed, then a new measure method of distance between vague sets is introduced, which is proved to satisfy the proposed axiom definition. Thus the present methodical deficiency is remedied.

articleTitle: A comparative study on QDCT-based and QDFT-based methods for multichannel vibration signals compression
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper had studied two methods for multichannel vibration signals compression, which were QDCT-based and QDFT-based method. In the experiment, the three signals data correspondent to orthogonal axes X, Y, Z were gotten by an acceleration sensor with three channels. The two methods could compress the multichannel vibration signal effectively, and also preserve the association for the signals of each channel, eliminate the noise and redundancy, extract the key features. The experiment results indicated its efficiency, and the comparative results indicated that the QDCT-based method was better than that of QDFT. Moreover that it provided a new method for multichannel signals to data compression and feature extraction.

articleTitle: Control system of a new multiple-point loading test machine for architecture component
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper, a new kind of multiple-point loading test machine is designed for the scaling-down mode of architecture components. And it is designed by the control algorithm of the single neuron self-adaptive PID, and the PC software is designed by the graphics language-LabVIEW. Resolved the defects of existing test machines-huge volume, large energy consumption, system complexity, through the simulation of the system, the control system designed in this paper can meet the control requirements.

articleTitle: Research on type selection of pump used in pumping irrigation well
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper, the scientific methods to select well pump for the user are presented. The major factors that affect the type selecting of well pumps are discussed in detail, including pump capacity, water head, minimum static water depth of the well and its changing laws, and so on. The three main methods to get the optimum water inflow of well pump are introduced, including test, estimation, and analogy methods. The specific steps of well pump type selection and the important ways used to check the operating points are also expounded. Finally, a simple approach to get the optimum of discharge and head is supplied, so that users can select the type of well pumps in a more reasonable and feasible way. As a result, both the investment of well pump and the cost of pumping can be reduced; the operating efficiency of equipments in the pump station will be raised at the same time. The approaches presented in this paper have high application value in practice.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The analysis of the oil and gas pipeline project disposable capital profitability
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Studies on sulphoaluminate aluminium cement clinker prepared by sodium bentonite
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Sodium bentonite was used as major raw material in sintering sulphoaluminate cement clinker successfully in the laboratory. An investigation was made into the sintering condition and mechanical performance based on the X-ray diffraction (XRD). The result shows that the clinker can be sintered properly at the temperatures of 1350 °C and sintered time of 120 min. It also showed that the amount of dihydrate gypsum strongly influenced the early strength, which was determined by testing the mechanical property of cement paste. The research possessed a certain theoretical and practical value for reference in exploitation of bentonite resource.

articleTitle: Spline estimation for nonparametric variance models with linear process innovations
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Nonparametric variance models with fixed design and linear process innovations are considered in this paper. Under mild conditions, bias and variance of the spline estimator of variance function are given. Uniform rate of convergence is also obtained. The estimation is applied to the CNY/USD foreign exchange rate series.

articleTitle: Study on the ecological transformation of historical buildings in Tanhualin Block
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper puts forward the strategy for the transformation of the historical architecture in Tanhualin Block by investigating such buildings which are combined with the historical and cultural background of the block as well as government department's new planning policy. It states different methods for the ecological transformation of the Tanhualin area on three aspects: utilization, transformation and upgrading through analysis and research on the value in use and the existing problems of the buildings in the block, and then presents principles and suggestions for the transformation of Tanhualin region.

articleTitle: The construction of the national excellent course “coummunication cirtuits”
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The course of Communication Circuits plays an important role in information science and electronic technology education field. The course in Tsinghua University has been approved as the national excellent course through many years of continual construction. The development of the course is introduced and the reforms of the course are explored in this paper. Utilizing and combining various advanced knowledge resources, the content construction and characteristics of the course is reviewed with new system structure established.

articleTitle: Supercritical fluid extraction of flavonoids from Eucommia ulmoides leaves and antioxidant activities before and after purification
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Total flavonoids were extracted from Eucommia ulmoides leaves using Supercritical fluid extraction and purified with AB-8 macroporous resin. In order to contrast the antioxidant activities of flavonoids before and after purification, three antioxidative tests including 1,1-diphenyl-2-picrylhydrazyl radicals (DPPH·), superoxide radicals and xanthine oxidase, have been used in this study. The results indicated that the antioxidant capacities of purified flavonoids are stronger than the crude flavonoids from Eucommia ulmoides leaves. For the crude flavonoids, IC<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">50</sub> of scavenging DPPH· and superoxide radicals were 0.21 mg/mL and 4.38 mg/mL. IC<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">50</sub> for inhibiting XOD was 7.5 mg/mL. But for the purified flavonoids, IC<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">50</sub> was found to be 0.14 mg/mL, 3.37 mg/mL and 1.2 mg/mL respectively.

articleTitle: Research and implement of heterogeneous educational resources integration
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Analyzing current problems of educational resources, the paper indicates the causes of the heterogeneous of the educational resources. We propose an effective solution to achieve the integration of heterogeneous resources, in order to achieve the purpose of efficient use and rational allocation of the resources.

articleTitle: Design of motion control system of butt girth welds scanner for oil and gas pipeline
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Because of the special working environment, the butt girth welds of oil and gas pipelines were inevitably damaged. Automatic ultrasonic testing (AUT) equipment for pipeline girth weld was designed to monitor the girth welds. The motion control system of scanner was the most important component of the AUT equipment. The mathematical model of closed-loop speed control system for traveling framework was established and simulated. Then a motion control system was designed, including SCM (Single Chip Micyoco) control module, power driven module and communication module. The engineering model machine was tested, and the experimental results satisfied the engineering requirements.

articleTitle: Performances of high performance polymer modified concrete for mining engineering
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Although ordinary concrete is used in mining engineering, it has many defects such as high brittleness and low flexibility. It is urgent to exploit a kind of high performance polymer modified concrete for mining engineering which has low cost price, high performance, high bond strength, great convenience and excellent durability. Mechanical properties and durability were studied on ordinary concrete, concrete with polyacrylic acid latex and concrete with polyacrylic acid, styrene-acrylic two latexies and silica fume. The results are as follow. First, compression strength of concrete with polyacrylic acid latex is lower than that of ordinary cncrete. And its rupture strength, tensile splitting strength, bond strength and impermeability is higher by 28.6%, 37.5%, 55.3% and 77.2% than ordinary concrete respectively. Second, concrete with polyacrylic acid, styrene-acrylic two latexies and silica fume has higher compression strength than common concrete. At the same time, its rupture strength, tensile splitting strength, bond strength and impermeability is higher by 48.8% 53.1% 73.0% and 83.3% than ordinary cncrete respectively. So, it is called high performance polymer modified concrete. Third, it was analysed by scanning electron microscope. Last, the experiments in a mine shows that its performances and bond strength with tunnels are higher than ordinary concrete while its price is only higher by 0.6% for 1 stere concrete.

articleTitle: The axonometric projection in mechanical drawing
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Axonometric projection is closely allied to view layout and projective transformation in CG. In the published books of mechanical drawing, there are few of the forming method about axonometric projection. This paper analyses the forming method by 3D graphic projective transformation in CG. The characteristics of generality about axonometric projection are presented, as well as the special axonometric projection drawing, that can strengthen the theory of projection and axonometric projection. It proved to be good result to the teaching practice.

articleTitle: Object recognition using relative-chord context
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper the relative-chord context is proposed for shape description in object recognition. The relative-chord is introduced to obtain the affine-invariant feature. The intervals of parallel chords are normalized by vertical direction-chord. Experimental result based on the Columbia University Coil-100 3D database demonstrates the feasibility of the relative-chord context methodology and also highlights its invariance to affine transforms.

articleTitle: Research on the growth process of aerobic granular sludge under high substrate loading rate
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Aerobic granular sludge taken from a sequencing batch reactor at steady state was used in this study. After aerated for 1 and 4 hours at high organic loading rate, the mixed liquid suspended solids (MLSS) concentration of granular sludge increased from 1.16 g/L to 1.48 g/L and 1.56 g/L, respectively, similar to the growth process of floc-like sludge and small granules. The number per milliliter mixed liquid of granules and flocs decreased from 283 to 201, resulted from the breakup of big granules. The mean weight of bioparticle for granules and flocs increased from 4.07 μg to 7.75 μg. During the experiment, the size distribution of sludge remained stable. Two peak values, 200 μm and 600 μm, appeared in the size distribution curve.

articleTitle: Effects of convex platform structure on couplings of strong electromagnetic pulse
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) method is utilized to simulate strong electromagnetic pulse coupling into the rectangular cavity with convex platform structure. The effects of the convex platform's different positions, shape and size in the same position on the maximum electric field strength of the cabinet center will be studied. Besides, the effects of the strong electromagnetic pulse's rise time and amplitude on the maximum power density of the cabinet center will be also analyzed. Results show that the convex platform structure can reduce the maximum electric field strength coupled into the cabinet center. Especially, round convex platform added on inside the cabinet is much better. Appropriate size of convex platform selected can increase the shielding effectiveness. In addition, the shorter the rise time is and the more easily the electromagnetic pulse is coupled into the cabinet. The power density coupled into the cabinet varies with the incident electric field values in terms of quadratic curve.

articleTitle: Study on the treatment of underground diesel exhaust
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Base on the control and purification of the tail gas emission for the mine flame proof diesel engine in underground mine, the paper introduced the development status and wet purifying technology of the diesel engine tail gas control, analyzed the principle and limitations of these technologies. The paper held that changing the internal structure of the wash box and putting the alkaline compound into the washing water can increase the washing effect greatly.

articleTitle: Research on product technical information coding based on object analyzing
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Although S1000D specification has made theory of information classification and coding, this paper takes the new way of analyzing object to make information coding. Firstly, establishing mapping between data module and analyzed product. Secondly, procuring SNS and DC/DCV of DMC according to product hierarchy and object needed code. Finally, taking bicycle coding for example to verify this paper's way. All we do can be propitious to the IETM application widely.

articleTitle: Characteristic study on boiling heat transfer of R417A and R22 outside smooth and enhanced tubes
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper presents information about boiling heat transfer of R417A replacing R22 outside horizontal smooth and enhanced tubes at the saturation temperature of 10°C. A Wilson plot technique was used to determine the refrigerant heat transfer coefficient. The results indicate that boiling heat transfer coefficients of R22 are larger than those of R417A at the same condition of saturation temperature and heat flux. Boiling heat transfer coefficient of R22 of tube E30 is 1.79 times as R417A, while 1.46 times as R417A for smooth tube. Boiling heat transfer coefficients of enhanced tube are larger than those of smooth tube at the same condition of saturation temperature and heat flux. Boiling heat transfer coefficient of enhanced tube E30 is 2.61 times as smooth tube for R22 at the condition of heat flux(75 kW m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-2</sup> K<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>). For R417A, tube E30 is 2.23 times as smooth tube at the condition of heat flux(60 kW m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-2</sup> K<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>).

articleTitle: Chromatographic chiral separation on chiral stationary phase by HPLC: Cellulose 4-methylbenzoate beads as chiral stationary phase for chiral separation of some racemates by high performance liquid chromatography
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The spherical beads were first systhesized by cellulose 4-methylbenzoate with partial hydroxyl groups, which was then crosslinked in the beads with 4, 4'-diphenylmethane dissocyanate. The obtained crosslinked beads were packed into an HPLC column and used as chiral stationary phase (CSP) for chiral separation of some racemates by high performance liquid chromatography (HPLC) using mobile phases contained with 1-hexane and different alcohols. The influence of the concentration and structure of alcoholic modifiers on separation were investigated. Among the tested racemates, four racemates were first separated on this CSP. The loading capacity of cellulose 4-methylbenzoate beads for racemic Trögger base was investigated.

articleTitle: Contribution of gypsum wallboard to lateral resistance capacity of wood shear wall
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Wood shear wall is the major lateral force resisting system in light-frame wood construction to resist horizontal loads. Gypsum wallboards are commonly used in partition walls or on the interior of the shear walls. In Chinese code for design of timber structures (GB 50005-2003), the contribution of gypsum wallboard to lateral resistance capacity is not taken into consideration. Evidence suggests that gypsum wallboard contributes to the lateral strength and stiffness of wood shear wall. A total of thirty walls with various sheathing materials were tested under monotonic and cyclic loading. Six walls were sheathed with only one panel of gypsum, twelve walls were sheathed with only one panel of OSB and others were sheathed with OSB on the exterior and gypsum wallboard on the interior. The result indicated that gypsum contributes to ultimate load, elastic stiffness and energy dissipated. Compared with results of walls only sheathed with gypsum wallboard which including the contribution of frame, these contributions did not increase linearly.

articleTitle: Implementation of coded pulse complex correlation algorithm on broadband ADCP
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: According to the needs of testing broadband ADCP, it is studied the measurement principle and the coded pulse complex correlation algorithm. Based on the characteristics of the measurement and coded pulse, it is simulated the coded pulse complex correlation algorithm of the broadband ADCP. In this paper, the complex correlation algorithm is simple and convenient. Simulation results show that the algorithm can estimate Doppler frequency in the case of low SNR. The algorithm fully meets the requirements of ADCP Doppler frequency measurement.

articleTitle: CT model experimental research on cable saddle zone of extradosed bridge
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Most of cable saddle test and theoretical study about extradosed bridge consider that the normal force on arc wall of embedded pipe is evenly distributed. The approximate load simulation will affect the accuracy of analytical results. Referring to the typical cable saddle structure of extradosed bridge, a polyurethane model was produced for this paper. Through a series of CT scan experiment, we obtained contact interface images under two loading conditions. Interface analysis based on image processing technology can provided displacement values of key points on the contact interface. Then the displacement values were applied as loads on the corresponding ANSYS finite element model. Results show that: 1) the contact normal pressure is nearly cosine distribution instead of uniform distribution; 2) There exist stress mutations around the junction of straight line and arc if the embedded pipe adopts "straight-arc-straight" design form. 3) Construction deviation may make excessive extrusion called "end effect" between cable and the exit of embedded pipe, causing the concrete near pipe edge appear stress concentration.

articleTitle: Weight analysis on parameters of self-pierce riveting
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In terms of the feature of the Self-Piercing Riveting process program, the evaluating index system for the process is created. The weighting aggregate is created with the analytic hierarchy process. The correctness of the weighting aggregate is tested by test results, Selecting the right test program basede on the value of weighting aggregate and synthetical importance.

articleTitle: Approach to knowledge service platform for modern design based on knowledge flow theory
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The current situation and problems of knowledge service and its supporting platform are discussed. In order to make product more competitive, a new framework of the knowledge service platform for modern design under distributed resource environment from a perspective of whole lifecycle of the products is proposed by the application of knowledge flow theory and knowledge service in this paper. This platform is a middleware platform based on SOA, in which TRIZ, AD and other design theories and methods are integrated and functional component sets are adopted, meanwhile the integration of network resources by cooperating with other websites to support product design is included. The key technology to realizing function of platform and their implementations are discussed, the network resources integration strategy under distributed resource environment is proposed, the operating mechanism of various coupling knowledge flows in the platform was studied, and the topological relations among those knowledge flows are described. The result shows that this platform can provide overall technical supports for design knowledge and dynamic design process and to form a powerful product design support environment.

articleTitle: Study and practice of 2μm program on engine advanced manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The source, purpose and significance of the engine advanced manufacturing engineering - 2μm-program is introduced. The relatively complete definition of the 2μm-program is firstly put forward. The general research goal of the 2μ-program is introduced from engine design to manufacturing process, detection, and so on. The main research contents as well as final targets of the program are presented. An application case of the 2μm-program theory in the B12 engine manufacturing quality improvement is introduced, in which the problem of machined trace on cylinder block finished surface is solved. Based on the quality statistical data analysis and the theoretical study, an optimizing process method was taken to solve the case. A machining experiment was carried out using the optimized process, and the 3D structure and flatness data of the surface is obtained using the advanced ShaPix surface detector. The results of the experiment demonstrate that the block manufacturing quality is remarkably improved, and the case settlement is very successful. The research and application of the 2μm-program will certainly play an important role in engine manufacturing technology and quality improvement.

articleTitle: Experimental study on transmission abnormal sound based on side-band frequency analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The transmission abnormal sound affects the vehicle interior sound quality and subjective comfort. In order to control the transmission abnormal sound, the noise sources were explored. The transmission vibration and noise field tests were performed on the basis of theoretical guidelines. The experimental study indicates that one of frequencies of vehicle interior noise falls within the range of gear meshing frequency (GMF). And also the abnormal vibration of gear engagement displayed the characteristics of sideband frequency, which caused the failure of fourth driving gear. With the help of disconnecting transmission, it was found that the fourth driving gear was badly worn out, which is consistent with the analysis result of sideband frequency. After replacing the worn gears in pair, the transmission abnormal sound disappeared and the gear meshing vibration reduced significantly at 1<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">st</sup> order GMF and 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">nd</sup> order GMF.

articleTitle: Arithmetic of associated rule discovery based on Information Granulation & its application of evaluation for equipment command system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: An improved arithmetic on associated rule discovery is designed for disadvantage of Apriori arithmetic, which adopts Information Granulation method attributed to Rough Sets theory. As can be seen from the result of the evaluation instance about associated rule discovery for equipment command system, its validity is certain.

articleTitle: An interconnect interface for reconfigurable multimedia system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper propose an efficient interconnect interface, which has been applied in reconfigurable multimedia system (REMUS). In order to achieve high performance of data share between multi cores, this interconnect interface applies overlapping operation mechanism in memory. Test of H.264 HiP (High Profile) decoding shows that the data exchange rate achieves a speedup of 285% compared with the AHB external memory, and the decoding can achieve a speed up of 12.0%. With the support of this competitive work, REMUS could achieve 1080p@30fps of H.264 HiP decoding when it works at the frequency of 200 MHz. This work is tested on the platform of SOC designer 7.1.

articleTitle: The selection of acceleration and deceleration lane length based on land-saving interchange
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: On the premise of guaranteeing the capacity and traffic safety of interchange, saving land usage as the fundamental purpose, from the perspective of driver's psychology and physiology response, based on a number of actual measured data, around speed consistency theory, using the research methods of operating speed contrast and driver's psychology and physiology characteristics, the paper establishes a mathematic model of the relationship between shift lane length and speed contrast, then analyzes the technical indicator of shift lane of land-saving interchange. This paper proposes the recommended value of acceleration lane and deceleration lane length, which will provide theoretical basis for interchange design and planning and so on.

articleTitle: Simulation and structural optimization of drum brake based on rigid-flexible coupling model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: According to the computing formula of floating double leading shoe drum brake damping factor, brake torque and vehicle equivalent inertia, taking BJ1029A lorry front brake for example, carry out theoretical calculation. Around the simulation design and structural optimization of the drum brake, explored the combination application of ADAMS software and ANSYS software to set up rigid-flexible coupling virtual prototype model of the drum brake, made simulation analysis for the model and simulation design for the initial angle of the friction plate based on ADAMS.

articleTitle: Modified algebraic decoding of the binary (47, 24, 11) quadratic residue code
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: A modified algebraic decoding algorithm (ADA) is presented to decode up to five possible errors in a binary systematic (47, 24, 11) quadratic residue (QR) code. The main key points of the proposed ADA are to modify the erroneous conditions in Case 3, Case 4, and Case 5 of the ADA given in He et al. (2001) and to find out the true conditions from Case 2 to Case 5. The new conditions can also be applied to the ADA given in Lin et al. (2010). A simulation result shows that the decoding time of the proposed ADA is faster than that of ADA given in Lin et al. (2010).

articleTitle: The study of a novel inverter based on combination of asymmetrical PWM and PDM control
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper, a novel zero current soft switching (ZCS) PWM single-ended push pull (SEPP) multi-resonant inverter is proposed. Its topology structure and power control scheme is introduced. The theoretical operating waveform of this inverter which works in steady state is proposed. Its operating principle is described by analyzing the equivalent circuit of the switching mode of the ZCS asymmetrical PWM inverter. In order to expand the zero current soft switching operating range, PDM control scheme is proposed. The rationality of theoretical analysis is verified by the simulation results and results analysis.

articleTitle: Seismic behavior of composite frame infilled composite steel plate shear walls
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Concrete-filled steel tubes (CFST) and composite steel plate shear walls (CSPSW) have advantages of high bearing capacities, high stiffness, excellent energy dissipation ability, and so on. Concrete-filled steel tube can be used as a column in composite frames. If composite steel shear walls are installed in composite frames, a new kind of composite structure is composed. As shear walls are not connected to frame columns, the premature overall buckling or local buckling failure of columns can be prevented. Meanwhile, the structural stiffness and bearing capacity can be adjusted by changing the size or the number of shear walls, which is attractive to both structural design engineers and architects. This paper presents the behavior of composite frame infilled composite steel plate shear walls connected with frame beams. A 20-storey composite structure model is developed using the finite element software OpenSees. Both the nonlinear static and dynamic response are analyzed to investigate the behavior of composite structures.

articleTitle: Research on energy loss analysis of steam turbine generating unit
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In order to optimize the performance of steam turbine unit performance monitoring system, the assessment indicators of which are not enough and limited to main operating parameters at present, more parameters are presented and their energy loss algorithms are given. The energy loss of these parameters aiming at an imported domestic 600MW supercritical steam turbine are analyzed, and their feather surfaces are depicted to supply reference for the power plant to optimize operation.

articleTitle: A fully-automatic higher precision apparatus for angular displacement calibration
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Based on a higher raster angular displacement sensor, a fully-automatic higher precise apparatus for angular calibration is described. By using a higher resolution stepping motor, both of the two types of sensors, the standard raster sensor and the corrected sensor which are fixed in the same axial, can rotate coaxially at the same step. Meanwhile, the related software application platform is developed, which is being used for angular calibration and angular detecting. The output signals from the standard and corrected sensors can be transmitted to a host computer via one COM port. Take a kind of smart angular displacement sensor for calibration example, its angular displacement mathematic model embedded in MCU can be corrected by using this apparatus with higher accuracy so that the technique specification, like basic errors and linearity error can be improved greatly. For the four capacitive angular displacement sensors, their calibrating results sensors show that the averaged basic errors are 0.19%, 0.16%, 0.12% 0.15% respectively and the maximum is 0.62%, and the averaged linearity errors are 0.15% 0.12% 0.10% 0.14% respectively, and the maximum is 0.58% The accuracy of 1.0 level of this capacitive angular displacement sensor can be obtained.

articleTitle: Component-based models for distributed systems
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Much larger flexibility of software adaptability is necessary to the destination platform and the user requirement in distributed systems. Component-based models are becoming increasingly ubiquitous as enabling technology for modern distributed system applications. Software modules and components have always played a key role in the systems. The fundamental contribution of component-based models lies in making the property of the distributed systems a core requirement. In this paper the component-based models, such as COM+, EJB, CORBA and OSGi, are evaluated, and how deployment modelling is described. To illustrate the component models, an application to POP3 Web service component is implemented in Visual Studio .NET.

articleTitle: Survivability assessment for command information system based on hierarchical junction tree
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The reasoning algorithm based on hierarchical junction tree is proposed for the requirement of command information system Survivability. The Bayesian network is switched into a hierarchical junction tree structure and as a secondary structure for inference. The example shows that, HJT structure can not reduce the accuracy of reasoning, but also greatly reduce the memory requirements of large complexity Bayesian networks and improve the efficiency of reasoning.

articleTitle: A convenient route for the synthesis of adenosine
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: A convenient route for the synthesis of adenosine uses hypoxanthine, which is obtained easily and low prices, and phosphorus oxychloride as starting materials was proposed. The route involved three steps as chlorination, condensation and aminolysis, respectively. The reaction condition is mild and the overall yield is higher than other conventional chemical synthesis methods. Firstly, 6-chloropurine was obtained from hypoxanthine and phosphorus oxychloride by chlorination with 90.0% yield. Then, adenosine was produced from 6-chloropurine and tetraacetyl-ribofuranose without separation by condensation and ammonolysis with 75.0% and 66.7% yields, respectively. The total yield of three steps is 45%, the optimum reaction temperature of condensation and ammonolysis are 135 °C and 100 °C, respectiveely. The structures of the compounds were confirmed by TLC, IR, NMR and MS analysis.

articleTitle: Settlement analysis of raft foundation in wall structure based on SAP2000
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Considering soil structure interaction, research on the finite modeling with the settlement of high-rise structure, determined the extent of soil, and use SAP2000 to calculate the settlement of a tall building, settlement discipline of a structure and main factors are obtained, provided a useful reference for the design.

articleTitle: Planning of 3G-oriented transmission network
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Transmission networks, is the basic network for all types of telecommunication business and is being constructed on a large scale. How to effectively and fully utilize the network resources becomes the great concern in network construction and maintenance. Meanwhile, the transmission operators also put their emphasis on how to build the transmission networks with clearer network organization, richer supported businesses, more convenient maintenance for operations, more efficient opening of circuits, more reliable network services and smoother expansion and upgrade. Therefore, the significance of optimizing transmission networks is increasingly highlighted. The traditional optical transmission network with complex configuration, low utilization rate of bandwidth, high cost and the poor expansibility, can't meet the requirements of 3G transmission network 3G network is a new generation mobile network that supports not only voice services, but also multimedia services, focusing on data service. This paper take the local transmission network of a telecommunication in Linyi as an example. Through analysis of the present network architecture, availability of resources and existence question, the paper tries to find out the key problems and the planning of 3G-oriented local transmission for the future. Network security, extensibility and compatibility also being evaluated and analyzed.

articleTitle: The study on the interfacial transition zone of tire rubber powder mortar
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this study, 0%, 5%, 10%, 15% and 20% of waste rubber powder and 10% of sand was used to made crumb rubber cement mortar specimens in order to investigate the physical and chemical properties of the resulting cement. The examine the resulting materials the following tests were used: normal consistency water of fresh properties, compressive strength, and flexural strength, splitting strength, shrinkage test and durability. The materials were cured for ages of 1, 3, 7, 28, 56 and 91 days. Optical microscope, X-Ray Diffract meter, and scanning electron microscopy observations of the rubber powder and cement paste were made to evaluate the interface characteristics, to verify the engineering properties of rubber concrete and to evaluate the development of the strength and durability of the materials. The aim of the study was to provide a basis for the use of waste rubber tires and to provide a reference for the future. The results showed that the setting time of crumb rubber cement mortar increases as the amount of replacement waste rubber powder increased. The higher the substitution in the mixture, the more water was necessary to achieve consistency. Compressive strength, flexural strength and splitting strength decreased, as the substitution of rubber powder increased; at the same time, the higher the amount of replacement, the lower the strength was. This result may be due to the lower viscosity of the rubber particles as compared to the cement particles. OM, X-ray, SEM observations confirmed these results and showed that the cement paste and rubber particles bond less. Thus, with more replacement material in the concrete, the material interfacial transition zone between the interfaces will become more vulnerable.

articleTitle: Solid-liquid metastable equilibria in the aqueous ternary system containing lithium, magnesium, and sulfate ions at 273.15 K
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Experimental studies on the metastable solubilities and physicochemical properties (densities and refractive index) of the aqueous ternary system (Li<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> + MgSO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> + H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O) at 273.15 K were determined by the method of isothermal evaporation. According to the experimental results, the metastable phase diagram and the diagrams of physicochemical properties versus composition were plotted. It was found that there is one invariant point of (Li<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>·H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O + MgSO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>·7H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O), two univariant curves, and two crystallization regions corresponding to lithium sulfate monohydrate (Li<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>·H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O) and epsomite (MgSO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>·7H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O) in the metastable ternary system. The system belongs to a hydrate type I, and neither double salts nor solid solutions were formed. The solution density and refractive index of the metastable ternary system changes regularly with the mass fraction of magnesium sulfate and all reach the maximum value at the invariant point. The calculated values of density and refractive index with the empirical equations are in good agreement with the experimental values.

articleTitle: Study on the size effect of composite foundation under the load test
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The size effect in the load test of composite foundation is studied through FEM analysis in the paper. From the result of study, we can see that the testing result on four piles area is closed to the result with the group piles effect in large-area composite foundation; In engineering, if the bearing capacity of the testing result from single or double pile composite foundation is used in large area composite foundation, the result is unsafe, so the bearing capacity must be reduced; the subsidence ratio of different cushion cap and the square root of area ratio of cushion cap are general shown in linear relation.

articleTitle: A non-iterative method and application on design planar six-bar mechanisms with an approximate equal velocity ratio transmission
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: A non-iterative design method on an approximate equal velocity ratio transmission mechanism is presented. The mathematical principle is that a compound function produced by two basic functions, let its one order differential is equal to a constant at special point, and then two to three order derivatives of the compound function are all zeroes, thus two algebraic equations are got, their solutions define a mechanism dimensions. This a principle not only sets up a new design method on approximate equal velocity ratio mechanisms but output displacement is independently designed. A design example shows that this method is simpler and transmission characteristics are better than optimization method.

articleTitle: The orientation workspace of a 3-PRS parallel manipulator
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper deals with the orientation workspace of a 3-PRS parallel manipulator. The manipulator is constituted by a fixed three frustum base, three incline guide rails, three P-R-S kinematic chains and a mobile platform. Based on the kinematic analysis, the orientation workspace of the 3-PRS parallel manipulator are analyzed. The three dimensional view of orientation workspace is drawn based on inverse solution of its positional problem and comprehensively considering the structural restraint. The impact of its geometric parameter on the orientation workspace is analyzed quantitatively. The work of this paper provides the basis for the design and the practical application of the parallel manipulator.

articleTitle: Oscillation results for a class of hyperbolic equations with continuous distributed deviating arguments
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: A class of hyperbolic equations with continuous distributed deviating arguments is considered and its oscillation theorems are discussed. These theorems are of higher degree of generality and deal with the cases which are not covered by the known criteria. Particularly, these criteria extend and unify a number of existing results.

articleTitle: Predicting the potential distribution patterns of the rare plant Gymnocarpos przewalskii under present and future climate change
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Knowledge about the geographic distribution of the rare and relic plant Gymnocarpos przewalskii is very important to inform conservation strategies. In this study, we attempt to simulate and predict the potential geographic distribution of the species under present and future climate change, using the model of maximum entropy (Maxent), a species distributional model. We created predicting models based on sixteen sampled localities and nineteen environmental layers. Our results indicated that the simulated present distributions agree well with the actual distribution ranges. Under the future climate scenario with Maximum and energy requirements, the G. przewalskii shift broadly northward and westward. Distribution patterns of the rare species changed greatly.

articleTitle: Research and design on wireless transmission of well depth counter
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The well depth counter is the most important indicators to the drilling operation, however, it is installed on the end of main winch, data lines and power supply cable arrangement to driller control house, which causes the routing to be complex and goes against the drill machine's relocation and the well-site maintenance. It is energy-saving to the new-style well depth counters design by using self-powered and wireless transmission techniques, and that structure is simpler and more compacted, and it's more convenient to the installment and maintenance.

articleTitle: Comparative study on logistics performance of the six provinces in Central China based on DEA model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The rising of Central China is now a major national strategy. Modern logistics industry plays an extremely important supporting role in the construction of economic zones in the Central China, at the same time the Central Economic Zones also provide tremendous opportunities for the development of modern logistics industry. Therefore, the logistics industry should be closely related with the development of the Central Economic Zones. In this paper, the author used DEA model to analyze logistics development level and respective strengths and weaknesses of the six provinces of Central China (Henan, Shanxi, Hubei, Hunan, Anhui, Jiangxi) by a number of input and output indicators, and put forward some suggestions for the development of logistics industry in these Central Economic Zones.

articleTitle: Research on complex goaf detection technology for mining converted from underground to open-pit based on GPR method
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In the mining converted from underground to open-pit, the existence of various complex goaf in the open-pit mining realm poses a grave threat to the safety of operation. This paper summarizes the composition of these various complex goaf, and introduces the principles and techniques from which the GPR (ground penetrating radar) was used to detect shallow complex goaf in the open-pit mining realm including data acquisition, processing and explanations. Utilizing GPR had obviously been effective for this specific project to detect shallow complex goaf in the mining converted from underground to open-pit. Thus the GPR can be equally useful and worthy to be applied and popularized in related fields.

Author Keywords: mining converted from underground to open-pit

articleTitle: Photodegradation of malachite green by Bi2WO6 photocatalyst
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Bi<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>WO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> photocatalyst was first utilized to degrade malachite green. The effects of malachite green's initial concentration, pH, and Bi<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>WO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> dosage on the photocatalytic degradation efficiency were investigated. This study presents a solution to eliminate highly toxic and persistent dyes such as malachite green.

articleTitle: A study on the engineering properties for the high flowing concrete made of new slag ash
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Environmental protection and sustainable development have been drawing global attention in the recent years so that how to effectively reuse by-products as viable green resourced materials is of importance. In the study a new pozzolanic material, also called new slag ash, containing blast furnace slag, basic oxygen furnace slag along with fly ash is developed and a part of cement in high flowing concrete is substituted by the new slag ash. To evaluate the engineering properties, uniformity and potential shrinkage of concretes, hardened properties such as compressive strength, splitting strength, elastic modulus, ultrasonic pulse velocity, and durability such as surface electrical resistivity, sulfate attack, as well as shrinkage are tested. As to the mixture design of high flowing concrete, the ratio of cement to new slag ash is 3:7. Also, the mixing water is 180 kg/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>, respectively. The design strength for both concretes is 210kg/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. Once other properties testing will show satisfactory results as well, the slag ash will be applied into a variety of concrete structures in practical constructions, being a kind of green materials to reduce cement consumption and improve concrete performance. It is promising that the benefits in terms of energy conservation, carbon dioxide emission reduction, and concrete structure safety can be achieved.

articleTitle: Dynamic simulation of three-axis variable elliptical trajectory equal-thickness screen based on MATLAB
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Introduction of a three-axis variable elliptical trajectory equal-thickness screen, according to Lagrange principle to establish the dynamic equations and make kinematics simulation using MATLAB software. Get the motion trajectories, vibrating direction angle, amplitude and throwing index of different points on screen surface. Through the analysis of these several parameters can be drawn that, vibrating screen in accordance with the method described in this article exercise can produce varying elliptical trajectory, is conducive to achieving equal-thickness screening.

articleTitle: Applications of indigenous plants in water landscape
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Top priority has been given to the application of water scenery in garden since ancient times. In the view of Ecology and Aesthetic, indigenous plants in the construction of water landscape have such advantages as strong adaptability, anti-pessimum and forming regional landscape, etc. And using indigenous plants are able to achieve rustic, natural effect. Therefore, suitable species of indigenous plants for application in water landscape were discussed in this essay. Meanwhile, the application modes of them in water landscape, including river, rivulet, lake and pond, etc, were also discussed.

articleTitle: Screening of a thermophilic hydrocarbon-degrading bacterial group and bioremediation of petroleum polluted soil
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: A thermophilic oil-degrading bacterial group, named KL6-3 was screened by means of enrichment culture from soil contaminated by heavy oil from Karamay of Xinjiang Oilfield. Its oil degradation rate was up to 48.6% at 45°C and oil concentration of 10g·L<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>(data not reported). To evaluate biodegradation to petroleum polluted soil of the KL6-3, the soil samples collected from Karamay supplemented with the KL6-3 group were incubated for 90 days at 45°C. The physicochemical quality, microorganism quantity and hydrocarbon component of the oil polluted soil were studied. The results showed that the presence of KL6-3 group could enhance the degradation of crude oil. The petroleum hydrocarbon was mainly degraded by microorganism. The saturates and aromatics were easy to be degraded and the resin and asphaltene were hard to be degraded. The microorganism quantity was increased significantly with manual composting.

articleTitle: Catalytic oxidation of 4,4'-Dibromobiphenyl in sub-critical water with Mn-Co-Ce complex oxides
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Mn<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>Ce<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> and Mn<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.9</sub>Co<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.1</sub>Ce<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> complex oxides were prepared by co-precipitation in hydrothermal conditions and their physicochemical properties were characterized with N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> adsorption, XRD, Raman, and SEM. The complex oxides show enough stability and catalytic activity for oxidative degradation of 4,4'-Dibromobiphenyl in sub-critical water. Mn<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.9</sub>Co<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.1</sub>Ce<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> has higher activity than Mn<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>Ce<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>, indicating doping of Co to Mn-Ce-O complex can improve the catalytic activity.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: A generalized forward-secure proxy blind signature scheme
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Design of video transmission and quality evaluation system based on NS-2
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper firstly elaborates the video transmission quality evaluation methods, and gives an overall scheme of video transmission simulation and quality evaluation system, then based on the open-source network simulation software NS-2, realizing the the entire system, finally, simulation experiments are provided to demonstrate the feasibility of the system, the result shows that the video transmission and quality evaluation system we designed can evaluate the multimedia transmission performance over complex environment very well, and it can be a powerful tool in multimedia transmission research.

articleTitle: Application on one-dimensional coupled model of contaminant transport considering consolidation deformation of soils
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The research on contaminant transport in deforming porous media is very lack. In this paper according to the coupled model of contaminant transport considering consolidation deformation of soils established previously, the authors have studied the application of model. The main work is simulated calculation on the concentration distribution with depth of main contaminant in dredging substrate sludge under the condition of different consolidation pressure. The results have showed consolidation deformation of soils has important effect on transport of contaminant in the soil layer.

articleTitle: Solving the output concentration of computer in multiple mixed flow reactors in series — Second-order reversible reaction
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: On the multiple mixed flow reactors in series for second-order reversible reaction, the output concentration of evening reactor can be solved by algebra and wag of graph. However, the former needs a great deal of time and energy, and the later is not accurate enough. Furthermore, it can not be calculated by two methods when the number of mixed flow reactor tends to infinity. A new method which overcame the shortcoming of the previous methods. The names that a program is developed in C++ according to the iterative formula, which can calculate the output concentration of each reactor quickly, the result of the running program being perfectly consistent with the calculating result. Moreover, the method is convenient, quick and accurate, and that it can increase the computing efficiency. It is not only practical in the design of multiple mixed flow reactors in series but also important in the production of the chemical industry. Therefore, the method of computer programming is worth of generalization.

Author Keywords: multiple mixed flow in reactors in series

articleTitle: Process parameters on silane protection for concrete in salt environment
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Protective effect of specimens with different w/c ratio, surface treatment methods, and protective time after dipping silane was studied by measurement of adsorption mass and Cl<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-</sup> content. The results show that: 1) the adsorption mass and Cl<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-</sup> content were decrease with protective time increasing, while its reduction degree was decline with the time up to 3 days. 2) There was no linear relationship between its adaptability to silane soakage and w/c ratio that the adaptability of specimens with different w/c ratio in order of decreasing size were as follows w/c=0.6, 0.4 and 0.5. 3) As for surface treatment, there was little difference about their effectiveness between air drying and vacuum drying, but the effectiveness of high-temperature drying is weakest.

articleTitle: Parameter sensitivity analysis of automotive ride comfort
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The sensitivity of ride comfort performance to the vehicle elastic component is studied in this paper, including suspension spring, suspension rubber component, seat and tire. Firstly the quarter ride dynamics model considering the elastic characteristic of vehicle and the friction and hysteresis characteristic of suspension system of one passenger car, having three degrees of freedom, is established. By the MatLab/Simulink simulation, the vibration responses of seat and floor under random input are achieved and some objective evaluation indexes of ride comfort are calculated. Furthermore the sensitivity analysis for objective evaluation indexes on key parameters which influence ride comfort is carried out with Parameter Sensitivity Analysis theory and some conclusions are summarized.

articleTitle: Study on spectrum sensing algorithm of cyclostationary feature based on time aliasing in cognitive radio
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In order to reduce the computational amount of the spectrum sensing algorithm and to improve the frequency resolution in cognitive radio, a spectrum sensing algorithm of cyclostationary feature based on time aliasing and smooth sinc window is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the basic steps of this spectrum sensing method are given carefully. Secondly, the performance of the algorithm are analysed from the aspects of computation complexity and bias error in spectrum domain by theoretical derivation. Finally, the simulation results are given to prove the effectivity of this spectrum sensing algorithm.

articleTitle: Structural strength analysis of suspended pipeline sealer
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper, according to the actual working conditions of suspended pipeline sealer, simulation and theoretical analysis of structural strength are carried out. On the platform of FEM, stress and strain of pipeline are analyzed by using software ANSYS. Furthermore, on the basis of critical buckling strain method and mechanical principle, critical buckling strain and actual pressure are calculated. Through comparing the results of the simulation and theoretical calculation, strength assessment of pipe wall and pin is received, without any yield distortion of pipe wall. In addition, strength of pin is testified enough. All in all, the results provide important reference value for the follow-up test.

articleTitle: Influenced factors and attainment rates of vapor recovery system for service stations in Beijing
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The vapor emission control of citywide service stations in Beijing has completed in 2008. 40 service stations have been tested according to China national standards between year 2008 to 2010, and 5 service stations have been tested in 2010 time after time. The result shows that in 2008 the acceptance test attainment rates of air tightness, dynamic back pressure, and air to liquid volume ratio (A/L) of vapor recovery system were 65.0%, 95.3% and 81.5%, which is better than the initial control level of Germany and America. The air tightness failure is due to the leakage of manhole covers, gauge hatches, P/V valves of underground tanks, etc. The dynamic back pressure failure is due to small diameter and inadequate slope of the vapor pipelines, etc. The A/L is failed because the vacuum pump failure, A/L control valve off, etc. The annual test attainment rates of air tightness, dynamic back pressure, and A/L of vapor recovery system raised to 82.5%, 85.0% and 84.8% in 2009, which is about the same in 2010. It also indicates that the attainment rate of distributed vapor recovery system is slightly higher than centralized system. The attainment rate of A/L is positively correlated with dynamic back pressure (R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>=0.26), and is negative correlated with the average gasoline amount dispersed by all fueling nozzles of each station (R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>=0.04). The exceeded A/L value rate of fueling nozzles, which is about 50% non-attainment of A/L, is less than 10%. Four times of test in every half year can raise the attainment rates of these three indicators of vapor recovery system from 65% to 90%. On-line monitoring systems were suggested to install in designated service stations according to GB 20592 as early as possible.

articleTitle: Study on analytical method of gear drive based on principle of minimal orientation-distance
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Mathematical model of acquiring driving error and contact point of tooth surface is built and simulation analytical method is put forward based on principle of minimal orientation-distance. On this basis, driving error and contact point of gear pair can be calculated with relevant program when error exists, and driving error curve and contact area of gear pair could be achieved. Making use of this method, contact point condition of a pair of loxodrome normal circular-arc bevel gears is analyzed, then transmission error and contact area variation of it are analyzed when helix angle error exists. This method is simple and efficient and it applies to analysis of any kind of gear drive.

articleTitle: A location method research of electricity emergency material storage
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Location of emergency material storage as an important part of the electricity emergency work, related to the repair resources efficient scheduling and the success of the emergency plan directly. In this paper considered the particularity of its own power system, presented an integrated importance and probability factors as the weights of the smallest total weighted time locating method. The method first defines the concept of material needs regional, comprehensive assess its importance, then introduction of interval failure probability model, to get its weights.
