Based on the time intervals transport network, used the restriction time as the standard to decide the number of material storage and filter paths, then building and solving the location model, get the optimal plan. Finally, use an example to demonstrate the effectiveness and practicality of the method.

articleTitle: Design of NC Shoe-last carving machine's HSC tool system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: High Speed Cutting (HSC) is an advanced manufacturing process technology which develops rapidly in recent years. It is also an important orientation in machining technology. It has made significant economic benefits in aviation, aerospace, automotive, mold, high-speed locomotives and other industry applications. Therefore, far-reaching significance will be achieved in improving the level of processing technology. Shoe-last is the basis of shoe making. In NC conventional machining, the speed and the accuracy have mutual affects on each other, while HSC can solve these problems. HSC Tool System is the key part of NC Shoe-last Carving Machine and its design will influence the precision and surface quality of Shoe-last.

articleTitle: The reliability based topology optimal design of continuum structural
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The continuum structure topology optimization design has been research hot spot and the difficulty in the structure optimization design. This article uses the reliability theory and the ESO method to solve the program of the reliability-based topology optimal design of continuum structural. The mathematical model is established and the perturbation method is utilized to the reliability restraint. The ESO method is used to process the topology optimization design of the continuum structure. Several examples are given; the results indicate that the reliability-based topology optimal design of continuum structural is feasible.

articleTitle: Adaptive morphological filter to fault diagnosis of gearbox
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Focusing on fault diagnosis extraction of gearbox, a novel approach is proposed according to the signal characteristics based on the adaptive morphological filter. Traditional linear filters have some limitations when extracting nonlinear features. As a nonlinear analysis method, the morphological filter has better performance on detail reservation and noise reduction, and can describe nonlinear morphological characteristics more clearly than linear filters. The structuring element (SE) of the morphological filter is similar to the window function of the linear filter. In order to avoid the drawbacks of the ambiguity of the selecting of SEs and the dependence on empirical rules, an adaptive morphological filter is proposed based on kurtosis maximization principle in this paper. The experimental results show that the adaptive algorithm can be more efficient to extract fault features of gearbox.

articleTitle: Games in PBL teaching for vocational school students: Take the course “The basic information technology” for an example
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The author take one section of the course "The Information Technology for University Student " for an example, carry out teaching activities in a learning environment based on edutainment, and by the way of problem-solving. It describes the various interesting ways and pleasant environment that can be used in PBL teaching. Use game as a learning language, the use of scene tools to implement the user's design. Learning resources and learning process in the organization of interspersed game scene, the problems can be a fun process. Enable the students' ability from the professional knowledge, core skills, professional quality, and many other aspects, made them develop the problem-solving capacity in problem-solving process, meanwhile, enable the construction process of knowledge.

articleTitle: Analysis of beat vibration for magnetic bearing spindle of high-speed precision grinding machine
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In the spindle system supported by active magnetic bearing (AMB), beat vibrations will occur. The beat vibration will affect the stability of high-speed rotation and precision of grinding in the high-speed precision grinding spindle system with AMB spindle. In this paper, beat vibration phenomena is observed by inner sensor of magnetic bearing in the high-speed precision grinder spindle system, without any external equipment. Experiments are designed to determine the origin of the beat vibration. The mechanism of the beat vibration is analyzed. This study offers the foundation for the AMB's active control of the spindle rotor to suppress the beat vibration.

articleTitle: A Tibetan input method based on MTK for mobile phone
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The current input methods of Tibetan on mobile phone are almost non-intelligent with slow development. Most of them have the defects of unsightly font, complex operation and low efficiency. In order to solve these problems, a new Tibetan intelligent input method is proposed and we implement this design in MTK mobile phone platform. This input method adopts new system architecture and intelligent search algorithms, so the whole input system reaches a higher height in search efficiency and humanity.

articleTitle: Characteristics analysis of high speed spindle based on full supported Aerostatic bearing
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: A novel high speed spindle based on full supported Aerostatic bearing is put forward to improve spindle's static state stiffness and loading capacity. A finite element method is employed to analyze the dynamic characteristics of spindle. The fluid-solid coupled analysis with ANSYS software is developed for the analysis of the static stiffness of spindle, compared with two dimensional FEM, the calculation accuracy is improved greatly. At last, an experiment system for static and dynamic performance of high-speed spindle based on full supported Aerostatic bearing was built up and the theoretical analysis is verified with the experimental results.

articleTitle: Mechanics-experimental researches on pipe unstable deformation under external pressure
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: It is a practical and efficient method to research the mechanism of pipe deformation under external pressure by means of pipe collapse-experiments. This article descripts pipe deformation experimental principles include the installations, experimental techniques, and experimental procedures and so on. The methods accord with the actual process of pipe deformation and particularly are propitious to record the test data and observe the processes of pipe deformation. It is very easy to record the test data and adjust the experimental methods. By the experimental data the factors influencing the pipe deformations under external pressure are analyzed and compared with present API theoretical methods, the results from the analysis are importance of which research the mechanism of pipe in failure of collapse deformation.

articleTitle: Design of a pair of noncircular gears meeting Ackermann steering principle
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper focuses on the design of a pair of noncircular gears, which is used in a concept automobile steering system to make the steering meet Ackermann steering principle. Based upon Ackermann steering principle, the pitch curves of the noncircular gears are formulated. The tooth profiles, addendum and dedendum curves, and transition curves of the noncircular gears are designed. Moreover, the phenomenon of the tooth profile reflection is discussed. Three-dimensional model of the noncircular gears is developed in Pro/ENGINEER, where a motion simulation is also carried out to prove the design.

articleTitle: Computer network database of attack and defense
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: With the rapid development of computer technology, computer networks have become an important part of human society, to the social development of a huge role. It used a variety of database technology, which is giving hackers to provide a means of attack damage. To this, aiming at the computer network database security threats and prevention of related problems are analyzed.

articleTitle: An energy efficient control strategy for fan static pressure difference
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Ventilation fans are energy-demanding equipment that stand for a significant share of a building's total energy consumption. Improving energy efficiency of fans is thus important. Fans used for demand controlled ventilation deliver a specific flow rate derived from the actual load in the building. This paper is about how to deliver the required flow rate to all rooms, without wasting energy on throttling. The simulation study shows that by introducing a relatively simple control procedure, the fan can be controlled more efficient and energy consumption can be reduced by as much as 40% (compared to constant set-point pressure difference control).

articleTitle: The analysis of information technology's application in middle school mathematics teaching — Based on surveys of the rural middle school in Hubei province
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The information technology and modern education, as well as integration of various subjects is a breakthrough in deepening educational reform. Combining with Hubei rural middle school mathematics classroom teaching in information technology usage questionnaire, and using questionnaire interview method and SPSS software, the paper analyzes the information technology application situation in rural middle school mathematics teaching. From the three factors of teaching process, the causes are analyzed, and it puts forward some methods to solve them.

articleTitle: Calculating room acoustic parameters by finite element method
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Room impulse response and the acoustical parameters of an actual room were calculated with acoustics finite element method using Comsol Multiphysics software. The procedure of calculating room impulse response and acoustic parameters were introduced. The calculated acoustics parameters up to octave bands of 500Hz were then compared with the field measured results. The FEM is proved to be a useful tool to predict the room acoustic parameters in low frequency range.

articleTitle: Dynamics analysis of mine trunk based on virtual simulation software ADAMS
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper, the model of mine truck, which including hydro-pneumatic suspension cylinder, oriented institutions, frame, wheels and so on, is established with the help of Pro/E. Some relevant simulation analyses of mine trunk are carried out using the software ADAMS, such as kinematic analysis, multi-rigid body dynamics simulation, climbing performance and roll performance. To some extent, it provides some design basis of mine trunk to improve its dynamic performance and security.

articleTitle: Simulation of full power hydraulic brake system for engineering vehicles
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Considered the high speed, heavy weight, heavy load and fast brake of heavy vehicle, the scheme of full power hydraulic brake system controlled by dual brake valve is adopted in the brake system which can accomplish steering brake and emergent brake for engineering vehicle. The nonlinear mathematic models of components for brake valve, brake cylinder, connecting pipeline and so on are established to the full power hydraulic brake system. The double pipelines steering brake and parking brake are discussed by simulation experiment based on Matlab/Simulink. The simulation results proved the rationality to develop the double pipelines for brake system.

articleTitle: A high accuracy localization based on RSSI measurements
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The location methods based on RSSI measurements are popular because the signal acquirement is convenient, cheap and low power consumption. However, the location results based on RSSI are not very stable since the variations of the environment of the sensor nodes. A high accurate location method based on RSSI measurement is proposed to overcome the sensor nodes position random and the noise from the complex environments. The proposed method max improves the location accuracy in both the location stage and the coordinate calculation stage. Theoretical analysis and simulation results show that the proposed method has better performance than the other similar algorithms.

articleTitle: Repairing algorithm design for FAT file system in embedded system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In embedded Linux applications, the power failure may lead to the abnormity of the FAT file system. An effective repairing algorithm for the FAT file system was designed and implemented in this paper. The scanning files method based on tree structure was utilized as the core of repairing algorithm. FAT tables and cluster markers were adopted to improve the memory efficiency. Furthermore, the abnormities were classified based on the information of FAT and cluster chain. The experimental result showed that the presented algorithm has good performance in memory usage, repairing speed, repairing efficiency and controllability for abnormity.

articleTitle: The trend analysis of low-carbon technology development of the Yangtze River Delta region in the post-World Expo
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: One of the original idea of World Expo 2010 Shanghai is to be introduced low-carbon idea, and to be created "low carbon Expo " and low-carbon model, which forms a broad, deep and sustained effects of low-carbon in post-World Expo, responses and describes a global low carbon revolution. According to the central requirements of scientific development, harmonious development, first development, integration development, the Yangtze River Delta should actively undertake the impact and radiation of low-carbon World Expo effect in the Post-World Expo, learn from low-carbon culture and the experience, speed up the low-carbon development of regional, effort to build a first, demonstration and leading area of the national low-carbon development, to seize the high ground of the future, achieve inclusive growth and make greater contributions in the International competition for China, by means of various ways and measures such as policy linkage, trade flows, technology transfer, joint research.

articleTitle: Computer simulation on life of the structure based on service structure for the reinforced concrete frame
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The distribution of the structure like in service is simulated through the simulation of the time and the intensity of earthquake and the elastoplastic response analysis of the reinforced concrete frame subjected to the acceleration of ground. This study is carried out under the consideration of the accumulated damage, the natural deterioration of the structure, durability of erosive damage and repair decision, combining with structural safety, durability and economical result. It provides a new thought and research method for forcasting the life of the structure.

articleTitle: Intelligent bridge monitoring system based on 3G
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Bridge monitoring system is significant to health diagnosis of railway bridges. This paper proposed and developed a novel architecture for large span bridge monitoring. A 3-level distributed structure is adopted in the monitoring system which includes central server, intelligent acquisition node and local controller. Acquisition nodes are located across the bridge. All the acquisition nodes are managed by one local controller. Every acquisition node has 8 channels which can sample displacement, acceleration and strain of bridge. To get high precision data, a 24bits A/D converter ADS1278 is used. Compare to the traditional method, the proposed architecture has two features. First, the acquisition node is a smart device based on powerful DSP processor. Signals of field sensors are analyzed and realtime compressed in the acquisition node. Only the processing results are sent to local controller through IEEE802.11 wireless network. This operation can relieve load of central server and decrease demand of communication bandwidth. Second, 3G wireless network is utilized to provide enough bandwidth for real-time data transmission between local controller and central server. The intelligent monitoring system has run on a large span railway bridge for six months. Running results show that the proposed system is stable and effective.

articleTitle: Research and analysis of classification model based on the shape parameters of cashew nuts
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The paper tried to build the classification model of cashew nuts and had analyzed the shape parameters of cashew nuts, and the paper concluded that there was a clear linear relationship between the length and height of cashew nuts and there was not a clear linear relationship between the length and thickness of cashew nuts or between the height and thickness of cashew nuts. Because of the restrictions of classification movement of cashew nuts, we could choose the length of cashew nuts to replace height of cashew nuts as key parameters of classification. Therefore, we could determine respectively three sizes of 18 mm, 28 mm and 42 mm as the length of long circular sieve of the classification machine. To solve the problem of the nonlinear relationship between thickness and length or height of cashew nuts, the paper analyzed the correlation between thickness of cashew nuts and breadth of long circular sieve. Finally the paper identified 19 mm width as long circular sieve.

articleTitle: Research on synthesis load modeling with online statistical measurement-based method
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper briefly introduced the research on synthesis load modeling with online statistical measurement-based method. Statistical measurement-based method provides a complementary advantage for synthesis method and overall statistics measurement method by their combination and improvement on the basis of history load data. It offers a better idea to put load modeling into practice, which enables us to realize long-term management of dynamic online load modeling and the time-variability and diversity of load can be adapted.

articleTitle: Strength optimization of the output shaft in EPS
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Strength optimization is important method to save material and improve the dynamic performance of parts. With the research object of the output shaft, the paper has established strength optimization model and used genetic algorithm method to solve the difference strength safely coefficients in each position of the output shaft. The results show that when the shaft, with maximum loading, has been optimized, the quality reduce 6.7 percent, the maximum deformation reduce 35%, the maximum strain decrease 1%, and the biggest stress decrease 1%.

articleTitle: The study of synthesis of geographic information on fuzzy C-means clustering algorithm
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: On the basis of building GIS data acquisition system, the paper fuses the geographic information got through the GPS device using the fuzzy C-means clustering algorithm, calculates the changes of geographic information, real-time and dynamically, updates geographic information system rapidly, and provides more accurate and detailed reference for the applications of geographic information.

articleTitle: Application of iSIGHT in solving multi-objective optimal design problems
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In view of the shortcomings of traditional multi-objective optimal methods, this paper introduces iSIGHT which is a kind of optimal design software. Based on optimal design framework Isight, the multi-objective optimal design method and step using the Neighborhood Cultivation Genetic Algorithm (NCGA) are investigated. Taking a multi-objective optimal design of spring as the example, the Pareto optimal sets are obtained, and then design maker can select a solution which suits the engineering best. The process and result verify the validity and feasibility of iSIGHT in solving multi-objective optimal design problems.

articleTitle: A PDSI with STBC scheme for PAPR reduction in OFDM system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this study, we have proposed a partition dummy sequence insertion (PDSI) method to reduce the high peak-to-average power ratio (PAPR) problem for the Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (OFDM) signal in the 802.11a WLAN with space-time block coding (STBC) system. The results show that the proposed STBC-PDSI method can avoid the BER degradation for different nonlinearity and the saturation point from the system simulation.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Characteristics and rebuilding of urban landscape of the Xuchang ancient city
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Numerical studies of the flowfield over a hybrid VAWT with different torque
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The study was a simulation of the organization of the axial wind turbines, the resistance type and three-piece lift-type structure, resistance type is semi-circular arc type, lift type of blade were NACA0018 airfoil and NACA4412, the inflow and rotational flow interactions. CFD computational fluid dynamics methods using finite volume method to solve Navier-Stokes equations to SIMPLE algorithms for incompressible flow, coupled with second-order upwind and dependency by testing the grid with the grid and the analytical characteristics of the turbulent flow pattern transition, And the other with sliding mesh method, and the additional number of dynamic flow rate of angular momentum, CFD simulation, the resistance type and NACA0018 and NACA4412 torque output, the more complex the fan if installed NACA0018 and NACA4412 additional vertical axis wind turbine will also improve the two Species of the wing part of the export value of the reverse. Only the resistance-type than the original state of the torque output value can be 3.6 times higher.

articleTitle: Teaching and research on assembly language for computational thinking
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Assembly language is a foundation courses for science and technology of computers. Computational thinking emphasizes just like computer scientists thinking. It is one of basic skills to solve problems with the computer technology. How to develop student's computational thinking is an urgent question in computer education. This paper analyzes the connotation of computational thinking, the embodiment of ability in assembly language and the process of formation; then proposes teaching programs of assembly language for computational thinking. In 2009 and 2010, cross-teaching experiments have been adopted between teachers and students. The feedback information from students shows that the introduction of computational thinking computing can help students to improve the professional ability. The teaching reform has achieved good results.

articleTitle: The research of hydropower plant unit state overhaul
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The deregulation of power industry creates the independent market entities with different objectives, including the self-interested hydropower producers for optimizing their potential payoffs. The traditional time-based mechanism of unit maintenance scheduling (UMS) may provoke more or less than necessary maintenance, which exposes serious risk on the related producers. On the other hand, the condition-based method considers the operation status of generating units, but it is difficult to be applied on the hydraulic power plant units effectively, for its ignoring the system operation. According to these two UMS mode, an optimizing unit maintenance strategy (OUMS) is proposed in this paper, based on the monitoring information, which can guarantee the producers' benefits and the reliability of generating units.

Author Keywords: Outage risk coefficient of generating Units

articleTitle: Infinite slope model of rainfall-induced landslide
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Assuming slope failures of weathered soil to be shallow sliding under heavy rainfall, an infinite slope model for slope stability analysis is proposed, in which the infiltration depth is explicitly expressed by time and the seepage force is taken into account. Comparative study on the influence of parameters is conducted, which shows that matric suction plays an insignificant role in slope stability while comparing to the slope angle and infiltration depth.

articleTitle: Research of a new type series-parallel converted UPS circuit and its control strategy
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper introduced circuit principle and control method of a new type of series-parallel UPS. Through the waveform of output voltage and current, Simulated by Matlab7.0, the results verify that circuit principle and control method are feasible. Also, this paper analyzes the circuit can reduce the switching losses and improve the efficiency of the superiority of the machine in case of mains power failure.

articleTitle: Research of heterogeneous robots system based on CORBA
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Data interactive service shall be required during the working process of distributed Heterogeneous robot for industry production line. The heterogeneity of bottom hardware and upper software between heterogeneous robots will be screened by introducing the CORBA technology of software development. integrated technology of heterogeneous robot system has been researched. As a result, data interactive monitor system platform is realized between heterogeneous robots based on the CORBA technology. And the whole production line will become more convenient for coordination work.

articleTitle: Study of optimization control strategy of ice storage system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The technique of ice storage is the uppermost technical measure for the future in China, which can realize the “peak load shifting” and the Demand-Side Management, meliorate the contradictions between providing and demanding. Based on the ASHRAE (American Society of Heating, Refrigeration, and Air Conditioning Engineers) coefficient method and ANN (Artificial Neural Networks) method, the hourly temperature and cooling load are predicted. A preliminary discussion is made to optimization control strategy and the real-time control of ice storage system. And the results show that the on-line correction is great value. Finally, the solution of real-time control and on-line correction is brought forward.

articleTitle: The Darboux transformation of the Gerdjikov-Ivanov equation from non-zero seed
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The explicit N-fold Darboux transformation with multiparameters for a kind of derivative nonlinear Schrödinger equation is constructed with the help of the gauge transformation of the spectral problem. What is more, dark soliton, bright soliton, breather solution, periodic solution of the Gerdjikov-Ivanov equation are given explicitly from different seed solutions.

articleTitle: The Gerber-Shiu discounted penalty function for classical risk model with a linear dividend barrier
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper, we consider the classical risk model with a linear dividend barrier. In this model, we study the Gerber-Shiu discounted penalty function. Two integro-differential equations for the Gerber-Shiu discounted penalty function are derived. The analytic results of discounted penalty function are obtained.

articleTitle: Vibration frequency vibratory roller stepless design and analysis of the hydraulic system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper studies on vibratory roller. Through designing and analyzing the return circuit of hydraulic pump and the main circuit of stepless frequency vibration system, the paper explains that the frequency control of vibration roller adopts pump-controlled system consisting of variable pump and hydraulic motor. By changing the input current of electrical hydraulic servo valve, the pump swashplate angle can be changed. Thus, the displacement of variable pump can be changed and the purpose of changing the motor's rotate speed is achieved. The vibration frequency of hydraulic vibration system can be regulated steplessly among the designed range in accordance with the operating requirements. Furthermore, based on known conditions, to compute and selecte the main components of hydraulic pump and hydraulic motor, to check the relevant parameters of the hydraulic system, and to test and verify whether the selected hydraulic pump and hydraulic motor meet the system requirements.

articleTitle: An intelligent lighting control system based on ergonomic research
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper an intelligent lighting control system is introduced with adjustable illuminance, uniformity, correlated color temperature (CCT) and duration and transition of different modes, whose control strategy is based on the ergonomic research. It is verified by ergonomic experiments to be a suitable adjustable system to meet different situation of human needs.

articleTitle: Public space design of resort hotel based on the landscape view
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Leisure tourism is favored by more and more people in the 21st century. At the same time, together with leisure tourism, resort hotel shows a sound and rapid development. Due to unique geographical location and customer needs of the resort hotel, the external environment becomes the main part during the planning and design, then the building is playing second fiddle. The surrounding environment must be fully considered when the investor and the designer select the location, which makes the environment become the main part. Therefore, to make the building harmony with the environment, the environmental landscape is the focus in the resort hotel design. The lobby and the dining space of resort hotel are anlysed, and it is discussed how to make the landscape environment entering into the indoor space during the public space of resort hotel design.

articleTitle: Design of CAN-Bus universal interface module based on USB
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper propose a scheme of CAN-Bus universal interface module base on USB, The scheme uses USB chip CH375, CAN chip SJA1000, and uses MSP430F449 as control unit to complete USB, CAN interface control, as well as between the data processing and others. This paper also introduces software process and PC application program. In order to record the transmission time interval of the CAN information frame, each CAN message is added the timestamp, the timestamp precision can reach 0.1ms. After tests show that the software and hardware of the design is reasonable, and work is reliable. The interface can be applied to 1553B bus system development, testing and simulation experiment.

articleTitle: The integrability and solvability for the variable coefficient higher-order nonlinear Schrödinger equation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: A more general variable coefficient higher-order nonlinear Schrödinger equation (VCHNLSE) in nonlinear fiber optics is studied by constructing a transformation which maps the VCHNLSE to the Sasa-satsuma equation (SSE), thus its solutions are expressed explicitly from the known ones of the SSE. One novel feature of this transformation is made up of two arbitrary functions so that we can design different integrable VCHNLSEs from different concerns.

articleTitle: Influences of delay unit on bite error rate in the BDPSK phase comparing demodulation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The relative theory of improved form BDPSK modulation is analyzed. The discussion focuses on the influences of system performance made by delay module during the process of BDPSK differential coherent demodulation. The system demodulation expression between precision delay and error delay is compared. Through improving demodulation system, theoretically, the accuracy of delay units is improved. The bite error rate is reduced. The system's ability to anti-jamming is enhanced.

articleTitle: Design of the measuring and controlling system of Test Bed for Hydraulic Bursting based on LabWindows / CVI
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Combining with a research of Hydraulic Bursting Test Bed, a software development of measuring and controlling system for this test bed is introduced, which was designed based on LabWindows/CVI. This paper introduces composition and working principle of both hardware and software structure of this system and highlights the PID control module. DLL, database and multithreading technology have been fully used in the progress of software designing to rationalize the software function. The program debugging result shows that, the software capability of the test system is rational, and is satisfied the testing accuracy and qualification of the system.

articleTitle: Study on torsional vibration characteristics of conical horn
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The realization of torsional vibration by conical horn has more valuable application in project than by exponential horn and stepped horn. The wave equation of torsional wave propagating in the conical horn is analyzed based on one-dimensional wave theory, and the obtained wave equation is a standard Bessel equation. The frequency equation of the conical horn with torsional vibration is deduced on the basis of wave equation and boundary conditions. Then the mathematical expressions of nodal point and transformation ratio are given. The numerical example shows that mathematical expressions describe the acoustic characteristics of the conical horn with torsional vibration accurately. This study could provide theoretical as well as practical values for the conical horn applied in ultrasonic torsional machining.

articleTitle: Discussion on sewage treatment technology of rural areas in Beijing
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Sewage treatment technology updates day by day, while, it is not easy to apply them to the Beijing rural sewage management, which can be reflected by the idle and inefficient operation of large numbers of sewage treatment facilities. Some appropriate sewage treatment technology for the rural sewage treatment was summarized, and their applications were comprehensively compared to each other, which provided a reference for selection of rural sewage treatment technology.

articleTitle: The implement of multichannel and adjustable gain A/D sampling system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: As the serve life of a battery will be greatly shorten if it is often over charged, battery automatic testing system can be used to judge the quality and the end point of battery charging process. One kind of multichannel and adjustable gain A/D sampling systems is introduced in this paper. In this system, 8-channel analog multiplexers/demultiplexers CD4051 and instrumentation amplifier INA114 are used to get adjustable gains, another CD4051 is used as digitally-controlled analog switches to expand channels of A/D sampling system. This circuit can replace relay selective switcher circuit in traditional intelligent instruments. It has the advantages of small turn on resistance and large shut down resistance.

articleTitle: Experimental study on shell-strengthening the lightweight pumice aggregates
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Natural pumice aggregates have the characteristics of low numerical tube pressure and high water absorption, in this study, the pumice aggregates was reinforced by making shell process with the methods of mixing pumice powder and silica fume into cement, which aimed to solve the problem that it was difficult for the preparation of lightweight concrete of high strength . Through the strengthening treatment of pumice aggregates, the light aggregates with the numerical tube pressure of 2.6Mpa bulk density less than 500 kg/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> and water absorption ranging from 12.1% to 17.5% were obtained. The lightweight aggregate concrete was also made up with pumice. The compressive strength of the concrete at 28d age was higher than 15MPa and the apparent density was about 1400 kg/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>. So the results of this research were conducive for the preparation and application of high-strength and lightweight pumice concrete.

articleTitle: Supply chain integration of virtual organization
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In the virtual organization environment, supply chain not only exists between the internal member enterprises of the virtual organization and within the member enterprise, but also exists in the supply and cooperation relationship between the virtual organization and external environment. The research of virtual organization integration need consideration in the supply network system of globalization, through analysis of the composition structure of supply chain of virtual organization, put forward the integration method adopting “from top to bottom, from bottom to top and vertical integration, horizontal integration”, conduct deep analysis of the information and business process in the virtual organization, and provide the solution of integration.

articleTitle: Characteristics simulation of the pulse-width modulated valve
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The pulse-width modulated valve (PMV) plays an important role in the whole electro-hydraulic automatic control system. In this paper, the magnetic field of the axially symmetric plane model simplified of the PMV is simulated with the magnetic finite element, thus accurate results on the distribution of magnetic field and flux-line can be obtained, as well as variation of the magnetic force and inductance. Based on above calculation results, dynamic response characteristic of the PMV can be obtained by the state equations of the circuit and dynamics. Finally a calculation process is developed to simulating and predicting the performance of the PMV for the optimal design.

articleTitle: Analysis of heat and mass transfer in a thin liquid film over an unsteady stretching surface
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper is focused on the study of coupled heat and mass transfer in a liquid film over an unsteady stretching surface. The stretching rate and temperature of the sheet vary with time. The governing partial differential equations are transformed into ordinary differential equations by using similarity transformations. The resulting similarity equations are solved analytically by an efficient perturbation expansion method. A parametric study illustrating the influence of the unsteadiness parameter and Prandtl number on the fluid velocity as well as temperature is conducted.

articleTitle: An improved mutual authentication scheme complaint to EPC Class-1 Generation-2 standard
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: With the mass deployment of the RFID system worldwide in recent years, the security concern of RFID system is becoming more and more important and pressing. However, one of the main standards of RFID technology, EPC Class-1 Generation-2 RFID standard has a very low security level, as analyzed in previous work such as. In this paper, we first have a brief review and fully security analysis of different authentication schemes. Then we propose an improved scheme, with a fully security analysis, the improved scheme proved to be a great improvement in security compared to the current ones. Finally, we also design a simple hardware plan to implement and verify the improved scheme proposed by this paper.

articleTitle: Preparation of colloid microspheres of SiO2/Polystyrene without a coupling agent via soap-free emulsion polymerization
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The colloid microspheres of SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>/Polystyrene without a coupling agent were prepared by soap-free emulsion polymerization. The component and microstructure of the composite particles were characterized by FT-IR and SEM technology, and the mechanism of polymerization was also investigated by the particles size and distribution using dynamic light scattering (DLS) method. The characterized results showed that polystyrene is cross-linked on the surface of SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> by the chemical band of Si-O groups. The structures of synthesized SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>/Polystyrene microspheres with the diameter of 180-320 nm are formed from petal-like structure to raspberry-like structure. The mechanism of polymerization revealed that the nucleation of polystyrene deposits and forms droplets on the surface of SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> at the beginning of polymerization. The droplets then agglomerate and shedding form the surface of SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>, resulting in the swell of new nucleation in suspension and a slower increase of SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>/Polystyrene microspheres diameter during the polymerization.

articleTitle: On campus network P2P and its link control
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper, based on the survey of students' online behavior and the Netflow statistics which turned out to be the fact that P2P flow accounts for about 70% of the total compus netflow and that the Thunder connection greatly endangers the firewall load, analyzed the download principle of thunder P2P software and put forward some methods on how to control Netflow.

articleTitle: Implementation of an embedded induction motor test and analysis system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This article presents the implementation of an embedded induction motor test and analysis system based on ARM and Linux. This system adopts the ARM microprocessor - S3C2410X - as the core of the hardware and the Linux as the embedded operating system. It can be used to sample and acquire the currents, voltages, and the rate of the tested induction motor, and with some extension software, the system can also be used to analyze and diagnose the faults of motors. With high computing and storage capability of the ARM, this system is stable and effective.

articleTitle: Effect of many air cooling fans in operation on dynamic response of bridge truss
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Large air cooling fan system is made up of many fans. The dynamic response of the fan bridge truss is very complicated when the fans are running simultaneously. Four fans and their supporting structures are selected from the fan system as analysis object. By finite element method, vibration response produced by 15 kinds of the combinations of running of fans is analyzed. Result shows that interaction of fans can't be neglected when dynamic response of fan bridge truss is calculated. The research result in this paper can be as the reference for calculation of vibration response of fan bridge truss.

articleTitle: Combined control of Single Neuron PID and normal PID of switched reluctance motor
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper, a combined control strategy of Single Neuron PID and normal PID is proposed for the switched reluctance motor, which has simple structure, adaptability to environmental changes and strong robustness. The input of outer loop is error of speed while output is torque which enters the inner loop of the Direct Torque Control system to control a three phase 6/4 pole SRM whose capacity is 60KW. For the outer loop, a Single-Neuron controller is adopted when the speed error is small, and a PID controller is adopted when the error is big. Simulation results indicate that the composite control method can solve the problem that normal PID can not solve because SRM is difficult to describe from an accurately math's equation, so the paradox between the response time and overshoot of speed is managed. The system has shown high control accuracy and good dynamic characteristics are achieved, and the system has better adaptability and good robustness.

articleTitle: Routing optimization of high-level orderpickers in a rectangular warehouse
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: With the rapid development of logistics transportation, the number of high-level orderpickers in the warehouse is increasing day by day. In order to improve order picking efficiency, a mathematical model of this optimization problem is constructed according to characteristics of order picking of the high level orderpicker in a rectangular warehouse. To solve the model, G-A (Genetic-Ant colony) algorithm is proposed. Experimental results show that the algorithm has good overall search ability and astringency. What's more, it reduces order picking time and improves operation efficiency to a great extent using G-A algorithm compared to using the traditional S-shape algorithm.

articleTitle: Grey relational analysis on technical index of Chinese men's football team
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In order to find the gap between the Chinese team and the other team, we had analysed to the six games of china in the 2010 World Cup qualifier by the method of grey reational analysis. The results showed that some technical indicators had a greater impact on the competition results such as shooting being plugging, shooting, offside, yellow card, the so on. It aimed to discover the rule and characteristics of the top-football-match, help to understand the trend and features of modern football Technical and explore the effective ways to improve Technical. the essay puts forwards some suggestions on how to get the Chinese football well developed in the future.

articleTitle: Optimization of sythesis conditions of 1,1' ferrocenedimethanol
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The synthetical conditions of 1,1'-ferrocene-dimethanol were investigated using 1,1'-ferrocenedicarboxylic acid as raw material. The effects of the component ratio, solvent, reaction temperature, time on the product yield have been discussed and the optimum technological conditions have been obtained. using 1,4-dioxane as solvent, the ratio of n(dicarboxylic acid):n(LiAlH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>)=1:10, reaction time 4.0h, reaction temperature 90°C, The product yield was 89.9%.

articleTitle: A framwork for grid workflow scheduling with resource constraints
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In order to process workflow application more efficiently, we propose a workflow scheduling framework with resource constraints. The proposed framework is defined in three independent layers: concept, logic and physical ones, where an improved process definition meta-model, which unifies the process, activity, and transition, is proposed to support the recursive composition. Furthermore, the application of workflow scheduling framework in grid environment with the resources constraints is discussed.

articleTitle: Research of roots flow meter based on ARM Cortex-M3
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper introduces an intelligent roots flow meter based on ARM Cortex-M3 processor and μC/OS-II embedded real-time operating system. ARM Cortex-M3 processor is an industry-leading 32-bit processor with lower power consumption and higher performance than other 8-bit or 16-bit processors. Using the μC/OS-II embedded real-time operating system, it will compensate the temperature and pressure of the roots flow meter more instantly. What's more, it makes communication and networking easier by using ZigBee technology.

articleTitle: A new method of QR code accumulation encoding in mobile education
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: QR code identification is a kind of effective method in mobile education information authentication, this paper puts forward a new QR code accumulation encoding method owing to the limited information faults in traditional QR code encoding. The accumulation of segmentation and bar code decoding identification were improved in this method. Through experiment analysis and compared with the original QR code encoding, it can be concluded that the method in encoding output, image segmentation and decoding aspects has better effects for large capacity files.

articleTitle: Study on the characteristics and utilization of urban sewage sludge
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In order to propose an effective method for the reclamation of sewage sludge, sewage sludge from three waste water treatment plants were sampled and analyzed. The results show that the digested sludge samples are alkalescent, and the undigested sludge samples are acidic. The moisture content ranged from 78% to 83%. The samples have plenty of organic matter, N, P, K, and the heavy metals are relatively low in content and are up to the Control Standards for Pollutants in Sludge from Agricultural Use (China). Landfilling of the sewage sludge should lead to the loss of nutrient and produce some problems in safety, processing, and leakage disposal, etc. The best approach to utilizing the sludge is to use as a fertilizer in forestry and flower gardens after compost.

articleTitle: A fuzzy-sliding mode controller for four-quadrant PWM converter of grid-connected wind generation simulator
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The aim of this paper is to design a fuzzy-sliding mode controller for a four-quadrant PWM converter used in grid-connected wind generation simulator. The main goal is to improve the power factor and realize unity power factor rectifying and inverting. This paper generates the mathematical model of four-quadrant PWM converter and proposes the procedure of designing a fuzzy-sliding mode controller. This controller has both advantages of fuzzy algorithm and sliding mode algorithm. And it is verified by experiments. The experimental results demonstrate the perfect performance of the controller.

articleTitle: Natural characteristic analysis of tracking frame of electro-optical theodolite by component modal synthesis method
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Component modal Synthesis method used in natural characteristic analysis is introduced in this paper. The principle of component modal synthesis method is described. Based on this principle, the sub-structure of tracking frame of electro-optical theodolite is divided and FEM is set up. The natural frequency of tracking frame of electro-optical theodolite is calculated in the end. The results showed the component modal synthesis method has the advantage of less calculation load, higher accuracy, worth to popularize and application foreground.

articleTitle: Simulation and research on active handoff decision strategy in aviation data link
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: An active handoff decision strategy is proposed to improve the handoff performance in aviation data link. According to this strategy, the high-quality data link is maintained timely. The VDLM2 models are created in Network Simulator version 2 (NS2) environments. The end-to-end delay and signal quality are analyzed. Simulation results illustrate that the proposed strategy achieves better handoff performance.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Plan of bicycle lane system in old urban areas: A case study on Xi'an Ming City Wall Area
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Regeneration of Ti-MMT used for adsorbent for arsenic removal used the regeneration solution
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Adsorptive (titanium pillared montmorillonite) with the TiCl<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> as the precursors were prepared for the regeneration. A novel approach was used to regenerate the Ti-MMT after removal As from the As solution using the regeneration solution, and the regeneration materials were characterized by FT-IR, XRD, BET. The results indicated that the capacities of the original and the regenerated materials were declined from 13.02mg/g to 11.79mg/g, but the selectivity for arsenic increased with the increasing times of regeneration. And as the times of regeneration increased, the surface area of the Ti-MMT decreased from 201.6m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>/g to 187.1m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>/g.

articleTitle: Model updating of air purification half time under complex electric fields
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The air is purified under high voltage and high frequency complex electric fields. The results show that the half time T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">H</sub> will drop while the initial concentration N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub> of the aerosol particles reduces indoor, under the joint action of high voltage and high frequency complex electric fields and the filter. The half time T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">H</sub> is reduced when they work together. But there is a obviously delay between the test value and the theoretical value of the half time. The error of experimental results is analyzed. Use exchange efficiency to modify the half time. The error is reduced by more than ten percent by comparison of unmodified model. The modification of the model is reasonable.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Exploration of an experimental teaching mode in innovating talents cultivating
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Study on NAIRC-PDM integrated system based on PDM
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Product data management system is one of the most important components of enterprise information construction. The concept and characteristics of product data management (PDM) has been introduced. In order to research the disadvantages of a company's data management system (NAIRC), NAIRC-PDM system based on PDM was been build on the traditional product data management system structure.

articleTitle: Analyses of chemical composition of PM10 and PM2.5 in Zhuankou Area of Wuhan
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Wuhan Economic & Technological Development Zone (WEDZ) is situated to Zhuankou area, Wuhan. Wuhan Economic & Technological Development Zone (WEDZ) is a national level development zone approved by the State Council of P.R.C. in April 1993. With nearly 20 years development history, WEDZ has grown into an important engine in economic development of Wuhan City. Meanwhile, atmospheric environment quality has become more and more worse, and paid on more and more attention. Quantification of the mass contribution of each pollution source is an effective management of atmospheric environment quality; great importance is attached to the identification of the sources of ambient particulates. In the study, the chemical compositional data of 5 chemical species measured at 2 sampling site were analyzed and presented for their monthly variations, compared to some large cities located in China, the concentration of atmospheric aerosols measured in WEDZ is relatively low. the monthly variation of particulate concentration (PM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</sub> and PM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2.5</sub>) is controlled by the weather conditions, i.e. the average wind pattern and rainfall in the campaign. The data has provided important information on particulate soluble ion profiles in WEDZ and revealed some useful trends.

articleTitle: The analysis of hydrochemical cause of karst
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: It is generally believed that the karst development, weak geotechnical property and rapid changes in hydrodynamic conditions of groundwater are the main factors to cause karst collapses, while we have insufficient understanding of the hydrochemical actions. Exploitation of groundwater has accelerated the process of partial water cycle, in addition that, water quality environment's changement such as water pollution and acid rain strengthen the corrosion of carbonates and eluviation of the soil, and cause to increase the salinity of the groundwater; The eluviation test using limestone and karst water of the karst collapses area as the material shows that increasing the water chemical composition and speeding up the water cycle both contribute to the dissolution of carbonate. Therefore we infer that it will be strength the eluviation of the soil, and it lead to soil become crisp due to "loss of "calcium and magnesium. The enhancement of corrosion of carbonates and eluviation of soil promote the emergence of karst land collapse.

articleTitle: The practical calculation solution and computer-aided design of beams in the engineering design
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper takes the design calculation of beams as the object of study, the theoretical design formulas of various forms of beams under different stressful condition are derived from the initial parameter method, and the design calculation is programmed into special software with the procedure form based on the obtained theoretical formulas to realize the computer-aided design of beams. Then through the specific design example, it is explained that this computer-aided design software can simplify the design process of components, the design result is more intuitive and clear, and thus the efficiency of the entire design process can be improved.

articleTitle: Application and evaluation on combination forecasting model based on information entropy and Shapley value
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The key problem of combination forecasting model is the weight of the single prediction methods. The values of the weights directly effect the accuracy of combination forecasting model. In this paper, taking agricultural machine total power in Heilongjiang province as original data, the three combination forecasting models were obtained through respectively using shapley value, information entropy and combining information entropy with shapley value to calculate weights of each single models. The combination forcasting model based on combining shapley value with information entropy after evaluation could get the highest prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: Determination and primary speciation analysis of metal elements in rhubarb roots by ICP-MS
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The metal elements in rhubarb roots were separated into soluble state and suspension state by 0.45 μm membrane filter based on traditional analytical flowchart program. The rhubarb roots at different producing areas and the decoction of rhubarb roots were pretreated by wet digestion, and then the metal elements were determined by ICP-MS analysis. The results indicate that there is obvious difference in the contents of metal elements between the different places. The dissolved rate of metal elements was low in the decoction of rhubarb, and the metal elements mainly existed in organic state with low water solubility. The determined metal elements mainly existed in soluble state, and their contents in soluble state are more than 50%. The determination and primary speciation analysis of the metal elements in rhubarb roots can provide useful information about bioavailability and pharmacological functions of rhubarb roots.

articleTitle: Dynamic analysis of cylindrical type ultrasonic motor based on Euler
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Circular wobbling motion of the stator head of a cylindrical type ultrasonic motor was simplified as revolution of a rigid body about a fixed point, by considering the motion and structural characteristics of the stator. The dynamic model of the stator was established by using the Euler angles and Euler dynamics theory. The complete dynamic model of the motor was derived on the basis of the integrated model of the stator and the rotor dynamics equations. The startup and shutdown dynamic response characteristics of the prototype motor with 30 mm of diameter were simulated utilizing the fourth order Runge-Kutta numerical method. Then the startup response characteristics of the prototype motor was experimented. The experimental measurement shows that the simulation results of the startup dynamic response characteristics were validated by the experimental results of the prototype motor.

articleTitle: Digital control system on bearingless permanent magnet synchronous motor
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper focus on the digital control system for bearingless permanent magnet rotor motors. The bearingless permanent magnet synchronous motor (BPMSM) is an innovational type of motor, as bearingless motors have all advantages of magnetic bearings, they play an important role in solving difficult problems of special electric drives in life science, chemical processing industry, semiconductor manufacturing industry, foodstuff processing industry, and so on. In the paper, based on the basic working principle of BPMSM, the mathematics models of the radial forces and rotation part on BPMSM are deduced by adopting rotor magnetic field oriented control (FOC) strategy. A digital vector control system according to the demand of decoupling is designed and presented using DSP technique. An experimental platform of digital control system is developed to meet the need, The experiment results have shown that the steady suspension of the rotor is realized and the speed of the rotor can be continuously adjusted within the range of 0-3000 r/min.

articleTitle: Vectorizaiton of lattice diagram based on straight line and circular arc fitting in variable-step
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Vectorization of the lattice diagram after contour segmentation is a critical techniqure to keep tufted carpet from destortion in the process of manipulator-tufting. A new algorithm is put forward to realize the vectorization, and keep the fitting error in an allowable range. The process of curve vectorization includes several steps: Form a feature point set by extracting the Freeman chain coding feature points from the pixel points of the image, then run straight line fitting and circular arc fitting in variable-step, and finally obtain the contour curve represented by linear and arc equations. The algorithm in this paper is mainly used for carpet image recognition and transfer in a manipulator-tufting system. Through VC++ programming of the algorithm and then repeated experiments, it is proved that the algorithm is effective, feasible and quick to especially satisfy the requirement of high efficiency.

articleTitle: On the quick construction of all edge-balance index sets of the graph Cn × P11
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper, we completely determine the edge-balance index sets of the graph C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</sub> × P<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sub> (n ≥ 3) and give constructive proof.

articleTitle: Variable forgetting factor recursive least square algorithm applied to multi-station passive location
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Study on the technology of direction finding (DF) and localization technology is of vital significance nowadays. For real target, the direction parameter becomes one of the most reliable radiation parameters. This paper proposed a new method of multi-station passive location, which is based on the variable forgetting factor recursive least square algorithm. First, establish the mathematical model of the algorithm for multi-station positioning; secondly, show the mathematical derivation of the algorithm and iteration formula; and then the implementation steps of the algorithm are proposed; finally the simulation comparison with least squares algorithm is discussed. The simulation results demonstrate that, when each measurement error meets with mean 0 and the same variance, this algorithm performs better no matter how the variances of measurement errors are chosen. Moreover, it is much more simplified compared to the least squares in the amount of calculation.

Author Keywords: variable forgetting factor recursive least squares

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Colour and urban landscape
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Appropriate technology of energy-saving for the rural residential in hot-summer and cold-winter area of China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Combined with the climatic characteristics of hot-summer and cold-winter area, describe the current requirements and energy saving in buildings of the rural residential in the hot-summer and cold-winter area of China. In the view of the appropriate energy-saving and insulation technology applied on walls, windows, roof and other parts of the building, and introduce the application of some relevant building energy-saving technology especially for the hot-summer and cold-winter area of China, in order to improve the performance of Energy Saving of the Rural Residential in the hot-summer and cold-winter area, reduce building energy consumption and improve the farmers' living condition.

Author Keywords: energy-saving and insulation of the rural residential

articleTitle: Natural gas pipeline leak detection based on data mining
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Using data mining's decision tree classification, DBSCN cluster analysis, and K-nearest neighbor algorithm realizes the information mining of natural gas pipeline leak, and alse uncovers the objective laws behind the natural gas pipeline transmission, intrinsically linking to the each parameter and development trend. We could reduce the risk of accidents and economic losses, in order to control the natural gas transmission in advance.

articleTitle: Mechanism study for magnetic levitation spherical reluctance driving joint to produce magnetic power and torque
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The multi-degree-of-freedom spherical driving joint with direct bearing driven by spherical motor owns high mechanical integrity and has many advantages such as control and trajectory planning. This paper presents a novel multi-degree-of-freedom spherical reluctance driving joint with magnetic levitation, and analyses operation mechanism, and next deduces the joint's magnetic conduction of the gap by means of the way to magnetic segmentation achieves the relationship between electrical and mechanical energy conversion, and then calculates the radial suspension force and the tangential suspension torque which spherical driving joint produces. The simulation experiments show that the system of driving joint has well static and dynamic characteristics.

articleTitle: A verifiable multi-secret sharing scheme based on LUC cryptosystem
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: A verifiable multi-secret sharing scheme based on LUC cryptosystem is proposed. Different from others's multi-secret sharing schemes, in the recovery phase of our scheme. only the secret that we need can be recovered, while the other secret is unknown completely. With analyzing, we find our scheme has many other secure characters, such as, perfectness, verifiablity, flexibility, optimal information ratio, low computational complexity.

articleTitle: The existence and uniqueness of adapted solutions of BSDE with non-Lipschitz coefficients
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper we shall propose a kind of non-Lipschitz assumption which is related to time variable t to the generator of backward stochastic differential equations (BSDE in short) and get the existence and uniqueness result for the adapted solution to BSDE.

articleTitle: Data model for product life cycle quality control mapping with product structure geometrical model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper focus on the technique of learning the knowledge on the design quality and manufacture quality. The characteristic of quality control are illustrated, such as status, process, structure etc, and a lot of feature of the quality control information which consist of geometrical structure model, manufacture technique, detect, fault diagnose and data analysis were presented. Then an approach of the mapping between the product quality control information to the components geometrical model is put out, which can be implemented to optimal the product design, manufacture and assembly in quality control. Finally a prototype system was designed based on the data model.

articleTitle: Research on workflow management system based on multi-agent
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Considering the problem of traditional workflow management system, this paper presents a workflow management system based on multi-agent, which applies the coordination and negotiation of multi-agent and the task distribution strategy based on contract net. So, it can not only contribute the communication of nested components, but also settle the conflict between the operations and the executors. Furthermore, it improves the efficiency and the applicability of the system.

articleTitle: Seismic performance levels and fortification objects of structure-equipment coupled system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: For the design of industry building, it is necessary to combine the equipment system with structure system into structure-equipment coupled system in some cases. It can accurately show the interaction between structure and equipment. According to the earthquake disaster phenomena of equipments, the failure modes and failure criteria are researched. The seismic performance levels and fortification objects of structure-equipment coupled system are presented. The failure criteria of structure-equipment coupled system are also analyzed. Finite element analysis on the direct air cooled condenser platform is done. According to the numerical calculation and the test data, the seismic performance objectives for the direct air cooled condenser platform structure-equipment coupled system are presented, which can be employed by the structural design.

articleTitle: Multipurpose fiber optic sensor for determination of temperature, density and refractive index
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)

authors.preferredName: V. V. S. S. S. Chakravarthy

abstract: Determination of density, refractive Index and temperature of liquids & solvents is of paramount importance in chemical and pharmaceutical industries. The degree of accuracy in determining the above will speak about the quality of the liquid or solvent, to a great extent. Conventional methods for the determination of the above involves the use of three different setups which is costly and time consuming. A method is proposed in our paper to determine the above three using optical fibers to very great accuracy of the order of sixth decimal place. The present setup is simple, cost effective and multipurpose for the determining all the above. With little effort the system can be used to measure the above parameters online either in chemical or pharmaceutical industry or both.

articleTitle: Efficient biosorptive removal of chromium(VI)
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
