publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper studies the axially compressed behavior of RC square columns strengthened by high performance ferrocement laminates (HPFL) through the monotonic loading comparison experiment of nine square columns. And on the basis of experimental research and theory analysis, the paper reveals the acting mechanism that the HPFL can improve or increase various performances of columns and establishes the calculation model and formulas of load-bearing capacity of RC square columns.

Author Keywords: calculation formulas of the load-bearing capacity

articleTitle: Application of Fe — Al — La composite oxide microsphere with CaO layer in treating wastewater containing high-concentration of fluorine
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: A kind of Fe - Al - La composite oxide microspheres coated with a delay water-soluble layer of CaO was prepared. It was used to treat wastewater containing high concentration of fluorine. When chemical precipitation, flocculation precipitation ended, the fluorine content in water was <;20 mg/L, the CaO layer of Fe - Al - La composite oxide microspheres is dissolved and Fe - Al - La oxide microspheres begin to adsorb fluorine. The amount of CaO added in industrial operation was as follows: C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">F</sub>: C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">Ca</sub> = 2.2:1.0 (mol ratio). Polymerized AlCl<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> wt 1.0%CaO, FeSO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> wt 1.0% CaO, MgO wt 1.0% CaO, a certain amount of PAM, 0.1% CaO, and Fe - Al - La composite oxide microspheres with CaO layer were mixed together and added into wastewater. After being stirred for 1.2h, the concentration of F was <; 8mg/L. this shows that this method is a new F-removal process having many advantages.

Author Keywords: Fe — Al — La composite oxide microspheres

articleTitle: A novel low thrust ripple 3-phase 6-slot permanent magnet linear synchronous motor
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper presents a novel constructive three-phase six-slotted permanent magnet linear synchronous motor (PMLSM) based on the approach of combinational iron-cored primary. In order to develop a small scale, large thrust and high thrust performance slotted PMLSM, a construct of separated three two-slotted armature iron-cores for each phase winding is proposed. The influence of couple between iron-cores on end-effect force is investigated in details. Optimal design of iron-core parameters is conducted and static thrust characteristics are extensively evaluated by finite-element method and harmonic analysis. Thrust ripple is reduced 4.85 times compared to a conventional 3-phase 6-slot PMLSM. The novel constriction can be applied to develop small-scale, large thrust and high control performance PMLSM, and extend slotted PMLSM application to small-scale automatic systems to replace slot-less PMLSM.

articleTitle: Instantaneous friction torque model for multi-cylinder engine
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Study on the friction torque of diesel engine is quite important to the transient fuel control. For the complexity of the system, there is no effective model the friction torque. After further study on the diesel engine, the friction torque is divided into several components and different model was built for each component. The model is used for multi-cylinder, four stroke engine. In order to prove the validity of the model, a multi-cylinder engine is used for the experiment. After measuring the output torque of the electromotor and the torque of the in-cylinder pressure, the average value of the friction torque is calculated. The model is proved to be validity from the experiment results.

articleTitle: Study on influencing factors of thermal performance of the flat-plate solar air collector
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: A 3-D numerical model of the flat-plate solar air collector was established. Five influencing factors of collector efficiency were selected and discussed. The Simulation program with orthogonal experiments was designed. With FLUENT simulation results, five factors that influence the collector efficiency are analyzed. Solar radiation intensity is a main factor that influences the collector efficiency. When the collector inlet air temperature is 283.15K, collector efficiency ranged from 64% to 80% with different working conditions designed by orthogonal experiment. Also, six to one of the best aspect ratio of the collector is verified.

articleTitle: Research on the intramural thermoelectric generator for lower speed fluid
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The thermoelectric conversion with lower Renault number (Re) fluid, such as waste heat from industry boiler, and engine's circled cooling water, which can be designed as intramural generator structure. In this research, a thermoelectric project analysis model and the description of an intensified system are presented, its generator with the aligned or staggered platoon structure has strengthened heat-transfer property, and the heat convection coefficient ratio has increased times than plain tube; For the fluid kinetic energy's loss is influenced by the whirlpool, the pressure difference is several hundred Pa level which changes along with geometric parameters of transform components; what's more, heat transfer area increase distinctly under the same generator volume, which has built the foundation for the enhancement output electric power.

articleTitle: Research on application of RFID technology in the automobile parts logistics
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper introduces RFID technology and the importance of applying RFID technology in the automobile parts logistics. It also discusses the composition of automobile parts logistics management and implementation. It indicates that although RFID technology is relatively high compared with the cost of bar code technology, but RFID technology will has a bright future in the automotive industry because of its big information capacity, high efficiency & security and good reusability.

articleTitle: Design and numerical simulation on guide vane of AP1000 Reactor coolant pump
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Accorded to the way used in design radial diffuser of centrifugal pump, tree different guide vanes of AP1000 nuclear coolant pump were designed. Base on ANSYS-CFX the numerical investigation of internal flow in three different guide vanes was made, which gave the distribution of velocity and static pressure. Through 8 different flow conditions, performance curves of 3 different guide vanes and impeller were obtained. The results can provide some references to the design of guide vane of AP1000 Reactor coolant pump.

articleTitle: Effect of double line viaduct noise barrier height on aerodynamic characteristics of high speed train
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Viaducts are widely built in the modern high speed railway system. The noise barrier will have some effect on the aerodynamic characteristics of the high speed train running on the double line viaduct. It is essential that the research on this effect will be made. It will provide some engineering reference for the high speed railway construction. Using the CFD(Computational Fluid Dynamics) soft Fluent, the effect of double line viaduct noise barrier height on the aerodynamic characteristic of the high speed train has been researched. When the high speed train runs on the windward, the aerodynamic forces and moments acting on the train are analyzed. The simulation results show that the aerodynamic forces and moments on the high speed train have some discipline with the changing of the noise barrier height. The side force coefficient decreases gradually in the head train, middle train and the rear train with the height increase of the noise barrier. The rolling moment of the head train reaches the maximum among the whole train and decreases gradually with the increase of the noise barrier height.

articleTitle: An identification method of stiffness of mechanical joint
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: A method based on finite element model is presented that is used to identify stiffness of mechanical joint. By means of shock excitation, response of the system is obtained in which joints are included. Fourier Transform is used to obtained response spectrum of system. Based on FEM, the system model including joints is build and then low order natural frequencies are obtained by modal analysis. Natural frequencies of finite element model are compared with resonance frequencies from response spectrum, data of joint stiffness in finite element model are modified. Through iterative computations, suitable data of joint stiffness are identified. Experiment result shows that the method is valid.

articleTitle: Study on damping of air spring with additional chamber
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: A mechanical model of the air spring with an additional chamber was built with considering the temperature influence. The static and dynamic external characteristics of the air spring were also studied by comparing the results of the simulation with the experiment. The research shows the larger the additional volume is, the smaller the spring stiffness, the air spring inherent damping will tend to be a stable value as the effective area of the connecting block increases to a certain extent, the system damping of the air spring will follow the outside exciting frequency when it rises.

articleTitle: Solitary wave solutions for the (2+1)-dimensional Broer-Kau-Kupershmidt equation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this work, the (2+1)-dimensional Broer-Kau-Kupershmidt equation is investigated. The extended tanh method is efficiently used for analytic study of this equation. New kink or anti-kink wave solutions and solitary wave solutions are formally derived. The proposed schemes are reliable and manageable.

articleTitle: Interference and energy aware topology control
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Topology control in wireless sensor networks has been well studied, and a huge amount of algorithms for topology construction have been proposed. Among those algorithms, only a few methods take interference into account. In this paper, with minimizing energy consumption and communication interference in mind, we present a Minimum Spanning Tree (MST) based algorithm, which has following properties: (1) only localized information is needed for topology construction; (2) both energy consumption and interference are minimized simultaneously; (3) connectivity of the network is almost preserved. We also show by simulation that the above design goals are all fulfilled.

articleTitle: A study on the model of mobile medical application in 3G network
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: With the rapid development of 3G (third generation) network and more powerful functions of intelligent terminals(such as mobile phone, PDA), operators have gradually expanded their businesses from the business applications and mobile internet to other industries. This paper proposes a model for mobile medical service of intelligent terminals based on 3G network. The design and implementation of the model are carried out at the same time. The model implements the integration of medical services and 3G network, and works as a new medical approach with traditional medical treatment mode and hospital management mode. Accordingly, it can improve the work efficiency of medical personnel and resource utilization and save the users' medical costs, allowing users enjoying more convenient and efficient medical services at any time and any place.

articleTitle: Magnetic field analysis of bearingless permanent magnet motor
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: As bearingless motors have all advantages of magnetic bearings; they play an important role in solving difficult problems of special electric drives. The simplest and most versatile form of bearingless motor is the bearingless slice rotor motor. This kind of motor with centrifugal pump has a wide range of applications in life science, chemical processing industry, semiconductor manufacturing industry, foodstuff processing industry, and so on. This paper presents the analysis of the operational principle, basic equations is given for a bearingless permanent magnet slice electromotor first. Then a modeling of a bearingless permanent magnet slice electromotor is built using Maxwell 3D of ANSOFT finite element software. Finally, the magnetic field and the torque force are analyzed for the two different structures of P<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">B</inf>=P<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">M</inf>±1. According to the analytic results, the structure of P<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">B</inf>=P<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">M</inf>+1 is more steady. In addition; its control is easier to get in the actual implementation and application.

articleTitle: Research on preparation and properties of environment-friendly solvent-free black material for masking existing road traffic markings
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In order to reduce pavement damage during the course of eliminating existing road traffic markings, an environment-friendly black material for masking existing road traffic marking is prepared. This material is composed of two components, the main agent without solvent and curing agent. Firstly, the film forming substance of the main agent is prepared by polyurethane/epoxy resin IPN composite. Secondly, the main agent is composed of the film forming substance, black pigment, filler and additives. Through wear resistance test, pull-off test, compression test, compression-shear test, luminance factor test, chromaticity coordinates test and skid resistance test, and so on, comprehensive properties of the material are systematically researched. The results show that wear resistance, heat resistance, weathering resistance, anti-cracking performance at low temperature, chromaticity performance, compression-shear strength and antiskid ability of this material are excellent under the optimum formula, and that the material also has the characteristics of rapid construction (30 minutes after construction open to traffic) in low temperature (-10t), which makes this material especially suitable for masking existing road traffic marking in cold regions.

articleTitle: Research and VLSI implementation on de-blocking method for MPEG
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: MPEG is one of the popular standards in image compression. Blocking is the most annoying artifact of encoding/decoding process. In this paper a post-processing deblocking algorithm for MPEG video stream is proposed. This method is based on the correlation of local pixels in block boundary region. It takes two 4×4 adjacent small blocks on both sides of a block boundary as a local processing region. Then the region is classified into smooth and gradual-change region, brightness step-change region, and texture region. The finally step is to eliminate blocking artifacts adaptively according to the classification. Compared with algorithm in, the proposed method offers a better result in de-blocking while preserving image details. Our design is implemented on FPGA and 0.13 μm CMOS technology.

articleTitle: Refitting design of miniature biogas generating system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Biogas is a kind of rich resource and cheap renewable biomass energy and wildly used in rural and remote mountain area in China. Based on methane gas combustion characteristic, the model of miniature gasoline generator refitted was selected. A kind of miniature gasoline generator was refitted by increasing the compression ratio, regulating the ignition advance angle, selecting and designing precipitator, desulfurization device, gas pressure stabilizer and mixer unit etc., to form a complete set of miniature biogas generator systems. This paper analyzed the biogas composition and the combustion characteristics of biogas, and described the methods of increasing the compression ratio and regulating the ignition advance angle, and the analysis and computation processes of designing gas pressure stabilizer and mixer. The miniature biogas generator designed and refitted can start normally and operate stably, and all the performance indexes accord with dynamo requirements, generating power can satisfy a household daily electricity demand.

articleTitle: Research on new automobile power hydraulic braking system by vibratory energy
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: A new automobile power hydraulic braking system by vibratory energy is introduced which includes four vibration dampers, four energy accumulators, hydraulic booster, one storage tank, four wheel cylinders, four electromagnetic one-way valves, brake master cylinder, vacuum booster, brake pedal and loading sensing pressure proportioning valve(LSPV). Vibration damper is composed of nitrogen cavity, piston, piston rod, shell, rebound valve, compression valve, inlet tube, outlet tube and so on. Energy accumulator contains relief valve and oil return tube. The electromagnetic one-way valves are controlled by brake pedal. Hydraulic booster is composed of piston, pushrod, inlet valve, oil return valve and so on. The oil is circulated between storage tank, energy accumulator, vibration dampers and hydraulic components. Oil from storage tank enters into vibration dampers by compression valve when the suspension is compressed and leaves by rebound valve when stretched. When the oil is flowing between compression valve and rebound valve, frictional heat is produced which depletes vibratory energy and damps the vibration. The pressurized oil flows into energy accumulator and then enters into hydraulic booster and wheel cylinders. Power generated by hydraulic booster and applied loads on brake pedal by driver is applied to piton of master cylinder and pressurize the oil. Pressurized oil from master cylinder and energy accumulator enters into wheel cylinders help them to fulfill their function. Vibratory energy is converted to output power of hydraulic component. The oil returns storage tank after braking is finished. The braking system can recycle some vibratory energy and convert to hydraulic energy which is used for automobile power braking system. It can reduce brake pedal force, lower fatigue of drive, shorten retardation time of braking, and enhance safety of braking.

articleTitle: Study on earth pressure with even load on arbitrary position behind retaining wall
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Based on the limit equilibrium theory and the Mohr-Coulomb criterion, considering the condition of static equilibrium when the slide wedge was in limit equilibrium, the even load on the arbitrary position behind the retaining wall is researched. The factor exerts an influence to earth pressure. Furthermore, formulas have been derived for the calculation of active earth pressure on cohesive and non-cohesive backfill soils. Numerical example is modeled about active earth pressure on retaining wall, and the results describe that the value of solutions is basically identical with those of theoretical and analytical results. These indicate that the study is valuable for practical applications.

articleTitle: An alternative method on dynamic analysis of food mastication based on discrete element method
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The consumption of food inside mouth involves various oral operations, such as first bite, chewing and mastication, transportation, bolus formation, swallowing, etc, which are essential procedures not only for the consumption and digestion of food, but also for the appreciation and pleasure of food texture and flavors. Despite continuous efforts made by scientists from food, psychology, physiology, dental and clinical studies, and other scopes, exact mechanisms and governing principles of these oral operations are still not fully understood. Recent progresses and literature findings about the techniques to study food processing and transformation in mouth are reviewed. Previous hardware and software techniques to study the relationships between food properties, mastication process are incapable of analyzing food breaking, blending, transforming behaviors in mouth. A software solution to investigate food mastication by discrete element method (DEM) is put forward in this article. Based on discussion of the application statues of DEM, the feasibility and advantages of DEM to study food mastication process are analyzed, and the key techniques involved are presented.

articleTitle: The choic of design for pneumatic overspeed control mechanism of a horizontal axis wind turbine
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper, the pneumatic overspeed control mechanism of 300 W wind turbine was design. This paper analyses the operation principle of overspeed control mechanism, and chooses rudder yaw mode, and gives the accurate formulae of back-position-torque of tale vane. This paper points out that the balance-torque of tail vane comes form its aerodynamic force generated by the angle between wind direction and tail vane. Finally the design method of the mechanism is given in this paper.

articleTitle: Separation of high-purity natural phytol from byproduct of silkworm excrement extract by molecular distillation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Natural phytol which is a flavor of natural food can be also used in the synthesis of medicine like vitamin K1, health products, functional foods and cosmetics, etc. In this study, preparation of high-purity natural phytol from byproduct of silkworm excrement processing was carried out by using secondary molecular distillation process. Natural phytol of 98 percent purity and above was observed as a result of process conditions optimization.

articleTitle: A study of novel ZVZCS PWM Buck converter
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: It is difficult to improve power capacity and switch frequency of the conventional switching power system because of so many drawbacks resulting from the hard switching state of power switches such as the losses and the diode reverse recovery problem and so on. In this paper, a novel ZVZCS (Zero Voltage Zero Current Switching) PWM (Pulse Width Modulation) Buck converter is proposed. A detailed analysis of the operation principle and MATLAB 7.0 simulation results show that both the main switch and the main diode are turned on and off under ZVZCS simultaneously, the auxiliary switch is turned on and off under Zero Current Switching (ZCS), and the soft chopper is suitable for application working in high frequency and high power situation.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of gas-particle two phase flow in Aluminum-oxide ceramics powder spraying process
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The quality of spraying is influenced by the gas velocity and particle velocity in the cold spraying process. A physical model for supersonic gas-particle two phase flow in cold spraying process is established. Numerical simulation for inlet and outlet flow field of Laval nozzle is carried out. The effects of throat diameter, spraying pressure, temperature and particle size on the gas velocity and particle velocity are investigated. The simulation results show that the gas velocity and particle velocity increase with the increment of spraying pressure and temperature, and the smaller throat diameter, the better gas acceleration in the nozzle, while the particle velocity increases when particle diameter decreases.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of elastic wave based on the staggered grid finite difference method
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The numerical simulation of elastic waves by the staggered grid finite difference method is researched to improve the simulation precision and efficiency, in addition, to decrease the numerical dispersion and spurious wave. Based on the velocity-stress staggered grid technique, we designed a two dimensional finite difference program with the accuracy of 0(Δ t<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> + Δ x<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup>). More stable condition and an artificial transmitting boundary condition are applied in the program. With the program, the modeling of wave propagation in a layered model is carried out, and reasonable results are derived. Subsequently, an ultrasonic experiment of a concrete slab is conducted, and then a comparative analysis of the first arrivals of numerical simulation by staggered grid finite difference and finite element method, measurement and ray tracing is carried on. The results indicate that the travel times of the simulation by staggered grid finite difference method are in accord with that by finite element method, and closer to the measured data than those derived from ray tracing. This verifies the reliability and the anomaly recognition ability of the wave fields by the staggered grid finite difference method.

articleTitle: The technology study of a new kind of pulse width modulation mode for eliminating torque ripple
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Permanent Magnet Brushless DC motor(BLDCM) has the advantages such high torque current ration, high ratating speed, good dynamic performance, reliable and easy to control, so it has extensive and important use in military and civilian. But BLDCM has the disadvantage of large torque tipple, it is necessary to eliminate torque ripple. The paper analyzes the mechanism generating torque ripples for current commutation, introducing five of the pulse width modulation (PWM) mode and infers that torque ripples being generated by the current commutation is the smallest in the PWM-ON modulation mode. The paper proposes a new PWM mode based on the basis. Being different from the traditional PWM modulation, the new PWM-ON-PWM modulation mode can significantly reduce the torque ripple. At the same time, the paper carries out modeling and simulation based on Matlab/Simulink, and the simulation results verify that the theoretical analysis is correct, and has a very high value for study.

articleTitle: Nonlinear cloud model control for ship steering based on genetic algorithms
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: A cloud model controller for ship steering is developed with nonlinear behavior and uncertain problems of ship motion. The fast Elitist non-dominating sorting genetic algorithm II (NSGA-II) is employed to optimize the parameters of the controller. Analysis and simulation results show the design of the cloud model controller based on multi-objective optimization of genetic algorithm is effective and the controller has good control performance and strong robustness.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Hydro-generator units operating condition forecasting and fault diagnosis based on GANN
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Research on the strategy to eliminate unexpected shifts of at on heavy vehicles
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Unexpected shift often occurs in the working of an automatic transmission. This paper analyzes the causes of this phenomenon and its influences on the heavy-duty vehicles' AT. The method of setting a reasonable shift delay interval and realtime detection on torque converter speed ration is proposed to solve this problem. The shift control strategy to eliminate unexpected shifts is designed and validated by simulation.

articleTitle: Stability analysis of surrounding rock of unlined highway tunnel in Chongqing
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Taking the Daxihe unlined tunnel located at Fuling-to-Pengshui section of 319 federal highway partly in Three Gorges Reservoir Region as project background and choosing its typical sections, numerical analysis for the stability of surrounding rock, based on coupled fluid-solid theorem, was done with Fast Lagrangian Analysis of Continua in three-dimension(FLAC3D). Meanwhile, effects of multiple factors such as unsymmetrical pressure, rock mass weathering degree, change of groundwater tables etc on the stability of surrounding rock were studied when considering fluid-solid coupled effect, resulting in obtainment of principal stresses, placements, plastic zones and pore water pressure distribution of the unlined tunnel under a variety of conditions during its open for trial service. The achieved results are expected to be applied successfully to guidance of the unlined tunnel disease treatment. Furthermore, the study results can also provide a theoretical basis for the disease management of similar tunnels containing water-rich strata.

articleTitle: New image de-noising method using Curvelet transform
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The image de-noising method via USFFT Curvelet transform is proposed in this paper. The method can preserve the detail information of high frequency of noisy image, and to avoid the phenomenon of edge slant during the image reconstruction. The USFFT Curvelet transform is used to the noisy image, the global threshold value is estimated in the Curvelet domain. The window technique is used to compute the shrinkage factor corresponding to pixel value. The de-noised image signal is obtained by using inverse USFFT Curvelet transform. The experimental results show that the algorithm obtains a higher PSNR value for gray and color images. It acquires a good de-noisy effect and visual effect, and preserves image edge well.

articleTitle: Influence of vehicle weight on CST shear fracture and blunt edge roundness
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: CST is a new kind of vehicle passive safety device. In order to study the difference of CST for different weight vehicles, UG, VPG, LS-DYNA would be used to simulate and calculate, and it showed that influence of vehicle weight on CST shear fracture and blunt edge roundness is very great, this could provide a strong foundation for the study of CST on different vehicles, and also has great reference value to the vehicle safety study.

articleTitle: A visual compensation method for binocular vision deficiency
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: A visual auxiliary method for compensating binocular vision deficiency, which has problems in identifying stereoscopic presentations, is proposed in this paper to reduce the inconvenience in the daily life. To solve this defect problem, a stereo information compensation algorithm, combining the image matching, triangulation algebra, and the image segmentation algorithms, is adopted to append the distance information into a single view image to achieve this purpose. Experimental results show that through the compensation process, users with binocular vision deficiency are capable of acquiring the relative distances and depth information of 3D objects in real space and can further define their perceptions of the world around them to avoid collision dangers.

articleTitle: Design of control system for the gypsum hollow block
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Gypsum hollow block is an important new material, which has a broad development prospect and promising. It can not meet the market demands because the technical and other reasons of the domestic enterprises, which restrict the development of the gypsum hollow block production. Therefore, the development and design of the gypsum hollow block production equipment have great significance. In this paper, the control system of the gypsum hollow block production equipment is introduced. The motors in the system are controlled by PLC and inverter, which can make the system operate smoothly. The production process such as ferruling, core-pulling, casting and molding can be controlled automatically according to the signal of the sensors, which can improve the productivity and reduce the operating costs. The system is also equipped with remote monitoring to realize the soft control. Experiments show that this control system has high reliability and stability.

articleTitle: Reliability simulation analysis for complex mechanism based on support vector machine
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In order to deal with the issues of implicit limit state function and high computational cost in the mechanism reliability analysis, the methodology for predicting the failure probability of mechanism by combining simulation technology and support vector machine (SVM) based reliability analysis is introduced. Then, two strategies of mechanism reliability analysis using support vector machine are proposed, and the different sample methods are adopted for the corresponding strategy. According to the two proposed strategies, an integrated platform combining with the commercial software for mechanism reliability simulation analysis is developed. Finally, a lock mechanism is utilized to illustrate the feasibility and efficiency of the proposed methods. The obtained results show that the computational costs of the proposed methods are much less than the computational costs of Monte Carlo Simulation (MCS). Therefore, the proposed methods might be efficient and valuable for the reliability analysis of complex mechanism.

articleTitle: Thermosolutal convection in annular enclosure with partially conductive outer-cylinder
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This study discussed the thermo-solutal natural convection phenomenon caused by temperature gradient and concentration gradient in a closed container in a geometric shape of double-cylinder through experimental method. The effect of local heat conduction of the outer-cylinder on the flow field in the double-cylinder closed container can be observed in the experiment based on the design of the geometric shape and boundary conditions. This experimental model is designed as one sixth of outer-cylinder and inner cylinder made of copper, and one and two thirds of outer-cylinder made of acrylate. The flow field pattern in a closed area is discussed according to relevant dimensionless parameters. The experimental work fluid is copper sulfate solution (CuSO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>+H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>+ H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O) at a concentration of 0.05M. The temperature gradient is maintained by two constant temperature water tanks at different temperatures, and the concentration gradient is set up by electrochemical system. The limiting current is applied to both ends of outer cylinder and inner cylinder to make them electrodes to result in concentration gradient. The flow field in the double-cylinder closed container is observed by using shadowgraph, and photographed as record for analysis. In order to determine the structure of flow field, the temperature and concentration distributions in the flow field are measured. Finally, the relations between the mass transfer rate Sh value and Gr<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">m</sub>, Gr<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">t</sub> are analyzed.

articleTitle: Research on KPCA fault diagnosis method based on multi-domain features
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: To gain reliable sensitive feature information and increase the completeness of fault information, kernel principal component analysis (KPCA) fault diagnosis method based on multi-domain features is proposed. The basic theory of KPCA is introduced, and signal pre-processing is given, multi-domain feature vector is extracted from time, time-frequency and frequency domain, faults are diagnosed with KPCA method. The new KPCA fault diagnosis method based on multi-domain features is tested on axial piston pump, the result shows that the method is effective, and studying multi-domain feature vector plays an important role in fault diagnosis system.

articleTitle: Spatial solitons of trapped atomic Bose-Einstein condensate
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: We present two families analytical solutions to the extended Gross-Pitaevskii equation (GPE), which describe the dynamics of bright and dark solitons in Bose-Einstein condensations(BECs) with varying coefficients of two and three-body interactions in a parabolic and complex potential. The properties of the dynamical evolutions of the bright and dark matter-wave solitons are investigated. It is interesting that the matter-wave can be controlled by applying the external magnetic field and a background.

articleTitle: Process scheme evaluating of TRB stamping panels based on FBQ
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Tailor rolled blank applied in panels is one of efficient approaches for automobile realizing lightweight, yet the stamping process schemes evaluating is the keypoint. Aimming at the uncertain problem of scheme decision-making for the evaluating parameters are equal or close, the actualized measure based on theory of fuzzy barycenter quadrature was presented to evaluate TRB process schemes, this ensured the complete veracity and reliability of taxis and evaluating result. Finally, the specific panel was illustrated the implementing steps, the result shows that TRB process scheme based on FBQ is more reasonable and practical.

articleTitle: A low cost low quiescent dissipation DC-DC converter for wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper proposes a compact DC-DC buck converter with low output power and very low quiescent current dissipation for use in an ultra-capacitor based wireless sensor networks (WSNs) nodes. This converter is controlled by a self-oscillation topology in order to achieve less silicon area and lower quiescent dissipation than the conventional designs. The work is implemented in the standard 0.35um CMOS process with a die size of 0.05mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and the total quiescent current is only 80uA. Simulation results show that at 1.2V output for 50mA load, the power supply regulation ratio is 1.3%. And the load regulation ratio is 1.2% within the whole load range.

articleTitle: Research and application of intermediate cooling control scheme for plate rolling
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Intermediate cooling control scheme of a medium plate plant is introduced. It consists of two-level computer control system. Process level realizes the function of model specification and self-learning, and basic level fulfills the task of plate head and tail tracking, roll table control and spray flow control. As a result of adopting multi purpose interrrupted cooling technology, the scheme can reduce holding time of intermediate billet, increase rolling rhythm and production capacity, and guarantees uniform grain size of plate.

articleTitle: Evaluation of water resources carrying capacity based on fuzzy recognition in the Tarim River
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Based on the data of nature, society, economics and water resources of Tarim River in 2005, we evaluate the water resources carrying capacity for the river by means of the fuzzy recognition. The results show that the comprehensive grade is 2 for Bazhou, Aksu and Kashi area, where the current water exploitation and use has reached a relative high degree, and there is only a very limited water carrying capacity, while the comprehensive grade is 1 in the Kizilsu and Hotan area, where water resources carrying capacity is much higher. As a whole, the comprehensive grade of Tarim river basin is 2 and the current water exploitation and utilization has reached a relative high degree. it is urgent to adopt some fundamental measures to promote the water carrying capacity.

articleTitle: Simulaition and optimization of organic working fluids bicirculating screw expander system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Organic working fluids bicirculating screw expander system is simulated by simulated program. The simulation results show that there is a peak output when dryness fraction of inlet working fluid being in a low range, and the optimal dryness fraction of inlet working is 0.1 to 0.2. The generated output difference between different working fluid is significant, and pentane is the optimal working fluid of bicirculating screw expander system.

articleTitle: Approximation of a kind of Kantorovich type q-Szász operators
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper, we introduce a modification of Kantorovich type q-Szász operators based on the concept of q-integral, we establish a local approximation theorem and discuss the weighted approximation theorem.

articleTitle: The study on the performance of Cu-Mn-O catalysts for the NO reduction by C3H8: About environmental clean technology
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Cu-Mn-O catalysts were prepared by co-precipitation and hydrothermal method at the different calcination temperature. These catalysts were characterized by BET, XRD, SEM and the catalytic activity for the reduction of NO by propane was evaluated. XRD results showed that Cu<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1.5</sub>Mn<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1.5</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> was the main phase in all these samples. The NO conversion over the catalysts prepared by hydrothermal method was markedly higher than that by co-precipitation method. SEM analysis revealed that the grain size of the obtained catalysts by hydrothermal method was smaller.

articleTitle: Optimization gateway discovery mechanisms for hybrid ad hoc networks
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The overall performance of hybrid ad hoc networks, which is the integration of ad hoc networks and fixed IP networks like the Internet is affected heavily by the discovery and selection of Internet gateways. Each of existing proposals is suited only for a limited range of network conditions and its performance can vary dramatically as the network conditions change. The obvious unidirectional links and the rebroadcasting of gateway discovery packets blindly during ad hoc nodes discovery available Internet gateway also degraded the Internet connectivity. In this paper, an internetworking algorithm with adaptive mechanisms has been proposed to enhance Internet connectivity for mobile ad hoc networks. Firstly, through exchanging hello packets which are identical to the AODV hello packets except for the additional symmetric neighbor list and asymmetric neighbor list fields, unidirectional links are removed from route computations and redundant or even harmful rebroadcasting of the broadcast packets are inhibited simultaneously in the procedure of gateway discovery. Secondly, based on the dynamic adjustment of the scope of the gateway advertisement packets and the intervals of sending hello packets according to the network conditions change, a lot of unnecessary overhead was reduced. Performance results using ns-2 simulations, under varying number of unidirectional links and node speeds, show that this adaptive Internet connectivity scheme can provide better performance than others due to its adaptive mechanisms, avoiding unidirectional links as well as relieving broadcast storm, and is a step closer to making the large-scale deployment of mobile ad hoc networks a reality.

articleTitle: Research on teacher education model constructed by virtual learning community based on video cases
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Developing high quality education has been as a basic state policy, and teacher education is also been placed on the key and prior position to carry out in many countries. Conducting effective teacher education becomes a main way to improve the level of teachers' specialization and classroom teaching quality. The development of modern information technology perfects the construction of web-based teacher learning community. And the application of video cases opens a new way for teachers' professional development. It's for this reason that in this paper we construct a new teacher education model, which constructed by a virtual learning community based on a teacher training platform on the internet. In the learning community, teachers as members carry out learning activities based on video cases learning. The learning activity mainly is discussion which combines leading by experts and peer coaching. This new teacher education model is also integrates teacher training with school-based research organically. It supports teacher education and promotes the development of regional teachers' specialization by way of sharing high quality teaching resources and scarce expert resources on the internet.

articleTitle: Fault diagnosis of 40TM liquid-gas hammer based on BP algorithm: Artificial Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The basic principle of Artificial Neural Networks and BP algorithm was introduced in this paper. The application of BP algorithm Artificial Neural Networks in fault diagnosis of 40TM liquid-gas hammer was studied. The superiority of BP algorithm Artificial Neural Networks in fault diagnosis was proved by the MATLAB simulation and the training. The causes of faults were determined by BP algorithm Artificial Neural Networks.

articleTitle: Research on adsorption mechanism and regeneration of organic modified montmorillonite
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The adsorption of thiophene from thiophene-octane mixture has been investigated using organic-montmorillonite under proper conditions. The adsorbents were prepared by a xerogel process, followed by thermo - treatment. The adsorptive experiments show that C-P-MMT adsorbent has the higher capacity, 3.8mg/g (mg of sulfur per g of adsorbent). BET, XRD, NMR were used to characterize the adsorbents. It was found that a new spinel-phase was formed during thermal treatment, and the layer spacing of C-P-MMT absorbent was larger than that of Na-MMT. The organic montmorillonite prepared by PTMAB and CTMAB has lower crystallinity and surface area but larger pore diameter than it was prepared only by PTMAB. The XRD and NMR results also showed that the structure of the adsorbents has not changed after adsorption, suggesting that the prepared adsorbents could be easily regenerated.

articleTitle: Unbiased estimation of parameters of linear continuous model based on bias correction with input/output measurement noises
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper, a algorithm, which is about unbiased parameters estimation of the model of linear continuous system with noise, was put forward. Using modulation function, through the digital modulating integral to the continuous-time model, an equivalent discrete identification model which is parameterized with continuous time model parameters is developed. Then based on this, parameters identification was conducted by the new biased correction method proposed in this paper, which introduced a new vector mainly by parameter of the transfer function, simultaneously producing a new regression vector. The special structure of this new parameter vector makes the deviation calculation with noise can eventually result in unbiased parameter estimation through the biased correction method. The simulation with a real example shows this method has certain advantages.

articleTitle: Simulative study of the control of vehicle suspension system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: LQG and LQI control theory were used to control the suspension system of the vehicle. We analyzed the characters of the system through simulation, and found that, with the LQI control algorithm, ride comfort and dynamic deflection can be improved simultaneously at the natural frequency of the weight on the spring. While with the LQG control algorithm cannot bring about that. But with LQG control, both of the two characters can be improved at the in-band. While the ride comfort of the suspension was improved at the low-frequency band, the dynamic deflection would increase.

articleTitle: A single port dipole for UHF RFID tag antennas with eliminated read-orientation sensitivity
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper, a passive UHF RFID tag antenna of planar circular-loop single port dipole is designed. The alteration of external circular-loop geometrical parameters can eliminate the read-orientation sensitivity of the tag antenna with ease. An inductively coupled feed method was adopted to facilitate impedance matching of the proposed antenna. The measured results are in good agreement with the simulated ones. It showed that the tag possesses the normalized gain deviation of less than 2.5 dB in E and H planes at the frequency of 915 MHz. The measured maximum reading range between the tag and the reader falls in 2.4 m ~ 2.9 m, depending on the rotation angle of the tag in 902 MHz ~ 928 MHz.

articleTitle: The unsteady heat transfer test of the surrounding rock
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The heat transfer between airway and airflow is an unsteady problem. Three experimental schemes (1, Variable wind temperature, the temperature of air flow are 15°C, 20°C, 25°C, 30°C; 2, Variable speed, wind speed are 1m/s, 2m/s, 3m/s; 3, Periodic wind temperature, 15°C~25°C and 20°C~30°C) are used to simulate the actual heat transfer process between airway and airflow. Test results show that it exists obvious unstable heat transfer characteristics; the temperature of airway is stable in the last. And the temperature increased with the decreasing difference in temperature between air flow and surrounding rock; and the time required to reach a steady was reduced; with the increase of airflow speed, the stable temperature of the soil was lower and the time required to reach a steady was reduced; when airflow temperature periodic changes, the heat transfer in the soil has obvious "lag" effect. The entire heat transfer process can be divided into severe heat section, excessive heat segment and stable heat section.

articleTitle: Mechanical property improvement on the door protection steel pipe by filling aluminum based porous metal
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper describes by powder metallurgy route method to make the Ø50mm precursor billets and then to be extruded became to small plate-type precursor (5mm×20mm) billets through extrusion machine, and put into the hallow steel pipe heated metal foaming in furnace, At the steel pipe added Al-foam, Under its total weight slightly increase of the condition, raise or improvement mechanical performance of the door protection steel pipe by the energy absorption.

articleTitle: Research of data mining in electronic commerce
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Electronic commerce and data mining are being payed maximum attention. Apply data mining to electronic commerce become a hot issue among businesses. This paper introduces the concepts and classifications of the Web mining. It takes the mining form Web logs as an ensample to discusses the methods and process of Web mining. At last, it presents its applications in Electronic commerce.

articleTitle: Analysis of Beijing rural domestic sewage treatment system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In recent years, Beijing rural sewage treatment systems are constantly emerging as the construction of new socialist countryside, and play a crucial part in water pollution control. Beijing rural domestic sewage treatment system at the present stage was analyzed in detail, suggestions of its development trend was put forward, and actual problems in establishment and operational management of rural sewage treatment facilities were deeply analyzed, at last provide a reference for the future construction of Beijing rural sewage treatment system.

articleTitle: Practical method for adjusting power flow unsolvable cases based on grid electric transportation properties
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper presents a power flow adjustment method for unsolvable power flow equation. The proposed method is based on the line transfer limit and system PV, QV and Pδ curve. New slop indexes are defined to describe the characteristics of the system infeasible critical point. Using the indexes can find the system weak line when system power flow is on the solution boundary. Paper also discussed the relationship between the line transfer limit and system static stability. The method is tested on EPRI36 nods system and Hunan system.

articleTitle: HIS and DWT based remote sensing image fusion and its application on road extraction
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper, an ideal proposed that improving the accuracy of the road information by enhancing the quality of image source. Apply the image information fusion algorithm that based on HIS transform and wavelet transform to the multi-spectral remote sensing images and QuickBird panchromatic remote sensing images fusion, the experimental results show that the quality of image source is substantially improved, and this ideal inaugurate a method for extract road information by the use of satellite remote sensing images accurately.

articleTitle: Numerical analysis on strengthen mechanism of GFP-SN slope based on FLAC
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Glass Fiber Polymer-Soil Nailing (GFP-SN), a new type of soil nailing, has being applied in slope support engineering, because it has good performance in many aspects. According to the reinforcement project of GFP-SN in Jiufeng Wuhan, FLAC3D three-dimensional calculation model was built and used to compute and reveal the stress and strain variation of the slope support, results showed that the maximal horizontal displacement of the reinforced slope appeared over a certain range in slope bottom, the largest settlement lied at the top of the slope; the force of GFP-SN was distributed along the length of the soil nails, but it wasn't evenly distributed, large in the middle and small at both extremes. The slope is supported by GFP-SN to achieve good support effect, and it is worth studying further.

articleTitle: The effect of the initial water of lignite on its liquefaction reactivity
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper, the effect of different initial water content of lignite on its direct liquefaction reactivity was studied. The results show that: initial water content in lignite can be used as hydrogen supplier and promote direct liquefaction reaction inducing higher total conversion rate, higher oil yield and lower pre-asphaltene / asphaltene yield, when the water content of lignite is of 20 ~ 30%. And the maximum of total conversion rate and oil yield is achieved 85.12% and 51.72%, respectively, when the water content of lignite is 25.33%. While the gas product yield and the pre-asphaltene /asphaltene yield is relatively lower, which is of 11.16% and 3.93%, respectively. This can be of practical significance to optimize the coal pre-treatment technology of direct liquefaction industry.

articleTitle: Study on the Wastewater Treatment and Nitrogen removal by anoxic/aerobic membrane bioreactor
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: A/O-MBR was conducted to treat simulated sewage and domestic sewage in this paper, and degradation of pollutants in reactor was studied at the same time. The results showed that the process had excellent removal efficiency of pollutants, under the conditions of C/N was 8:1~10:1, MLSS was 5~9g/L, HRT of part A was 3.93h, HRT of part O was 5.5h, DO of part A was 0~0.5mg/L, DO of part O was 1~3mg/L. The average removal rates of COD<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">cr</sub>, NH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>-N, TN and turbidity was 95.4%, 96.91%, 93.9% and 98.74%, respectively, when simulated sewage was treated. The average removal rates of COD<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">cr</sub>, NH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>-N, TN was 96%, 95.89%, 92.14%, respectively, when domestic sewage was treated. The pollutant removal of A/O-MBR mainly depended on high microbial concentration kept by the membrane; and suitable technology of membrane fouling control ensured that the MBR reactor could be in normal operation.

articleTitle: Temperature field numerical simulation and analysis of TP2 copper strip during hot rolling
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Hot rolling cogging can make full use of the high temperature plasticity of alloy, and it can provide large volumes of heavy strip. Besides, it has the characteristics of small deformation resistance and high productivity. Therefore more than 90 percent of copper and copper alloy strip in the world are produced by using hot rolling cogging. The paper presents details of simulation and analysis of 3500×980×200 specification copper strip hot rolling process. With the aid of the technology of finite element simulation, particular attention is paid to predict the temperature distribution and temperature history in each lane during the rolling process.

articleTitle: Multi-channel technology based animated interaction in E-paper device
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: E-paper device has good performance in embedded mobile reading field benefits from many merits. This kind of display material is applicable for protracted reading and brings comfortable reading experience. This display screen technology has given birth to numerous innovative mobile application, such as E-book, E-newspaper, E-board etc. However, in human-computer interaction aspect, E-paper is still kept in a primitive level for the slow refreshment speed, Animated transition can show the process of interaction and give people timely feedback. It's good for improving user's interactive experience. This paper presented a novel and effective interaction method based on touch screen in E-paper device. Based on multi-channel technology of E-paper display controller, modeling paper bending and page selection animation are designed. The proposed interaction method achieved the benefits of timely response. The experiment and evaluation indicated that the proposed interaction method is more convenient and works better than common method.

articleTitle: Hardware design of embedded fingerprint identification system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In the modern age, people enjoy the advantages coming from the information technology. At the same time, all kinds of problems of information security appear. Those methods which are used to identify someone's status according to his marker or knowledge have been limited. Thereby, some new techniques based on biological characteristics, especially the fingerprint identification, have been developed quickly.

articleTitle: Research on algorithms for constrained optimization problems
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: A Culture Heuristic Evolutionary Programming (CHEP) method is proposed in this paper. Method CHEP evolves both on the culture space and the population space. When this method is used to slove constrained optimization problems, the constraints are described as knowledge in belief space, and guide to search in population space. Test shows the validity and universality of method CHEP for solving constrained optimization problems.

articleTitle: Aerodynamic and structural dynamics analysis of swept transonic compressor rotors
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The application of sweep on rotor blades is one of the most significant technological evolution to improve the aerodynamic behavior of transonic compressor stages. New transonic swept rotors are modeled from the original Rotor 37, by changing the meridional curvature of the original stacking line through four control points (located at 20%, 40%, 60% and 80% of span). All the new swept transonic rotors are simulated on design and two off-design conditions of original Rotor 37. But the original tip leading point, tip trailing point, hub leading point and hub trailing point are not changed. A systematic investigation to understand the impact of axially swept blades on the aerodynamic behavior of transonic axial-flow compressor rotors is undertaken. Then, the static, dynamic natural frequencies and mode shapes of Rotor 37 and new swept transonic compressor rotors are calculated. By using CFX Pressure load, the static structural analysis is carried out with rotational load to understand the stress levels of swept models at design and two-off design speeds. At the last, the harmonic response behavior of Rotor 37 and swept models are calculated.

articleTitle: TIPO: A heuristic algorithm for delay constrained power optimization
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper, we present TIPO, a heuristic algorithm for timing constrained power optimization. The algorithm utilizes Dynamic Programming-like (DP_like) search method with consistency iteration and a fast gradient-based multiplier selection method that provides an effective set of Lagrange multipliers. Compared to the previous subgradient method provided by DP_like approach, TIPO is considerably faster and does not have the inefficiencies due to difficulties to determine initial vector of multipliers and the step size for updating multipliers. We compared the two algorithms on ISCAS85 benchmarks. On average TIPO is 54 times faster than the previously published algorithm and can reach tight delay constraint which cannot be reached by DP_like approach.

articleTitle: The dynamic behavior of information dissemination mechanism in the Internet of things
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: On the complex networks formed by the Internet of things of network nodes, information transmission between network nodes is the subject of things in a new research direction. This paper focuses on the complex network of information dissemination mechanism, through the use of the Internet routing table information simulation model of the internet of things network topology. By analysis transmission of the virus according to biological mechanisms and transmission dynamics of small world network, it's indicates that information dissemination in accordance with the node degree distribution is optimal efficiency.

articleTitle: A cooperated supervision and management commission for low-carbon society in Wuhan city circle
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Wuhan city circle is a nationwide pilot experimental area of resource-saving and environment-friendly society. It's essential to setting up working mechanism for controlling greenhouse-gases emission. The purpose of this work is to analyze what kind of mechanism we should establish in Wuhan city circle. This paper is focus on the establishment of a cooperated supervision and management mechanism for carbon emission, on the basis of openness, transparency, capacity building and bottom-up design, all in the context of sustainable development. This theory is then applied to the Wuhan City Circle and a framework of the Carbon Emission Management Commission is structured. It is concluded that a quality system and a huge network of all sectors of society is more require and significant at the large urban agglomeration region. Then we present a detailed analysis of three kinds of information platform between institution of Carbon emission supervision, between government, enterprise and public, between each city of Wuhan city circle. In this work, an attempt will be made to initiate such research as well as to identify the areas which will require further detailed study. We expect that this method could take an active part in the development of low-carbon society.

articleTitle: The front bearing design of the high-pressure rotor of a gas turbine
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The front bearing of the high-pressure rotor of a gas turbine is a high-speed bearing, according to the work of the bearing, the bearing structure was designed. On the basis of determining design variables, a multi-objective optimization function was established, constrainted design variables appropriately and obtained the optimal design result by solving the function. Based on the optimization result, the values of the bearing performance parameters were calculated, and showed that the bearing optimized can satisfy the design requirements and the actual working condition.

articleTitle: Handling stability analysis of traffic vehicle at high velocity on the bend surface
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper builds an automobile dynamic model, which analyzed typical traffic accidents while it is turning on the basis, as occurred on the bend surface at a high velocity. The paper analyzes the main factors which may have effect on the handling stability of vehicles, including vehicles turning characteristics, critical speed, tire pressure, tire mixed installation, center of gravity of the automobile, mass of automobile and shaft distance etc. In the end the paper proposes driving capability and the safety measures that can keep stability of a turning vehicle and avoid accidents.

articleTitle: Optimal coherent integration time design of 3rd-order digital carrier tracking loop for weak signals in GNSS receivers
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Conventional thermal noise phase jitter formula of GNSS receivers' digital phase-locked loop (DPLL) for carrier recovery, which implies that the phase jitter monotonously decreases with the coherent integration time (CIT), can not be used for high-sensitivity DPLL design effectively. Variance comparison between I · Q phase detector (PD) which is normalized by the total power and two-quadrant arctangent PD indicates that the I · Q PD performs better than the other when used for tracking weak signals. The new thermal noise phase jitter formula for 3<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">rd</sup>-order carrier DPLL is derived based on the newly developed linear loop model. Analytical results show that there exists an optimal CIT for minimizing thermal noise phase jitter. Finally, the optimal CIT of 3<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">rd</sup>-order carrier DPLL is given by numerical method, which can be used for high-sensitivity digital carrier tracking loop design directly.

articleTitle: The electric power clamping device driven by stepmotor and screw-togge-lever force amplifier in series
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Hydraulic clamping device is widely used in modern manufacturing. But, the energy efficiency of a hydraulic clamping device is lower and the environmental pollution is serious. We introduce a new type of electrical power clamping device in this paper. Its working principle is, by using the screw-toggle-lever three-step series force-amplifier, the rotary motion of the stepmotor is changed into linear motion of the clamping component. Using the self-locking performance of sliding screw mechanism, we can always maintain the clamping force acting on the workpiece during manufacturing process. This clamping device has the following advantages: (1) very compact in structure, (2) saves energy and protects environment against pollution.

articleTitle: Setting reasonable housing price based on fuzzy math
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper is based on data analysis and literatures, land use system, demographic factors, and economic development situation, fiscal and financial policies which have influence on the price of the house are studied. In order to discuss housing price purely on the basis of statistical data, the main factors and their weights are calculated based on the survey of house price and usage of grey theory. Creating a fuzzy optimization system of house price by the factors, the reasonable price can be figured out so the polity of the house price can be proposed. In addition, the thesis make an analysis of the factors of house price including price polity, economic development, regional factors, demographic factors and so on, then make an analysis of these factors based on the house price using grey theory, Using the fuzzy math, the thesis predicts the house price by creating the closeness function. Each region as far as the four coefficients of real estate investment, per capita income, population density, the annual loan interest rate are known, the reasonable house price can be figured out.

articleTitle: Research on the mechanism of the load schedule and the I/O schedule of Intelligent Network Disk Storage System
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: With the rapidly increasing demand of the mass information storage in Internet, the intelligent network storage technology be coming more and more important. At the same time, the traditional storage system exists some problems in the architecture, the performance and the scalable, etc. thus, this paper first presented a novel Intelligent Network Disk Storage System (INDSS) architecture, and then introduced the software structure and the mechanism of load schedule and I/O schedule in INDSS, Finally, also give the corresponding algorithms.

articleTitle: Dynamics study in high-speed running of central pin assembly of the dynamics stability vehicles
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Combined with finite element software ABAQUS/Standard, the dynamic response of center pin assembly system on high-speed running is analyzed, which using interaction nonlinear numerical method. The result reveals that with the increase of running speed, contacting force increase and on the other hand, maximum stress, maximum strain and maximum displacement all decrease. This paper provided theoretical basis for improving and perfecting of the center pin assembly system and lay theoretical foundation for the further research of the dynamic stability vehicles.

articleTitle: The effects of temperature-dependent specific heats of the working fluid on the performance of a Dual cycle with heat loss and friction
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The purpose of this study is to analyze the effects of variable specific heats of working fluid on the performance of a Dual engine with considerations of heat transfer and friction by using finite-time thermodynamics. The results show that the power output as well as the efficiency where maximum power output occurs will increase with increasing the amount of heat added to the engine due to combustion or with decreasing the quantity of heat loss through the cylinder wall. The temperature-dependent specific heats of working fluid have a significant influence on the performance. The power output and the working range of the cycle increase with the increase of specific heats of working fluid, while, the efficiency decreases with the increase of specific heats of working fluid. Furthermore, the power output and efficiency of the cycle decrease with increasing the parameter b related to the friction loss. It is noteworthy that the effects of heat transfer with considerations of variable specific heats of working fluid and friction loss on the performance of a Dual engine are significant and should be considered in practice cycle analysis.

articleTitle: Thermodynamic model study of micro-turbine with MATLAB/Simulink
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The governing equations of micro-turbine components were built on the basis of thermodynamic analysis with MATLAB/Simulink. Combining with the experimental data of micro-turbine, the sample from the manufacture and previous researches on the variable condition characteristics of gas turbine, a high computational efficiency micro-turbine thermodynamic model was developed, which is applicable for energy consumption analysis. A CCHP (Combined Cooling Heating & Power) demonstration project in Shanghai was modified for measurements.
