A CAT (Computer Aided Testing) system was built for real-time data acquisition of micro-turbine under the summer and winter operation conditions. The measured key performance parameter results of micro-turbine were obtained and compared with experimental results. The results show a good agreement, thus, the validity of the thermodynamic model of micro-turbine.

articleTitle: The design and implementation of Media Distribution System in 3Tnet VOD
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: According to the characteristics of 3Tnet VOD, we propose a design and implementation of Media Distribution System for streaming media, which utilizes the bandwidth of 3Tnet and improves the media distribution speed, while also providing a more scalable distribution scheme. Simulation results show that the proposed scheme could not only support VOD service on the 3Tnet in a scalable way, but also reduce the hardware cost of the network and server load.

articleTitle: Loss of hydropower caused by upstream water diversion: A case study of Pingshang water diversion project in Shanxi, China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: For water diversion projects, both the economic benefits from solving water shortage for water supply area and the effects on economy and environment for water source site should be highly valued. This paper analyzes the influence of diversion volume and selection of water source sites on the loss of cascade and parallel hydropower plants downstream and presents an optimization diversion scheme for the minimum energy loss based on the minimum ecological base flow of the water source site and the downstream river via a case study of Pingshang water diversion project in Shanxi province, China. The results show that energy output increases greatly with river runoff increase and energy loss cuts down as the volume of upstream diversion reduces. When water source site of diversion projects lies in the upstream parallel plants, optimal allocation of diversion volume depends mainly on distribution of the downstream power stations, the total installed capacity of cascade hydropower stations and the individual kinetic energy characteristics. The optimization diversion scheme of the project studied based on the minimum ecological base flow could cut down 13.7% of energy loss compared with the scheme that water diverted symmetrically from two parallel rivers.

articleTitle: On oscillation of solutions of even oder neutral equations with distributed deviating arguments
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper, A class of even order neutral equation with distributed deviating arguments is studied and new oscillation criteria are obtained. Our results are sharper than those known in the literature.

articleTitle: The effects of a green roof on rainwater runoff
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: To quantify the effects of a green roof on rainwater runoff physical experiments will be carried on. In the research, physical model which include rainfall generate, testing platform, observation system is established various confirmation of rainfall intensity and slope are examined. A major finding are that, a green roof has benefits of reducing flood peak, flood volume, delaying the beginning time of flood and extending the duration of flood peak. It has revealed the potential of green roof as an effective new tool for stormwater management in the unban areas.

articleTitle: Heat transfer of counter flow in porous medium
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The steady heat transfer of fluid counter flow through porous medium is studied by using thermal non-equilibrium method, the energy equation of the porous frame solved by fluidizing the porous frame method. First the correctness of simulation is validated by satisfying the energy conservation law. Then the temperature profiles of fluid and porous frame are discussed. At last the effects of porosity, particle diameter and fluid superficial velocity to the heat transfer intensity and energy efficiency are compared.

articleTitle: The design of simulation platform of satellite data transmission
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper provide a simulation platform of satellite data transmission, including mathematical model and operating platform. The platform can simulate all kinds of link losses in satellite-to-ground transmission, such as free space loss, ionospheric loss, tropospheric loss and so on.

articleTitle: The thermal self-defocusing effects and limiting properties of methyl red doped PMMA film
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The nonlinear optical properties of methyl red (MR) doped PMMA film are measured. The self-diffraction of the film at 441.6nm and at 535nm is investigated respectively, and the results indicate it possesses high quality of optical limiting. The lasers of 441.6nm and 535nm can all induce thermal self-defocusing effects in the film.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation research on reasonable range of grouting reinforcement for soft soil tunnel
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The subway tunnel's unstable settlement caused by long-term operation brings an unfavorable influence on the stability of tunnel. Therefore, researches on dynamic response analysis of tunnel foundation and reasonable range of grouting reinforcement are important to the safe operation of subway. Based on the vehicle dynamic load conditions during operation of subway, the tunnel dynamic stability analysis model of shield tunnel was established, and the numerical simulation was used to carry on the dynamic stability calculations of tunnel underlying soil which consist of silty clay. The calculation results showed that, when the tunnel depth was determined, the amplitude and frequency of dynamic load had some influence on the stability of tunnel underlying soil. The effect of dynamic load amplitude was more remarkable. The final settlement of tunnel reduced with the increase of tunnel depth and diameter of tunnel lining, the final settlement increased with the increase of the amplitude and frequency of dynamic load. The dynamic response range of tunnel underlying soil was mainly related to amplitude of dynamic load and tunnel depth. Through numerical simulation, the empirical formula of influence range was obtained by regression analysis, and it was useful to determine the reasonable range of grouting reinforcement.

articleTitle: Fault line selection based on improved grey relation analysis of zero-sequence transient current in small current grounding system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Analysis of the existing methods for fault line selection and the characteristics of zero-sequence transient current in small current grounding system, a novel fault line selection method based on grey relation analysis is proposed. The difference between fault line and normal lines is distinguished by the relation degree of the zero-sequence transient current of fault line and normal lines'. Besides, an improved algorithm is proposed to enlarge the difference. The simulation results using PSCAD show that the method proposed can be applied to any distribution system with different grounding patterns and has large difference between fault line and normal lines. So the method has high accuracy and high ability of anti-disturbance.

articleTitle: A shift and scale invariant estimator for index of extreme value distribution
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In many fields in the world of finance and insurance extreme events tend to occur more frequently than one would expect under classical statistical assumptions. The random mechanisms generating these events are called heavy tailed, indicating that the underlying probability distributions have tails that decay essentially as power functions. In the analysis of such heavy tailed data and in the estimation of extreme quantiles and tail probabilities the extreme value index plays a decisive role. In this paper, we are interested in overviews of the main methods on tail index estimation and outline a shift and scale invariant estimator, which is much simpler to use in practice. We next proceed to an asymptotic comparison of these estimators at their optimal levels. An illustration of the finite sample behavior of the estimators is provided through representative procedures.

Author Keywords: a shift and scale invariant estimator

articleTitle: Estimating the range of marine radar with bending angles from GPS occultations
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Vertical atmospheric refractivity profiles could be used to estimate the range of marine radar. However, inversing vertical atmospheric refractivity profiles with GPS occultations was a hard work. A way was put forward in the article to estimate the range of marine radar with bending angles from GPS occultations. This way could save the hard work and eliminate errors from the hard work.

articleTitle: An inquiry into the effects of incorporating WebQuest in an EFL college course
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This study describes a task-based English learning project based on the framework of WebQuest. A questionnaire was administered to collect students' perspectives on this activity. The results show students indicated positive responses to this web-based inquiry project. They improved their reading ability and viewed the task in the WebQuest as a meaningful tool for language learning. This study then makes suggestions for future researchers interested in researching this topic.

articleTitle: Effect of HIP temperature on the microstructure and properties of Be-Al alloys
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The effect of HIP-temperature on the tensile properties and fracture mechanism of a powder metallurgical (PM) Be-Al alloy based alloy has been investigated in this study. Prealloyed, the PM Be-Al alloy are fabricated with the HIP temperature of 700°C and 900°C. The tensile tests and scanning electric microscopy (SEM) in situ fatigue observations of Be-Al alloy have been conducted. The results of present study indicate that the alloy HIP'ed at 700°C exhibited higher ultimate tensile strength and lower ductility than that of the alloy HIP'ed at 900°C under tension loading. Fatigue tests showed that the former has higher fatigue strength and fatigue resistance than the latter. All fatigue fracture surface observed by SEM are characterized by the faceted crystallographic cleavage planes in Be phases surrounded by shear or tear-induced ductile fracture of Al phases. Characteristic fatigue striations in Be grain interior of the alloy HIP'ed at 700°C can be seen while the alloy HIP'ed at 900°C has many interlaced strips along the interfaces between Be and Al phase.

articleTitle: Distribution of trace elements in sediments from rivers around the northern Taihu Lake and evaluation of the contamination level
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: There exist the interaction between lake and ambient rivers. This study focuses on the total and bioavailable concentrations of trace elements in river sediments around the northern Taihu Lake. We can recognize the characteristics of trace elements in different sites by comparing the west, north and the east rivers and evaluate the contamination level of sediment. The concentrations of TP and TN in west rivers were higher than those in other rivers. The concentrations of trace elements were highest in sediments from the north rivers. The concentrations of NH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>-N were higher significantly than NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>-N, denoting the effect of domestic sewage. Sediments of the north rivers showed the elevated bioavailable fractions of Cu, Zn, Pb, indicating input of industrial wastewater. Correlation analyses manifest that there are good correlations between TOC and trace metals, weak correlations between Al<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> and trace metals. No correlation exhibits between CaO, Fe<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> and trace metals. Geoaccumulation index was employed to evaluate the contamination levels of sediment. Zinc shows the moderate contaminated grade, Cu and Mn reveal the slight contaminated grade. The other metals are the uncontaminated level. The west rivers contribute more nutrients to Taihu Lake, and the north rivers contribute more trace metals to Taihu Lake by comparison of trace elements in sediments from the west, north and east regions. Sediments of the east rivers show the low contaminated level.

articleTitle: Experimental study on effect of magnetic fields on heat transfer performance of nanofluid heat pipe
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Solar water heater are manufactured throughout the world and considered an appropriate technology at present for it is a simple, economic and environmental friendly technology. The heat transfer coefficient of the heat pipe plays an interval role on the efficient of making use of solar energy. This experimental research focuses on the heat transfer performance of heat pipes by introduce the magnetic fields and Nanofluid. The experimental results show that: without magnetic field, the heat transfer rate of the heat pipe with magnetic fluid is 13.9% higher than that of traditional heat pipe; under DC magnetic field, the heat transfer rate of magnetic fluid heat pipe is improved an average of 10.6%, and that of water heat pipe is improve 6% The outcomes have proved that the heat transfer performance can be enhanced by the magnetic field and magnetic fluid. The improvement of efficiency of solar energy usage would contribute to decreasing the environment limit on application of the solar heater in a wide range.

articleTitle: The numerical analysis of the highline system considering the influence of the inclined angle
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: A three-degree-of-freedom nonlinear dynamic model of highline system for underway replenishment at sea was investigated, which considered the influence of the inclined angle. The cases with lumped mass swing are numerical analysed by Mathematica program, which considered one to two internal resonance and dominate external resonance. The result showed that the oscillation amplitude of the highline system would decrease with the inclined angle decreasing.

articleTitle: Multi-scale decomposition for remote sensing image processing
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Based on image gradients, an alternative image multi-scale decomposition approach for remote sensing image processing is derived through solving a Poisson equation in this paper. First, the image gradients are obtained. Second, the gradients with given magnitudes are attenuated using some operators. Finally, the modified gradients are used to solve a Poisson equation to obtain the smooth base layer and thus the detail layer. This multi-scale decomposition approach is used for remote sensing image enhancement and remote sensing image smoothing, which outperforms the other methods such as bilateral filter (BLF) and weighted least squares based multi-scale decomposition (WLSMD) in edge-preserving image decomposition via experiments.

articleTitle: Entropy weight fuzzy synthetic evaluation-based risk evaluation for real estate agent construction project
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Effective risk management is essential to the success of real estate projects. However, in fact most of statistics emerging in the process of risk management are either ambiguous or unquantifiable, which makes it very hard to fathom. Fuzzy mathematics, to the contrary, is superior and feasible in the way to enable assessment by means of expressive variables. This article constructs a risk index system for real estate enterprise's construction project by means of Delphi method, and then quantifies and analyzes the risk factors by the method of entropy weight fuzzy synthetic evaluation. The case study demonstrates that the fuzzy synthetic evaluation model is practical for estate enterprise's agent construction project prior to the investment and during the contract negotiation.

articleTitle: Research on change detection based on wavelet transformation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Based on comparative analysis of precision and direction selection characteristic of image frequency feature in the course of wavelet transform, combined with important influence factors of sub-space estimation during independent component analysis - decomposing of image block, the author puts forward two schemes on change detection of remote sensing image by use of wavelet transform, and analyzes application scope and realization difference deeply, and interprets improves results of image change detection by use of two schemes on the basis of theory. Simulation results show that application scope in second scheme is broader than that in first scheme because of parallel algorithm and robustness for massive remote sensing images.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of gasoline generator throttle intelligent controller
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper focuses on the design of a intelligent throttle controller for a portable gasoline generator. Fuzzy control technique is imposed in the controller design. When the load is lighter, the control target is the frequency of the generator. With the load increasing, the control strategy is switched from frequency control to voltage control in an appropriate moment. The experiment shows the good control performance whether with the resistive or inductive loads.

articleTitle: The research on underground space development and utilization trend of site museum buildings
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The protection of cultural relic site is an essence in modern society. Due to the immovability of the relic museum site, any attempt to exhibit the site will require the underground space to be dug out and recovered to its original appearance. Based on the characteristic of relic museum architecture, by case analyzing of domestic and foreign typical museums, the author explained and suggested the advantage and running pattern of underground space exploration of such relic museum sites.

articleTitle: Nonlinear dynamic model and governing equations of low speed and high load planetary gear train with respect to friction
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: A torsional-lateral nonlinear dynamic model for planetary gear train system is developed considering surface friction, gear mesh stiffness and synthesis mesh errors. The originally derived governing equations are very hard to solve for which are characterized by semi-definition, time-variation and nonlinearity. The appropriate coordinate transformation is selected, and a unified equation of analysis model of non-linear and dimensionless is established.

articleTitle: Design of an indoor positioning and tracking algorithm for wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Today, positioning techniques like GPS already has satisfied performance in outdoor environment, but there are many problems in indoor positioning, and some conventional methods for indoor positioning also have their disadvantage. In order to overcome these problems and find a better performance over these methods, we proposed a new positioning and tracking method. It is based on the wireless sensor networks deployed in an area, and uses the path loss model. In positioning we estimate the distance of each sensor to the target, then form the circular equation and finely use the last sensor to get the estimated coordinate of the target. Besides, we modified the simple method for distance estimation to overcome the influence brought by environment. In tracking we combine the location of former and latter time index to smooth the path. In the end, we've done many simulations and proved that our method performs better while comparing with the location fingerprinting method. Because of the low computational complexity, high accuracy and the applicability to different environment, it can be used in many practical applications.

articleTitle: Influence factor study on relative horizontal displacement of underground rock powerhouse under earthquake
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The influence of depth attenuation, in-suit stress field, damping ratio, elastic modulus, peak acceleration, and frequency spectrum of input earthquake on the relative horizontal displacement of some underground rock powerhouse is analyzed by FLAC<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3D</sup>. It is shown that the in-suit stress field and elastic modulus are of small influence on the relative horizontal displacement. The maximum relative horizontal displacement will decrease steadily with damping ratio, and increase linearly with peak acceleration. The frequency spectrum is of great influence on the displacement. If the dominant frequency of input earthquake approaches the natural frequency of underground caverns, the maximum relative horizontal displacement will increase markedly. The study results could be used as a primary guidance to the anti-earthquake design for underground caverns.

articleTitle: Control of air-dense medium density based on fuzzy control
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The air dense medium fluidized bed concentration is a new method in the separation field. It is widely used because of its vast scope of application. The key part of the air dense medium fluidized bed concentration is the selection of the dense medium. The density of the fluidized bed varies in the separation process. This influences the separation effect. This paper firstly introduces the principal and importance of the density of the dense medium in the producing process of preparation plant, secondly, a fuzzy controller is designed with the density of the dense medium as the control target. At last, the study is done on the basis of different inference methods.

articleTitle: Investigation of the transform domain code division multiple access
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper, the transform domain code division multiple access (TDCDMA) is proposed, which synthesizes the excellence of the transform domain communication system (TDCS) and the code division multiple access (CDMA) technology. The TDCDMA has the characteristic of low probability of intercept (LPI) and the capability of multiple access (MA), and it's great potential to be applied in the cognitive radio (CR) contexts. Compared with the traditional TDCS and CDMA, the complex RAKE receiver is avoided in TDCDMA. The transceiver block diagram and the signal model of TDCDMA are given, and it's performance is investigated, discussed and simulated in Additive White Gaussian Noise (AWGN) and multi-path fading channels. Computer simulation results show that the TDCDMA is much more superior than the traditional TDCS and can be a promising transmission scheme in CR contexts.

articleTitle: Optimum design of Articulated Dump Truck's final drive based on Adaptive simulated annealing algorithm
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The structure and size of Articulated Dump Truck's final drive greatly impacted on the car's dynamic and economic performance. With the objective function of the smallest volume for final drive, to meet conditions with the contact strength, bending strength and boundary constraint, it built the articulated dump truck's final drive optimum design mathematical model. To use Adaptive simulated annealing algorithm as optimization strategy and the articulated dump truck final drive as an example. The results showed that the method could obtain optimal solution of the structure, effectively reduce the dimensions of the final drive, and proved the correctness and feasibility of the method. It has important theoretical and practical engineering significance.

articleTitle: Research on exterior noise source dentification of high speed trains
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In order to clear about the major source, distribution and frequency characteristics of high speed trains exterior noise in operation, using the advanced noise identification and measure system of multi-channel microphone spoke array, the field tests of high-speed train noise were carried out. The results show that the major noise sources of high speed trains are wheel/rail rolling noise and the pantograph noise. Their center frequency band is 500Hz-1000Hz. The biggest noise acoustic pressure level of the head car is 73.0dB. Its main center frequencies are 500Hz and 630Hz. The sound production frequency band is 500Hz-1000Hz. The mid vehicle has no pantograph, of which the biggest noise acoustic pressure level is 77.0dB. Its major center frequencies are 1000Hz, 1250Hz and 1600Hz. The sound production frequency band is 630Hz-1600Hz. The pantograph car own three noise sources that are wheel/rail rolling noise, the pantograph noise and the aerodynamic noise induced by the foundation of pantograph. Among these noise sources, the pantograph noise is the most important, of which the biggest noise acoustic pressure level is 84.0dB. Its principal center frequency is 800Hz. The sound production frequency band is 500Hz-800Hz.

articleTitle: A pilot study on biological nitrogen removal in a frequent anoxic-aerobic alternation sequencing batch reactor
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The present study focused on investigation of biological nitrogen removal efficiency and the superiority of continuous feeding sequencing batch reactor system with a frequent anoxic-aerobic alternation strategy. The result indicated that continuous feeding SBR achieved an excellent efficiency for pollutants removal. The removal efficiency of COD and NH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>-N reached above 90% and 91.4% respectively which was not significantly affected by A/O alternating frequency. Removal efficiency of TN was positively related to A/O alternating frequency, the average TN removal efficiencies reached 71.5%, 82.4% and 87.2% respectively with the alternating frequency changed from 5 to 15 and 30, the 5-5min agitation-aeration mode was the best one for nitrogen removal. Moreover, continuous feeding SBR was proved to be better in domestic wastewater treatment compared with instantaneous feeding SBR, and this superiority was more significant with a 5-5min agitation/ aeration operation strategy.

articleTitle: Enumeration of Eulerian planar near-quadrangulations
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: A map is called Eulerian if all the valencies of its vertices are even. If a map has all but one of its faces quadragles, then it is called a near-quadrangulation. Up until now, there is no research work on Eulerian planar near-quadrangulations. The main result in this paper is to establish a form of functional equation satisfied by enufunction of rooted Eulerian planar near-quadrangulations with the valency of the root-face and the number of non-rooted faces as parameters.

articleTitle: Energy entropy efficient ad hoc routing algoritham
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: A Mobile Ad Hoc Network (MANET) is a dynamic wireless network that can be formed without the need for any pre-existing infrastructure in which each node can act as a router. Wireless mobile ad hoc stations have limited battery capacity, hence, ad hoc routing protocols ought to be energy conservative. Energy aware routing protocols are consistently cited as efficient solutions for ad hoc and sensor networks routing and data management. However, there is not a consistent approach to define the energy related cost metrics that are used to guide the routing protocol performance. In this paper, we provide an analysis and critical review of energy entropy metrics, it present an Energy Entropy on EECA (EE-EECA) multipath routing protocol. The key idea of the protocol is to find the minimal node residual energy of each route in the process of selecting path by descending node residual energy. It can balance individual nodes battery power utilization and hence prolong the entire networks lifetime. Simulation results show that the proposed EE-EECA routing protocol performed better than EECA.

articleTitle: DLA simulation with sticking probability for viscous fingering
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The morphological evolution of viscous fingering, which occurred in two-dimensional Hele-Shaw cells with various displaced fluids, were simulated using a modified diffusion-limited aggregation (DLA) model on off-lattices. Different from other DLA models, the present model introduced three adjusted parameters. They control the morphological evolution of DLA clusters from a skeletal pattern to a fleshy pattern, so that experimental viscous fingering occurred in a Hele-Shaw cell can be simulated with various shapes. The fractal dimension of fractal clusters can be calculated simultaneously. The present algorithm was used to simulate the experiments of glue and glycerol displaced by water respectively in a Hele-Shaw cell. The present simulation and experiment are in good agreement. In addition, the calculation results of fractal dimensions for viscous fingering indicated that the great viscosity of displaced fluid responds to high fractal dimension for same driving fluid. The present computer model can simulate different viscous fingerings for various experimental conditions and provides a new investigation site for fluid dynamic behaviors of viscous fingering.

articleTitle: Errors resulting from calibration distance
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In the system of calibrating radiometer with calibration targets, the calibration distance has an effect on calibration accuracy. Results indicate that the effect calibration distance on brightness temperature received by radiometer, and obtain uncertainty introduced by small movement of calibration distance.

articleTitle: Information support for strategic spatial planning
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Urban spatial development is driven by economic, social political, environmental forces. In the meantime, strategic spatial planning becomes more holistic in scope, more strategic and scenario-oriented in content and more interactive and collaborative in nature. In this article, the features and evolving view of strategic spatial planning is described and the application of information support system is identified. Based on the complex system idea, the future-oriented planning approaches are presented. Chinese strategic spatial planning is discussed and it is presented that the application of PSS in plan-making is just at the initiate stage.

articleTitle: Based on the simulation for ideal injection rate and study for its influence
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Ideal injection rate has greater influence on improve diesel combustion process and its performance. In order to realize the ideal boot-type injection rate, the paper founds mathematics model for the diesel injection system electric controlled injector, The application of MATLAB/SIMULINK software had simulation study and be got desired the desired ideal boots-type fuel injection rate. Meanwhile, analysis the injector main structure parameters on the fuel injection law influence, the effects of some important structural parameters of injector are analyzed. Results show that the main parameters of maximum plunger lift and speed, needle pre-lift, control piston diameter, boot-type valve fluid-release area and outside diameter has influence on the injection rate. The results for diesel injection system research and design provide the reference.

articleTitle: High frequency modeling of electric control unit
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Electrical control unit has been widely in all kinds of electrical systems. If it is interfered by external noises, it will affect the stable of whole system. In order to simulate the ECU, the impedance of ECU be measured by using Impedance Analyzer. The frequency domain impedances/admittances are fitted by Vector Fitting Method to approximate rational function. Based on the impedance synthesis theory, the equivalent circuits can be obtained. Then pspice/Spice model can be used to simulate the ECU. The simulation and experimental results have been given and compared. The results demonstrated the validity of method.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Planning method for large scale waste transfer station location of Xuzhou urban area
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: A new equivalent method of permanent magnets and analytical solution of air-gap magnetic field of permanent magnet linear synchronous motors
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: It is difficult to obtain an analytical solution of magnetic field of permanent magnet linear synchronous motors due to longitudinal opening of its primary iron-core. This paper presents a new equivalent method of permanent magnets for analytical of magnetic field. Firstly, the physical model of the motor is proposed under a series assumptions based on features of the motor. Through analysis of characteristics of magnetic materials and the equivalent current method of permanent magnets, the paper proposes that the magnet array is treated as independent field source at the analytical region boundary, and derivates its mathematic form of equivalent boundary condition of permanent magnets. By this equivalent method, the Poisson equation of describing magnetic field is simplified into the second order homogeneous partial differential equation and can be easily solved. Finally, analytical of air-gap magnetic field is conducted and the analytical solution is conveniently obtained. By comparing with other research works, the correctness of the analytical result is confirmed. The proposed method could be further applied to explore analytical of magnetic fields for different regions of permanent magnet linear synchronous motors.

articleTitle: A crosscut tree routing scheme for preemptive distributed address assignment mechanism
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: ZigBee is the emerging industrial standard for wireless sensor networks. Preemptive Distributed Address Assignment (PDAA) Mechanism improves ZigBee address assignment algorithm, and PDAA Mechanism presents an autorouting protocol which does not require any routing tables to send the packets to the destination. It can be used in any device in ZigBee, such as router and end device. However, the autorouting protocol has the problem that the packets follow the tree topology to the destination even if the destination is located nearby, and if the destination is a preempted node, a reduplicate path is induced. So, we propose a crosscut hierarchical routing scheme to reduce the routing cost of the autorouting algorithm by using the neighbor table that is originally defined in the ZigBee standard. The crosscut hierarchical has a nice character that it is adapted to ZigBee. Simulation results show that the crosscut hierarchical routing algorithm saves more than 20 percent of the hop count compared with the ZigBee hierarchical routing.

articleTitle: The preliminary study of small wind turbines applied to installation on the roof with deflectors — A case study of factory buildings
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In the condition of current power shortage, how to use the renewable energy effectively has become a very important issue for the present. This research aims to discuss the combination of small wind turbines and architectures. Owing to the turbulent flow on the roof wind turbines which need steady flow to run have no real benefit in generating power. Therefore, the research simulates the flow field on the roof with the Fluent 6.3, and analyzes the flow field after the installation of a deflector on the roof. By the deflector stabling the chaotic flow field afterward, small wind turbines with boards in different length are installed on deflectors with different angles, in order to simulate the best benefit of power generation. According to the simulation results of annual power generation, a deflector generates most power in the angle of 10. The results can serve as the material of future wind turbines installation on buildings.

articleTitle: B cell epitope determination of chicken IBDV VP3 protein by overlap peptide scanning technique
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: To investigate B cell epitopes on the VP3 of infectious bursal disease virus (IBDV), the VP3 gene of IBDV were subcloned into the pET28a vector to construct expression vector of pETVP3. The recombinant VP3 (rVP3) was expressed in E. coli BL21(DE3) by inducing with IPTG. The expressed VP3 protein was recognized specifically by anti-IBDV antisera in western blot assays. According to antigenic structure of IBDV VP3, overlapping peptides which cover the full sequence of VP3 were synthesized and Conjugated to carrier Protein BSA to prepare conjugated antigens. Their reactivities with anti-IBDV monoclonal antibodies (MAb) or polyclonal antibody were detected by peptide-ELISA and Dot-ELISA The results showed that there were 2 linear epitopes recognized by neutralizing Mabs on the VP3, 728PRDWDRLPYLNL739 and 982PKPKPKPNAPTQ993, which can also react with IBDV antiserum. Dot-ELISA confirmed that there were still 4 linear epitopes recognized by polyclonal antibody on the VP3, 818LANAPQAGSKSQRA831, 851QREKDTRISKK METMGIYFATP872, 876ALNGHRGPSPGQLKYWQN TREI897 and 961QMKDLLLTAMEMK973. It is helpful for the developmentof IBD epitope vaccine.

articleTitle: Non-destructive testing numerical simulation of anchor system based on dynamic response
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Numerical simulation is used widely in the field of geotechnical engineering, the paper used finite difference software FLAC3D to numerical simulate status of anchorage system, according to setting different material parameters grouting to simulate different defect in the anchor system. Numerical simulation of anchorage system in the case of characteristic frequency and typical vibration loading are carried out, it was found that the stress wave decaying with the excitation frequency and the vibration loading increases when the stress wave spread in the process of anchoring system.

articleTitle: Analysis of aerodynamic characteristic on cylinder exhaust of pneumatic frictional clutch
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The pneumatic frictional clutch is one of chief devices on the mechanical processing apparatus, thus its aerodynamic characteristic during normally working and the compressed air exhausting is discussed. Considering the effect of the back-moving spring in the cylinder on exhausting, and four cases of sonic or subsonic exhaust with constant volume or varying volume, the mathematical model and numerical simulation program is presented. The results of the verified experiment carrying on the experimental platform of the mechanical press of type JH23-63 shows that the analytical results is in a good agreement with the experimental results, with the maximum and average of relative error less than 10.1% and 4.9%, respectively. The increase of the speed and maximal speed at the nozzle as well as the exhaust time vary with the increase of the initial pressure in a cylinder. Below the given error range, the aerodynamic characteristic such as the pressure fluctuation, speed at the nozzle and exhaust time can be easily analyzed by using the presented mathematical model and numerical simulation program.

articleTitle: Fabrication of dumbbell shape microstructures by hot embossing through microporous mould
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The effect of using hot embossing to fabricate the microstructures through microporous mould is investigated. An ultrasonic welding machine is used to study the characteristics of polymer under ultrasonic vibration. The sandwich placement of polymer slices and mould lead to the dumbbell shape microstructures. The stainless steel moulds with different diameter micropores are used. Different welding time are attempted to discover the micro flow and conjugation behavior of PE (Polyethylene) and PC (Polycarbonate) in micropores of the mould. The varied shapes of microstructures get from the different diameter micropores indicate the capillarity plays a role during the welding process.

articleTitle: Soccer robot based on ant colony method of obstacle avoidance
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: A new method of path planning approach to moving robot 2 soccer in dynamic environment based on ant colony algorithm is presented in this paper. For the path planning, a method of adaptive refresh strategy is used to plan the best path, two simplified and perfect probability function and fusion function are derived for the adaptive refresh to optimize the path of obstacle 2 avoiding for Robot 2 soccer. The results of simulated experiment show that the method is effective in the path planning for Robot 2 soccer under the condition of meeting obstacles.

articleTitle: Simulation platform repository of three-dimensional entity database design and development
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The collaborative simulation platform, the establishment of the repository development of the whole system is essential. Especially in the visual simulation, in order to effectively utilize and manage the various configuration files and three-dimensional solid model, composed of model components and their texture, the need for a database management system to manage these models or components. This paper proposes the development of open Visual Studio under the three-dimensional model (component) method of database management software systems to create a model library of the database structure. To Microsoft SQL Server 2008 database support system, the use of Deep View Open Flight API with ADO API in Visual Studio 2008 under the development and application of that effective management of the system using three-dimensional solid model.

articleTitle: Biotechnology for odor control from sewage treatment plants
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The odor generated from sewage treatment plants can cause nuisance to adjacent residents and contribute significantly to atmospheric pollution. Sources of odor from sewage treatment plants include wastewater collection system, wastewater treatment system and sludge handling system. Most of the odor generated are sulfur-based compounds, nitrogen-based compounds and volatile organic compounds including sulfide hydrogen, methyl mercaptan, dimethyl sulfide, ammonia, trimethyl amine, acetic acid and butyric acid. Compared with conventional physical-chemical technologies, biological technologies, such as biofilters, bioscrubbers and biotrickling filters, have been widely applied in sewage treatment plants for odor control owing to their efficiency, cost-effectiveness and environmental acceptability. The operational stability of conventional bioreactors is often hampered by acidification of the packing materials and reduction of removal efficiency. Besides, it is difficulty to remove all odorous compounds with different characteristics effectively at the same time by conventional bioreactors. To overcome these problems, new technologies such as low-pH bioreactor, two-stage bioreactor and combined-bioreactor have been developed.

articleTitle: Numerical analysis on the mechanism with CFS rammed expanded piles by particle flow code
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Numerical modeling of soil-pile interaction under vertical loading was performed by Particle Flow Code in two dimensions. The numerical simulations show that the change of the soil particle and porosity in which the composite foundation with rammed expanded piles under the different vertical loading, and interpret the pile-soil mechanism that is quantitative analysis. The phenomena and corresponding mechanisms obtained from numerical tests benefit design and implementation of physical model tests.

articleTitle: On the quick construction of all edge-balance index sets of the graph Cn × P5
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper, the edge-balance index sets of the graph C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</sub> × P<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sub> (n ≥ 3) are researched, and graphical construction method of the corresponding graph is given.

articleTitle: The simulation towards a robust wireless sensor network for the environment control
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The wireless sensor network has promising future in the environment monitoring, such as river flood watching, ice storm watching, mine flood watch, forest fire watching. The wireless sensor network can observe the parameter such as the temperature, humidity for both underground and aboveground mine. During our experiment of the wireless sensor network in the river of Ontario, we gained a series experience of the implementation, such as sensor nodes' energy control, dormancy/ awaken, node positioning and network overlaying. We have transmitted the live data to the center of monitor laboratory successfully. The purpose of this application is to monitor the weather, and control the water damage; as such, the network reliability and link robustness is the utmost concern. We have proposed to use a mobile jammer probe to test the network breaking down point and safety margin. In order to find out the proper jamming power and proper test spot and distance, we used simulation tool to provide a baseline reference for the field trial.

articleTitle: Disaster prevention of rockfall hazard risk at Laiyi Village, Pingtung County, Taiwan
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In recent years, the world due to the impact of global warming, around the world have the case of extreme type of climate also led to mix the rainy season. Slope of the incidence of rockfall hazard was higher effect on the increasing rainfall duration and its intensity. Taiwan is located on the Pacific, and the young fragile geology, typhoon hit higher probability because the climatic characteristics of this island. Slope rockfall hazard not only harmful to people's safety but also devastating for the crop damage. The Laiyi Village suffered a considerable extent in Morakot typhoon calamity on 2009 and the river and slope near The Laiyi Village were getting serious disaster in Fanapi typhoon calamity on 2010. Under the influence of the super typhoon, the village's tourism and farming industries suffered severe shock. Due to the extreme rainfall by climate changes, looking many ways for reducing the damage caused by the slope disasters, increasing the safety of local residents and the local economy will be recovery rapidly. Rockfall disaster of slope was the most direct threat to the safety of life. So, if we estimate the path of falling rock stone for the various physical processes and in accordance with the investigations of river channel, we can proposed an effective way to control dangerous slope in the future. This paper is exploring the hydrological and geomorphologic factors, local capacity and analysis of physical and chemical properties for the sediment gradation of river bed by soil samples at the river channel and the resistance for landslide near collapse in the region to conduct field surveys, combined with the Colorado Rockfall Simulation Program(CRSP) to find out the countermeasurements for the hillslope engineering.

articleTitle: The design and calculation of the mooring system of saucer-like Wave Energy Convertor
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Saucer-like Wave Energy Convertor is an offshore wave energy convertor for collecting the overtopping waves and converting the water head into electric power. The mooring system of this new type ocean device is designed in the present paper. A new design plan of the mooring system called Chain Tension Leg is proposed and calculated by AQWA, which has confirmed that the design plan is suitable for this device.

articleTitle: Synthesis of trimethylolpropane trioleate and their emulsification-resistive properties
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Trimethylolpropane trioleate was synthesized by oleic acid and trimethylolpropane as the raw material, SnCl<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>·2H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O as catalyst, toluene as watercarrying. The optimum reaction condition obtained through the experiments were found as follows: the molar ratio of OA to TMP was 3.1:1, the amount of SnCl<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>·2H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O was 2%, with toluene 2ml, reacted for 2h at temperature 170°C and vacuum degree 0.07Mpa. The results show that in the optimum conditions, the AE value of emulsification-resistive was 438.81, the ester value was 91.65%, the acid value was 2.41mgKOH/g, according with the standard of GB/T264. The structure of product was identified by IR.

articleTitle: The study of learning method of “communication principle”
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Communication principle course plays an important role in communication and electronics specialties. Because abstract concepts and mathematical derivation, the students believe it difficult to learn. According to rich experiences in teaching and counseling on communication principle and postgraduate entrance examination, this paper starts from basic features of communication principle combined with status of students, puts forward a solution to the communication principle problems in the learning process. The method is based on modeling, analog and case study, emphasizes on good study habits, mathematical reasoning and conclusions of law and skills, which fundamentally enhancing the learning interest of students on communication, simultaneously, making them out of complex mathematical derivation, and focusing on understanding the basic principles and concepts of communications from the system.

articleTitle: Variable structure neural network control
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: A variable structure neural network control (VSNNC) is proposed for a class of uncertain nonlinear SISO systems, in which neural network is used as an estimator for the system unknown nonlinear functions. And variable structure control strategy is improved by adding the continuous function item to control input. It can adjust discontinuous item in control variable adaptively according to the distance between the state point and the sliding mode switching surface. The proposed control method can not only effectively restrain the chattering around the switching surface but also guarantee the dynamic performance and eliminate the static error. Finally, some results of simulation experiments indicate that the proposed control scheme is feasible.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Present situation analysis and development countermeasures of park green space in Changsha
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Present situation and developing prospects of mining under primary road
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: With the study of `mining under buildings, railways and water-bodies', this paper summarized the actual state of mining under primary road at home and abroad, introduced the damage to primary road which effected by mining underground, recommend the design formulas of damage to primary road and the protecting standard and protective measures of primary road which effected by mining underground. Aiming at the shortage of research on mining under primary road at home and abroad in current, this paper proposed the research directions of mining under primary road in the future deeply with the actual needs of the fabricating yard.

articleTitle: Research on the processing of fluorescence oil-film evolution image
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In order to extract global skin friction from the evolution image of fluorescence oil-film, the fluorescent oil film evolution equation is introduced. On the basis of this theory, the method for solving the global skin friction from the evolution image of fluorescence oil-film is derived from Horn & Schunk's optical flow technology and the variational method. By means of numerical simulation, the method is verified. Finally, through the study of the inclined impinging jet, the application prospect of the method in specific experiments is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Analysis of outrigger trusses in hybrid structure
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper is concerned with the analysis of outrigger trusses in hybrid structure on a background of project. Several types of outrigger trusses are applied in a hybrid tall building to enhance the stiffness of structure and to weaken the abrupt change of inner force in strengthened stories. Comparing the effects of small size outrigger trusses and large size outrigger trusses under frequent earthquake, a new concept of outrigger, mixed outrigger, is proposed to ease the conflicts. The results of analysis indicate that the mixed outrigger trusses have significant advantages and can be utilized in hybrid tall buildings.

Author Keywords: abrupt change of shear and stiffness

articleTitle: Research on simplification of PERT network chart
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This article focused on the methods of simplification of PERT network chart without changing the logical relationships inside the network itself. It proposed the characteristic viewpoints with the realization algorithm and instruction. It also proposed and demonstrated the correctness of a computational formula to calculate the time parameters of the equivalent task corresponding the probabilistic sub-network.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The barriers and countermeasures for energy conservation and emission reduction on tourism
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Model of performance evaluation to electronic resources of University Library Consortia based on rough set
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Electronic resource of university library is important academic resource. To realize the advantages of electronic resources and achieve a regional sharing of electronic resources, University Library Consortia has been established. A reasonable evaluation to performance of electronic resources is essential for promoting the utilization of university library electronic resources. Based on the method of rough set, a system of performance evaluation to electronic resource is set up, and performance of electronic resources is evaluated.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The relationship of strategic emerging industries development and government investment in China — International comparative horizon
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: The motivation of private enterprise overseas listing
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: With the increasing of the private enterprises overseas listing, the study of motivation of private enterprises overseas listing attracted widely attention. This paper proposes motivation hypothesis of private enterprise overseas listing; then use empirical research methods of collecting data, select variables, establish a Logit model. The Empirical results showed that Private enterprise overseas listing has significant financial motivation, Corporate Governance motivation, maximizing shareholder wealth motivation, Security and equal motivation motivation.

articleTitle: Research on behavior modeling framework for virtual soldier in urban battlefield
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In recent years, the development of military operations on urbanized terrain (MOUI) simulations has attracted the military departments. The virtual soldier's behavior modeling is a important technique in the military M&S realm, so its research is not only the requirement of military, but also of national defense of our country,. This artick firstly bring up the definition of virtiial soldier and its behavior modeling, then elaborate the need analysis of the virtual soldier's behavior modeling, finally give the virtual soldier's modeling framework.

articleTitle: Design of a multi-spots temperature monitoring and alarming system based a person computer
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper a multi-spots temperature monitoring and alarming system based on a person computer is designed. The system consists of a person computer as a host and a subsystem as a slave. The host can communicate with the slave by its serial port. The host can also control the slave and receive temperature value from it that can be displayed on the screen of the host. The host will alarm when the temperature value is beyond the user-defined two's complement alarm trigger values. The user program of the host is developed by Visual c++ 6.0. The slave consists of a microcontroller unit AT89S52, temperature sensors DS18B20, serial port electrical level converting circuit, alarm circuit, display circuit, power circuit and so on. The slave can receive temperature data from the sensors that can be displayed on its display and be sent to the host. The slave will also alarm when the temperature value is beyond the user-defined two's complement alarm trigger values. The system is simple, its cost is low and its operation is easy. Its accuracy and resolution is excellent.

articleTitle: The application of data mining technology on the enterprise' CRM
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Along with the development of the global economy, the importance of the CRM(customer relationship management) and information technology has been learned by more and more enterprises. With the rapid development of the data mining technology, its usage in the enterprise' CRM will be more in-depth. The enterprise can find potential new customers and keep good relationships with old customers with the help of the advanced data mining technology. This paper lists the category of enterprise' customer, classfies them by their value to the enterprise, and builds the model of ID3 algorithm to find the most valuble customer of the enterprise. This will attain the intellectual need in the CRM interactive process, help the enterprise understand the behavior of the customers to a fuller extent, and improve the core competitiveness of the enterprise.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The application of Project Controlling in large project governance: With Hongqiao Transportation Hub project for example
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Design and simulation of wireless environment monitor based on Proteus
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The design of wireless environment monitor based on the AVR single-chip microcontroller and equipped with peripheral of nRF24L01, DS18B20K, DS1302 and LCD12864 chips is presented. Hardware circuit and main program flow are given in detail. The results of function simulation with the Proteus and ICCAVR have proved this design realized real-time monitoring of the environment parameters such as temperature, illuminance and so on.

articleTitle: The optimal density of heterogeneous sensor network in coverage condition
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The authors of the paper build a heterogeneous surveillance sensor network concerning the relay transmissions of the sensor network nodes among and within the clusters, based on which a binary work node is built to ensure balanced energy consumption of the network. An analysis is also made on the service life of the network in bin-packing conditions, following which an optimal solution is found to the node distribution in light of the service life constraint of the network. The solution determines the factors affecting the service life of the network which are practically significant to finding effective energy saving plans and prolonging the service life of wireless sensor networks.

articleTitle: Design of frequency controlled bi-directional converter using improved delta modulation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper presents a bi-directional converter using improved delta modulation (IDM), it has a simple structure, a minimum number of components. The non-isolated buck-boost DC / DC converter use IDM controller can achieve zero voltage switching (ZVS) and fast response. In light load condition, it will limit the switching frequency, reduce switching loss of the converter. finally, the operation principle of the proposed converter is described and verified by experimental result.

articleTitle: Iterative learning control scheme for linear time-varying discrete system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: An iterative learning algorithm was presented for a linear time-varying discrete system in the paper and a necessary and sufficient condition for the existence of convergent algorithm was proved. Then, we proved that the same condition is sufficient for the robustness of the proposed learning algorithm against state disturbance, output measurement noise, and initialization error. Lastly, a simulation example was given to illustrate the results.

articleTitle: The axonometric projection in teaching practice
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Because of the explicit, the axonometric projection is useful in engineering. But in the published books of mechanical drawing, only the characteristic and the drawing steps of the axonometric projection are focused on, and the forming method and the expression of the unapparent edges of object are not mentioned. This paper analyses the forming method by 3D graphic projective transformation in CG, as well as the unarmed draft of the object. The characteristics of generality about axonometric projection are presented, and the expression of the unapparent edges of object is discussed. These can take supplement to the theory of the axonometric projection.

articleTitle: Modeling and its simulation of AD603 based on PSpice software
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: PSpice is one of the most extensive simulation software for current analogy circuit, and it can't be used in circuit simulation for new integrate circuit (IC) or without current model in PSpice model library. PSpice modeling method is detailed and the model for variable gain amplifier AD603 is founded as an example, a series of simulation is conducted for the designed model. The simulations prove that the designed PSpice model is precise and can be used in circuit simulation.

articleTitle: Design of inquiry-based learning model based on the theory of situated cognition in SecondLife
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This article based on the theory of situated cognition, combined with the characteristics of SecondLife virtual environment and inquiry-based learning to explore the learning model, and believe that the environment based on SecondLife is fit for students to do the inquiry-based learning initiatively and actively.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Based on the concept of Service-Learning, on constructing the mechanism of intellectual fostering in Educational Technology
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: The strategy research on the control of electric vehicle hybrid permanent magnet brushless motor
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: A new hybrid permanent magnet motor combining permanent magnet with excitation windings is tested, which can weaken or strengthen the magnet flux control by adjusting the field winding current. In this paper, by analyzing regulation principle of the magnetic field and control theory obtained with both advantages of the permanent magnet DC machines and easy to get magnetic flux control, successfully solved the weakening speed permanent magnet motor problem. Experiments show that can significantly improve the operating performance of the motor and meet the electric vehicle drive in the start, climbing, acceleration, driving the need for different working conditions.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: A landscape influenced by Tourism: The transformation of Northern Yang-zhou suburb (1689–1795)
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Anti-swing and position control for bridge cranes by BVP arithmetic
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The anti-swing problem of the bridge cranes is discussed, and the anti-swing and position control strategy based on BVP arithmetic is presented. The anti-swing and position control programming of bridge cranes can be transformed into the two-point boundary value problem (BVP) of nonlinear systems. According to the boundary conditions of the anti-swing and position process, the tractive force function of Fouries series form with free parameters is constructed. The BVP is solved with the bvp4c function in Matlab toolbox, and the tractive force sequence is obtained. The anti-swing and position control process of bridge cranes belongs to open-loop feedforward control essentially. The simulation of anti-swing and position control process illustrates the effectivity of the control strategy.

articleTitle: Motion trajectory planning of picking robot for eggplant
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In order to realize accuracy control, a trajectory planning algorithm is designed for the 4 DOF articulated eggplant-picking robot. The structure selection of the robot is made according to the eggplant's growth circumstance and distribution space. The robot kinematics model is established with D-H method and the forward kinematics solution for the robot is obtained. The inverse kinematics solution is solved by using the simplified inverse transformation method The method of using triple polynomial in joint space is adopted to plan the motion trajectory of the 4-DOF picking robot for eggplant. The repeat location accuracy is ±2.5 mm according to repetitious test. The experiments on the complete machine show the robot with 4 DOF worked stably and credibly, meet the demand of the picking.

articleTitle: Thinking and survey on information technology application of special education teachers
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Investigation theme of this paper is "special school teachers in the application of information technology", a series of comprehensive practical investigation is given for special education school teachers of different regions, type, forms. We hope understand the application situation of information technology in special education teaching by this survey, and propose some measures to improve, some practical basis and decision-making is proposed for development of modern special education information further.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The investigation and thinking about the effects of Network Youth Subcultures on college students
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Research on cryptosystem with low-power consumption
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In the field of information security, one of the most important topic is how to construct cryptosystem. In this paper, firstly we propose definition of cryptosystem with low-power consumption. Then, methods to construct symmetric and asymmetric cryptosystem with low-power consumption are given. Finally, we discuss how to design component element of cryptosystem with low-power consumption.

articleTitle: Research on calculation method of retaining structure with double-row pile
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: As one of the optimum design of enclosure structures for deep excavation, the double-row pile has advantages of large lateral stiffness, no support and small footprint. But more studies should be done on how it works practically. the paper summarizes the currently used model, analyses and compares of their characteristics. Using a typical example, verifies the advantages and disadvantages of flexible calculation method, and directs the future study of double-row pile.

articleTitle: Research on the basic properties of recycled ceramic aggregate
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The difference between recycled ceramic aggregate concrete (RCAC) and natural aggregate concrete lies in the application of recycled ceramic aggregate (RCA) in the production of concrete. Therefore research on the characteristic of RCA to improve the quality of RCAC is very important. Testing results of physical performance of recycled ceramic coarse aggregate (RCCA) show that the size of RCA is suitable to control in 5~25mm. The porosity and water absorption of RCA are higher than those of natural coarse aggregate (NCA). At the same time, the apparent density, bulk density, close density, water absorption rate and crush index of RCA is lower than that of NCA. The scanning electron microscope (SEM) experiment of RCA demonstrates that ceramic with non-glazed surface has the obvious hole, but the natural aggregate is opposite.

articleTitle: The application of precision surveying for ancient architecture protection
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: To achieve the protection of ancient buildings, it used the modern surveying technology and advanced equipment including Johanna T-602 total station and PD30 Rangefinder to site survey ancient architecture in Longyou County, Zhejiang Province. It surveyed the ancient architecture undamaged from plane, profile and facade in the unified plane controlling network and vertical control network, then, it analyzed the surveying error. From analyzing the process of surveying ancient architecture, it concluded that mean error may evaluate accuracy class of surveying and achieve the effective protection to the ancient architecture. The methods could provide references for other ancient architecture.

articleTitle: Moving object tracking system based on camshift and Kalman filter
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: To accomplish real-time tracking of moving objects requirements, and overcome the defect of occlusion in the process of tracking moving object, this paper presents a set of real-time tracking system. The tracking system uses a combination of camshift and kalman filter algorithm. When the moving object is a large area blocked, the velocity of moving object is applied linear prediction to kalman filter tracking. When the camera moves, we can quickly find the target in this tracking system. The experimental results show that : this system designed for tracking moving targets has good robustness.

articleTitle: Obstacle avoidance in mobile robot using Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Investigate mobile robot's history, obstacle avoidance is one of most important research area and also the foundation of building robot's successful behaviors. This paper proposes a Neural Network control system that is able to guide the mobile robots (AmigoBot and P3DX) traverse through a maze with arbitrary obstacles. The pattern is trained by using Matlab toolbox and Aria library for motion control. There are 256 specific patterns defined to help robot organize the situation. For input data, sonar and laser range finder are two main sensors for passing on information of environment. The empirical results show the effectiveness and the validity of the obstacle avoidance behavior of Neural Network control strategy.

articleTitle: Car license plate detection based on MSER
